LOC_BELIEF_SCRIPTURE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 邻近城市的宗教传播的压力增加25%。[NEWLINE]一旦研发出印刷术，增加到50%。

LOC_BELIEF_STEWARDSHIP_EXPANSION2_DESCRI.en_US: +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science or +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each Campus or Commercial Hub district respectively for each city following this Religion.
LOC_BELIEF_STEWARDSHIP_EXPANSION2_DESCRI.zh_Hans_CN: 信仰此宗教的每座城市的每座学院或商业中心相应提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值或 +1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

LOC_BELIEF_STUPA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows construction of Stupas (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity).
LOC_BELIEF_STUPA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许修建窣堵波（+3 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度）。

LOC_BELIEF_SYNAGOGUE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许建造犹太教堂（+5 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值）。

LOC_BELIEF_TITHE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each city following the Religion.
LOC_BELIEF_TITHE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 信奉宗教的每个城市+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

LOC_BELIEF_WARRIOR_MONKS_EXPANSION2_DESC.en_US: Allows spending [ICON_FAITH] Faith to train Warriors Monks (A land combat unit) and Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Holy Site.
LOC_BELIEF_WARRIOR_MONKS_EXPANSION2_DESC.zh_Hans_CN: 允许花费 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值来生产陆地战斗单位“武僧”。建成圣地后对相邻单元格施放文化炸弹。

LOC_BELIEF_WAT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows construction of Wats (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +2 [ICON_Science] Science).
LOC_BELIEF_WAT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许建造佛寺（+3 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值）。

LOC_BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP.en_US: Holy Site district’s [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Production] Production as well.
LOC_BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 圣地区域的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值相邻加成也提供 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_BELIEF_WORLD_CHURCH_EXPANSION2_DESCR.en_US: +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every 4 followers of this Religion.
LOC_BELIEF_WORLD_CHURCH_EXPANSION2_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 该宗教每有4个信徒则+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

LOC_BELIEF_ZEN_MEDITATION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity in cities with 2 specialty districts.
LOC_BELIEF_ZEN_MEDITATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有2个特色区域的城市+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_ARCHERY.en_US: Kill a unit with a Slinger.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_ASTRONOMY.en_US: Build a University adjacent to a Mountain.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_ASTRONOMY.zh_Hans_CN: 在邻近山岳的地方建造1所大学。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BALLISTICS.en_US: Have 2 Forts in your territory. Both constructed by a Military Engineer.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BALLISTICS.zh_Hans_CN: 使用军事工程师在领土中建设2座堡垒。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BUTTRESS.en_US: Build a Classical era or later wonder
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BUTTRESS.zh_Hans_CN: 建造1个古典时代或以后的奇观。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CASTLES.en_US: Have a government with 6 policy slots.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CASTLES.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有带有6个政策槽位的政体。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CHEMISTRY.zh_Hans_CN: 与一个文明完成一次研究协议。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CIVIL_ENGINEERING.zh_Hans_CN: 建造7个不同的特色区域。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CIVIL_SERVICE.zh_Hans_CN: 一个城市的人口增长到10。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_COMBINED_ARMS.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有3支军队或无敌舰队

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_COMPUTERS.en_US: Have a government with 8 policy slots.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_COMPUTERS.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有带有8个政策槽位的政体。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CONSERVATION.en_US: Have a Neighborhood district with Breathtaking Appeal.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_DEFENSIVE_TACTICS.en_US: Be the target of a Declaration of War.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_DIPLOMATIC_SERVICE.en_US: Have an alliance with another civilization.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_DIPLOMATIC_SERVICE.zh_Hans_CN: 与另一个文明国家结盟。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_EARLY_EMPIRE.en_US: Grow your civilization to at least 6 population.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_FLIGHT.en_US: Build an Industrial era or later wonder.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_FLIGHT.zh_Hans_CN: 建造1个工业时代或以后的奇观。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ADVANCED_BALL.en_US: Development of new power plants has spurred on industrial advances that could help your armament production.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ADVANCED_BALL.zh_Hans_CN: 建造新的发电厂的发展带动了工业进步，这对您的武器生产很有帮助。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ADVANCED_FLIG.en_US: Your extensive experience with biplanes has led to several aeronautic breakthroughs.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ADVANCED_FLIG.zh_Hans_CN: 您在建造双翼机时获得的丰富经验能促进航空学的突破性进展。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_APPRENTICESHI.en_US: With raw materials now coming in from a wide variety of mines, the need to better teach new craftsmen to use them is essential.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_APPRENTICESHI.zh_Hans_CN: 现在的原材料来自各种各样的矿山，非常需要更好地指导工匠使用它们。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ARCHERY.en_US: After finally killing an enemy with a Slinger, you long for a stronger ranged weapon.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ARCHERY.zh_Hans_CN: 终于，您的投石兵杀死了一名敌人，您渴望一种更强大的远程武器。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ASTROLOGY.en_US: Discovering a natural wonder has inspired your people with the majesty of the universe.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ASTROLOGY.zh_Hans_CN: 自然奇观的发现以及宇宙万物的壮丽鼓舞了您的国民。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ASTRONOMY.en_US: Your scientists are hiking into the mountains for a sharper view of the heavens. Maybe a permanent facility would help?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ASTRONOMY.zh_Hans_CN: 为了看清天空的样子，您的科学家正在山里徒步远行。[NEWLINE]或许，一种永久设施能帮助他们？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BALLISTICS.en_US: Your cities have been protected by multiple fortifications, what if they could be defended by cannons?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BALLISTICS.zh_Hans_CN: 多项防御工事正在保护您的城市，如果用来防御大炮的话，效果会怎样？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BANKING.en_US: Your emerging guilds have plans that require a large influx of gold. Perhaps we can find a way to let them take out a loan?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BANKING.zh_Hans_CN: 您的新产业有着各自的规划，但是他们也需要大量的金币。也许，我们可以找到一种方法让他们获得贷款。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BRONZE_WORKIN.en_US: Your fights with Barbarians highlight the need for stronger weaponry.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BRONZE_WORKIN.zh_Hans_CN: 和蛮族的战争让你渴望更强大的武器。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BUTTRESS.en_US: Now that you have finished a wonder of the classical world, what will your architects build next?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BUTTRESS.zh_Hans_CN: 您完成了一座古典时代的奇观，建筑师们在未来还会建起什么呢?

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CAPITALISM.en_US: With stock exchanges springing up in several cities, investment capital is plentiful and a market economy is ready to emerge.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CAPITALISM.zh_Hans_CN: 随着证券交易所在数个城市涌现，投资资本充足，市场经济已经整装待发。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CARTOGRAPHY.en_US: With so many ships leaving the harbors of your empire you long to document your explorations.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CARTOGRAPHY.zh_Hans_CN: 已经有这么多的船只从您的港口扬帆起航，您也开始渴望将您的伟大探险记录下来。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CASTLES.en_US: Our new government’s defense minister suggests that we might want to build impressive defenses to protect our bustling capital.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CASTLES.zh_Hans_CN: 我们新政府的国防部长建议我们建立更牢靠的防御来保护我们繁华的首都。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CELESTIAL_NAV.en_US: Your fishermen are learning how to guide their travels based on studying the night sky.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CELESTIAL_NAV.zh_Hans_CN: 您的渔民正在学习如何才能通过观察夜晚的星空来确定航线。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CHEMISTRY.en_US: Joining forces with other nations has started a chain reaction of scientific advances.  Will the next push be in chemistry?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CHEMISTRY.zh_Hans_CN: 与其他国家进行合作已经在科学领域带来了一系列的连锁反应。下一个进展会出现在化学领域吗？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CIVIL_ENGINEE.en_US: Having constructed so many types of districts, your engineers have become skilled in city construction.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CIVIL_ENGINEE.zh_Hans_CN: 您的工程师已经建造了如此多不同类型的区域，他们对于城市建造的技术已经炉火纯青了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CIVIL_SERVICE.en_US: Your large urban center will soon require a corps of bureaucrats.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CIVIL_SERVICE.zh_Hans_CN: 您的大型市中心很快会需要一群官员。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CLASS_STRUGGL.en_US: Your factory workers clamor for better working conditions. It is time for the workers of the world to unite!
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CLASS_STRUGGL.zh_Hans_CN: 您的工厂工人要求改善工作条件。是时候让全世界的工人团结起来了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COLD_WAR.en_US: The advent of nuclear weaponry will surely change the nature of armed conflict across the globe.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COLD_WAR.zh_Hans_CN: 核武器的出现必将改变全球范围内所有武装冲突的本质。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COLONIALISM.en_US: Your new knowledge of the heavens is helping your navy navigate and establish a global empire.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COLONIALISM.zh_Hans_CN: 关于天空的知识能为您的海军导航，也能够帮助您建立起全球性帝国。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMBINED_ARMS.en_US: Now that your military has expanded could it be further enhanced with a new resource?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMBINED_ARMS.zh_Hans_CN: 既然您的军事实力已经得到提升，何不用一种新资源来让它如虎添翼？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMBUSTION.en_US: Your archaeologist has noticed petroleum seeping out of the rocks. Perhaps your geologists would like to take a look?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMBUSTION.zh_Hans_CN: 您的考古学家已注意到了从岩石里渗透出的石油。也许您的地质学家会想去一探究竟。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMPOSITES.en_US: Tanks have been the backbone of your army so your scientists are striving for a more advanced model.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMPOSITES.zh_Hans_CN: 坦克是您军队的支柱，所以您的科学家正在努力研发一种更高级的型号。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMPUTERS.en_US: A modern government comes with a lot of bureaucracy. Developing ways to efficiently track data will be a huge help.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMPUTERS.zh_Hans_CN: 现代政府带有浓重的官僚作风。扩展途径去有效追踪数据将有很大帮助。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CONSERVATION.en_US: The residents of your breathtaking new neighborhood clamor for a plan to conserve all the world’s natural treasures.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CONSERVATION.zh_Hans_CN: 您那惊艳的新社区居民要求实行一项保护世界自然宝藏的计划。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CONSTRUCTION.en_US: Work on the Water Mill has taught your workers much about construction practices.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CONSTRUCTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在水磨工作让工人了解了很多关于工程建筑的知识。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CORPORATE_LIB.en_US: Developing a critical defense resource leads to a new relationship between business and government.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CORPORATE_LIB.zh_Hans_CN: 随着重要防御资源完成开发，政府和商界之间的一种新关系便凸显出来。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CRAFTSMANSHIP.en_US: With the land around our first city developing nicely, we can fine tune our production techniques.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CRAFTSMANSHIP.zh_Hans_CN: 我们第一座城市周围的土地得到了很好的开发，我们已经能够很好的调整我们的生产工艺了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CULTURAL_HERI.en_US: With a perfectly curated museum, your people's strong cultural heritage is on exhibit for all to see.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CULTURAL_HERI.zh_Hans_CN: 有了完美的策展式博物馆，您国民强大的文化遗产会展示在大家面前。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CURRENCY.en_US: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route directly exchanges goods, but a medium of exchange would make trade more flexible.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CURRENCY.zh_Hans_CN: 您的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线能直接交换货物，但交换媒介能让贸易更加灵活。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DEFENSIVE_TAC.en_US: Faced with the threat of invasion, your people are ready to come up with innovative defenses.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DEFENSIVE_TAC.zh_Hans_CN: 面对入侵威胁，您的国民已准备好了一种新型防御措施。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DIGITAL_DEMOC.en_US: You finish signing the contract with the rock band. “Whatever,” they say, but you see how excited they are to start the tour.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DIGITAL_DEMOC.zh_Hans_CN: 您与一支摇滚乐队签下了合约。尽管他们嘴上说着“爱咋咋地”，但对于巡演的兴奋之情却溢于言表。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DIPLOMATIC_SE.en_US: The legwork to build an alliance has trained up your first corps of diplomats.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DIPLOMATIC_SE.zh_Hans_CN: 建立联盟的外勤工作已为您培养了第一支外交官团队。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DIVINE_RIGHT.en_US: Your devout people believe strongly that your rule is a blessing from the divine.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DIVINE_RIGHT.zh_Hans_CN: 您虔诚国民的信仰如此坚定，以致于让您的统治得到了神的祝福。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DRAMA_POETRY.en_US: The glory of completing a wonder has energized your people. They are writing works to commemorate this great event.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_DRAMA_POETRY.zh_Hans_CN: 建造一个奇观的荣耀感让您的国民倍感激励。他们写了著作来纪念这一伟大事件。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EARLY_EMPIRE.en_US: The growing number of citizens in your lands dream of having an empire.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EARLY_EMPIRE.zh_Hans_CN: 您土地上有越来越多的公民梦想着建立一个帝国。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ECONOMICS.en_US: The power of your banks in on the rise.  It is time to formally study the forces that are shaping your national economy.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ECONOMICS.zh_Hans_CN: 银行的影响力不断增加。是时候正式研究那些塑造您国家经济的驱动力了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EDUCATION.en_US: The teachings from your Great Scientist have inspired a renewed interest in learning in your realm.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EDUCATION.zh_Hans_CN: 大科学家在您的王国里激发了新一轮学习热情。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ELECTRICITY.en_US: Your crafty privateers are intrigued by the discovery of electric current. Could they use this to create stealthy propulsion?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ELECTRICITY.zh_Hans_CN: 您那些狡猾的私掠船长对最近发现的电流感到着迷。他们能使用电流来创造隐形推动力吗？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ENGINEERING.en_US: Completing walls around your city demonstrated the principles of engineering needed for Aqueducts and Catapults.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ENGINEERING.zh_Hans_CN: 城市周围城墙的竣工论证了水渠和石弩所需的工程原理。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ENVIRONMENTAL.en_US: Your people prove that solar power is more than an idea—it is potentially the future of power production.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ENVIRONMENTAL.zh_Hans_CN: 您的人民证明了太阳能不仅仅是一个概念，它很可能就是电力生产的未来。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EXPLORATION.en_US: The lessons you have learned from Caravel exploration have led to a new way of governing your people.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EXPLORATION.zh_Hans_CN: 您从轻快帆船的探索中学到的经验教训催生了管理国民的新方式。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FEUDALISM.en_US: A system of lords and vassals is forming to manage all the farmlands of your empire.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FEUDALISM.zh_Hans_CN: 您国土内的所有农田都在被正在形成的领主和诸侯制度所管辖着。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FLIGHT.en_US: Having completed a modern wonder, our engineers are sure they can tackle anything. What, are they thinking of flying next?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FLIGHT.zh_Hans_CN: 完成了一个现代奇观，我们的工程师确信自己能够解决任何问题。什么，他们想飞起来？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FOREIGN_TRADE.en_US: Having discovered another continent we realize there is a wide world of trading opportunities.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FOREIGN_TRADE.zh_Hans_CN: 我们发现了一个新大陆，这个广阔的世界有很多的贸易机会。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GAMES_RECREAT.en_US: Your new skills in construction will surely help create venues for games and entertainment.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GAMES_RECREAT.zh_Hans_CN: 毫无疑问，您在建筑上的新技术对创建游戏和娱乐场所大有裨益。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GLOBALIZATION.en_US: With so many airports in place, the world is truly becoming a smaller place.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GLOBALIZATION.zh_Hans_CN: 有这么多机场，世界真的变得越来越小了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUIDANCE_SYST.en_US: Your military has defeated an enemy plane. Now it is time to have the best defense against enemy aircraft.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUIDANCE_SYST.zh_Hans_CN: 您的军队击败了一架敌机。是时候发展全面的对空防御了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUILDS.en_US: The success of your commercial districts has spurred the growth of trade guilds.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUILDS.zh_Hans_CN: 您商业区的成功促进了贸易行业的发展。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUNPOWDER.en_US: Your men at the armory are fashioning a new weapon that will devastate opponents.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUNPOWDER.zh_Hans_CN: 您在兵工厂里的人研制了一种能彻底摧毁敌人的新武器。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_HORSEBACK_RID.en_US: With animals now domesticated into Pastures, it is time to learn to ride.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_HORSEBACK_RID.zh_Hans_CN: 动物现在被驯养在牧场里，是时候学习骑乘它们了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_HUMANISM.en_US: The inspiration provided by your newly-acquired Great Artist is awakening our people to the power of the individual.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_HUMANISM.zh_Hans_CN: 您新获得的大艺术家带来的启示使我们的人民意识到了个体的力量。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_INDUSTRIALIZA.en_US: The busy workshops of your empire hint at greatness to come. Is an Industrial Revolution about to commence?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_INDUSTRIALIZA.zh_Hans_CN: 您的帝国繁忙的工作坊暗示着伟大时代的到来。这预示着工业革命就近在眼前吗？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_IRON_WORKING.en_US: Access to a steady source of Iron has enabled you to build better weapons and stronger armor.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_IRON_WORKING.zh_Hans_CN: 稳定的铁资源能让您铸造更好的武器和更强大的装甲。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_IRRIGATION.en_US: Farming a resource has given you an appreciation of the importance of irrigating your crops.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_IRRIGATION.zh_Hans_CN: 改良1种农产资源让您充分意识到灌溉作物的重要性。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_LASERS_XP2.en_US: With our Drones in the air, refining and focusing the light becomes increasingly important.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_LASERS_XP2.zh_Hans_CN: 无人机升空之后，改善并聚焦光线就变得越来越重要了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MACHINERY.en_US: You look to machinery to improve the performance of your sizable contingent of ranged troops.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MACHINERY.zh_Hans_CN: 您期望机械设备能提高您庞大的远程部队的战场表现。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASONRY.en_US: Quarrying a resource has given you the raw materials you need to employ masons.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASONRY.zh_Hans_CN: 开采1种资源为您提供了泥瓦匠需要的原材料。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASS_MEDIA.en_US: The advent of radio beckons the start of a new era of communication.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASS_MEDIA.zh_Hans_CN: 无线电的出现代表了通信新时代的开始。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASS_PRODUCTI.en_US: Now that you have a ready supply of standardized boards, your shipping industry will soon take off.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASS_PRODUCTI.zh_Hans_CN: 您已经准备好了标准板材的供应，您的海运业很快就能启动。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MATHEMATICS.en_US: Your district planners have worked out the basics of geometry. Maybe a full mathematical system will follow soon?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MATHEMATICS.zh_Hans_CN: 您的区域规划师研究出了几何基础知识。或许很快会出现一个完整的数学系统。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MEDIEVAL_FAIR.en_US: The increase of commerce through your lands will soon attract a trade fair.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MEDIEVAL_FAIR.zh_Hans_CN: 您领土上的贸易正在蓬勃发展，这将很快促使商品交易会的产生。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MERCANTILISM.en_US: Your new Great Merchant is sharing ideas on how we can get the edge on our economic competitors.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MERCANTILISM.zh_Hans_CN: 您新的大商人分享了如何在经济竞争中取得优势的观点。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MERCENARIES.en_US: With such a large standing army, you may want to consider adding mercenaries if your army needs to expand further.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MERCENARIES.zh_Hans_CN: 有这样庞大的常备军，如果您的军队需要进一步扩大的话，您可能需要考虑增加雇佣兵。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_METAL_CASTING.en_US: With so many Crossbowmen in the field, we’ve had a lot of practice studying ranged weapons.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_METAL_CASTING.zh_Hans_CN: 这片区域有很多弩手，我们已对远程武器的使用进行了大量研究和实践。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_ENGI.en_US: Your military leaders carefully followed the progress on your aqueduct. They see new ways to use these engineering skills.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_ENGI.zh_Hans_CN: 您的军事领导人很关注您的水渠的修建过程。他们找到了一些使用这些工程技能的新方法。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_SCIE.en_US: Your valiant Knight has vanquished his foe. Let us learn from this victory and become students of military affairs.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_SCIE.zh_Hans_CN: 您勇敢的骑士击败了他的敌人。让我们从这场胜利中得到学习，并成为军事学生吧。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TACT.en_US: Your spearmen are proving effective, but now your opponents are stronger and faster. Perhaps a longer weapon is needed?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TACT.zh_Hans_CN: 您的枪兵很厉害，但如今您的对手实力变强了，行动也更快了。您或许需要一个更长的武器？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TRAD.en_US: Your soldiers hope your victory over a Barbarian Outpost is the start of a long line of military successes.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TRAD.zh_Hans_CN: 您的士兵希望您对蛮族哨站所取得的胜利是一长串军事胜利的开始。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TRAI.en_US: With an Encampment now in place, we can formalize our military training.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TRAI.zh_Hans_CN: 随着一座军营的竣工，我们的军事训练可以更加规范。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MOBILIZATION.en_US: Your military is better organized. Now time to take your force to the world stage.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MOBILIZATION.zh_Hans_CN: 您的军队被安排得更具条理性。现在是时候让您的军队登上世界舞台啦。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MYSTICISM.en_US: Worship of your pantheon of gods has brought up further questions about spiritual forces in our world.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MYSTICISM.zh_Hans_CN: 对万神殿神明的崇拜引出关于精神力量更深层次的问题。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NANOTECHNOLOG.en_US: Having a diverse set of metals to experiment on will help your scientists push into new fields.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NANOTECHNOLOG.zh_Hans_CN: 各种不同的金属实验会帮助您的科学家对新领域进行研究。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NATIONALISM.en_US: Your people believe in the just nature of this war.  It has become an issue of national pride for us!
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NATIONALISM.zh_Hans_CN: 您的国民对战争的天然正义深信不疑。对我们而言，这是一个民族自豪感的问题。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NATURAL_HISTO.en_US: With a museum now ready to hold your findings, it is time to see what you can discover out in the natural world.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NATURAL_HISTO.zh_Hans_CN: 博物馆已经准备好收藏您的发现了，是时候来看看您在自然界可以发现什么了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NAVAL_TRADITI.en_US: Your victory at sea inspires your people to strive to become a naval power.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NAVAL_TRADITI.zh_Hans_CN: 您在海上取得的胜利激励您的人民努力让国家成为海上强国。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NEAR_FUTURE_G.en_US: Having adopted an advanced form of government, your people think of even further advances to civic life.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NEAR_FUTURE_G.zh_Hans_CN: 在您采用一个高级政体后，人民对市政生活有了更深邃的思考。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NUCLEAR_FUSIO.en_US: We've split the atom apart, now let's smash them together!
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NUCLEAR_FUSIO.zh_Hans_CN: 我们既然可以让原子分裂，那也可以让它们聚合起来！

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NUCLEAR_PROGR.en_US: With a dedicated research lab in place, your initiative to recruit scientists into a nuclear research program can commence.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NUCLEAR_PROGR.zh_Hans_CN: 随着专项研究实验室的竣工，您可以招募科学家进行核项目研究了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_OPERA_BALLET.en_US: The unveiling of a new museum is drawing people to the arts. Perhaps dance and opera are next?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_OPERA_BALLET.zh_Hans_CN: 新博物馆揭幕仪式引起人们对艺术的关注。接下来会是舞蹈和歌剧？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PLASTICS.en_US: Having a source of petrochemicals should lead to many advances. Its plasticity is of particular interest.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PLASTICS.zh_Hans_CN: 石油化工产品资源会带来很多进步。人们对它的可塑性特别感兴趣。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_POLITICAL_PHI.en_US: Your contact with other states has crystallized your ideas on governing your own people.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_POLITICAL_PHI.zh_Hans_CN: 和其他城邦的交流让您对如何管理国民有了更明确的看法。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PRINTING.en_US: Out of necessity your scholars are devising methods for quickly copying books.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PRINTING.zh_Hans_CN: 出于需要，您的学者正在设计新方法以便能更快速地复印书籍。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PROFESSIONAL_.en_US: Your 2 cities with Entertainment Complexes want to compete in a new professional sports league.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PROFESSIONAL_.zh_Hans_CN: 您旗下建有“娱乐设施”的2座城市希望参加新职业体育联盟的比赛。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RADIO.en_US: Your new national park needs visitors. Perhaps a new form of communications will help advertise it?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RADIO.zh_Hans_CN: 您的新国家公园需要游客。也许一种新的通信方式能帮它做宣传？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RAPID_DEPLOYM.en_US: With air bases now spanning the globe, our military is ready to be deployed anywhere in the world at a moment's notice.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RAPID_DEPLOYM.zh_Hans_CN: 如今空军基地横跨全球，我们的军队已随时做好准备在世界各地进行部署。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RECORDED_HIST.en_US: With plans to house many scrolls in the libraries of your campuses, your people begin to record the history of your empire.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RECORDED_HIST.zh_Hans_CN: 您的国民打算把更多卷轴放在您的学院图书馆里，他们开始记录帝国历史了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REFINING.en_US: Your nation is now powered. However your scientists are already hard at work on developing alternative energy sources.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REFINING.zh_Hans_CN: 文明现已供电充足。您的科学家仍在努力开发备用能源，以备不时之需。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REFORMED_CHUR.en_US: The growth of your Religion comes with the danger of schism. Reforming corrupt church practices better happen soon!
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REFORMED_CHUR.zh_Hans_CN: 您的宗教成长伴随着分裂的危险。最好早点开始改革腐败的教会。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REPLACEABLE_P.en_US: Your armament makers are tired of having to hand craft so many muskets.  Perhaps some standardization would help?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REPLACEABLE_P.zh_Hans_CN: 您的武器制造商已厌倦了手工制作数量如此庞大的步枪。或许建立标准化对此有帮助？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RIFLING.en_US: With a source of niter, your firearms industry is switching into top gear. The next step will be to improve our accuracy.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RIFLING.zh_Hans_CN: 硝石资源让您的兵器工业如火如荼地进行。下一步将提高精准度。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ROBOTICS.en_US: Having a diverse set of metals to experiment on will help your scientists push into new fields.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ROBOTICS.zh_Hans_CN: 各种不同的金属实验会帮助您的科学家对新领域进行研究。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SAILING.en_US: Gaining a city on the Coast has given your civilization insight into navigating the waves.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SAILING.zh_Hans_CN: 建立一座海滨城市让您的文明能深刻明白如何在海浪上航行。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SANITATION.en_US: With the introduction of neighborhoods, our cities are growing larger than ever before.  Developing a sanitation plan is crucial.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SANITATION.zh_Hans_CN: 引进社区后，我们的城市能比之前发展地更快。制订一项卫生计划至关重要。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SCIENTIFIC_TH.en_US: The dawning of an age of enlightenment in our realm has sparked a serious discourse on our scientific methods.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SCIENTIFIC_TH.zh_Hans_CN: 我们领土上启蒙时代的曙光引发了对科学方法的严肃讨论。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SCORCHED_EART.en_US: Modern warfare is clearly a brutal affair.  Your military doctrine is starting to reflect some of these principles of total war.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SCORCHED_EART.zh_Hans_CN: 现代战争显然是一件很残酷的事。您的军事政策开始反映出全面战争的部分原则。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SHIPBUILDING.en_US: Constructing a squadron of Galleys has taught you much about building larger ships.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SHIPBUILDING.zh_Hans_CN: 建造一队桨帆船教会了您很多关于建造大型船只的知识。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SIEGE_TACTICS.en_US: After creating bombards you realize that castles are not impregnable – you need a stauncher defense!.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SIEGE_TACTICS.zh_Hans_CN: 在射石炮出现后，您意识到城堡并非固若金汤——您需要更坚固的防御措施！

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SOCIAL_MEDIA.en_US: Your advances in communications technology are allowing people to congregate online.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SOCIAL_MEDIA.zh_Hans_CN: 通信科技的进步让人们可以聚集在网络上。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SPACE_RACE.en_US: The unveiling of your new Spaceport has energized your people to push into space.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SPACE_RACE.zh_Hans_CN: 您的新宇航中心揭幕仪式鼓励了您的人民进入太空。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SQUARE_RIGGIN.en_US: The success of your Musketmen on land has spurred a new idea: what if we upgrade to gunpowder weaponry at sea?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SQUARE_RIGGIN.zh_Hans_CN: 您的火枪手在陆地上取得的成功促使了一个新想法的产生：如果我们升级海上的火药武器，结果会怎样？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STATE_WORKFOR.en_US: Bringing our first district online has proven the value of conscripting workers for state projects.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STATE_WORKFOR.zh_Hans_CN: 首个区域的建立，证明了国家项目征召工人的价值。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STEAM_POWER.en_US: Let us apply our industrial acumen to your newly-constructed shipyards. Steam-powered naval vessels could rule the seas.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STEAM_POWER.zh_Hans_CN: 让我们把工业智慧用在您新建的造船厂中。蒸汽驱动的海军舰艇可以统治海洋。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STEEL.en_US: Your coal-powered blast furnaces and test runs with an Ironclad should soon allow us to produce the finest-grade steel.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STEEL.zh_Hans_CN: 有了燃煤高炉的冶炼和装甲舰的试用，我们很快便能生产出最优质的钢材。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STIRRUPS.en_US: The feudal lords in your realm want a champion to defend their lands. Perhaps mounting an armored warrior will do the trick?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STIRRUPS.zh_Hans_CN: 您王国内的封建领主想要一名英雄来捍卫他们的土地。或许让一位铠甲勇士上马就能达到理想效果。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SUFFRAGE.en_US: The women of your empire have clamored for proper sanitation. Having won that battle, they now need the right to vote.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SUFFRAGE.zh_Hans_CN: 您帝国内的女性要求拥有适当的卫生设施。在取得了那场战争的胜利后，她们现在要求有投票的权利。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SYNTHETIC_MAT.en_US: With facilities for aircrafts in multiple cities, your aeronautic industry is taking off.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SYNTHETIC_MAT.zh_Hans_CN: 很多城市都有了飞机相关设施，您的航空业开始发展了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SYNTHETIC_TEC.en_US: The elegant dance of robotic limbs under computer control inspires your engineers and scientists.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SYNTHETIC_TEC.zh_Hans_CN: 在电脑的控制下，机械手臂划出了优美的舞姿，同时也激励着您的工程师与科学家们。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_TELECOMMUNICA.en_US: With your pioneers in radio and television leading the way, you’ve grown adept at transmitting data quickly.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_TELECOMMUNICA.zh_Hans_CN: 您在无线电和电视方面是先驱，您越来越擅长快速传输数据。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THEOLOGY.en_US: The formation of a Religion by your Great Prophet inspires deeper thought on the nature of the divine.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THEOLOGY.zh_Hans_CN: 宗教的形成得益于您的大预言家，他们对于神的本质激发了更深层次的思考。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THE_ENLIGHTEN.en_US: The ideas from your great people have inspired intellectual discussion throughout the land.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THE_ENLIGHTEN.zh_Hans_CN: 您的伟人的观点引起了整个地区的集中讨论。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THE_WHEEL.en_US: Your mining operations have given you the ability to create an axle. Will the wheel follow?
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THE_WHEEL.zh_Hans_CN: 采矿业让您拥有了建造轮轴的能力。接下来是车轮？

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_TOTALITARIANI.en_US: The discipline instilled by your military academies is now second nature to your citizens.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_TOTALITARIANI.zh_Hans_CN: 您的军事院校灌输的纪律如今是您公民的第二天性。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_URBANIZATION.en_US: Your large city is getting overcrowded. It's time to start planning for some suburbs.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_URBANIZATION.zh_Hans_CN: 您的大城市变得越来越拥挤。是时候开始规划一些郊区了。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_WRITING.en_US: After meeting another civilization you see the need for new ways to communicate.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_WRITING.zh_Hans_CN: 在与另一个文明国家会晤后，您意识到了新的交流方式的必要性。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MATHEMATICS.zh_Hans_CN: 建造3个不同的特色区域。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MERCENARIES.en_US: Have 8 land combat units in your military.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MERCENARIES.zh_Hans_CN: 您的军队有8个陆地战斗单位。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MILITARY_SCIENCE.en_US: Kill a unit with a Knight.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MILITARY_TACTICS.en_US: Kill a unit with a Spearman.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MUST_STEAL.en_US: Boost through Great Scientist or Spy.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MUST_STEAL.zh_Hans_CN: 通过大科学家或间谍提升。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_NATIONALISM.en_US: Declare war using a casus belli.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_NAVAL_TRADITION.en_US: Kill a unit with a Quadrireme.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_NAVAL_TRADITION.zh_Hans_CN: 使用四段帆船击杀1个单位。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_NEAR_FUTURE_GOVERNANCE.en_US: Adopt a government with 10 inherent policy slots.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_NEAR_FUTURE_GOVERNANCE.zh_Hans_CN: 采用带有10个固定政策槽位的政体。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_RAPID_DEPLOYMENT.en_US: Build an Aerodrome or Airstrip on a foreign continent.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_RAPID_DEPLOYMENT.zh_Hans_CN: 在海外领土上建造1座航空港或1条飞机跑道。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_REFORMED_CHURCH.zh_Hans_CN: 使6座城市信奉您的宗教。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_SAILING.en_US: Found a city on the Coast.

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_SQUARE_RIGGING.en_US: Kill a unit with a Musketman.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_SQUARE_RIGGING.zh_Hans_CN: 使用火枪手击杀1个单位。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_STEEL.en_US: Build a Coal Mine and an Ironclad.
LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_STEEL.zh_Hans_CN: 建造1座煤矿、生产1艘装甲舰。

LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_URBANIZATION.zh_Hans_CN: 一座城市的人口增长到15。

LOC_BUILDING_AIRPORT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +50% combat experience for air units trained in this city. +2 air unit slots in Aerodrome district. Allows the ability to airlift land units between Aerodrome districts with Airports after the Rapid Deployment civic is unlocked.
LOC_BUILDING_AIRPORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 该城市训练的空中单位+50%战斗经验值。航空港+2空中单位槽位。紧急部署市政解锁后，可以在带有机场的航空港之间空运陆地单位。

LOC_BUILDING_ALHAMBRA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 Military policy slot[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides the same defensive bonuses as the Fort improvement. Must be built on Hills adjacent to an Encampment district.
LOC_BUILDING_ALHAMBRA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: +1 军事政策槽位[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]提供同堡垒改良设施一样的防御加成。必须建立在邻近军营区的丘陵上。

LOC_BUILDING_ALHAMBRA_QUOTE.en_US: “Everything here appears calculated to inspire kind and happy feelings, for everything is delicate and beautiful.”[NEWLINE]– Washington Irving
LOC_BUILDING_ALHAMBRA_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 这里的一切似乎都是为了激起友好快乐的感觉，因为一切都如此精致而美丽。[NEWLINE]——华盛顿·欧文

LOC_BUILDING_AQUARIUM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Bonus [ICON_Amenities]  Amenity extends to each city center within 9 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 9 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science to each coastal resource, Shipwreck, and Reef tile in this city.
LOC_BUILDING_AQUARIUM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度加成延伸到9个单元格中的每个市中心。此加成1座城市仅能应用1次，因此市中心9个单元格以内相同的此建筑不会再额外提供加成。此城中的每处海岸资源、海难遗址和礁石单元格+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

LOC_BUILDING_AQUATICS_CENTER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Bonus [ICON_Amenities]  Amenities extend to each city center within 9 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 9 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +2 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism for each Wonder built in this city on or adjacent to a Coast tile.
LOC_BUILDING_AQUATICS_CENTER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度加成延伸到9个单元格中的每个市中心。此加成1座城市仅能应用1次，因此市中心9个单元格以内相同的此建筑不会再额外提供加成。此城中建在海岸单元格之上或周围的每座奇观+2 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。

LOC_BUILDING_ARENA_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Provides 1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.
LOC_BUILDING_ARENA_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有“保护地球”市政后提供1点 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。

LOC_BUILDING_ARMORY_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI.en_US: +25% combat experience for all land units trained in this city.[NEWLINE]Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).
LOC_BUILDING_ARMORY_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 该城市中训练的所有陆地单位+25%战斗经验值。[NEWLINE]战略资源储备+10（标准速度下）。

LOC_BUILDING_BARRACKS_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP.en_US: +25% combat experience for all melee and ranged land units trained in this city.[NEWLINE]Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Stable.
LOC_BUILDING_BARRACKS_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 该城市中训练的所有近战和远程陆地单位+25%战斗经验值。[NEWLINE]战略资源储备+10（标准速度下）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]无法建造在已有马厩的军营区域中。

LOC_BUILDING_BIG_BEN_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT.en_US: +1 Economic policy slot[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Immediately after construction [ICON_GOLD] Gold in treasury is increased by 50%. Must be built next to a River adjacent to a Commercial Hub district with a Bank.
LOC_BUILDING_BIG_BEN_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: +1经济政策槽位[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造后，国库的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币立即增加50%。必须建在邻近带有银行的商业中心的河流旁边。

LOC_BUILDING_BIG_BEN_QUOTE.en_US: “Don’t watch the big clock; do what it does. Keep going.”[NEWLINE]– Sam Levenson
LOC_BUILDING_BIG_BEN_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 不要盯着大钟看；要做大钟正在做的事。继续前进。[NEWLINE]——萨姆·李文森

LOC_BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATER_QUOTE.en_US: “Bolshoi Ballet is a universe of the imagination, a place of magic and enchantment, beauty and romance. Its many worlds vibrate with graceful dancers, glorious music, and sumptuous costumes.”[NEWLINE]– Trudy Garfunkel
LOC_BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATER_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 莫斯科大剧院芭蕾舞团是充满想象力的地方，一个具有魔法和吸引力的美丽浪漫之地。优雅的舞者、气势磅礴的音乐以及华丽的服饰让世人为之震撼。[NEWLINE]——特鲁迪·加丰科

LOC_BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATRE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Awards 2 randomly-chosen free civics when completed. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Theater Square district.
LOC_BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATRE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 完成时，随机获得两个免费市政。必须建在邻近剧院广场区域的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_BROADWAY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +20% [ICON_Culture] Culture in this city. 1 free random Atomic era civic boost. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Theater Square district.
LOC_BUILDING_BROADWAY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 为此城+20% [ICON_Culture] 文化值。免费随机提升1个原子能时代的市政。必须建在邻近剧院广场区域的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_BROADWAY_QUOTE.en_US: “There’s no business like show business.”[NEWLINE]– Irving Berlin, 'Annie Get Your Gun'
LOC_BUILDING_BROADWAY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 轻歌曼舞好营生，娱乐业至上。[NEWLINE]——欧文·柏林《飞燕金枪》

LOC_BUILDING_CASTLE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Increases the strength of your outer defenses. Provides 2 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic. This city is not affected by Battering Rams.
LOC_BUILDING_CASTLE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 提升外部防御力。获得“保护地球”市政以后提供2点 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。此城不受“破城槌”特效影响。

LOC_BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture to all Rainforest tiles for this city. +1 [ICON_Production] Production to all Rainforest tiles for this city. Must be built on Rainforest.
LOC_BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 该城市所有雨林单元格+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。该城市所有雨林单元格+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。必须建在雨林。

LOC_BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA_QUOTE.en_US: “The Great Ball Court is also very impressive. I would like to have seen them play a game, although it sounds like the end was pretty violent. I think it was safer to be a spectator.”[NEWLINE]– IslaDeb
LOC_BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 大竞技场也让人印象深刻。我很想看他们在这里进行比赛，虽然结局听起来很暴力。我认为作为观众还是会安全些。[NEWLINE]——伊斯拉德布

LOC_BUILDING_COAL_POWER_PLANT_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal [ICON_PowerRight] 4 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Heavy CO2 into the atmosphere
LOC_BUILDING_COAL_POWER_PLANT_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 将任意数额的 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] 煤自动转换为 [ICON_Power] 电力，每回合可为周围6个单元格内的城市提供其所需电力：[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1点 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] 煤 [ICON_PowerRight] 4点 [ICON_Power] 电力[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]会向大气层排放大量二氧化碳

LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: The Colosseum's [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Amenities] Amenities are extended to each city center within 6 tiles. Must be built on flat land adjacent to an Entertainment Complex district.
LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 罗马斗兽场的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值和 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度延伸至6个单元格以内的所有市中心。必须建在靠近娱乐中心的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM_QUOTE.en_US: “While the Colosseum stands, Rome shall stand; when the Colosseum falls, Rome shall fall; when Rome falls, the world shall fall.”[NEWLINE]– Saint Bede
LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 竞技场耸立，罗马屹立不倒；竞技场倒塌，罗马倒塌；罗马倒塌，整个世界都会崩溃。[NEWLINE]——圣徒比德

LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSUS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity. Grants a Trader unit. Must be built on the Coast, adjacent to land and a Harbor district.
LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSUS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。获得1个商人单位。必须建在邻近陆地和港口的海岸上。

LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSUS_QUOTE.en_US: “At Rhodes was set up a Colossus of seventy cubits high, representing the Sun … the artist expended as much bronze on it as seemed likely to create a dearth in the mines.”[NEWLINE]– Philo of Byzantium
LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSUS_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 在罗兹岛上建成了一座36米高的巨像，以此代表太阳…艺术家在上面使用了大量青铜，可能是想引起矿产资源匮乏。[NEWLINE]——费隆（拜占庭）

LOC_BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: [ICON_Tourism] Tourism output from [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics and Holy Cities is not diminished by other civilizations who have researched The Enlightenment civic. +100% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from Seaside Resorts across your civilization. Must be built on Hills.
LOC_BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物和圣城的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩产值不会被其他研究了“启蒙运动”市政的文明削弱。您文明中“海滨度假区”产出的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩+100%。必须建在丘陵上。

LOC_BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR_QUOTE.en_US: “Thus, the sculpture serves to give people one thought – ‘Everything is in God’s hands.’”[NEWLINE]– Sergey Semenov
LOC_BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 因此，雕塑的作用是让人感到‘一切都掌握在上帝的手中’。[NEWLINE]——谢尔盖·谢苗诺夫

LOC_BUILDING_DAR_E_MEHR_EXPANSION2_DESCR.en_US: +1 additional [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each era since constructed or last repaired. Cannot be pillaged by natural disasters.
LOC_BUILDING_DAR_E_MEHR_EXPANSION2_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 从建造或最后被修复开始每个时代额外+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。无法被自然灾害掠夺。

LOC_BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: All tiles in your civilization gain +2 Appeal. Must be built on flat land adjacent to the City Center.
LOC_BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 您的文明所有单元格可+2魅力。必须建在邻近市中心的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER_QUOTE.en_US: “I ought to be jealous of the tower. She is more famous than I am.”[NEWLINE]– Gustave Eiffel
LOC_BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我应该嫉妒这座塔。她比我更出名。[NEWLINE]——古斯塔夫·埃菲尔

LOC_BUILDING_ELECTRONICS_FACTORY_EXPANSI.en_US: A building unique to Japan. Provides +4 [ICON_Culture] Culture to this city after researching the Electricity technology. Its [ICON_Production] Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from this building type.

LOC_BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA_DESCRIP.en_US: +2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities in each city in your civilization. Must be built on flat land adjacent to an Entertainment Complex district with a Stadium.
LOC_BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 您文明国家的每个城市+2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。必须建在靠近带有体育场的娱乐中心的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA_QUOTE.en_US: “Down through its history, only three people have managed to silence the Maracana: the Pope, Frank Sinatra, and me.”[NEWLINE]– Alcides Ghiggia, Uruguayan soccer player
LOC_BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 纵观历史，只有三个人能让马拉卡纳球场安静下来：教皇、法兰克·辛纳屈、我。[NEWLINE]——阿尔喀德斯·吉贾（乌拉圭足球运动员）

LOC_BUILDING_FACTORY_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT.en_US: Its [ICON_Production] Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from this building type.
LOC_BUILDING_FACTORY_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 其 [ICON_Production] 生产力加成延伸到6单元格内的所有市中心（前提是其尚未从其他的此建筑获得加成）。

LOC_BUILDING_FILM_STUDIO_EXPANSION2_DESC.en_US: A building unique to America. +100% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism pressure from this city towards other civilizations when the game enters the Modern era.

LOC_BUILDING_FLOOD_BARRIER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Protects Coastal Lowland tiles in this city from flooding. Initial build cost and per turn maintenance are variable based on the number of Coastal Lowlands in this city and the current sea level. If constructed after some of a city's tiles have been flooded, those tiles can be repaired in full. Submerged tiles however are never recoverable.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built in a city with one or more Coastal Lowland tiles. Will not be pillaged if the city is captured.
LOC_BUILDING_FLOOD_BARRIER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能保护该城市的海岸低地单元格不受洪水侵袭。初次修建与每回合维护的成本将根据城中海岸低地数量和当前海平面高度而定。如在城市单元格受到洪水侵袭后修建，则可将这些单元格完全修复。但沉入海底的单元格无法复原。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须修建在拥有1个或以上海岸低地单元格的城市中。城市被占领时不会遭到掠夺。

LOC_BUILDING_FOOD_MARKET_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Can only be built once in a city, even if the city has multiple Neighborhoods.
LOC_BUILDING_FOOD_MARKET_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 只能在城市中建造一个，即使城市拥有多个社区也同样如此。

LOC_BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 Wildcard policy slot[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on flat land adjacent to the City Center.
LOC_BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: +1 通配符政策槽位[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须建在靠近市中心的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY_QUOTE.en_US: “The whole palace complex is built along a central axis, the axis of the world, everything in the four directions suspend from this central point represented by these palaces.”[NEWLINE]– Jeffrey Riegel
LOC_BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 整个宫殿是沿着一条中心轴建立的，这也是整个世界的轴心，以宫殿为代表，四个方向的所有东西都是从中心点悬吊下来的。[NEWLINE]——杰弗里·里格尔

LOC_BUILDING_FOSSIL_FUEL_POWER_PLANT_DES.en_US: Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil [ICON_PowerRight] 4 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Moderate CO2 into the atmosphere[NEWLINE]Its [ICON_Production] Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.
LOC_BUILDING_FOSSIL_FUEL_POWER_PLANT_DES.zh_Hans_CN: 将任意数额的 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油自动转换为 [ICON_Power] 电力，每回合可为周围6个单元格内的城市提供其所需电力：[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1点 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油 [ICON_PowerRight] 4点 [ICON_Power] 电力[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]会向大气层排放中量二氧化碳[NEWLINE]其 [ICON_Production] 生产力加成延伸到6单元格内的所有市中心（前提是其尚未从其他的“发电厂”建筑获得加成）。

LOC_BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE_DESCRIPT.en_US: Land units can cross without needing to embark. Acts as Modern Road and creates Modern Roads (if not present) in land tiles on either end. City gains +3 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities. All tiles in this city +4 Appeal. +100% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from improvements and National Parks in this city. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on a Coast tile. The bridge must run straight across the hex between two land tiles directly opposite one another. At least one water tile must be present on both the left and right sides of the bridge.
LOC_BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 陆地单位无需上船便可从桥上跨越。大桥的效果与现代道路相同，并会在桥头两端的陆地单元格中建造现代道路（若未修建）。城市+3 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。城市中的所有单元格+4魅力。城市中的改良设施与国家公园+100% [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。如 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线途径此处，其将从目的地的区域处获得成倍 [ICON_Gold] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须修建在海岸单元格中。大桥必须修建在相隔一个单元格并正对的两个陆地单元格中。大桥左右两侧必须各有至少1个水域单元格。

LOC_BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE_QUOTE.en_US: “The golden gates of Sleep unbar[NEWLINE]Where Strength and Beauty, met together,[NEWLINE]Kindle their image like a star[NEWLINE]In a sea of glassy weather!”[NEWLINE] - Percy Bysshe Shelley
LOC_BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 美梦金门徐徐而开，[NEWLINE]英雄美人相识相爱。[NEWLINE]如画美景闪耀星河，[NEWLINE]碧波大海气象万千！[NEWLINE]——珀西·比希·雪莱

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_CITYSTATES_EXPANSION2_D.en_US: +3 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor. Leveraging City States costs half [ICON_Gold] Gold.[NEWLINE]City State units gain +4 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength if you are the City State's Suzerain (including Leveraged Units).[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_CITYSTATES_EXPANSION2_D.zh_Hans_CN: +3 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。征召城邦单位消耗的 [ICON_Gold] 金币减半。[NEWLINE]如您是城邦的宗主国，则城邦单位+4 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力（征召单位包含在内）。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_CONQUEST_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Capturing an enemy City grants 20% bonus [ICON_Production] Production in all Cities for 5 turns.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_CONQUEST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 占领一座敌方城市后，所有城市将获得20%的 [ICON_Production] 生产力加成，效果持续5回合。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_CULTURE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Provides 4 slots for any Great Work.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_CULTURE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 提供任意4个巨作槽位。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_FAITH_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants the ability to buy land units with [ICON_Faith] Faith.[NEWLINE]Pillaging Improvements and Districts provides bonus [ICON_Faith] Faith.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_FAITH_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 获得用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买陆地单位的能力。[NEWLINE]掠夺改良设施和区域可提供 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值加成。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_MILITARY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: All units heal up to 20 hit points when they eliminate a unit.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_MILITARY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 所有单位消灭敌方单位均可恢复生命值（上限20点）。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_SCIENCE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Builders gain the ability to use all of their charges to provide bonus [ICON_Production] Production to a District Project. Once per city per turn.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_SCIENCE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 建造者能使用所有次数为一个区域项目提供 [ICON_Production] 生产力加成。一次只能用于一座城市，每回合仅限使用一次。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_SPIES_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 Spy and Spy capacity.[NEWLINE]All Spy Operations have a higher chance of success.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_SPIES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 间谍与间谍容量+1。[NEWLINE]所有间谍行动的成功率上升。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_TALL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities and +4 [ICON_Housing] Housing in Cities with [ICON_Governor] Governors[NEWLINE]-2 Loyalty in Cities without [ICON_Governor] Governors.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_TALL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 有 [ICON_Governor] 总督的城市+2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度、+4 [ICON_Housing] 住房。[NEWLINE]无 [ICON_Governor] 总督的城市-2忠诚度。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GOV_WIDE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: 50% increased [ICON_Production] Production toward Settlers in this City.[NEWLINE]New cities receive a free Builder.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
LOC_BUILDING_GOV_WIDE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在此城中生产开拓者时 [ICON_Production] 生产力+50%。[NEWLINE]新城市获得1个免费的建造者。[NEWLINE]奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔。

LOC_BUILDING_GRAND_BAZAAR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A building unique to the Ottomans. Accumulate 1 extra Strategic resource for every different type of Strategic resource this city has improved. Receive 1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity for every Luxury resource this city has improved.

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_BATH_DESCRIPTION.en_US: The Floodplains tiles along the river containing the Great Bath are now immune to Flood damage (though [ICON_FOOD] Food and [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production bonuses from flooding drop by 50%). Floodplains tiles belonging to this city gain +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each time Flood damage is mitigated.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on a Floodplains tile.
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_BATH_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 建有大浴场的河畔泛滥平原单元格免受洪水侵袭（但来自洪水的 [ICON_FOOD] 食物和 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力加成减半）。每次缓解洪水破坏后，属于此城市的泛滥平原单元格所产出的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值+1。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须建在泛滥平原单元格中。

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_BATH_QUOTE.en_US: “Yet in this captious and intenible sieve[NEWLINE]I still pour in the waters of my love[NEWLINE]And lack not to lose still: thus, Indian-like,[NEWLINE]Religious in mine error, I adore[NEWLINE]The sun, that looks upon his worshipper,[NEWLINE]But knows of him no more.”[NEWLINE] - William Shakespeare
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_BATH_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 就算落入的是无情的滤筛，[NEWLINE]我仍愿意将我的爱情之水倾泻倒下。[NEWLINE]即使失败，我也在所不惜。如此，如虔诚的印度人一般。[NEWLINE]我愿虔诚信仰，[NEWLINE]我崇拜太阳，炙热阳光普照信徒，[NEWLINE]但却不知一人为它痴狂。[NEWLINE]——威廉·莎士比亚

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Receive boosts to all Ancient and Classical era technologies. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Campus district with a Library.
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 所有远古和古典时代的科技均获得提升。必须建在平原上，平原需靠近带有图书馆的学院。

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY_QUOTE.en_US: “We can roam the bloated stacks of the Library of Alexandria, where all imagination and knowledge are assembled; we can recognize in its destruction the warning that all we gather will be lost.”[NEWLINE]– Alberto Manguel
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我们可以徜徉在亚历山大图书馆密密麻麻的书架前，这是想象力和知识的聚集地；它的毁灭是一种警告，让我们意识到我们所拥有的一切都将消失。[NEWLINE]——阿尔维托·曼古埃尔

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: +1 [ICON_Movement] Movement for all naval units[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on the Coast, and adjacent to land and a Harbor district with a Lighthouse.
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 所有海军单位+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须建在海岸上，且必须与陆地和已有灯塔的港口相邻。

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE_QUOTE.en_US: “This Lighthouse was the cynosure of all eyes.”[NEWLINE]– Henry David Thoreau
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 灯塔是所有目光的焦点。[NEWLINE]——亨利·大卫·梭罗

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes from this city get +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for every Bonus resource within 3 tiles of the city and in this city's territory. Must be built adjacent to a Commercial Hub district with a Market and adjacent to [ICON_RESOURCE_CATTLE] Cattle.
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量+1。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]城市领土中3个单元格以内的每个加成资源将为从此城市发源的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。必须建在与商业中心区域（要求拥有市场）和 [ICON_RESOURCE_CATTLE] 牛资源相邻的单元格上。

LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE_QUOTE.en_US: “King Solomon gave the Queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.”[NEWLINE]– 1 Kings, 10:13
LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 示巴女王所要求的一切东西，所罗门王都满足了她；另外还按照自己的意愿给予她丰富的馈赠。所以她和仆人一起返回了自己的国家。[NEWLINE]——《列王纪》10章13节

LOC_BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Missionaries and Apostles can spread Religion 1 extra time. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Holy Site district, and you must have founded a Religion.
LOC_BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 传教士和使徒可以额外传播一次宗教。您必须已经创立了一个宗教，[NEWLINE]此外，还必须建在靠近圣地的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA_QUOTE.en_US: “It is a beautiful and important monument and an international, inter-cultural treasure … Unless and until it can be shared by both religions in harmony – which would be a grand idea – it should remain a secular building honoring both religions who have made it beautiful.”[NEWLINE]– Ljubo Vujovic
LOC_BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 它是一座华丽的重要纪念碑，是跨文化宝藏…除非和直到它能被两种宗教和谐共享——这真是一个伟大的想法——它应该被建成世俗的模样，以此向这两种宗教致敬，是它们让纪念碑如此华丽。[NEWLINE]——牛博·武约维奇

LOC_BUILDING_HANGAR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +25% combat experience for air units trained in this city. +2 air unit slots in Aerodrome district.
LOC_BUILDING_HANGAR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 当前城市训练的空中单位+25%战斗经验值。航空港区域+1空中单位槽位。

LOC_BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Increases growth by 15% in all cities. Must be built next to a River.
LOC_BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 所有城市发展加速15%。必须建在河流旁边。

LOC_BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS_QUOTE.en_US: “The ascent to the highest story is by stairs, and at their side are water engines, by means of which persons, appointed expressly for the purpose, are continually employed in raising water from the Euphrates into the garden.”[NEWLINE]– Strabo
LOC_BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 通过楼梯可以到达顶层，旁边是抽水机，雇佣了大量工人来齐心协力从幼发拉底河抽水到花园。[NEWLINE]——斯特拉博

LOC_BUILDING_HERMITAGE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Must be built along a River.

LOC_BUILDING_HERMITAGE_QUOTE.en_US: “Museums are on the front lines of the fight for culture, of good with evil – in any case, of the fight against platitudes and primitiveness.”[NEWLINE]– Mikhail Piotrovsky, Director of the State Hermitage
LOC_BUILDING_HERMITAGE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 博物馆处于文化斗争的前沿，扬善抑恶——总之，一直在同陈腐和原始的东西做斗争。[NEWLINE]——冬宫博物馆馆长米哈伊尔

LOC_BUILDING_HUEY_TEOCALLI_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity from entertainment for each Lake tile within one tile of Huey Teocalli. +1 [ICON_Food] Food and +1 [ICON_Production] Production for each Lake tile in your empire. Must be built on a Lake tile adjacent to land.
LOC_BUILDING_HUEY_TEOCALLI_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在休伊神庙一个单元格以内的每个湖泊单元格为娱乐设施+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。为您帝国内的每个湖泊单元格+1 [ICON_Food] 食物和+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。必须建在靠近陆地的湖泊单元格上。

LOC_BUILDING_HUEY_TEOCALLI_QUOTE.en_US: “But the wrath of Huitzilopochtli was great, and as the sacrifice passed each of the four rooms dedicated to the sun god, the sun disappeared or reappeared in the sky.”[NEWLINE]– Fray Diego Durán
LOC_BUILDING_HUEY_TEOCALLI_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 但维齐洛波奇特利非常生气，作为牺牲，穿过了4个房间，献身于太阳神，天空中的太阳消失了，或再次出现了。[NEWLINE]——福莱·迪亚哥·杜兰

LOC_BUILDING_HYDROELECTRIC_DAM_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Provides the city +6 [ICON_Power] Power from renewable water sources.
LOC_BUILDING_HYDROELECTRIC_DAM_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 可再生水源向城市提供+6点 [ICON_Power] 电力。

LOC_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE_EXPANSION2_DESCR.en_US: +25% combat experience for all naval units trained in this city. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food on all Coast tiles for this city. +2 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing if this city is adjacent to coast. +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Market building.
LOC_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE_EXPANSION2_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 此城生产的所有海军单位+25%战斗经验值。此城的所有海岸单元格+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。如此城与海岸相邻，则+2 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。如此城尚无市场，则+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。

LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_CULTURE.en_US: +{1_num} [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from the adjacent Mountain {1_Num : plural 1?tile; other?tiles;}.
LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_CULTURE.zh_Hans_CN: +{1_num} [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值来自相邻山脉{1_Num : plural 1?单元格; other?单元格;}。

LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Mountain tiles provide a standard adjacency bonus to Commercial Hub, Theater Square, and Industrial Zone districts in all cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on a Mountain tile that does not contain a Volcano.
LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 山脉单元格为所有城市的商业中心、剧院广场及工业区提供标准的相邻加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须修建在无火山的山脉单元格中。

LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_GOLD.en_US: +{1_num} [ICON_GOLD] Gold from the adjacent Mountain {1_Num : plural 1?tile; other?tiles;}.
LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_GOLD.zh_Hans_CN: +{1_num} [ICON_GOLD] 金币来自相邻山脉{1_Num : plural 1?单元格; other?单元格;}。

LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_PRODUCTION.en_US: +{1_num} [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from the adjacent Mountain {1_Num : plural 1?tile; other?tiles;}.
LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_PRODUCTION.zh_Hans_CN: +{1_num} [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力来自相邻山脉{1_Num : plural 1?单元格; other?单元格;}。

LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_QUOTE.en_US: “...Eagles fly, The turrets round, and seem to flout the sky;[NEWLINE]They eye those walls now crumbling in decay,[NEWLINE]And scare from quiet rest their destined prey.”[NEWLINE] - Samuel Prout Hill
LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 苍鹰翱翔，高塔环绕，直入云霄威风堂堂；[NEWLINE]眼中城墙，斑驳残破已成过往，[NEWLINE]所猎之物，无处可躲尸骨埋葬。[NEWLINE]——萨缪尔·普劳特·希尔

LOC_BUILDING_MADRASA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A building unique to Arabia. Bonus [ICON_Faith] Faith equal to the adjacency bonus of the Campus district.
LOC_BUILDING_MADRASA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 阿拉伯特色建筑。提供与学院区的相邻加成等量的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。

LOC_BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE_EXPANSION2.en_US: +2 Diplomatic Victory Points and grants 2 Apostles when built.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on Woods adjacent to a Holy Site district with a Temple, and you must have founded a Religion.
LOC_BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE_EXPANSION2.zh_Hans_CN: 建成后+2外交胜利点数，并提供2个使徒。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须建在与圣地区域（此区域中须建有寺庙）相邻的树林中，前提还须已创立宗教。

LOC_BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE_QUOTE.en_US: “In a dusty, bustling corner of the Indian state of Bihar, there is a magical place that one might think of as the hub of Buddhism.”[NEWLINE]– Visitor’s Guide, Bodh Gaya
LOC_BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 在印度比哈尔邦尘土飞扬的喧闹角落里，有一个神奇的地方被人们当作佛教中心。[NEWLINE]——《旅游者指南》里的菩提伽耶

LOC_BUILDING_MARAE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A building unique to the Māori. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and [ICON_FAITH] Faith to all of this city's tiles with a passable feature or natural wonder. After Flight is researched receive +1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism to all of this city's tiles with a feature or natural wonder. Costs no maintenance. Has no Great Work slots.

LOC_BUILDING_MARKET_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPTI.en_US: +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Lighthouse building.
LOC_BUILDING_MARKET_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 如此城尚未建有灯塔，则+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。

LOC_BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Grants 2 Gurus. Gurus are 30% cheaper to purchase. Religious units adjacent to Gurus receive +5 [ICON_Religion] Religious Strength in Theological Combat and +1 [ICON_Movement] Movement. Must be built adjacent to a Holy Site and you must have founded a Religion.
LOC_BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 获得2名上师。购买上师的费用降低30%。与上师相邻的宗教单位在神学战争中+5 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力、+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。必须建在圣地旁，同时必须已创立宗教。

LOC_BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE_QUOTE.en_US: “We greet you, Devi Meenakshi, she who shines like a thousand-million suns, adorned with bracelets and garlands... She who is auspicious, she who embodies existence. I always bow to you, whose compassion is an ocean.”[NEWLINE] - Adi Shankara
LOC_BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 向您致敬，伟大的米纳克希女神。您如若千万太阳般耀眼夺目，满身手镯花环更是五彩缤纷…您是吉祥的化身，亦是万物的象征。我愿永远臣服于您，因您的慈悲宛如无边汪洋。[NEWLINE]——阿迪·商羯罗

LOC_BUILDING_MILITARY_ACADEMY_EXPANSION2.en_US: +25% combat experience for all land units trained in this city.[NEWLINE]Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).[NEWLINE]Allows Corps and Armies to be trained directly. Corps and Army training costs reduced 25%.
LOC_BUILDING_MILITARY_ACADEMY_EXPANSION2.zh_Hans_CN: 此城中训练的所有陆地单位+25%战斗经验值。[NEWLINE]战略资源储备+10（标准速度下）。[NEWLINE]可直接训练军团和军队。军团和军队的训练费用降低25%。

LOC_BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: All Apostles you create gain the Martyr ability in addition to a second ability you chose normally. Must be built on Floodplains or Marsh.
LOC_BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 您创建的所有使徒除了拥有第二个您通常选择的能力外，还获得了殉教能力。必须建在泛滥平原上或沼泽上。

LOC_BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL_QUOTE.en_US: “Church and State, Soul and Body, God and Man, are all one at Mont Saint Michel, and the business of all is to fight, each in his own way, or to stand guard for each other.”[NEWLINE]– Henry Adams
LOC_BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 教会和国家、灵魂和身体、神和人类，这些都是圣米歇尔山上的一个整体，主要任务是进行战斗，各行其事，或为彼此守卫。[NEWLINE]——享利·亚当斯

LOC_BUILDING_MONUMENT_EXPANSION1_DESCRIP.en_US: Provides +1 Loyalty per turn in this city. If the city already has maximum Loyalty, also provides an additional +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
LOC_BUILDING_MONUMENT_EXPANSION1_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 使此城每回合的忠诚度+1。如城市忠诚度已达最高，则额外+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_BUILDING_MOSQUE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Missionary and Apostles created here have +1 spread.
LOC_BUILDING_MOSQUE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 此处创建的传教士和使徒+1传教次数。

LOC_BUILDING_MUSEUM_ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Holds [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts. May not be built in a Theater Square district that already has an Art Museum.
LOC_BUILDING_MUSEUM_ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可存放 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物。如果在剧院广场区域已经有一座艺术博物馆则无法修建。

LOC_BUILDING_MUSEUM_ART_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Holds [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Great Works of Art. May not be built in a Theater Square district that already has an Archaeological Museum.
LOC_BUILDING_MUSEUM_ART_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可存放 [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 艺术巨作。如果在剧院广场区域已经有一座考古博物馆则无法修建。

LOC_BUILDING_ORACLE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Patronage of Great People costs 25% less [ICON_Faith] Faith. Districts in this city provide +2 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person points of their type (for example, [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer points from the Theater Square district). Must be built on Hills.
LOC_BUILDING_ORACLE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 伟人赞助消耗的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值减少25%。该城市区域为它们类型的 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数+2（比如，来自剧院广场区的 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家点数）。必须建在丘陵上。

LOC_BUILDING_ORACLE_QUOTE.en_US: “I sprang upon the swift ship in the form of a dolphin, pray to me as Apollo Delphinius; also the altar itself shall be called Delphinius and overlooked forever.”[NEWLINE]– Homer
LOC_BUILDING_ORACLE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我像海豚一样跳向快速驶过的船只，祈祷自己成为阿波罗海豚星座；祭坛本身也被称作海豚星座。[NEWLINE]——荷马

LOC_BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +100% [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor per turn from starting a turn as Suzerain of a City-State.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on a River.
LOC_BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 成为一座城邦的宗主国后，每回合从此城邦获得的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持+100%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须修建在河边。

LOC_BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ_QUOTE.en_US: “With self-government is freedom, and with freedom is justice and patriotism.”[NEWLINE] - Lajos Kossuth
LOC_BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 自由是自治之基础，而公正与爱国则是自由的根本。[NEWLINE]——科苏特·拉约什

LOC_BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY_DESCRIPTI.en_US: +20% [ICON_Science] Science in this city, and awards 2 randomly-chosen free technologies when completed. Must be built on Grassland or Plains adjacent to a Campus district with a University.
LOC_BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 当前城市+20% [ICON_Science] 科技值，完成时，随机奖励2项免费科技。必须建在靠近带有大学的学院区域的草原或平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY_QUOTE.en_US: “The clever men at Oxford... Know all that there is to be knowed. But they none of them know one half as much... As intelligent Mr. Toad!”[NEWLINE]– Kenneth Grahame
LOC_BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 牛津大学的聪明人…知道所有需要知道的事。[NEWLINE]但他们都没有蟾蜍先生一半聪明！[NEWLINE]——肯尼思·格拉姆

LOC_BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Upon completion 1 or 2 adjacent Canal districts are automatically constructed. The Canal wonder tile can now be crossed by naval units. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on a flat land tile where there are two adjacent tiles directly across the build tile from one another that meet the following criteria: one adjacent tile must be able to legally hold a Canal district connecting into the Panama Canal construction tile; the other must be either a city, a water tile, or be another tile that can hold a connecting Canal.
LOC_BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 修建完成后，将自动建造1或2个相邻运河区域。海军单位现可穿越运河奇观单元格。如 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线途径此处，其将从目的地的区域处获得成倍 [ICON_Gold] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须修建在平原单元格之上，同时建筑单元格两侧相邻的两个正对单元格必须满足以下条件：其中一块单元格必须能够修建与巴拿马运河单元格连接的运河区域；另一块单元格则必须为城市、水域或可以修建相连运河的单元格。

LOC_BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL_QUOTE.en_US: “Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea; Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof.”[NEWLINE] - Psalms 46:2-3
LOC_BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 因此，即便山崩地裂，坠入大海，我们并不惧怕；即便江河蒸腾，海枯石烂，我们同样毫不惧怕。[NEWLINE]——旧约《诗篇》46:2-3

LOC_BUILDING_PETRA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +2 [ICON_Food] Food, +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold, and +1 [ICON_Production] Production on all Desert tiles for this city (non-Floodplains). Must be built on Desert or Floodplains without Hills.
LOC_BUILDING_PETRA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 为该城市所有沙漠单元格（非泛滥平原）+2 [ICON_Food] 食物，+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币，+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。必须建在没有丘陵的沙漠或泛滥平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_PETRA_QUOTE.en_US: “Petra is a brilliant display of man’s artistry in turning barren rock into majestic wonder.”[NEWLINE]– Edward Dawson
LOC_BUILDING_PETRA_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 约旦-佩特拉古城是人类工艺的绝妙展示，它把贫瘠的岩石变成了伟大的奇迹。[NEWLINE]——爱德华·道森

LOC_BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE_EXPANSION2_DE.en_US: +1 Diplomatic policy slot.  +1 Diplomatic Victory point.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on a Hill adjacent to a Mountain.
LOC_BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE_EXPANSION2_DE.zh_Hans_CN: +1外交政策槽位。+1外交胜利点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须建在靠近山脉的丘陵上。

LOC_BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE_QUOTE.en_US: “The first time I stepped onto the rooftop of the Potala Palace, I felt, as never before or since, as if I were stepping onto the rooftop of my being: onto some dimension of consciousness that I’d never visited before.”[NEWLINE]– Pico Iyer
LOC_BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我第一次踏上布达拉宫房顶时，像步入生命的巅峰一般，这种感觉是前所未有的：整个人进入到从未有过的意识范围之中。[NEWLINE]——皮柯·耶尔

LOC_BUILDING_POWER_PLANT_EXPANSION2_DESC.en_US: Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium [ICON_PowerRight] 16 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Miniscule CO2 into the atmosphere[NEWLINE]Once built, as a Nuclear Power Plant ages, there is an increased chance for a Nuclear Accident to occur. Its [ICON_Production] Production and [ICON_Science] Science bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.
LOC_BUILDING_POWER_PLANT_EXPANSION2_DESC.zh_Hans_CN: 将任意数额的 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] 铀自动转换为 [ICON_Power] 电力，每回合可为周围6个单元格内的城市提供其所需电力：[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1点 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] 铀 [ICON_PowerRight] 16点 [ICON_Power] 电力[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]会向大气层排放少量二氧化碳[NEWLINE]建成后发生核事故的概率会随着核电站老化而增加。其 [ICON_Production] 生产力和 [ICON_Science] 科技值加成延伸到6单元格内的所有市中心（前提是其尚未从其他的“发电厂”建筑获得加成。）

LOC_BUILDING_PYRAMIDS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants a free Builder. All Builders can build 1 extra improvement. Must be built on Desert (including Floodplains) without Hills.
LOC_BUILDING_PYRAMIDS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 赠予1个免费建造者。所有建造者可建造1个额外的改良设施。必须建在没有丘陵的沙漠上（包括泛滥平原）。

LOC_BUILDING_PYRAMIDS_QUOTE.en_US: “From the heights of these pyramids, forty centuries look down on us.”[NEWLINE]– Napoleon Bonaparte
LOC_BUILDING_PYRAMIDS_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 四十个世纪从这些金字塔的顶端，俯瞰着我们。[NEWLINE]——拿破仑·波拿巴

LOC_BUILDING_QUEENS_BIBLIOTHEQUE_DESCRIP.en_US: A building unique to Sweden. This building provides 2 slots of [ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] Writing, [ICON_GreatWork_MUSIC] Music, and any type of [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Art.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.

LOC_BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +20% [ICON_Production] Production in this city, and +1 [ICON_Production] Production for each Mine and Quarry in this city. Must be built along a River adjacent to an Industrial Zone district with a Factory.
LOC_BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 该城市+20% [ICON_Production] 生产力，此城中每个矿山和采石场+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。必须沿河而建，且与拥有工厂的工业区区域相邻。

LOC_BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY_QUOTE.en_US: “The industrial heart of Germany practically stopped beating. Hardly anyone worked; hardly anything ran. The population of the Ruhr area … had to be supported by the rest of the country.”[NEWLINE]– Adam Fergusson
LOC_BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 德国的工业中心实际已停止了运营。几乎没有人工作，几乎没有任何东西在运行；鲁尔地区的全体居民…需要其他国家的援助。[NEWLINE]——亚当·弗格森

LOC_BUILDING_SEAPORT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +25% combat experience for all naval units trained in this city. Allows Fleets and Armadas to be trained directly. Fleet and Armada training costs reduced 25%.  +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold on all Coast tiles for this city.
LOC_BUILDING_SEAPORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 此城中生产的所有海军单位+25%战斗经验值。可直接生产舰队和无敌舰队。舰队和无敌舰队的生产费用降低25%。此城所有海岸单元格产出的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币+2。

LOC_BUILDING_SHIPYARD_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP.en_US: +25% combat experience for all naval units trained in this city. Bonus [ICON_Production] Production equal to the adjacency bonus of the Harbor district. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production on all unimproved Coast and Lake tiles for this city.
LOC_BUILDING_SHIPYARD_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 此城中生产的所有海军单位+25%战斗经验值。[ICON_Production] 生产力加成等于港口区域的相邻加成。此城所有未改良的海岸和湖泊单元格提供的 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力+1。

LOC_BUILDING_SHOPPING_MALL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +4 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. Can only be built once in a city, even if the city has multiple Neighborhoods.
LOC_BUILDING_SHOPPING_MALL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: +4 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。只能在城市中建造一个，即使城市拥有多个社区也同样如此。

LOC_BUILDING_SHRINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows the purchasing of Missionaries. Missionaries can only be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
LOC_BUILDING_SHRINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许购买传教士。只能使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值进行购买。

LOC_BUILDING_STABLE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI.en_US: +25% combat experience for all cavalry and siege class units trained in this city.[NEWLINE]Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Barracks.
LOC_BUILDING_STABLE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 此城市生产的所有骑兵类和攻城类单位+25%战斗经验值。[NEWLINE]战略资源储备+10（标准速度下）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不能建造在已拥有兵营的军营区域中。

LOC_BUILDING_STADIUM_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPT.en_US: Bonus [ICON_Amenities] Amenities extend to each city center within 6 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +2 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism if the city [ICON_CITIZEN] population is 10 or higher and +5 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism if the city [ICON_CITIZEN] population is 20 or higher.
LOC_BUILDING_STADIUM_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度加成延伸到6个单元格中的每个市中心。此加成+2座城市仅能应用1次，因此市中心6个单元格以内相同的此建筑不会再额外提供加成。如城市 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口大于等于10，则+2 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩；如城市 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口大于等于20，则+5 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。

LOC_BUILDING_STAR_FORT_EXPANSION2_DESCRI.en_US: Raises the strength of your outer defenses to the highest possible level. Provides 3 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic. This city is not affected by Siege Towers or Battering Rams.
LOC_BUILDING_STAR_FORT_EXPANSION2_DESCRI.zh_Hans_CN: 将外部防御能力提升至最高级。获得“保护地球”市政后提供3点 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。此城不受“破城槌”或“攻城塔”特效影响。

LOC_BUILDING_STAVE_CHURCH_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A building unique to Norway. Required to purchase Apostles and Inquisitors with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Holy Site districts get an additional standard adjacency bonus from Woods.  +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to each coastal resource tile in this city.
LOC_BUILDING_STAVE_CHURCH_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 挪威特色建筑。建成后可使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买使徒和审判官。圣地区域可从树林获得额外的标准相邻加成。城市中每个海岸资源单元格+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

LOC_BUILDING_STONEHENGE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants a free [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet. [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophets may found a Religion on Stonehenge instead of a Holy Site. Must be adjacent to [ICON_RESOURCE_STONE] Stone and on flat land.
LOC_BUILDING_STONEHENGE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 免费获得1个 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家。 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家可在巨石阵（代替圣地）创立一个宗教。必须建在靠近 [ICON_RESOURCE_STONE] 石材的平原上。

LOC_BUILDING_STONEHENGE_QUOTE.en_US: “Can you imagine trying to talk six hundred people into helping you drag a fifty-ton stone eighteen miles across the countryside and muscle it into an upright position, and then saying, ‘Right, lads! Another twenty like that … and then we can party!”[NEWLINE]– Bill Bryson
LOC_BUILDING_STONEHENGE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 你能想象试图说服600人帮你将一个重为50吨的石头拖动28千米穿过乡村，并用力将它立起来，然后说：‘好了，小伙子们！再推动20块这样的石头…然后就可以庆祝啦！’这样的场景吗？[NEWLINE]——比尔·布莱森

LOC_BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE_DESCRIPT.en_US: Must be built on the Coast, adjacent to land and a Harbor district.
LOC_BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 必须建在海岸上，且需要靠近陆地和一个港口。

LOC_BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE_QUOTE.en_US: “An opera begins long before the curtain goes up and ends long after it has come down. It starts in my imagination, it becomes my life, and it stays part of my life long after I've left the opera house.”[NEWLINE]– Maria Callas
LOC_BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 在幕布拉起前很久，歌剧已经开始，在幕布降下后很久，歌剧才结束。它开始于我的想象中，变成了我的生命，在我离开歌剧院很久之后，它依然是我生活的一部分。[NEWLINE]——玛丽亚·卡拉斯

LOC_BUILDING_TEMPLE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows the purchasing of Apostles, Gurus, Inquisitors, and with the proper belief, Warrior Monks. These units can only be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
LOC_BUILDING_TEMPLE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可购买使徒、上师、审判官，拥有特定信仰还可购买武僧。这些宗教单位只能通过 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。

LOC_BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: All current units gain a promotion level. All Archaeologists from the owner may enter foreign lands without Open Borders. Must be built on flat Grassland or Plains adjacent to an Encampment district with a Barracks or Stable.
LOC_BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 目前所有单位获得1级强化升级。所拥有的考古学家可在没有开放边界的情况下进入外国。必须建在平坦的草原或平原上，且靠近带有兵营或马厩的军营区域。

LOC_BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY_QUOTE.en_US: “There were seven wonders in the world, and the discovery of the Terracotta Army, we may say, is the eighth miracle of the world.”[NEWLINE]– Jacques Chirac
LOC_BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 世界上有七大奇迹，我们可能会说兵马俑是世界第八大奇迹。[NEWLINE]——雅克·希拉克

LOC_BUILDING_THERMAL_BATH_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A building unique to Hungary. +2 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities and +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production extends to each city center within 6 tiles. These bonuses apply once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This city receives +3 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism and +2 additional [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities if there is at least one Geothermal Fissure in this city's borders.

LOC_BUILDING_TLACHTLI_XP1_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A building unique to the Aztecs. Provides 2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities, +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith, and a [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General Point. Provides +1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.
LOC_BUILDING_TLACHTLI_XP1_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 阿兹特克特色建筑。提供2点 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度、+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值、+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，并提供1点 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军点数。采用“保护地球”市政后，提供的 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩+1。

LOC_BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE_DESCRIPT.en_US: Other Civilizations' [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to this city provide +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for them. +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for every [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route to this city. Domestic [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes give an additional +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith to this city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Must be built on the Desert or Desert Hills, and adjacent to a Campus district with a University.
LOC_BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 与该城连接的其他文明 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线向城市提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值与+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。与该城连接的每条 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线向该城额外提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]必须修建在沙漠或沙漠丘陵之上，同时必须与大学区域相邻。

LOC_BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE_QUOTE.en_US: “Scholars are the heirs of the prophets, for the prophets did not leave behind a legacy of wealth but that of knowledge.”[NEWLINE] - Musnad al-Bazzar 10/68
LOC_BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 学者皆是先知的子嗣。先知并未在世间留下任何财富，而是将宝贵的知识传给后人。[NEWLINE]——穆斯奈德·艾尔-巴扎尔10/68

LOC_BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Receive a second naval unit each time you train a naval unit. Must be built on a Coast tile that is adjacent to an Industrial Zone district.
LOC_BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 每训练一个海军单位，便会获得第二个海军单位。必须建在靠近工业区的海岸单元格上。

LOC_BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL_QUOTE.en_US: “The commonwealth of Venice in their armory have this inscription: ‘Happy is that city which in time of peace thinks of war.’”[NEWLINE]– Robert Burton
LOC_BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 威尼斯联邦的军械库上有这样一段题词：快乐是城市在和平时期想起战争的痛苦。[NEWLINE]——罗伯特·伯顿

LOC_BUILDING_WALLS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Provides Walls around the City Center and Encampment district. Walls allow [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strikes from the City Center and Encampment district, and must be defeated before a city can be assaulted. Provides 1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.
LOC_BUILDING_WALLS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 提供环绕市中心和军营的城墙。城墙使市中心和军营能发起 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击。必须先击毁城墙方能进攻城市。获得“保护地球”市政后提供1点 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。

LOC_BUILDING_WATER_MILL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Bonus resources improved by Farms gain +1 [ICON_Food] Food each. City must be adjacent to a River.
LOC_BUILDING_WATER_MILL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 由农场改良的每个加成资源提供的 [ICON_Food] 食物+1。城市必须与河流相邻。

LOC_BUILDING_ZOO_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Bonus [ICON_Amenities] Amenity extends to each city center within 6 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science to each Rainforest and Marsh tile in this city.
LOC_BUILDING_ZOO_EXPANSION1_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度加成延伸到6个单元格中的每个市中心。此加成1座城市仅能应用1次，因此市中心6个单元格以内相同的此建筑不会再额外提供加成。此城中的每处雨林和沼泽单元格+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

LOC_CIVIC_CIVIL_ENGINEERING_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Can build Farms on Grassland Hills and Plains Hills.
LOC_CIVIC_CIVIL_ENGINEERING_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可以在草原丘陵和平原丘陵上建造农场。

LOC_CIVIC_COLD_WAR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy.

LOC_CIVIC_CONSERVATION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Awards 3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys. Allows the building of National Parks and the purchase of Naturalists with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Allows Builders to plant Woods (second-growth). Woods in your territory that have never been removed (old-growth) gain +1 Appeal. Receive [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from Walls.
LOC_CIVIC_CONSERVATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 奖励3位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。允许使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值建造国家公园和购买自然学家。允许建造者植树造林（人造林）。您领土上从未被移除的树林（非人造林）获得+1魅力。从城墙获得 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。

LOC_CIVIC_DIPLOMATIC_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants the ability to construct a Spy.

LOC_CIVIC_EARLY_EMPIRE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the abilities to enforce borders and grant Open Borders to other civilizations.
LOC_CIVIC_EARLY_EMPIRE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁加固边境和为其他文明开放边界的能力。

LOC_CIVIC_ENVIRONMENTALISM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在帝国全境内+25% [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。
