LOC_CIVIC_FEUDALISM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Farm improvements now gain +1 [ICON_Food] Food from every 2 adjacent Farm improvements.
LOC_CIVIC_FEUDALISM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 现与2个农场改良设施相邻时，农场产出的 [ICON_Food] 食物+1。

LOC_CIVIC_FOREIGN_TRADE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows the creation of [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
LOC_CIVIC_FOREIGN_TRADE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许创建 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。

LOC_CIVIC_FUTURE_CIVIC_XP2_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Can be completed multiple times, increasing your points towards the Score Victory. Also awards 1 [ICON_Governor] Governor title and 50 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each time it is completed.
LOC_CIVIC_FUTURE_CIVIC_XP2_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可多次完成，增加分数胜利点数。每完成一次便奖励1个 [ICON_Governor] 总督头衔与50点 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。

LOC_CIVIC_IDEOLOGY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy.

LOC_CIVIC_MERCANTILISM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Camp improvements receive +1 [ICON_Production] Production and +1 [ICON_Food] Food.
LOC_CIVIC_MERCANTILISM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 营地改良设施获得+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力和+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。

LOC_CIVIC_MILITARY_TRADITION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants flanking and support combat bonuses to all combat units.
LOC_CIVIC_MILITARY_TRADITION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 所有战斗单位获得夹击和支援战斗加成。

LOC_CIVIC_MOBILIZATION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows formation of Defensive Pacts. Allows forming three identical units into an Army or Armada. Allows one new Casus Belli that can be used to justify wars: War of Territorial Expansion.
LOC_CIVIC_MOBILIZATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许进行共同防御。允许3个相同单位组成一支军队或无敌舰队。现在可用一个新的战争借口替战争辩护：领土扩张战争。

LOC_CIVIC_NATIONALISM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy. Allows forming two identical units into a Corps or Fleet. Allows one new Casus Belli that can be used to justify wars: Colonial War.
LOC_CIVIC_NATIONALISM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可额外招募一名间谍。允许两个完全相同的单位组成一个兵团或舰队。现在可用一个新的战争借口替战争辩护：殖民战争。

LOC_CIVIC_RAPID_DEPLOYMENT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows for the transport of land units between Aerodrome districts that contain Airports.
LOC_CIVIC_RAPID_DEPLOYMENT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许在包含机场的航空港之间运输陆地单位。

LOC_CIVIC_THE_ENLIGHTENMENT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Religious [ICON_Tourism] Tourism effects are halved versus your civilization.
LOC_CIVIC_THE_ENLIGHTENMENT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 同您开战的文明，宗教 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩减半。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_ALLIANCE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Establish an Alliance with a Declared Friend. Allies may not go to war, automatically have Open Borders, and each receives a Casus Belli on an aggressor civilization if one of their allies loses a city.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_ALLIANCE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与公开宣布的朋友结成同盟。盟友之间不会开战，会自动形成开放边界，如果其中一位盟友失去一座城市，其他人会获得一个针对侵略者文明的战争借口。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_COLONIAL_WAR_DES.en_US: Used to declare war on a power that is two technology eras behind you. All warmonger penalties halved.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_COLONIAL_WAR_DES.zh_Hans_CN: 适用于向落后于您两个科技时代的国家宣战。所有好战程度减半。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_FORMAL_WAR_DESCR.en_US: Used to declare war on a player that Denounced you or that you have Denounced at least 5 turns ago. No restrictions on which cities you may capture.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_FORMAL_WAR_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 用于对谴责过您的玩家，或您之前谴责过（至少5回合前）的玩家宣战。不限制具体的占领城市。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_FRIENDSHIP_DESCR.en_US: Formally state your intention to maintain friendly relations with this power. While a friend you will be eligible for an Alliance but will not be able to declare a formal war on this power.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_FRIENDSHIP_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 正式表明您愿同该国维持友好关系的意愿。作为朋友，您能获得一个盟友，但无法对该国正式宣战。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_GOLDEN_AGE_WAR_D.zh_Hans_CN: 在黄金时代中拥有“全民皆兵”着力点时用于对玩家宣战。可在对文明进行谴责后直接宣战，无需等待正常所需的回合数。不限制占领的城市。产生的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满降低75%。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_HOLY_WAR_DESCRIP.en_US: Used to declare war on a power that has religiously converted one of your cities. All warmonger penalties halved.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_HOLY_WAR_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 适用于向转变了您某座城市宗教信仰的国家宣战。所有好战程度减半。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_IDEOLOGICAL_WAR_.zh_Hans_CN: 用于向采纳不同第三级政体的文明宣战。不限制占领的城市。产生的普通 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满降低50%。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_LIBERATION_WAR_D.en_US: Used to declare war on a power that has captured a city from one of your friends or allies.  No warmonger penalty for liberating any of those cities.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_LIBERATION_WAR_D.zh_Hans_CN: 适用于向占领了您某位朋友或盟友城市的国家宣战。解放任何已被占领的城市都不会增加好战程度。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_PROTECTORATE_WAR.en_US: Used to declare war on a power that has attacked one of your allied city-states. No warmonger penalty for liberating that city-state.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_PROTECTORATE_WAR.zh_Hans_CN: 用于向占领您同盟城邦的国家宣战。解放被占领的城邦不会增加好战程度。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_RECONQUEST_WAR_D.en_US: Used to declare war on a power that has captured one of your cities. No warmonger penalties apply.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_RECONQUEST_WAR_D.zh_Hans_CN: 适用于向占领了您某座城市的国家宣战。不影响好战程度。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_SURPRISE_WAR_DES.en_US: Used to immediately start a war. Normal warmonger penalties increased by 50%.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_SURPRISE_WAR_DES.zh_Hans_CN: 适用于立即开战。普通好战程度增加50%。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_TERRITORIAL_WAR_.en_US: Used to declare war on a power that borders your empire. Must have 2 of your cities within 10 tiles of 2 opponents' cities. Warmonger penalties reduced by 25%.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_TERRITORIAL_WAR_.zh_Hans_CN: 适用于向您的帝国接壤的国家宣战。在两位对手城市的10个单元格范围内，必须有属于您的两座城市。好战争度减少25%。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DECLARE_WAR_OF_RETRIBUTI.zh_Hans_CN: 用于向过去30个回合内对您背弃承诺的国家宣战。不限制占领的城市。产生的普通 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满降低50%。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DEMAND_TRIBUTE_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Demand a diplomatic gift from this power.

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DENOUNCE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Used to formally state your unhappiness with this power. A formal declaration of war (with or without a Casus Belli) can follow after 5 additional turns have passed.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DENOUNCE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 通常会向该国正式表达您的不满。5个额外回合之后可正式宣战（使用或不使用战争借口均可）。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_DIPLOMATIC_DELEGATION_DE.en_US: Send a delegation with a gift of [ICON_Gold] Gold for this power. If accepted, the recipient will be a bit friendlier and you will gain a level of Access. Lasts until you gain the Diplomatic Service Civic.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_DIPLOMATIC_DELEGATION_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 派遣代表团带着 [ICON_Gold] 金币作为礼物前往该国。如果对方接受，则会变得更加友好，您也会提升一个访问级别。这种状态会一直持续到您获得“外交部门”市政为止。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_JOINT_WAR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Establish a Joint War against a target civilization.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_JOINT_WAR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 创建联合作战对抗目标文明。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_KEEP_PROMISE_DONT_CONVER.zh_Hans_CN: 承诺不会转变城市信仰

LOC_DIPLOACTION_KEEP_PROMISE_DONT_DIG_AR.en_US: Promise To Not Dig Up Artifacts

LOC_DIPLOACTION_KEEP_PROMISE_DONT_SETTLE.en_US: Promise To Not Settle Too Near
LOC_DIPLOACTION_KEEP_PROMISE_DONT_SETTLE.zh_Hans_CN: 承诺不在临近之处进行安置

LOC_DIPLOACTION_MAKE_PEACE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Negotiate a deal to end the current war with this power.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_MAKE_PEACE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 达成一项协议来结束同该国当前的战争。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_OPEN_BORDERS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Ask this power to allow your units to travel through their controlled territory.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_OPEN_BORDERS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 请求该国允许您的单位穿越他们的管辖区域。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_PROPOSE_PEACE_DEAL_DESCR.en_US: Propose a peace deal with this power.

LOC_DIPLOACTION_PROPOSE_TRADE_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Initiate trade negotiations with this power.

LOC_DIPLOACTION_REQUEST_ASSISTANCE_DESCR.en_US: Ask this power for a diplomatic gift.

LOC_DIPLOACTION_RESIDENT_EMBASSY_DESCRIP.en_US: Establish a permanent Embassy with this power. If accepted, the recipient will be a bit friendlier, you will gain a level of Access, and the recipient's [ICON_Capital] Capital will be revealed.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_RESIDENT_EMBASSY_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 同该国建立一个永久大使馆。如果接受，接受者会变得更加友好，您也会获得一个访问级别，同时，显示接受者的 [ICON_Capital] 首都。

LOC_DIPLOACTION_THIRD_PARTY_WAR_DESCRIPT.en_US: Join another player's war against a target civilization.
LOC_DIPLOACTION_THIRD_PARTY_WAR_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 加入其它玩家针对目标文明的战争。

LOC_DIPLOMACY_ALLIANCES_TT.en_US: Propose an Alliance with this power

LOC_DIPLOMACY_RENEW_ALLIANCE_TT.en_US: Propose to extend the duration of your current Alliance with this power
LOC_DIPLOMACY_RENEW_ALLIANCE_TT.zh_Hans_CN: 提议延长当前和此文明的同盟周期

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: It is in combat that the true soul of a civilization is revealed. May the best man win.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 文明真正的灵魂在战斗中展露无遗。愿最优秀的人取胜。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: The world is ours for the taking! And take it, you have.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 世界就是供我们自由索取的。想要什么拿什么。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: It is good that our relationship is built on the strength of knowing other people’s secrets.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我们的关系建立在对其他人民秘密的了解之上，这一点很好。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I must say, the power of your airforce is not one to be trifled with. Very nice.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我必须得说您的空军可真不是好惹的。很棒。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I am impressed with the unique culture your people are developing.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 您的人民发展出的特色文化让我印象深刻。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: Peace be to you and yours. It is heartening to see another just as pious as myself.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 愿您永享和平。看到另一个和我一样虔诚的人让我振奋不已。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I'm hearing talk that your people want to celebrate your rule. Nice job keeping them happy.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我听说您的国民想庆祝您的统治。您管理的不错，能让他们如此高兴。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I extend my heartiest congratulations on the productivity of your people.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我衷心祝贺您的国民的生产效率如此之高。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: Great minds think alike, I see. There are so many uses for that technology...
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 伟大的思想总是相似的。那项科技可是太有用了…
您的敌人在烈焰与恐惧中知晓了您的名号。他们祈求能够从您的盛怒中逃出，但上天却毫无回应。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: The number of people living in your empire is truly impressive.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 您领土上的国民数量真的很惊人。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I am impressed with the depth of your scientific research.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 您科研的深度让我印象深刻。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I love a leader who is surrounded by an impressive military.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我喜爱的这个领袖拥有令人印象深刻的军事力量。
在追随致真信仰之人的统治下，这片土地中的百姓该是如何的快乐啊，他选择保护的正是人民的灵魂！
最大限度的自由只会来自追寻自身利益的文明，您说是吧？

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: Yes, very good. Leave the exploring to me.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 是的，很好。探索这事就交给我来做吧。
我很高兴看到你已经做好准备，来接受我成为这星球的最高领袖。已经有人开始窃窃私语，表示我的时代已然来临。
我们已经准备好为您国的游客提供世界顶级的旅游服务了。显然，您的文明可拿不出这种级别的服务。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: We are true friends with the smaller civilizations. We appreciate that you recognize this fact.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我们是较小文明的真正朋友。我们很感激您承认这一事实。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: It is an admirable thing to look out for those who cannot look out for themselves.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 照料那些无法照料自己的人是一件很了不起的事。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: I see you're a like-minded individual, and must commend your government practices.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我发现您和我志趣相投，必须赞扬您对于新政体的实践。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: Our poets and philosophers hold up your civilization as the light of the world, and I must agree with them.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 我们的诗人和哲学家将您的文明视为世界之光，我同意他们的观点。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.en_US: Our civilization admires the way you’re bearing your current trouble with hardiness and resolve.
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_.zh_Hans_CN: 您用意志力和决心面对当前的难关，这一点让我们的文明十分敬佩。

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_BARBAROSSA_REASON_.en_US: (You are not attacking or allying city-states)
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_BARBAROSSA_REASON_.zh_Hans_CN: （您没有攻击城邦或与其结盟）

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_MVEMBA_REASON_ANY.en_US: (You have established a Religion and brought it to Kongo)
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_MVEMBA_REASON_ANY.zh_Hans_CN: （您创立了宗教并将其带回了刚果）

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_PEDRO_REASON_ANY.en_US: (You are not threatening to gain more Great People)
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_PEDRO_REASON_ANY.zh_Hans_CN: （您没有威胁着要获得更多伟人）

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_PETER_GREAT_REASON.en_US: (You are strong in Science and Culture)
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_PETER_GREAT_REASON.zh_Hans_CN: （您有丰富的科技值和文化值）

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_QIN_REASON_ANY.en_US: (You are not threatening to build more wonders)
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_QIN_REASON_ANY.zh_Hans_CN: （您没有威胁着要建造更多奇观）

LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT_REASON.en_US: (You have kept the peace on his home continent)
LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT_REASON.zh_Hans_CN: （您在他的国土上维护了和平）

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_ALLIED_WITH_FRIEND.en_US: Declared an alliance with a friend
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_ALLIED_WITH_FRIEND.zh_Hans_CN: 已与一位朋友宣布结盟

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_ALLY_OF_ENKIDU_DECLAR.zh_Hans_CN: 吉尔伽美什喜欢宣布友好

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_ALLY_OF_ENKIDU_DENOUN.en_US: Gilgamesh hates it when you denounce his friends
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_ALLY_OF_ENKIDU_DENOUN.zh_Hans_CN: 吉尔伽美什讨厌您谴责他的朋友

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BACKSTAB_AVERSE_FRIEN.zh_Hans_CN: 托米丽司喜欢宣布友好

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BACKSTAB_AVERSE_SURPR.en_US: Tomyris dislikes people who declare surprise wars
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BACKSTAB_AVERSE_SURPR.zh_Hans_CN: 托米丽司讨厌宣布突袭战争的人

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BIG_STICK_CONTINENT_A.en_US: Teddy hates attacks on civs based on his continent
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BIG_STICK_CONTINENT_A.zh_Hans_CN: 泰迪讨厌在自己的大陆上攻击其他文明人

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BIG_STICK_CONTINENT_P.en_US: Teddy likes peaceful civs on his continent
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BIG_STICK_CONTINENT_P.zh_Hans_CN: 罗斯福喜欢与来自同一大陆的其他文明和平共处

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BROKEN_PLEDGE.en_US: We broke our pledge to move our troops from their borders
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BROKEN_PLEDGE.zh_Hans_CN: 我们未履行从他们边界撤军的承诺

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BROKEN_PROMISE.en_US: We broke a diplomatic promise we made to them
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_BROKEN_PROMISE.zh_Hans_CN: 我们违背了对他们做出的外交承诺

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_CONVERTED.zh_Hans_CN: 我们转变了他们的宗教城市

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_OCCUPIED.en_US: We occupy one of their cities
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_OCCUPIED.zh_Hans_CN: 我们占领了他们的一座城市

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_OCCUPIED_FRIEND.en_US: We occupy a city belonging to their friend or ally
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_OCCUPIED_FRIEND.zh_Hans_CN: 我们占领了属于他们朋友或盟友的城市

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_STATE_COMPETING.en_US: They are angry you are recruiting their city states
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_STATE_COMPETING.zh_Hans_CN: 他们很生气您正在拉拢他的城邦

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_STATE_NOT_COMPET.en_US: They are happy you are not competing over city states
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CITY_STATE_NOT_COMPET.zh_Hans_CN: 他们很高兴您没有争夺城邦

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CLOSE_TO_VICTORY.en_US: We are winning. They fear us.
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CLOSE_TO_VICTORY.zh_Hans_CN: 胜利即将属于我们。他们已经感到害怕。

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_COUNTER_REFORMER_ENCR.en_US: Philip is furious your religion is present in his empire
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_COUNTER_REFORMER_ENCR.zh_Hans_CN: 菲利普愤怒至极，因为您的宗教出现在了他的帝国里

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_COUNTER_REFORMER_SAME.en_US: Philip is happy you share a religion
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_COUNTER_REFORMER_SAME.zh_Hans_CN: 菲利普因与您拥有共同的宗教信仰而感到非常高兴

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CULTURE_BOMBED.en_US: We culture bombed one of their cities
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_CULTURE_BOMBED.zh_Hans_CN: 我们对他们的某座城市施放了文化炸弹。

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DECLARED_FRIENDSHIP_W.zh_Hans_CN: 已与一位敌人宣布友好
已与一位朋友宣布友好

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DECLARED_SURPRISE_WAR.en_US: Declared a surprise war on an enemy
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DECLARED_SURPRISE_WAR.zh_Hans_CN: 已向一位敌人宣布突袭战争

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DECLARED_SURPRISE_WAR.en_US: Declared a surprise war on a friend
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DECLARED_SURPRISE_WAR.zh_Hans_CN: 已向一位朋友宣布突袭战争

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DELEGATION.zh_Hans_CN: 我们向他们派遣了代表团

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DELIAN_COMPETING.en_US: Pericles is angry you are recruiting his city states
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DELIAN_COMPETING.zh_Hans_CN: 伯里克利很生气您在拉拢他的城邦

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DELIAN_NOT_COMPETING.en_US: Pericles is happy you are not competing over city states
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DELIAN_NOT_COMPETING.zh_Hans_CN: 伯里克利很高兴您没有争夺城邦

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DEMAND.en_US: We made a demand of them
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DEMAND.zh_Hans_CN: 我们对他们提出了一个索取要求

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_ATTACKS_B.en_US: They are pleased to see you clearing barbarian camps
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_ATTACKS_B.zh_Hans_CN: 他们很高兴看到您清理蛮族营地

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_DIFFERENT.en_US: They dislike your approach to governing
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_DIFFERENT.zh_Hans_CN: 他们讨厌您的统治方式

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_ENJOYS_WA.en_US: They like those who fight and win
LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_ENJOYS_WA.zh_Hans_CN: 他们喜欢那些打胜仗的人

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_EXPANSION.zh_Hans_CN: 他们喜欢豪占土地的帝国，讨厌不这么做的国家。

LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_EXPLOITAT.en_US: They are watching your progress on improving your territory

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: It is a deplorable thing to bully the weak.
Our ideological differences are only the beginning. I cannot approve of the way you govern your people...

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: I often wonder why you say so little. I believe you’ve nothing interesting to say.
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 我经常在想你的话为什么这么少。是因为没什么能说的吧。
你有什么权利可以将自己政治议程强加于我的文明？我绝不接受违背意愿的统治。

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: There is only so much to discover, and I'm afraid I cannot abide anyone who sets out ahead of my own explorers.
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 可探索的就这么点，恐怕我无法容忍任何人比我的探险家先出发。
我看透了你的糖衣炮弹和假惺惺的馈赠。你只不过是想为自己谋权，还想要各国亲自为你奉上无限权力。
我知道全世界都在争先恐后地前往你的旅游景点，但是你给我听好了！我的人民拥有精制的牛仔裤和狂野的摇滚乐，随时准备让世界大开眼界。
你的臣民胆敢亵渎神明，发表异端学说！你必须重拾真正的信仰才能挽救人民那堕落的灵魂！

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: There is no glory to keeping your feet on the ground. You should really try building an airforce.

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: What guides you? Surely, you cannot believe in nothing. Come, show your people the light!
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 是什么在引导您？当然，您肯定有自己的信仰。来，把光明带给您的国民吧！

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: You might want to look into a few more amenities for your citizens. I don't think they are enjoying your rule.
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 建议你调查下你们国家的宜居度。我认为你的国民并不满意你的统治。

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: Your people are lazy and unworthy. If you can produce nothing, your civilization will soon be forgotten.
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 你的国民又懒又蠢。如果你的国家生产不出任何东西，那你的文明将很快被遗忘。

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 核武器将主导未来！你竟然对此视而不见？
敌人向你发动了战争，但你却不愿意掠夺他们的土地作为报复。这到底是出于懦弱，还是过于礼貌？

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: There are so few people living in your empire. It must be hard to get anything done.
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 居住在你国家的人太少了。要想做成一件事很难。

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: You are not spending much time on research. How will your people keep up?
LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.zh_Hans_CN: 你花在科研上的时间不多。你的国民如何才能不被淘汰？

LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN.en_US: You have so few troops.  Aren't you scared for your life?

LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_ALT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A district that provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity. Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of an Aqueduct's production.

LOC_DISTRICT_NEIGHBORHOOD_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 基于单元格的魅力，您城市里的一个区域提供住房情况如下：[NEWLINE]惊艳的：+6 [ICON_Housing] 住房。[NEWLINE]迷人的：+5 [ICON_Housing] 住房。[NEWLINE]普通的：+4 [ICON_Housing] 住房。[NEWLINE]无吸引力的：+3 [ICON_Housing] 住房。[NEWLINE]令人厌恶的：+2 [ICON_Housing] 住房。

LOC_DISTRICT_ROYAL_NAVY_DOCKYARD_EXPANSI.en_US: A district unique to England for naval activity in your city. Replaces the Harbor district. Also removes the [ICON_Movement] Movement penalty for embarking and disembarking to and from this tile. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Movement] Movement for all naval units built in Dockyard[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +4 Loyalty per turn when built on a foreign continent. Cannot be built on Reef

LOC_DISTRICT_ROYAL_NAVY_DOCKYARD_GOLD.en_US: +{1_num} [ICON_Gold] Gold from the adjacent Royal Navy Dockyard district.
LOC_DISTRICT_ROYAL_NAVY_DOCKYARD_GOLD.zh_Hans_CN: 如靠近皇家海军造船厂区域+{1_num} [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_DISTRICT_SPACEPORT_DESCRIPTION_XP2.en_US: A district that is required to construct the Science Victory projects. This includes {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_EARTH_SATELLITE_NAME}, {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_MOON_LANDING_NAME}, {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_MARS_BASE_NAME}, and {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_EXOPLANET_EXPEDITION_NAME}. Cannot be built on Hills.

LOC_DISTRICT_STRATEGIC_PRODUCTION.zh_Hans_CN: 相邻战略资源提供+{1_num} [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

LOC_DISTRICT_STREET_CARNIVAL_CULTURE.zh_Hans_CN: 相邻街头狂欢节区域提供+{1_num} [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_DISTRICT_STREET_CARNIVAL_EXPANSION2_.en_US: A district unique to Brazil. Replaces the Entertainment Complex district, and provides +2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities. Also unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity when underway and a variety of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People points once completed. Cannot be built in a city with a Copacabana.

LOC_DISTRICT_SUGUBA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A district unique to Mali specializing in finance and trade that replaces the Commercial Hub. Units, Buildings, and Districts are 20% cheaper to purchase with [ICON_GOLD] Gold and [ICON_FAITH] Faith in this City.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold bonus for each adjacent Holy Site. +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold bonus from a tile containing a River edge. +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold bonus for every two adjacent district tiles.

LOC_DISTRICT_THEATER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A district in your city for cultural sites.
LOC_DISTRICT_THEATER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 您城市里的文化遗址区。

LOC_DISTRICT_TUNDRA_FAITH.en_US: +{1_num} [ICON_Faith] Faith from the adjacent Tundra {1_Num : plural 1?tile; other?tiles;}.
LOC_DISTRICT_TUNDRA_FAITH.zh_Hans_CN: +{1_num} [ICON_Faith] 信仰值来自相邻冻土{1_Num : plural 1?单元格; other?单元格;}。

LOC_DISTRICT_WATER_ENTERTAINMENT_COMPLEX.zh_Hans_CN: 建在海岸单元格上的区域，可增加 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，让人民生活幸福。无法建在拥有娱乐设施的城市中。无法建在礁石上。

LOC_DVP_TOOLTIP_OTHER_SOURCES.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_BOLT] 从奇观、科技和市政获得{1_Amount}点

LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile natural wonder that can be found on coastal terrain and provides +3 [ICON_Food] Food and +2 [ICON_Science] Science. Major adjacency bonus to the Campus district.
LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 位于海岸地貌上、占2个单元格的自然奇观，提供+3 [ICON_Food] 食物、+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。对学院区域提供大量相邻加成。

LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_QUOTE.en_US: “Organisms don't think of CO2 as a poison. Plants and organisms that make shells, coral, think of it as a building block.”[NEWLINE]– Janine Benyus
LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 微生物不认为二氧化碳是一种毒药。形成贝壳和珊瑚的植物与微生物把二氧化碳看作它们的基本成分。[NEWLINE]——珍妮·班娜斯

LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_SCIENCE.en_US: +{1_num} [ICON_SCIENCE] Science from the adjacent natural wonder Great Barrier Reef.
LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_SCIENCE.zh_Hans_CN: +{1_num} [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值，来自相邻自然奇观大堡礁。

LOC_FEATURE_CHOCOLATEHILLS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Four tile natural wonder. It provides +1 [ICON_Food] Food, +2 [ICON_Production] Production,  and +1 [ICON_Science] Science.

LOC_FEATURE_CHOCOLATEHILLS_QUOTE.en_US: “The wicked king pursued the lovers Juan and Maria on his swiftest horse. As he overtook them, Maria flung down her ring, and at once rose up seven tall hills, and the king was slowed.”[NEWLINE] - Filipino Folk Tale
LOC_FEATURE_CHOCOLATEHILLS_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 邪恶的国王骑着他最快的马匹，追赶着爱侣胡安与玛利亚。在他即将追上他们时，玛利亚将她的戒指抛向地面。七座巨人般高大的山丘随即冲破地面，国王不得不放缓追逐的脚步。[NEWLINE]——菲律宾民间传说

LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_QUOTE.en_US: “Under the White Cliff’s battlemented crown, Hushed to a depth of more than Sabbath peace.”[NEWLINE]– William Wordsworth
LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 在白色悬崖城垛上的王国政府里，一片寂静，比安息日还要寂静。[NEWLINE]——威廉·华兹华斯

LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_XP2_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile natural wonder. It appears with Cliffs adjacent to water and provides +3 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +2 [ICON_Food] Food, and +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Provides +4 appeal, instead of the standard +2 appeal of Natural Wonders, to adjacent tiles. Improvements cannot be placed on it.

LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: One tile natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides +5 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Science] Science, and Fresh Water.
LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 占1个单元格的自然奇观。其外观为湖泊，提供+5 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值，以及淡水。

LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_QUOTE.en_US: “Never again can I gaze upon the beauty spots of the Earth and enjoy them as being the finest thing I have ever seen. Crater Lake is above them all.”[NEWLINE]– Jack London
LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我再也没能看到地球上的美景，这些景色是我见过的最美好的事物。火山口湖是最美的景观。[NEWLINE]——杰克·伦敦

LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture. Units heal completely if they heal for one turn adjacent to the Dead Sea. Does not provide Fresh Water.
LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 占2个单元格的湖泊自然奇观，提供+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值及+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。单位相邻死海时选择恢复一回合，可在此期间完全恢复。不提供淡水。

LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_QUOTE.en_US: “Like to the apples on the Dead Sea’s shore, all ashes to the taste.”[NEWLINE]– Lord Byron
LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 就像死海海岸上的苹果，吃了一口，全是灰。[NEWLINE]——拜伦勋爵

LOC_FEATURE_DEVILSTOWER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: One tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +1 [ICON_Production] Production to adjacent tiles.

LOC_FEATURE_DEVILSTOWER_QUOTE.en_US: “Seven girls were chased by bears. The bears were just about to catch them when the girls jumped on a low rock. One of the girls prayed to the rock, "Rock take pity on us, rock save us!" The rock heard them and began to grow upwards, pushing the girls higher and higher.”[NEWLINE] - Kiowa Legend
LOC_FEATURE_DEVILSTOWER_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 七名少女正被熊群追逐。正当熊快要追上她们时，少女们纵身一跃，跳上了一块低矮的岩石。一名少女向岩石祈祷道：岩石啊，怜悯我们吧，救救我们吧！岩石随即便回应了她们的祈祷，拔地而起，将少女们送往天际。[NEWLINE]——基奥瓦传说

LOC_FEATURE_EVEREST_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Three tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles. Religious units who move next to Mount Everest ignore Hills for the rest of the game.
LOC_FEATURE_EVEREST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 占3个单元格的自然奇观，不可通行。使相邻单元格的产出+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。移动到珠穆朗玛峰附近的宗教单位可在之后的游戏中无视丘陵地貌的影响。

LOC_FEATURE_EVEREST_QUOTE.en_US: “It is not the mountain we conquer but ourselves.”[NEWLINE]– Sir Edmund Hillary
LOC_FEATURE_EVEREST_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我们征服的不是高山，而是自己。[NEWLINE]——埃德蒙·希拉里爵士

LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_DESERT_DESCRIPTI.en_US: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has flooded before, giving it more [ICON_Food] Food production than a usual Desert tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.
LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_DESERT_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 这是相邻江河的低洼地区，该流域曾经泛滥洪水，因此其比普通沙漠单元格的 [ICON_Food] 食物产量更高。如果江河再次泛滥洪水，该单元格中的建筑或区域会受损或被摧毁，但有几率获得额外产量。

LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_GRASSLAND_DESCRI.en_US: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has not yet flooded so it starts the game with the same yields as a flat Grasslands tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.
LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_GRASSLAND_DESCRI.zh_Hans_CN: 这是相邻江河的低洼地区，该流域未曾泛滥洪水，游戏开始时其与平地草原单元格的产量相同。如果江河泛滥洪水，该单元格中的建筑或区域会受损或被摧毁，但有几率获得额外产量。

LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_PLAINS_DESCRIPTI.en_US: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has not yet flooded so it starts the game with the same yields as a flat Plains tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.
LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_PLAINS_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 这是相邻江河的低洼地区，该流域未曾泛滥洪水，其在游戏开始时与平原单元格的产量相同。如果江河泛滥洪水，该单元格中的建筑或区域会受损或被摧毁，但有几率获得额外产量。

LOC_FEATURE_GALAPAGOS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile impassable natural wonder. It appears on coastal terrain and provides +2 [ICON_Science] Science to adjacent tiles.
LOC_FEATURE_GALAPAGOS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 不可逾越的2个单元格的自然奇观。它表现为海岸地形，为邻近单元格+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。

LOC_FEATURE_GALAPAGOS_QUOTE.en_US: “The natural history of this archipelago is very remarkable: it seems to be a little world within itself.”[NEWLINE]– Charles Darwin
LOC_FEATURE_GALAPAGOS_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 这个群岛的自然历史非常奇特：它好像自成一个小世界。[NEWLINE]——查尔斯·达尔文

LOC_FEATURE_GEOTHERMAL_FISSURE_DESCRIPTI.en_US: The ground in this area, probably located near a boundary between two continents, has been ruptured by subterranean geothermal activity. Heated water and steam escape from the ground here, making it ideal to place structures such as Aqueducts, Roman Baths, and Hungarian Thermal Baths nearby.
LOC_FEATURE_GEOTHERMAL_FISSURE_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 通常位于两块大陆板块之间的地区，地表由于地热活动而被破坏。温泉与蒸汽会从此处奔腾而出，使其周围十分合适修建水渠、罗马浴场和匈牙利温泉浴场。

LOC_FEATURE_GOBUSTAN_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Three tile natural wonder. It provides +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_Production] Production.

LOC_FEATURE_GOBUSTAN_QUOTE.en_US: “Then weave the web of the mystic measure;[NEWLINE]From the depths of the sky and the ends of the earth,[NEWLINE]Come, swift Spirits of might and of pleasure,[NEWLINE]Fill the dance and the music of mirth.”[NEWLINE] - Percy Bysshe Shelley
LOC_FEATURE_GOBUSTAN_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 接着便用神秘手法织成的网；[NEWLINE]从天空深处蔓延至大地尽头，[NEWLINE]来吧，那力量与欢愉的灵动幽冥，[NEWLINE]用舞蹈与歌声满布这世间。[NEWLINE]——珀西·比希·雪莱

LOC_FEATURE_IKKIL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: One tile impassable natural wonder. +50% [ICON_Production] Production when producing wonders and districts in adjacent tiles. It provides Fresh Water.

LOC_FEATURE_IKKIL_QUOTE.en_US: “Son, have you seen the rain of God? It passed and entered beneath the mountains of God... There will be a ring in the sky where the water of God has passed.”[NEWLINE] - Books of Chilam Balam
LOC_FEATURE_IKKIL_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 孩子，你见过天神之雨吗？雨水落下，浸入天神之山…天空中将出现一道圆环，天神之水便会从中缓缓流出。[NEWLINE]——《方士秘录》

LOC_FEATURE_KILIMANJARO_QUOTE.en_US: “As it turns out, Mount Kilimanjaro is not wi-fi enabled, so I had to spend two weeks in Tanzania talking to the people on my trip.”[NEWLINE]– Nancy Bonds
LOC_FEATURE_KILIMANJARO_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 事实证明乞力马扎罗山上没有WIFI，所以，旅行途中我花了两周时间在坦桑尼亚和人聊天。[NEWLINE]——南希·邦兹

LOC_FEATURE_KILIMANJARO_XP2_DESCRIPTION.en_US: One tile impassable natural wonder. It appears as a Volcano and provides +2 [ICON_Food] Food to adjacent tiles. On eruption it gives low yields and is most likely to damage improvements and buildings. Infrequently erupts, but is always active.

LOC_FEATURE_PAMUKKALE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile impassable natural wonder. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity. It provides an additional [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity if adjacent to an Entertainment Complex. Major adjacency bonus to Theater Square, Campus, and Commercial Hub districts. Standard adjacency bonus to the Holy Site district. It provides Fresh Water.

LOC_FEATURE_PAMUKKALE_QUOTE.en_US: “Near the Mesogis, opposite Laodicea, is Hierapolis, where are hot springs, and the Plutonium, both of which have some singular properties. The water of the springs is so easily consolidated and becomes stone, that if it is conducted through water-courses dams are formed consisting of a single piece of stone.”[NEWLINE] - Strabo
LOC_FEATURE_PAMUKKALE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 在美索吉旁，与劳迪希亚相对的便是希拉波利斯古城，那里盛产温泉，还有一座冥王神殿，而这两者的属性皆非同凡响。这里的泉水十分容易沉积为岩石。通过水道进行疏导后，这些泉水便可潺潺流出，形成一整片石堤。[NEWLINE]——斯特拉波

LOC_FEATURE_PANTANAL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Four tile natural wonder. Provides +2 [ICON_Food] Food and +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
LOC_FEATURE_PANTANAL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 占4个单元格的自然奇观。提供+2 [ICON_Food] 食物、+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_FEATURE_PANTANAL_QUOTE.en_US: “The Pantanal is the most complex intertropical alluvional plain of the planet and perhaps the least known area of the world.”[NEWLINE]– Aziz Ab’Saber
LOC_FEATURE_PANTANAL_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 潘塔纳尔湿地是世界上最复杂的热带冲积平原，可能也是最不为人所知的地方。[NEWLINE]——阿齐兹·萨比尔

LOC_FEATURE_PIOPIOTAHI_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Three tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold to adjacent tiles.
LOC_FEATURE_PIOPIOTAHI_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 不可逾越的3个单元格的自然奇观。为邻近单元格+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值和+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_FEATURE_PIOPIOTAHI_QUOTE.en_US: “But as I headed into the heart of New Zealand’s fiordland that same child-like feeling, long lost, of pure unadulterated awe came rushing back. I knew the road to Milford Sound was good – but this good?”[NEWLINE]– Darroch Donald
LOC_FEATURE_PIOPIOTAHI_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 但，当我进入新西兰峡湾中心时，我有了久违的孩童般的喜悦感，纯粹的敬畏感也涌入心底。我知道通往米尔福德峡湾的道路景色很美——但这岂止是美？[NEWLINE]——达罗克·唐纳德

LOC_FEATURE_TORRES_DEL_PAINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile impassable natural wonder. Doubles the terrain yields of all adjacent tiles.
LOC_FEATURE_TORRES_DEL_PAINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 不可逾越的2个单元格的自然奇观。所有邻近单元格的地形产量翻倍。

LOC_FEATURE_TORRES_DEL_PAINE_QUOTE.en_US: “Several closely situated granite peaks resembling tiger’s teeth dramatically soar about a kilometer into the sky”[NEWLINE]– Howard Hillman
LOC_FEATURE_TORRES_DEL_PAINE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 一些坐落在一起的花冈岩峰很像老虎的牙齿，高高耸入天空。[NEWLINE]——霍华德·希尔曼

LOC_FEATURE_TSINGY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: One tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_Science] Science to adjacent tiles.
LOC_FEATURE_TSINGY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 不可逾越的1个单元格的自然奇观。为邻近单元格+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值和+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值。

LOC_FEATURE_TSINGY_QUOTE.en_US: “Tsingy is a 250-square-mile tiger trap made up on massive obelisks riddled with jagged spears. And yes, they will cut your pretty face.”[NEWLINE]– Budd Erickson
LOC_FEATURE_TSINGY_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 泰斯尼是个占地647平方千米的老虎陷阱，由带有参差不齐长矛的巨大方尖碑组成。是的，它们会将你的漂亮脸蛋刺破。[NEWLINE]——巴德·埃里克森

LOC_FEATURE_VESUVIUS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: One tile impassable natural wonder. It appears as a Volcano and provides +1 [ICON_Production] Production to adjacent tiles. On Eruption it gives high yields to adjacent tiles, but large [ICON_Citizen] Population loss. It is always active.

LOC_FEATURE_VESUVIUS_QUOTE.en_US: “The sea seemed to roll back upon itself, and to be driven from its banks by the convulsive motion of the earth; it is certain at least the shore was considerably enlarged, and several sea animals were left upon it. On the other side, a black and dreadful cloud, broken with rapid, zigzag flashes, revealed behind it variously shaped masses of flame...”[NEWLINE] - Pliny the Younger
LOC_FEATURE_VESUVIUS_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 大海不断地拍打着自己，仿佛像是被大地的震动从海岸边驱赶开来；唯一可确定的是，海岸逐渐变得宽阔起来，众多海洋生物也被留在了沙滩之上。而在海平线的另一头，一团乌黑可怕的积云，裹挟着激烈凶猛的闪电，正揭示其背后那汹涌翻滚的火焰…[NEWLINE]——小普林尼

LOC_FEATURE_VOLCANIC_SOIL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: This land adjacent to a volcano has suffered from a previous eruption. Although people and structures may have been damaged, the rich deposits of minerals the volcano has brought forth have probably enhanced the yields here. Rebuilding in this area may therefore be worthwhile, especially if the volcano goes dormant.
LOC_FEATURE_VOLCANIC_SOIL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 这片靠近火山的土地曾经历一次喷发。尽管居民与建筑物都受到了损害，但火山带来了富含矿物质的沉积物，间接地提高了此处的产量。因此在这里进行重建工作十分有利，尤其是火山进入休眠状态时。

LOC_FEATURE_VOLCANO_DESCRIPTION.en_US: This mountain tile, probably located near a boundary between two continents, starts the game as an inactive volcanic site but may become active as the game progresses. Once active, beware -- an eruption could occur at any time. Volcanic eruptions damage features and structures in adjacent tiles but may also leave behind volcanic soil that boosts the yields from that location.
LOC_FEATURE_VOLCANO_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 此山脉单元格最常出现在两块大陆之间的边缘地区。在游戏伊始时为非活跃火山区域，但随着游戏的发展，其可能进入活跃状态。请注意，一旦进入活跃状态，火山可能会随时喷发。火山喷发会损害相邻单元格中的地貌与建筑物，但留下的火山土能提升该地区的产量。

LOC_FEATURE_WHITEDESERT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Four tile natural wonder. It provides +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture,  and +4 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.

LOC_FEATURE_WHITEDESERT_QUOTE.en_US: “I have filled a water-bag from my people and gone to the desert,[NEWLINE]And walked empty wastes while the wolf howled, like a gambler whose family starves.”[NEWLINE] - Imru-ul-Quais
LOC_FEATURE_WHITEDESERT_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 我从子民那盛满甘泉，走向那炙热的沙漠，[NEWLINE]伴随着野狼的嚎叫，我走在荒芜的土地，犹如那离家的赌徒，弃饥饿的妻儿于不顾。[NEWLINE]——伊姆鲁-乌尔-夸伊斯阿拉伯古诗

LOC_FEATURE_YOSEMITE_QUOTE.en_US: “Yosemite Valley, to me, is always a sunrise, a glitter of green and golden wonder in a vast edifice of stone and space.”[NEWLINE]– Ansel Adams
LOC_FEATURE_YOSEMITE_QUOTE.zh_Hans_CN: 对我来说，约塞米蒂谷是在石头和空间组成的巨大建筑物上形成的一个永远有日出、闪着绿光的金色奇迹。[NEWLINE]——安塞尔·亚当斯

LOC_FEATURE_YOSEMITE_XP2_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Two tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold, +1 [ICON_Food] Food,  and +1 [ICON_Science] Science to adjacent tiles.

LOC_GAMESPEED_ONLINE_HELP.en_US: Double-speed game used for online multiplayer.
LOC_GAMESPEED_ONLINE_HELP.zh_Hans_CN: 用于在线多人模式的双倍速游戏

LOC_GOSSIP_SOURCE_HIGHLEVEL_SPY.en_US: Your Spy, {1_Name}, found documents revealing that
LOC_GOSSIP_SOURCE_HIGHLEVEL_SPY.zh_Hans_CN: 您的间谍{1_Name}找到的相关文件揭示了

LOC_GOSSIP_SOURCE_TECH.en_US: A recent news article revealed that
LOC_GOSSIP_SOURCE_TECH.zh_Hans_CN: 最近一篇新闻报道揭露了

LOC_GOSSIP_SOURCE_TRAIT.en_US: Your lady-in-waiting, {1_Name}, heard at the court ball that
LOC_GOSSIP_SOURCE_TRAIT.zh_Hans_CN: 您的侍女，{1_Name}，在宫廷舞会上听说

LOC_GOVT_ACCUMULATED_BONUS_BRIEF_DEMOCRA.zh_Hans_CN: 使用 [ICON_Gold] 金币购买时费用-15%。

LOC_GOVT_ACCUMULATED_BONUS_BRIEF_THEOCRA.zh_Hans_CN: 使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买可享受15%折扣。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_AUTOCRACY_XP1.en_US: +1 to all yields for each government building and palace in a city.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_AUTOCRACY_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 城市中的每个政体建筑和宫殿将使所有产量+1。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_CLASSREP_XP1.en_US: All cities with a district receive +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing and +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_CLASSREP_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有区域的所有城市+1 [ICON_Housing] 住房、+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_COMMUNISM_XP1.en_US: +0.6 [ICON_Production] Production per [ICON_Citizen] Citizen in cities with [ICON_Governor] Governors.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_COMMUNISM_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有 [ICON_Governor] 总督的城市中每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民将提供0.6点 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_CORPORATE_LIBERT.en_US: Commercial Hubs and Encampments provide cities with +10% [ICON_Production] Production, and accumulating resources with improvements provide +1 per turn.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_CORPORATE_LIBERT.zh_Hans_CN: 商业中心与军营向城市提供+10% [ICON_Production] 生产力；改良设施产出的资源每回合+1。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_DEMOCRACY_XP2.en_US: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to an Ally or Suzerain's city provide +4 [ICON_Food] Food and +4 [ICON_Production] Production for both cities. Alliance Points with all allies increase by an additional .25 per turn.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_DEMOCRACY_XP2.zh_Hans_CN: 您通往盟友或宗主国城市的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线为双边城市+4 [ICON_Food] 食物、+4 [ICON_Production] 生产力。所有盟友的同盟点数每回合额外增加0.25点。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_DIGITAL_DEMOCRAC.en_US: +2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities in all cities, and +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture per Specialty District.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_DIGITAL_DEMOCRAC.zh_Hans_CN: 所有城市+2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，每个特色区域+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_FASCISM_XP1.en_US: All units gain +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength.  War Weariness reduced by 15%.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_FASCISM_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 所有单位+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。厌战情绪降低15%。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_MERCHREP_XP1.en_US: +10% [ICON_GOLD] Gold in all cities with an established  [ICON_Governor] Governor.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_MERCHREP_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 所有 [ICON_Governor] 总督就职城市产出的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币+10%。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_MONARCHY_XP1.en_US: +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing per level of Walls. +2 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor for every Renaissance Wall.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_MONARCHY_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 城墙每拥有一个等级，则+1 [ICON_Housing] 住房。每有一座文艺复兴城墙，则+2 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_OLIGARCHY_XP1.en_US: All land melee, anti-cavalry, and naval melee class units gain +4 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_OLIGARCHY_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 所有陆地近战、抗骑兵和海军近战类单位 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力+4。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_SYNTHETIC_TECHNO.en_US: +3 [ICON_Power] Power in all cities, and +30% [ICON_Production] Production towards all city projects.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_SYNTHETIC_TECHNO.zh_Hans_CN: 所有城市+3点 [ICON_Power] 电力；建造所有城市项目时 [ICON_Production] 生产力+30%。

LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_THEOCRACY_XP1.en_US: +5 [ICON_Religion] Religious Strength in Theological Combat.[NEWLINE]+0.5 [ICON_Faith] Faith per [ICON_Citizen] Citizen in cities with [ICON_Governor] Governors.
LOC_GOVT_INHERENT_BONUS_THEOCRACY_XP1.zh_Hans_CN: 神学战争中+5 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Governor] 总督就职的城市中每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民将+0.5点 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。

LOC_GREATPERSON_COMBAT_STRENGTH_AOE_LAND.zh_Hans_CN: 大将军的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗加成+5

LOC_GREATPERSON_COMBAT_STRENGTH_AOE_SEA_.zh_Hans_CN: 海军统帅的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗加成+5。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_AIRSTRIP_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct an Airstrip.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Can support 3 air units. Can only be built on flat terrain. -1 Appeal.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_AIRSTRIP_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁军事工程师建造飞机跑道的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]能放置3个空中单位。只能建在平坦地貌上。-1魅力。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_BARBARIAN_CAMP_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Creates additional Barbarians.[ICON_Gold] Gold award if destroyed. -1 Appeal
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_BARBARIAN_CAMP_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 创建额外的蛮族。摧毁后将奖励 [ICON_Gold] 金币。-1魅力。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_BEACH_RESORT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Seaside Resorts.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides [ICON_Tourism] Tourism equal to the tile's Appeal. Can only be built on Coastal Desert, Coastal Plains, or Coastal Grassland tiles. Minimum Appeal of Breathtaking.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_BEACH_RESORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造海滨度假区的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]提供等于此单元格魅力的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。只能建在海岸沙漠、海岸平原，或海岸草原单元格上。所在单元格魅力必须达到惊艳以上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CAMP_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Camps.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CAMP_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造营地的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。只能在有效资源上建造。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如建在奢侈品资源上，城市则能利用该资源。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CHATEAU_EXPANSION2_DESCR.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Château, unique to France.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1  [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 Appeal. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture for every adjacent wonder (becomes +2 after researching Flight). +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold if on a tile containing a River edge. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from [ICON_CULTURE] Culture after researching Flight. Must be placed adjacent to a Bonus or Luxury resource. Cannot be built adjacent to another Château.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CITY_PARK_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A [ICON_Governor] Governor unique improvement that can be built in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Parks and Recreation promotion. Yields 2 Appeal and 1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity if adjacent to water. +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the  Parks and Recreation promotion. Cannot be adjacent to another City Park.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CITY_PARK_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Governor] 总督特色改良设施，可在“测量师”总督（必须拥有“公园与休憩”升级）就职的城市中修建。产出2点魅力和1点 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。如与水域相邻，则+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。“测量师”总督（必须拥有“公园与休憩”升级）在城市就职时，+3 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。无法建在另一个市立公园旁。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_COLOSSAL_HEAD_EXPANSION2.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Colossal Head.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest or for every adjacent Rainforest once Humanism is discovered. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Woods or for every adjacent Woods once Humanism is discovered. [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from [ICON_FAITH] Faith once Flight is researched. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_COLOSSAL_HEAD_EXPANSION2.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造巨神头像的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。与每2个雨林相邻+1信仰值，而解锁“人文主义”市政后与每1个雨林相邻便能+1信仰值。与每2个树林相邻+1信仰值，而解锁“人文主义”市政后与每1个树林相邻便能+1信仰值。研究“飞行”科技后可通过 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值获得 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。无法建在雪地或雪地丘陵上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FARM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Farms.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] Food. Can only be built on Grassland or Plains.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Constructing farms adjacent to other Farms provides bonuses to Housing.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FARM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造农场的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。只能建在草原或平原上。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]农场与农场相邻，能提供住房加成。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FISHERY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A [ICON_Governor] Governor unique improvement that can be built in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Aquaculture promotion. Yields 1 [ICON_Food] Food, +0.5 [ICON_Housing] Housing, +1 additional [ICON_Food] Food if adjacent to a sea resource. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Aquaculture promotion. Must be built on a coastal plot.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FISHERY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Governor] 总督特色改良设施，可在“测量师”总督（必须拥有“水产养殖”升级）就职的城市中修建。产出1点 [ICON_Food] 食物；如与海洋资源相邻，则额外+1 [ICON_Food] 食物、+0.5 [ICON_Housing] 住房。“测量师”总督（必须拥有“水产养殖”升级）在城市就职时，+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。必须建在海岸格位上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FISHING_BOATS_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Fishing Boats.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] Food. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FISHING_BOATS_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造渔船的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。只能在有效资源上建造。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果建在奢侈品资源上，城市则可以利用该资源。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FORT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Occupying unit receives +4 [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 进驻单位+4 [ICON_Strength] 防御力，并自动获得两回合驻扎加成。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_GEOTHERMAL_PLANT_DESCRIP.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Geothermal Plant.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Science] Science. +2 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 4 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on a Geothermal Fissure.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_GEOTHERMAL_PLANT_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造地热发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1点 [ICON_Science] 科技值；+2点 [ICON_Production] 生产力。每回合提供4点 [ICON_Power] 电力。必须建在地热裂缝之上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_GREAT_WALL_EXPANSION2_DE.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct the Great Wall, unique to China.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Provides an increase to [ICON_Strength] Defense. Bonus to [ICON_Gold] Gold if adjacent to other segments. Additional [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism as you advance through the Technology Tree for adjacent segments. Must be built in a line along the borders of your empire. Can only be pillaged (never destroyed) by natural disasters.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ICE_HOCKEY_RINK_DESCRIPT.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Ice Hockey Rink, unique to Canada.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent Tundra, Tundra Hills, Snow, and Snow Hills tile. Provides [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from Culture once Flight is unlocked. +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food and [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production once the Professional Sports civic is unlocked. +4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if adjacent to a Stadium building. Can be built on Tundra, Tundra Hills, Snow, and Snow Hills. One per city. +2 Appeal.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_KURGAN_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Kurgan, unique to Scythia.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for each adjacent Pasture (becomes +2 after researching Stirrups). Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from [ICON_FAITH] Faith after researching Flight. Cannot be built on Hills.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_KURGAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造塞西亚特色建筑坟墩的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、+3 [ICON_Gold] 金币。每与一座牧场相邻便+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值（研究完“马镫”后提升为+2）。研究完“飞行”之后将根据 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。不能建在丘陵上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_LUMBER_MILL_EXPANSION2_D.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Lumber Mill.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Production] Production. Can only be built on Woods. Once Mercantilism is unlocked it can also be built on Rainforest.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_LUMBER_MILL_EXPANSION2_D.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造伐木场的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。只能建在树林上。解锁“重商主义”市政后也能建造雨林上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MAORI_PA_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Toa ability to construct a Pā, unique to Māori.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Occupying unit receives +4 [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification. A Māori unit occupying a Pā heals even if they just moved or attacked. Must be built on a Hill tile.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Mines.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. -1 Appeal. Can be built on hills or valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury or Strategic resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造矿山的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。-1魅力。只能在丘陵或有效资源上建造。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果建在奢侈品资源或战略资源上，城市则可以利用该资源。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MISSILE_SILO_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct a Missile Silo.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acts as a launch site for Nuclear and Thermonuclear Devices.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MISSILE_SILO_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁军事工程师能力来建造导弹发射井。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]作为核装置和热核装置的发射地。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MISSION_EXPANSION2_DESCR.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Mission, unique to Spain.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, and +1 [ICON_FOod] Food if on a different continent than your [ICON_Capital] Capital. +1 [ICON_Science] Science for every adjacent Campus and Holy Site district. Additional [ICON_SCIENCE] Science once Cultural Heritage is discovered. +2 Loyalty per turn for cities with a Mission improvement adjacent to the City Center and not on your original [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOAI_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Moai.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture for every 2 adjacent Moai. +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture if on or adjacent to a Volcanic Soil tile. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture if adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile . Additional [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree. Can be built on Plains, Plains Hills, Grassland, Grassland Hills, or Volcanic Soil. Cannot be placed adjacent to a Woods or Rainforest tile.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOAI_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造摩艾石像的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。每2个相邻的摩艾石像+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。位于火山土单元格之上或与其相邻时，+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。与海岸或湖泊单元格相邻时，+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。随着市政与科技树的发展，可获得额外的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值与 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。可建在平原、平原丘陵、草原、草原丘陵或火山土之上。无法建在与树林或雨林相邻的单元格上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUND_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Cahokia Mounds.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Cities receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from their first Cahokia Mound improvement. Upon discovering Natural History, cities receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from their second Cahokia Mound improvement. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every 2 adjacent Districts once Feudalism is discovered or for every adjacent District once Replaceable Parts is researched. Provides +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. Receive an additional [ICON_HOUSING] Housing once Cultural Heritage is discovered. Cannot be built adjacent to other Cahokia Mounds.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUND_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造“卡霍基亚土墩”的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。城市建造首座卡霍基亚土墩改良设施可提供+1点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。发现“自然历史”后，城市建造的第二座卡霍基亚土墩改良设施可提供+1点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。发现“封建主义”后，每2个相邻区域+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；或研究“可更换部件”后，每个相邻区域+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。提供+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房；发现“文化遗产”后，可额外获得1点 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。无法建造在另一个卡霍基亚土墩旁。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUNTAIN_ROAD_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Qhapaq Ñan, unique to Pachacuti.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acts as a movement portal on a mountain range, allowing units to move into it and exit from another portal at the cost of 2 [ICON_Movement] Movement. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination. Can only be built on an adjacent Mountain tile. Cannot be pillaged or removed.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUNTAIN_TUNNEL_DESCRIPT.en_US: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct a Mountain Tunnel.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acts as a movement portal on a mountain range, allowing units to move into it and exit from another portal at the cost of 2 [ICON_Movement] Movement. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination. Can only be built on an adjacent Mountain tile. Cannot be pillaged or removed.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUNTAIN_TUNNEL_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁军事工程师建造“穿山隧道”的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]其用作山脉地形上的移动通道，单位可消耗2点 [ICON_Movement] 移动力从一个点进入，再从另一个点走出。如 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线途径此处，其将从目的地的区域处获得成倍 [ICON_Gold] 金币。只能建在与山脉相邻的单元格上。无法被掠夺或移除。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_NAZCA_LINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Nazca Line.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles with a resource. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food to adjacent Desert and Desert Hill tiles after discovering Civil Service. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to adjacent flat tiles after researching Mass Production. +1 Appeal. Can only be built on flat Desert. This tile cannot be worked .
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_NAZCA_LINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造纳斯卡巨画的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]相邻的单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值；拥有资源的相邻单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。发现“行政部门”后，相邻的沙漠、沙漠丘陵单元格+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。研究“大量生产”后，相邻的平原单元格+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；同时+1魅力。仅能建在沙漠平原上。此单元格无法进行改良。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OFFSHORE_OIL_RIG_DESCRIP.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Oil Rig.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-1 Appeal. Can only be built on Coast or Lake tiles with [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OFFSHORE_OIL_RIG_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造海上石油钻机的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-1魅力。只能建在拥有 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油的海岸或湖泊单元格上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OFFSHORE_WIND_FARM_DESCR.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on Coast or Lake terrain.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OFFSHORE_WIND_FARM_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造离岸风力发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。每回合提供2点 [ICON_Power] 电力。必须建在海岸或湖泊地貌上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OIL_WELL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Oil Well.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-1 Appeal. Can only be built on land tiles with[ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OIL_WELL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造油井的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]只能建在拥有 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油的陆地单元格上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OPEN_AIR_MUSEUM_DESCRIPT.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Open-Air Museum, unique to Sweden.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +2 Loyalty per turn in this city. +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +2 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism for each type of terrain (Snow, Tundra, Desert, Plains or Grassland) in which at least one Swedish city is founded. One per city. Tiles with Open-Air Museums cannot be swapped.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_PASTURE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Pastures.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Strategic resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_PASTURE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造牧场的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。只能在有效资源上建造。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果建在战略资源上，城市则可以利用该资源。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_PLANTATION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Plantations.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_PLANTATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造种植园的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。只能在有效资源上建造。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果建在奢侈品资源上，城市则可以利用该资源。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_QUARRY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Quarries.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. -1 Appeal. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on a Luxury resource, the city will gain use of that resource.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_QUARRY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造采石场的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。-1魅力。只能在有效资源上建造。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果建在奢侈品资源上，城市则可以利用该资源。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ROMAN_FORT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Roman Legion ability to construct a Roman Fort, unique to Rome.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Occupying unit receives +4 [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ROMAN_FORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁罗马军团的能力来建造罗马特色堡垒。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]占领单位+4 [ICON_Strength] 防御力，并自动获得两回合防御工事。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SEASTEAD_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Seastead.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food. +1 [ICON_Production] Production for each adjacent Fishing Boats. Fishing Boats receive +1 [ICON_Production] Production for each adjacent Seastead. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism for every adjacent Reef. +2 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. Must be built on Coast, Lake or Ocean terrain. Cannot be placed adjacent to another Seastead.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SEASTEAD_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造“海洋家园”的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。相邻的每条渔船+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。每个相邻的海洋家园向渔船提供+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。每个相邻的礁石+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值与 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。+2 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。必须建在海岸、湖泊或海洋地貌上。无法建在另一个海洋家园旁。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SKI_RESORT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Ski Resort.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +4 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. Provides an [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity. Can only be built on a Mountain. Cannot be built adjacent to another Ski Resort. Cannot be pillaged, worked or removed.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SKI_RESORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造滑雪场的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+4 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。提供1点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。只能建在山脉上。无法与另一座滑雪场相邻。无法被掠夺、改良或移除。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SOLAR_FARM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Solar Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on flat terrain. Cannot be built on Snow.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SOLAR_FARM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造太阳能农场的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币；+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。每回合提供2点 [ICON_Power] 电力。必须建在平坦地貌上。无法建造在雪地上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SPHINX_EXPANSION2_DESCRI.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Sphinx, unique to Egypt.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. +2 Appeal. +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith if next to a wonder. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if built on Floodplains. Additional [ICON_CULTURE] Culture once Natural History is discovered. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be built next to another Sphinx. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_STEPWELL_EXPANSION2_DESC.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Stepwell, unique to India.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] Food and +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith if adjacent to a Holy Site district. +1 [ICON_Food] Food if adjacent to a Farm. Additional [ICON_Housing] Housing, [ICON_Faith] Faith, and [ICON_Food] Food as you advance through the Technology and Civics Tree. Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Cannot be built on Hills or adjacent to another Stepwell.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_TERRACE_FARM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Terrace Farm, unique to the Inca.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food. Provides +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Mountain Tile. Gain +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for each adjacent Aqueduct district. Receive +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if adjacent to Fresh Water and not an Aqueduct district. Additional [ICON_FOOD] Food as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree for adjacency with other Terrace Farms. Can be placed on Grassland Hills, Plains Hills, and Desert Hills.

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_WIND_FARM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on Hills terrain.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_WIND_FARM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造风力发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币；+1点 [ICON_Production] 生产力。每回合提供2点 [ICON_Power] 电力。必须建在丘陵地貌上。

LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ZIGGURAT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Ziggurat, unique to Sumeria.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Science] Science. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture if next to River. Cannot be built on Hills.
LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ZIGGURAT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 解锁建造者建造苏美尔特色金字形神塔的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。如果紧挨着河流，+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。不能建在丘陵上。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_1_CHAP.en_US: There are four main types of air units: support reconnaissance, support defense, fighters, and strategic bombers. These can be produced in any city that has built an Aerodrome and researched the prerequisite technologies.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_1_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 空中单位有四种主要类型：支援侦察、支援防御、战斗机、战略轰炸机。这些单位可在已建立了空港并研究了必要技术的城市进行生产。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_2_CHAP.en_US: Air units do not move around the map like ground and naval units. They must be "based" somewhere. The City Center can always hold one air unit, but building an Aerodrome, Airstrip, or Aircraft Carrier can increase your available slots. The Aerodrome can have up to 8 slots, the Airstrip 3, and the Aircraft Carrier begins with 2 but can gain more through promotions.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_2_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 与地面和海军单位不同，空中单位不会在地图上移动。它们必须“驻扎”在某处。市中心可以放置一个空中单位，但建造一个航空港、飞机跑道，或航空母舰则能增可用的槽位。航空港最多可有8个槽位，3个飞机跑道，航空母舰一开始就能有2个槽位，并能通过强化获得更多。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_3_CHAP.en_US: Fighter aircraft can be deployed to a valid hex within their [ICON_Movement] Movement range from a friendly air base. After it is deployed, the aircraft will begin flying an orbiting pattern around its effective intercept range (currently 1 hex radius). This should make it more clear to both the attacker and defender the status of the Fighters in the Patrol state.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_3_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 从友好空军基地开始，把战斗机部署在 [ICON_Movement] 移动力范围内的有效格位上。部署完成后，飞机会环绕它的有效拦截距离（目前是1个格位半径范围）按照轨道运行模式进行飞行。这会让袭击者和防御者更清楚地看到处于巡逻状态的战斗机状态。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_3_CHAP.en_US: The Patrol state is continuing, somewhat like the 'Fortify' unit operation. Once an aircraft has been set to Patrol it will do so until it is ordered otherwise or it is destroyed. While Patrolling, the aircraft will continue to intercept and defend against multiple attackers.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_3_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 巡逻状态会持续，有点像“驻扎”单位操作。一旦设置飞机进行巡逻，它会一直执行此操作，直到得到其他命令指示，或被摧毁。飞机巡逻时会继续拦截和抵御多类攻击。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_3_CHAP.en_US: At any time during the player's turn, Fighter aircraft can 'Return to Base' (station at a friendly air base) in order to heal. Aircraft stationed at an air base do not intercept attacking aircraft. Aircraft can heal at the end of the game turn when stationed on a City Center, Aerodrome, Airstrip, or Aircraft Carrier only if they have not been involved in combat. Healing is 'fastest' on an Aerodrome district, and less so on Airstrips and Carriers. These values can be increased through promotions and/or Policies.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_3_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 在玩家回合中的任何时候，为了治愈，战斗机能‘返回基地’（驻扎在一个友军空军基地）。驻扎在空军基地的飞机不会拦截攻击机。只有当飞机驻扎在一个未参战的市中心、航空港、飞机跑道，或航空母舰时，它能在游戏回合结束时进行治愈。驻扎在航空港的时候治愈速度是最快的，位于飞机跑道和航空母舰时，速度则会慢一些。通过强化或政策能提升这些数值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_4_CHAP.en_US: Heavy Bomber aircraft cannot deploy on Patrols, but they are instead considered 'stationed' at a friendly air base and can carry out attacks from that base. Unlike Fighter aircraft, Bombers do not engage in dogfighting, but they head straight for their target and attack.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategic Bombing: Bomber aircraft can attack district buildings and city improvements directly, if no land unit currently occupies the target location. When successful, the result of this type of attack is the same as a ground unit Pillage action with one exception - the attacking air unit does not get the resulting benefit from the pillage action. In order for a bombing attack to be successful, the attacking air unit must be at 50% health or higher after resolving any damage taken from defending fighter aircraft and anti-air support units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Priority Target: Air units also have the Priority Target ability which allows them to attack Support class units directly, without first having to eliminate the enemy combat unit placed in the same location.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_4_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 重型轰炸机无法进行巡逻，它们将“驻扎”在一个友方空军基地中，并从该基地发动袭击。和战斗机不同，轰炸机不直接参加空战，而是直奔目标发动攻击。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]战略轰炸：如当前无地面单位占据目标位置，轰炸机可直接对区域建筑和城市改良设施发动攻击。成功发动攻击产生的效果等于地面单位的掠夺行动，唯一不同是发动攻击的空中单位无法获得掠夺行动的收益。遭防御战斗机和防空支援单位攻击后，空中攻击单位的生命值必须高于50%才能形成有效轰炸。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]优先目标：空中单位还拥有“优先目标”能力，可直接攻击敌方支援单位，无需先消灭位于同一位置的敌方战斗单位。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_5_CHAP.en_US: Fighters can be deployed to a location on the map within range where they will patrol the adjacent plots.  If an air unit tries an air strike against a target within the range of an intercepting unit, the interceptor will fire on the attacker and do damage to it.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If an attacking aircraft enters the defensive radius of more than one patrolling aircraft, the highest strength aircraft is chosen to intercept. The remaining aircraft act in support of the defense by adding +5 to the strength of the main interceptor.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Once combat is resolved with any anti-air ground units and intercepting air units, if the attacking bomber survives, combat is then resolved with the original target. If a fighter is intercepted by another fighter on its way to a ground target, it is forced to only engage the enemy fighter and will not attack the ground target. Bombers do not have this restriction, and will continue to the target if they survives any defending interceptors and anti-air attacks.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_AIRCOMBAT_5_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 战斗机可部署在地图上的某个位置，并在附近一定范围内的单元格中巡逻。如果一个空中单位尝试对处于拦截范围中的目标发动攻击，拦截机将对攻击者发起反击并对其造成伤害。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如发起进攻的飞机进入多个巡逻飞机的防御半径，战斗力最强的巡逻机将起飞进行拦截。其余巡逻机则会为主拦截机+5战斗力，提升其防御力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]地面防空单位和空中拦截单位攻击完成后，如果发动进攻的轰炸机仍存活，则其将继续对原定目标执行轰炸。如一架战斗机在进攻地面目标的途中遭另一架战斗机拦截，则其被迫与拦截的地方战斗机进行空战，无法对地面目标进行攻击。而轰炸机则不受此限制，只要它们在拦截机和防空火力的攻击下幸存，均会继续对地面目标进行轰炸。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_ALLIANCES_1_CHAP.en_US: Alliances are a relationship between two different civilizations, a mutual agreement to work together in some way. To enter into an Alliance, you must first be Declared Friends with the civilization, and both civilizations must have researched the Civil Service civic.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There are several Alliance types, each one provides different mutual benefits according to its type. The effects of these levels are cumulative, so if you are in a Level 3 Alliance, you also gain the Level 1 and Level 2 effects. When you are in an Alliance with another Player, you gain Alliance Points every turn.  Collecting enough increases your Alliance Level, resulting in more benefits from your Alliances.  You can increase the rate at which you gain Alliance Points by trading with your Ally.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Every Alliance, regardless of its type, provides Open Borders and a Defensive Pact to both parties. Members of an Alliance cannot declare war on each other.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You may have only one kind of alliance with another civilization, and once you have created that alliance, you cannot have it with another civilization, although you might have another kind of alliance with them. For example, you might have a Research Alliance with Korea, so you cannot make a new Research Alliance with the Cree. You might create a Military, Cultural, Religious, or Economic Alliance with the Cree, however. Note that this limits you to five total Alliances in a game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Research Alliance[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 1: [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes between allies grant additional [ICON_Science] Science.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 2: Allies share 1 Tech Boost every 30 turns (on Standard Speed).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 3: Gives bonus [ICON_Science] Science when studying the same technology as your ally or one that your ally has completed, and while your ally is researching a tech you have completed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cultural Alliance[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 1: Allies do not exert Loyalty pressure on each other, and [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes between allies grant additional [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 2: When your cities have [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes with your ally, gain additional [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person points in the origin cities based off of the districts in those cities.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 3: You gain a portion of your ally’s [ICON_Tourism] Tourism and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Military Alliance[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 1: Allies gain bonus [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength against civilizations on whom both allies have declared war.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 2: Allies share visibility and gain bonus [ICON_Production] Production toward military units when either ally is at war.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 3: Units start with a bonus promotion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Religious Alliance[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 1: Ally cities do not exert Religious pressure on each other, and [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes between allies grant additional [ICON_Faith] Faith.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 2: Allies gain [ICON_Religion] religious Combat Strength against Religions not founded by either ally.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 3: You gain Faith based on the number of your [ICON_Citizen] Citizens following your ally’s Religion, and bonus Religious Pressure in cities with no followers of your ally's Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Economic Alliance[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 1: [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes between allies grant additional [ICON_Gold] Gold.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 2: Gain an [ICON_ENVOY] Envoy point for every City-State with your Ally as Suzerain.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Level 3: Allies share the Suzerain bonus of all city-states of which they are Suzerain.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_ALLIANCES_1_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 同盟是两个不同文明间相互协商、在某方面进行合作的一种关系。结为同盟之前双方必须首先宣布友谊，且均已完成市政“行政部门”的研究。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]同盟类型有数种，提供的益处皆有所不同。与其他玩家处于同盟关系时，每回合将获得同盟点数。获得足够的点数后同盟等级将提升，产生更多益处。与盟友进行贸易可提升获得的同盟点数。同盟等级效果叠加计算，如果处于第3级同盟，则也会获得第1级和第2级效果。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每种同盟均会使双方开放边界并共同防御。盟友之间无法宣战。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]您只能和其他文明结成一种同盟。一旦结成一类同盟，则无法与其他文明再次结成此类同盟，但可与之结成其他类型的同盟。举例而言，您与朝鲜结成研究同盟后便无法再与克里结成研究同盟，但却可以与其建立军事、文化、宗教或经济同盟。注意，游戏中最多只能结缔5个同盟。[NEWLINE]研究同盟[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第1级：盟友之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可产出更多 [ICON_Science] 科技值。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第2级：盟友每30回合共享1个科技提升（标准速度下）。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第3级：与盟友研究相同科技、或研究盟友已研究完成的科技时获得 [ICON_Science] 科技值加成；盟友已研究您完成的科技时也可获得科技值加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]文化同盟[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第1级：盟友之间不会相互施加忠诚度压力；盟友之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可产出更多 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第2级：城市与盟友之间存在 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线时，将根据起源城市中建造的区域获得更多 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第3级：您将获得盟友城市产出的部分 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩和 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]军事同盟[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第1级：与双方盟友均已宣战的文明作战时将获得 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力加成。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第2级：盟友之间共享能见度；其中一个盟友处于战争状态时，双方生产军事单位时都将获得 [ICON_Production] 生产力加成。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第3级：单位初始便拥有一次奖励升级。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宗教同盟[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第1级：不会对盟友的城市释放宗教压力；盟友之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可产出更多 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第2级：与非盟友创建的其他宗教进行宗教战争时获得 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力加成。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第3级：基于信仰盟友宗教的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民数量获得信仰值；在没有盟友宗教信徒的城市中获得奖励宗教压力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]经济同盟[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第1级：盟友之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可产出更多 [ICON_Gold] 黄金。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第2级：每个视盟友为宗主国的城邦将提供一点[ICON_ENVOY]使者点数。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 第3级：盟友之间共享双方获得的全部城邦宗主国加成。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.en_US: In Civilization VI, buildings are no longer trapped in your City Center, but may sprawl across your territory as part of districts. The map is more important than ever as you are faced with important strategic placement decisions. The Campus and Holy Site each receive special boosts from placement near Mountain tiles, but the Campus also benefits from a nearby Rainforest tile.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 在《文明VI》中，建筑将不再挤在城市中心，但其会作为区域的一部分遍布在整个领土上。地图对于重要战略位置的选择至关重要。放置在山脉单元格附近的学院和圣地将获得特殊提升，但前者也将受益于附近的雨林单元格。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.en_US: A city must expand its [ICON_Citizen] Population before it can construct multiple districts:[NEWLINE]• 1 [ICON_Citizen] Population for 1 District[NEWLINE]• 4 [ICON_Citizen] Population for 2 Districts[NEWLINE]• 7 [ICON_Citizen] Population for 3 Districts[NEWLINE]• Each additional District requires +3 [ICON_Citizen] Population[NEWLINE]The Aqueduct, Neighborhoods, and Spaceports ignore this [ICON_Citizen] Population requirement. Districts which require a certain number of [ICON_Citizen] Population are specialty districts.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 城市必须扩大 [ICON_Citizen] 人口才能建造多个区域：[NEWLINE]• 1个区域需要1 [ICON_Citizen] 人口[NEWLINE]• 2个区域需要4 [ICON_Citizen] 人口[NEWLINE]• 3个区域需要7 [ICON_Citizen] 人口[NEWLINE]• 每个额外区域需要 +3 [ICON_Citizen] 人口[NEWLINE]水渠、社区和宇航中心无视此 [ICON_Citizen] 人口要求。要求特定数量 [ICON_Citizen] 人口的区域即为特色区域。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.en_US: When a city is ready to construct something, the Choose Production button will appear. If a district can be constructed, it will appear on this menu. Click on the district to order the city to begin construction, opening the district placement lens. Here, you will be given an overview of the different yield outcomes available on the tiles surrounding your City Center, and you can better make a decision about where to place your district. This lens will also show you which tiles are unavailable, as some districts have very specific placement requirements (for example, the Encampment cannot be built adjacent to a City Center). Furthermore, all districts must be built within 3 tiles of a City Center.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 当一座城市准备建造时，会出现选择生产项目的按钮。当某区域可用于建造时，会出现在该菜单中。点击区域，命令城市进行建设，并且打开区域滤镜。您会在此大致了解到不同的收益效果，这些效果对您市中心周围的单元格有效。同时，您还能对区域所在位置做出更好的选址决定。滤镜会向您展示可用的单元格，因为某些区域有特定的布局要求（比如，军营不能建在市中心附近）。再者，所有区域必须建在市中心3个单元格范围之内。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.en_US: Districts may be placed on top of features such as Woods or Rainforest if you have the technology to remove those features, but for a longer construction time. No District can be built on a floodplain.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_10_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有移除树林或雨林等地貌的科技后便可在这些地貌上放置区域，但建造时间加长。泛滥平原上无法建造区域。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: Neighborhoods are a special district that allows a city to house more [ICON_Citizen] Population and is affected by Appeal. The term “Appeal” is used to describe a special form of adjacency bonus that just applies to Neighborhoods, and also will affect the Culture Victory’s [ICON_Tourism] Tourism system through National Parks and Seaside Resorts.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 社区是一种特殊区域，能让城市容纳更多 [ICON_Citizen] 人口，并受魅力影响。“魅力”是一种特殊的相邻加成，只适用于社区，同时会通过国家公园和海滨度假区来影响文化胜利的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩系统。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: +1: Each adjacent Holy Site, Theater Square, Entertainment Complex, or wonder
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: +1：每个相邻圣地、剧院广场、娱乐中心，或奇观

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: +1: Each adjacent Mountain, Coast, Woods or Oasis
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: +1：每个相邻山脉、海岸、树林，或绿洲

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: +1: If the tile is on a River or Lake
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: +1：如果单元格位于河流或湖泊上
+1：每个法国特色城堡和狮身人面像

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: -1: Each adjacent Industrial Zone, Encampment, Airport or Spaceport
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: -1：每个相邻工业区、军营、机场，或宇航中心

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: -1: Each adjacent Rainforest, Marsh or Floodplain
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: -1：每个相邻雨林、沼泽，或泛滥平原

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: -1: Each adjacent Mine, Quarry, Oil Well, Offshore Oil Rig, and Airstrip
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: -1：每座相邻矿山、采石场、油井、海上石油钻机和飞机跑道
惊艳的社区提供6个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。
迷人的社区提供5个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。
普通的社区提供4个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。
无吸引力的社区提供3个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。
令人厌恶的社区提供2个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: Finally, Appeal also affects the ability to place National Parks and Seaside Resorts.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 魅力值会最终影响国家公园和海滨度假区的放置。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: A tile's Appeal can be viewed in its tooltip and is affected by the following:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 单元格的魅力可在其提示框查看，并受到以下情况的影响：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_11_CHAPTE.en_US: +4: if the tile is on a Mountain.

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_12_CHAPTE.en_US: Your city will grow, or add more [ICON_Citizen] Citizens, with surplus [ICON_Food] Food. Any amount of [ICON_Food] Food over the total consumption of a city's [ICON_Citizen] Citizens, 2 per, is considered surplus, and is added as progress towards a new [ICON_Citizen] Citizen.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_12_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有 [ICON_Food] 剩余食物，您的城市会获得发展，或增加更多 [ICON_Citizen] 公民。超过城市 [ICON_Citizen] 公民所需的任意数量的 [ICON_Food] 食物都会被当作剩余食物，并用于产生新 [ICON_Citizen] 公民。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_12_CHAPTE.en_US: A city will add all surplus [ICON_Food] Food towards growth if its current [ICON_Citizen] Population is 2 or more below the city's [ICON_Housing] Housing limit. If the city is 1 [ICON_Citizen] Population below its [ICON_Housing] Housing limit, its growth will slow to 50%. When the [ICON_Citizen] Population is at the [ICON_Housing] Housing limit, it will grow only at 25% the normal rate. A city can grow to 5 [ICON_Citizen] Citizens over its [ICON_Housing] Housing limit at this rate, and then it will stop growing entirely.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_12_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 如果某座城市目前的人口数比城市的 [ICON_Housing] 住房上限低2或更多，城市会把所有 [ICON_Food] 剩余食物用于发展。如果城市的 [ICON_Citizen] 人口比 [ICON_Housing] 住房上限低1，其发展速度会降至50%。当 [ICON_Citizen] 人口数量达到住房上限时，其发展速度仅为普通速度的25%。照此速度，城市能在超过其 [ICON_Housing] 住房上限的情况下，发展到5个 [ICON_Citizen] 公民，随后，人口会完全停止增长。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_12_CHAPTE.en_US: A city will stagnate and not grow if it does not have surplus [ICON_Food] Food. If it makes less [ICON_Food] Food than its [ICON_Citizen] Citizens consume, the city will starve and slowly lose [ICON_Citizen] Population until it is able to support itself again.
