LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_12_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 如果一座城市没有 [ICON_Food] 剩余食物，其将停滞不前，无法获得进一步发展。如果城市所产生的 [ICON_Food] 食物少于 [ICON_Citizen] 公民消耗，其会忍饥挨饿，并逐渐失去 [ICON_Citizen] 人口，直至其能再次生产足够食物为止。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_13_CHAPTE.en_US: A city requires 2 [ICON_Food] Food per [ICON_Citizen] Citizen (another term for "[ICON_Citizen] Population") per turn to avoid starvation. A city acquires [ICON_Food] Food (as well as other yields) by assigning its [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to "work" the land around the city. The city can work any tile within 3 spaces of the city that is also within the civilization's borders, provided as well that it is not being worked by another city. Cities cannot work tiles occupied by wonders.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_13_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 城市里的每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民（这是“ [ICON_Citizen] 人口”的另一种表达方式）每回合需要2份 [ICON_Food] 食物来避免饥饿。通过派遣其 [ICON_Citizen] 公民“改良”周围土地，城市能获得 [ICON_Food] 食物（以及其他收益）。城市能改良3个距离以内的任意单元格（位于文明境内且没被其他城市改良过）。城市无法改良被奇观占领的单元格。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_13_CHAPTE.en_US: Left to its own devices, the city will assign as many [ICON_Citizen] Citizens as needed to acquire its [ICON_Food] Food.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_13_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 为了自给自足，城市会派遣尽可能多的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民来获取 [ICON_Food] 食物。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_14_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Housing] Housing is a representation of the maximum amount of [ICON_Citizen] Citizens or [ICON_Citizen] Population you can have in each city. The base source of [ICON_Housing] Housing is a water source.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_14_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Housing] 住房代表您能在每座城市所拥有的最大数量的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民或 [ICON_Citizen] 人口。 [ICON_Housing] 住房的基本来源是水资源。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_14_CHAPTE.en_US: Many buildings grant [ICON_Housing] Housing. After researching Pottery, every city is able to build a Granary, which adds 2 [ICON_Housing] Housing, and later they can build Sewers, which also adds 2 [ICON_Housing] Housing. Buildings in other districts sometimes add [ICON_Housing] Housing, such as the Barracks in the Encampment district, the University in the Campus, and the Lighthouse in the Harbor. The Palace building in your capital city also adds 1 [ICON_Housing] Housing.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_14_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 大多建筑能提供 [ICON_Housing] 住房。研究完制陶术后，每座城市都能建造粮仓，其将增加2个 [ICON_Housing] 住房，随后能修建下水道，下水道也能增加2个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。其他区域的建筑有时也能增加 [ICON_Housing] 住房数量，比如军营区域的兵营，学院区域的大学，港口区域的灯塔。您首都城市的宫殿建筑也能增加1个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_14_CHAPTE.en_US: Each Farm, Pasture, Plantation, or Camp supports a small amount of [ICON_Citizen] Population — 1 [ICON_Housing] Housing for every 2 such improvements. Supporting rural [ICON_Citizen] Population in this fashion will allow for slightly larger [ICON_Citizen] Populations prior to the Industrial Era, when the Neighborhood district becomes available.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_14_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 每座农场、牧场、种植园，或营地都能供养少量 [ICON_Citizen] 人口——每两个这样的改良设施能提供1个 [ICON_Housing] 住房。在工业时代之前，用这种方式供养农业 [ICON_Citizen] 人口可支持稍大数量的 [ICON_Citizen] 人口，之后则可使用社区区域供养人口。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_15_CHAPTE.en_US: Placing your city near a water source should be one of your first decisions in any game. The presence of a good water source will immediately set the initial [ICON_Housing] Housing level of a city. A city not adjacent to any water will have a max [ICON_Citizen] Population of 2 at the start. A city on the coast will have a max [ICON_Citizen] Population of 3. And a city adjacent to a River, Lake, or Oasis will have a max [ICON_Citizen] Population of 5.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_15_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 游戏中的首要决策之一是把您的城市放置在水源附近。一旦出现优良水源，会立即设定出城市最初 [ICON_Housing] 住房等级。不靠近水源的城市一开始最多能拥有2个 [ICON_Citizen] 人口。位于海岸上的城市最多拥有3个 [ICON_Citizen] 人口。靠近河流、湖泊，或绿洲的城市最多拥有5个 [ICON_Citizen] 人口。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_15_CHAPTE.en_US: The fresh water status of a city may be upgraded by adding an Aqueduct tile next to the City Center. Aqueducts may only be placed in tiles that are adjacent to a River, Lake, or Mountain that is also adjacent to the City Center.  Completion of the Aqueduct district raises the city’s [ICON_Housing] Housing from water by 2 or up to 6, whichever is larger—so 7 if adjacent to River, Lake or Oasis, or 6 otherwise.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_15_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 可通过将一个水渠单元格添加至市中心附近引水。水渠必须放置在与河流、湖泊，或山脉相邻的单元格上，且河流、湖泊，或山脉需要靠近市中心。水渠区域建成后，住房大幅提升，城市 [ICON_Housing] 住房数量能从2增加至6——如果靠近河流、湖泊，或绿洲，数量为7，其他情况数量为6。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_16_CHAPTE.en_US: Happiness measures the contentment of your people in a single city, and is measured by seeing if the [ICON_Citizen] Population of that city has as many [ICON_Amenities] Amenities as expected. 1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity is required for each 2 [ICON_Citizen] Population, starting at a [ICON_Citizen] Population of 3. A Content city will not have any modifier applied to it, but a Happy city will have a 10% growth increase and a 5% yield increase. Furthermore, an Ecstatic city will have a 20% growth increase and 10% yield increase. Likewise, having too few [ICON_Amenities] Amenities will create displeasure among your [ICON_Citizen] Citizens, and the growth and yields will receive negative modifiers. At the level of Unrest, your growth will stop and you may find rebel partisans in your city.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_16_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 幸福度用来衡量在单个城市中您的国民的满意度，衡量的方式是看该城市的 [ICON_Citizen] 人口是否拥有所需的相应 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。从 [ICON_Citizen] 人口达到3起，每2个 [ICON_Citizen] 人口需要1点 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。满意状态的城市不会受到任何影响，而高兴状态的城市会得到10%的发展和5%的收益加成。此外，欣喜若狂状态的城市会得到20%的发展和10%的收益加成。[ICON_Amenities] 宜居度过低则会引发 [ICON_Citizen] 公民的不满情绪，并对发展和收益产生负面影响。当幸福度状态为不安时，您的城市会停止发展，并且有可能出现叛军。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_17_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Amenities] Amenities can come from a wide variety of sources. Each type of Luxury resource can contribute up to 4 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities to your empire (1 per city) to the 4 cities that need them most. Distribution happens automatically, as long as the Luxury resource is improved (a Plantation improvement built on Spices, for example). The Arena, built in the Entertainment Complex, provides [ICON_Amenities] Amenities to its local city. The Zoo and Stadium also provide [ICON_Amenities] Amenities, but regionally. Some wonders also provide [ICON_Amenities] Amenities. Furthermore, there are a few Religious Beliefs and policies that provide [ICON_Amenities] Amenities. Some [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People also provide [ICON_Amenities] Amenities.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_17_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度有多种来源。每种奢侈品资源可为您帝国里4座最需要宜居度的城市提供最多4点 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度（每座城市平均1点）。奢侈品资源得到改良后（例如在香料资源上建造种植园改良设施）便会自动进行宜居度分配。建在娱乐区域中的竞技场能为当地城市提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。动物园和体育场也能提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，但有地域限制。部分奇观也能提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。此外，少量宗教信仰和政策能提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。部分 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人也能提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_17_CHAPTE.en_US: War weariness and bankruptcy will lower the [ICON_Amenities] Amenities in a city.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_17_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 厌战情绪和破产会降低城市的 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_1_CHAPTER.en_US: Cities are vital to your civilization's success. They allow you to build units, buildings, and wonders. They allow you to research new technologies and gather wealth. You cannot win without powerful, well-situated cities.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_1_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城市对您的文明取得胜利至关重要。您可在此建造单位、建筑和奇观。城市还能让您研究新技术、积累财富。没有强大的、地理位置良好的城市，您根本无法获胜。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_2_CHAPTER.en_US: Cities are constructed by Settler units. If the Settler is in a location where a city can be constructed, the "Found City" action button will appear. Click on the button and the Settler will disappear, to be replaced by the new city.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_2_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城市由开拓者单位建造而成。如果开拓者所处位置可建造城市，则会出现“建立城市”按钮。点击该按钮，开拓者会消失，取而代之的是一座新城市。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_3_CHAPTER.en_US: Cities should be constructed in locations with plenty of [ICON_Food] Food and [ICON_Production] Production and with access to Strategic, Luxury, and Bonus resources. It is often a good idea to build a city on a River or coastal hex, as sources of water are very important to a growing [ICON_Citizen] Population. Cities constructed on Hills gain a defensive bonus, making it harder for enemies to capture them.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_3_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城市应被建在拥有大量 [ICON_Food] 食物、 [ICON_Production] 生产力，并且可使用战略、奢侈品和加成资源的地方。最好把城市建在河流和海岸格位上，因为水资源对 [ICON_Citizen] 人口增长非常重要。建在丘陵上的城市能获得防御加成，让敌人更难入侵。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_3_CHAPTER.en_US: With a Settler selected, ideal city locations will be shown on the map with an icon. Additionally, every Settler after your first will show the Settler Lens, giving you an idea of where on the map will provide the best source of water for your city, and indicating unavailable tiles.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_3_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 选择开拓者后，理想的城市位置会以图标的形式显示在地图上。此外，除了您的第一个开拓者，之后每个开拓者都会显示出开拓者滤镜，由此，您可知道地图上哪些地方能为您的城市提供最好的水源，其还会指示出不可用的单元格。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_5_CHAPTER.en_US: After your district has been built, you may now begin populating it with buildings. Buildings can be built through the Production Menu similarly to how you build your district. Some buildings have prerequisites, such as other buildings or technology requirements; these buildings will not be visible in your Production Menu. You may notice that you have some buildings available to build before you place any districts, such as the Monument. These buildings reside in the City Center.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 区域建造完成后，您可以在上面修建建筑。可通过生产项目界面来建造建筑，方法和建造区域类似。一些建筑会有先决条件，比如要求周围有其他建筑或其他技术要求；这些建筑不会出现在生产项目选择菜单上。您可能已注意到有一些建筑可以在放置区域前修建，比如纪念碑。这样的建筑位于市中心。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_6_CHAPTER.en_US: Wonders are a special type of building that fills an entire hex and has a significant impact on gameplay. When you select one to build from the Production Menu, you will enter the placement lens, just like you would for building a district. Most wonders have specific placement requirements, and the lens will highlight which tiles are available. All wonders must be built within 3 tiles of a City Center. If you complete a wonder in a city, that city will immediately expand its borders by two tiles.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_6_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 奇观是特殊类型的建筑，它填满整个格位，对游戏玩法有较大影响。和建造区域一样，从生产项目界面中选择奇观进行建造时将进入放置滤镜。多数奇观都有特殊的放置要求，可进行建造的单元格将高亮显示。所有奇观必须建在市中心的3个单元格以内。在城市中建成奇观后，城市边界将立即拓宽2个单元格。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_6_CHAPTER.en_US: Each wonder is unique. Though multiple civilizations may attempt to build the same wonder, only the civilization that first completes the wonder can reap its benefits. Civilizations failing to complete a wonder in time are refunded a portion of [ICON_Production] Production and some [ICON_Gold] Gold.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_6_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 每种奇观皆独一无二。多个文明可尝试建造相同奇观，但只有率先完成建造的文明才能获得增益。未能及时完成奇观建造的文明将获得一部分 [ICON_Production] 生产力和 [ICON_Gold] 金币作为补偿。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_6_CHAPTER.en_US: For more information on each wonder, see the Wonders and Projects section of the Civilopedia.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_6_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 如需了解每种奇观的详细信息，请查阅文明百科中的“奇观和项目”章节。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_7_CHAPTER.en_US: The Palace is a special building. Part building, part wonder, the Palace automatically appears in the first city you build, which makes that city the [ICON_Capital] Capital of your empire. The Palace provides a small amount of [ICON_Production] Production, [ICON_Science] Science, [ICON_Gold] Gold, and [ICON_Culture] Culture to your civilization. If your [ICON_Capital] Capital is captured by another civilization and you still have other cities under your control, the Palace will automatically transfer to another city, which will become your new [ICON_Capital] Capital.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_7_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 宫殿是特殊建筑。一半建筑，一半奇观，宫殿会自动出现在您建造的第一座城市里，它会让这座城市成为您帝国 [ICON_Capital] 的首都。宫殿为您的文明提供少量 [ICON_Production] 生产力、 [ICON_Science] 科技值、 [ICON_Gold] 金币和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。如果您的 [ICON_Capital] 首都被另一文明占领，如果您还控制着其他城市，宫殿则自动转移到另一座城市，并使所在城市成为您的新 [ICON_Capital] 首都。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_8_CHAPTER.en_US: Cities thrive based upon the land around them. Their [ICON_Citizen] Citizens "work" the land, harvesting [ICON_Food] Food, [ICON_Gold] Gold, [ICON_Production] Production, [ICON_Science] Science, and many other yields from the tiles. [ICON_Citizen] Citizens can work tiles that are within three tiles' distance from the city and that are within your civilization's borders. As your city grows, it automatically assigns its [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to work the lands around it. It seeks to provide a balanced amount of [ICON_Food] Food, [ICON_Production] Production, and [ICON_Gold] Gold. You may order a city's [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to work other tiles – for example, if you want a certain city to concentrate on generating [ICON_Gold] Gold, or [ICON_Production] Production, select the Manage Citizens icon in the City Selection Panel to choose specific tiles for your [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to work.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_8_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城市的繁荣基于周围的土地。他们的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民在国内辛苦“劳作”，从单元格上收获了 [ICON_Food] 食物、  [ICON_Gold] 金币、 [ICON_Production] 生产力、 [ICON_Science] 科技值，以及来自于单元格的其他收益。 [ICON_Citizen] 公民能改良距离城市三个单元格，并位于您文明内的单元格。随着城市发展，会自动分配它的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民到周围土地上工作。追求平衡的 [ICON_Food] 食物、 [ICON_Production] 生产力、和 [ICON_Gold] 金币产出。您可以命令城市 [ICON_Citizen] 公民前往其他单元格工作——比如，如果您希望某个特定城市专注于生产 [ICON_Gold] 金币，或 [ICON_Production] 生产力，就在城市选择面板上选择管理公民图标，以此为您的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民选择特殊单元格进行工作。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Specialists are alternative assignments for [ICON_Citizen] Citizens, which involve working a district tile instead of a normal tile. As a general rule, specialists are a good way to get yields otherwise hard to find on normal tiles, but the city needs a solid support base of [ICON_Food] Food to support them in the long term. Specialists are also particularly useful when a city grows large later in the game, and has more [ICON_Citizen] Population than there are normal tiles to work. There are different types of specialists, each with different effects. All specialist types except the generic [ICON_Citizen] Citizen have a limit on how many assignments there can be in a city. This limit is determined by the number of buildings in the district associated with that specialist type. Check the building's page to see if they add to the district additional [ICON_Citizen] Citizens yields.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 专家是另一种 [ICON_Citizen] 公民，其将在区域单元格、而非普通单元格中工作。一般情况下，玩家能通过专家获得难以在普通单元格上获得的收益，但城市也需要稳定的 [ICON_Food] 食物基础，以便对他们进行长期支持。城市在游戏中逐渐发展壮大，拥有的 [ICON_Citizen] 人口多于需要改良的普通单元格时，专家将发挥重要作用。专家有不同类型，每种有不同影响力。除普通 [ICON_Citizen] 公民外，所有类型的专家在城市中进行指派时都存在数量限制。数量限制视与专家类型相关的区域中的建筑数量而定。查看建筑的页面，了解其是否会为区域带来额外的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民产出。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Scientists work in the Campus and provide +2 [ICON_Science] Science.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 科学家在学院工作，提供2点 [ICON_Science] 科技值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Priests work in the Holy Site and provide +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 祭司在圣地工作，提供2点 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Commanders work in the Encampment and provide +1 [ICON_Production] Production and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 指挥官在军营中工作，提供+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力和+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Captains work in the Harbor and provide +1 [ICON_Food] Food and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 船长在港口中工作，提供+1 [ICON_Food] 食物和+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Merchants work in the Commercial Hub and provide +4 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 商人在商业中心工作，提供4个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Engineers work in the Industrial Zone and provide +2 [ICON_Production] Production.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 工程师在个工业区工作，提供2点 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Artists work in the Theater and provide +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITIES_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 艺术家在剧院工作，提供2点 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_1_CHA.en_US: City-states are the smaller political entities. They cannot win a game – they're not competing against you – but they can greatly assist or impede your progress towards victory. You can befriend city-states and gain a number of important benefits, you can ignore them and concentrate on bigger and more important foes, or you can conquer them and take their stuff. It's up to you.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_1_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 城邦是更小的政治实体。它们无法在游戏中获胜——它们不会同您竞争——但他们会极大帮助或阻碍您走向胜利。您可以同城邦交朋友并获得大量重要好处，您也可以忽略它们，并专注于更大更重要的敌人，或者，您可以征服它们并拿走它们的东西。一切取决于您。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: There are six different "flavors" of city-states. Each can provide you with different benefits if you befriend or ally with them.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 城邦有6种不同“风情”。如果您同它们交朋友或结盟，它们会为您提供不同的好处。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: A trade city-state can provide [ICON_Gold] Gold to your civilization.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 贸易城邦能为您的文明提供 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: A Religious city-state can provide [ICON_Faith] Faith to your civilization
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 宗教城邦能为您的文明提供 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: A militaristic city-state can provide [ICON_Production] Production toward producing units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 军事城邦能为您的生产单位提供 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: A scientific city-state can provide [ICON_Science] Science to your civilization.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 科技城邦能为您的文明提供 [ICON_Science] 科技值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: A cultural city-state can help you improve your [ICON_Culture] Culture.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 文化城邦能帮您提升 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.en_US: An industrial city-state can provide [ICON_Production] Production towards wonders, buildings, and districts.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_2_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 工业城邦能为您的奇观、建筑和区域提供 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_3_CHA.en_US: In order to communicate with a city-state, you must find it first. When one of your units encounters a city-state, the city-state will tell you what type it is, and if you're the first to discover it, you will automatically earn an [ICON_Envoy] Envoy with that city-state. Once you have met, you will be able to undertake "quests" from that city-state. If you want to get in touch with the city-state, you can click on the city itself, or you can go through the City-State Panel.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_3_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 为了同一个城邦交流，您必须先找到它。当您的某个单位遇见一个城邦时，城邦会告诉您它的类型，如果您是第一个发现它的人，您会自动获得该城邦的一位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。一旦遇见城邦，您便能够执行来自城邦的“任务”。如果想和城邦进行联系，您可以点击城邦，或者进入城邦面板。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_4_CHA.en_US: The bonuses you earn from a city-state depend on how many [ICON_Envoy] Envoys you have sent to the city-state. [ICON_Envoy] Envoys are earned over time with influence points (which come from Governments and Policies), or instantly by completing certain Civics. Once earned, you will receive a prompt to choose which city-states to send them to. If you have multiple [ICON_Envoy] Envoys, you may divide them between city-states as you desire.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_4_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 从城邦获得的加成数量取决于您派往城邦的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者数量。可通过影响力点数（来自政体和政策）随时间推移获得 [ICON_Envoy] 使者，或完成特定市政即刻获得。获得使者后将弹出提示，选择派遣的城邦。如有多个 [ICON_Envoy] 使者，可把他们随意分派到各个城邦。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_4_CHA.en_US: Declaring war directly on a city-state removes all [ICON_Envoy] Envoys you had there. Otherwise, [ICON_Envoy] Envoys stay on the city-state permanently. [ICON_Envoy] Envoys at a city-state are visible to all players, and placing them may have diplomatic consequences. The bonuses earned are based on how many [ICON_Envoy] Envoys you have present, regardless of who else has [ICON_Envoy] Envoys there. City-states of a type all share the same Type Bonuses. They are cumulative, so that as a player places more and more [ICON_Envoy] Envoys on a city-state, they stack with the bonuses from before. Each [ICON_Envoy] Envoy placed in a city-state expands its borders by 1 tile.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_4_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 对城邦直接宣战会移除所有您派遣到那里的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。否则，[ICON_Envoy] 使者会永远待在城邦。所有玩家都能看见待在该城邦的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者，放置他们可能会产生外交影响。获得的加成数量取决于您目前拥有的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者数量，和其他人放置在那里的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者数量无关。同种类型的城邦会共享相同的类型加成。加成可以累积，所以，当玩家在一个城邦放置越来越多的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者时，之前获得的加成可以叠加。每在城邦中放置1个 [ICON_Envoy] 使者，其边界便扩张1个单元格。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_4_CHA.en_US: Successfully completing the espionage mission Fabricate Scandal will remove a rival's [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys from the targeted city-state.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_4_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 成功完成间谍任务“捏造丑闻”后可将对手的 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者从目标城邦中赶走。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_5_CHA.en_US: The civilization with the most [ICON_Envoy] Envoys on a city-state, and at least 3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys, is considered that city-state's Suzerain. There can be at most one Suzerain; ties are not allowed. If nobody has [ICON_Envoy] Envoys on a city-state, there is no Suzerain. The Suzerain gets several significant benefits:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_5_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 如果某个文明在城邦拥有的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者最多，且至少有3个 [ICON_Envoy] 使者，那么该文明即为此城邦的宗主国。最多只能有一个宗主国；不能有并列宗主国。如果城邦中没有 [ICON_Envoy] 使者，则没有宗主国。宗主国获得以下几个显著好处：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_5_CHA.en_US: Unique Bonus: This is a powerful bonus awarded to the Suzerain which no other city-state will provide.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_5_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 特色加成：这是奖励给宗主国的强大加成，其他城邦将无法提供。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_5_CHA.en_US: Friendly Territory: The city-state's territory is considered 'Friendly' to its Suzerain, allowing the Suzerain to gain the same privileges that are provided by its own territory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CITYSTATES_5_CHA.zh_Hans_CN: 友好领土：城邦的领土将视为其宗主国的“友好”领土，宗主国能在领土内获得和自身领土相同的特权。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_10_CHAPTE.en_US: When your unit enters an enemy city, you have two choices: you can destroy the city (if it was not a [ICON_Capital] Capital) or you can annex it and make it part of your empire. If that city once belonged to another civilization, you may also chose to liberate it to its original owner.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_10_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 当您的单位进入一座敌方城市时，您有两个选择：摧毁这座城市（前提是它不是 [ICON_Capital] 首都） ，或吞并这座城市，让其成为您帝国的一部分。如该城市属于另一个文明，也可以选择将其解放，回归原主。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_12_CHAPTE.en_US: Formations allow you to easily move units together. This can be useful for escorting civilian units in hostile lands, or even creating stronger units in Corps and Armies. A military unit can create a formation with a support or civilian unit at any time. Naval military units may also create a formation with embarked land units. Support units, such as siege units, are most effective in battle when linked with another military unit.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_12_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 编队让您能轻易将单位移动到一起。它对于在敌对领土上护送平民单位，或甚至在军团和军队里创建更强大的单位非常有用。军事单位能随时创建带有一个支援单位和平民单位的编队。海军军事单位也能创建编队，编队带有能上船的陆地单位。支援单位，比如攻城单位，在战斗中，与另一军事单位一起时，最有效。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_12_CHAPTE.en_US: Starting in the Industrial era after completing the Nationalism civic, players will be able to unlock the ability to combine multiple military units of the same type into a single stronger unit. Two military units of the same type will be able to combine to create a Corps, giving them +10 to their base [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. After researching Mobilization, three units of the same type may be combined into an Army, giving +7 to their base [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. Keep in mind that their HP is NOT increased when units are combined in this way.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_12_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 完成民族主义市政后，会进入工业时代，玩家可以解锁能力，将同种类型的多个军事单位联合起来形成一个更强大的单位。相同类型的两个军事单位能结合起来创建军团，为他们的基本 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力+10。研究完动员后，相同类型的三个军事单位能结合起来形成军队，为他们的基本 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力+7。请记住，当单位以这种方式联合在一起时，生命值不会增加。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_12_CHAPTE.en_US: Once a Corps or Army has been formed, the units may not be broken apart into individual units again. The experience and promotions of the highest experience unit is preserved when creating this type of formation, so it is beneficial to combine rookies with more experienced units. Naval units may also be combined into Fleets and Armadas.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_12_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 一旦形成军团或军队，这些单位不会再被分解成个人单位。创建此种类型的编队时，拥有最高经验值的单位，其经验值和强化值会被保存，因此，它有利于把新手和更有经验的单位联合起来。海军单位也可被合并成舰队和无敌舰队。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_13_CHAPTE.en_US: Both improvements and buildings in districts without garrisons can be pillaged. This action renders them inoperable and awards the pillaging unit with some form of "plunder." With the exception of healing, these plunder awards increase in magnitude as you progress through the game.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_13_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 可以对区域中未驻军的改良设施和建筑进行掠夺。此行为会使其无法正常运转，并使掠夺单位获得某种形式的“战利品”。这些掠夺奖励会随着游戏时代的发展而增多，但治疗效果除外。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_13_CHAPTE.en_US: Pillaging a district takes 3 Movement Points, or all of your movement. Each building in a district must be pillaged separately, and awards some sort of plunder based on the district. Refer to the district's page for specific yields. Once pillaged, a building cannot be pillaged again until it is brought back online by its owner (done through the Production Menu and takes 25% of the [ICON_Production] Production cost of initial construction of that building.)
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_13_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 掠夺区域将消耗3点或所有移动力。必须对区域中的每个建筑进行单独掠夺，并根据区域类型来获得不同类型的战利品。请查阅区域的页面，了解特定的掠夺收益。完成掠夺后，需等待所有者将区域修复后方能再次对其进行掠夺。（修复区域在“生产项目”菜单中进行，消耗的生产力为初次建造该建筑所需 [ICON_Production] 生产力的25%。）

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_13_CHAPTE.en_US: Pillaging an improvement will take 3 Movement Points, or all your movement (if you have [ICON_Movement] Movement Points of less than 3).  It will mark the improvement in the tile as "pillaged".  Once pillaged, an improvement cannot be pillaged again until it is brought back online by its owner (a Builder operation that always takes one turn but does not require a Builder charge).Refer to the improvement's page for specific yields.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_13_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 掠夺改良设施将消耗3点移动力。如果 [ICON_Movement] 移动力低于3点，则消耗掉所有移动力。此操作会将单元格上的改良设施标记为“已掠夺”。完成掠夺后，需要等待所有者将其修复后才能再次对其进行掠夺。（使用“建造者”可在一回合后完成修复，且不消耗建造次数）。请查阅改良设施的页面，了解特定的掠夺收益。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_1_CHAPTER.en_US: Combat occurs between two political entities that are at war with each other. A civilization may be at war with another civilization or with a city-state. Barbarians are always at war with all civilizations and city-states.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_1_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 战斗发生在两个交战的政体之间。一个文明可能会同另一个文明或城邦交战。蛮族永远同所有文明和城邦处于交战状态。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_2_CHAPTER.en_US: There are a few ways to declare war. The first requires you move a military unit you control into another civilization's unit. This will prompt a pop-up message to appear asking if you want to start a war. Alternately, war can be declared in the Diplomacy Window. Within that window, you will always have the option to make a surprise declaration of war, except against your declared allies. Your civilization will suffer a costly warmongering penalty if you make a surprise declaration of war. To avoid some of this penalty (but not all), denounce the offending civilization and soon the option to formally declare war will appear in the Diplomacy Window.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_2_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 宣战的方式有数种。第一种：将一个自己控制的军事单位移动到其他文明单位所在的格位。此时会弹出一个提示信息，询问是否确认开战。第二种：通过外交窗口宣战。使用此窗口可以随时宣布开战，但不能对盟友宣战。突然宣战会导致本文明的好战程度陡增。为避免遭受减益（但也无法完全避免），可以先谴责对立的文明，之后外交窗口中便会很快出现正式宣战的选项。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_2_CHAPTER.en_US: You will also declare war against the target of a Military Emergency, City-State Emergency, Nuclear Emergency, and Betrayal Emergency, if you join that Emergency.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_2_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 如您加入了紧急状况，则也将向军事紧急状况、城邦紧急状况、核武紧急状况和背叛紧急状况所针对的目标宣战。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_3_CHAPTER.en_US: Having a nation that is constantly at war will diminish the productivity and happiness of your people. War weariness grows for every battle you fight. This accumulation is worse when those battles occur in foreign territory or when your units are killed. It is worse still if those units are killed by a nuclear weapon, but launching a nuclear weapon yourself is the greatest source of war weariness. All war weariness you accumulate is increased depending on the era and if you declared war without using a Casus Belli.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_3_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 如果国家总是处于战争状态，生产效率和人民的幸福度会降低。厌战情绪会随着每场战争而增加。战争发生在外国领土或您的单位被击杀时，情况会更糟。而使用核武器将带来最大程度的厌战情绪。不使用战争借口宣战会增加累积的厌战情绪，增加的量在每个时代也有所不同。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_3_CHAPTER.en_US: War weariness is applied to every city you own as a negative [ICON_Amenities] Amenity, lowering your city growth and productivity. Having low [ICON_Amenities] Amenities for too long can cause rebel partisans to spawn in your cities. These hostile units will attack your units and pillage your tiles and districts.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_3_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 厌战情绪会被作为一种负 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，应用于您每座城市之中，由此降低您城市的发展速度和生产力。长期拥有较低的 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度会让叛军在您的城市四处繁衍。这些敌对单位会攻击您的单位、掠夺您的单元格和区域。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_3_CHAPTER.en_US: While war weariness will slowly reduce while you are still at war, it reduces at a greatly increased rate when you are not at war with any player.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_3_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 当您仍然处于战争状态时，厌战情绪会缓慢减少，当您不与任何玩家发生战争时，厌战情绪会极大减少。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_4_CHAPTER.en_US: Wars can end violently or peacefully. A war ends violently when one side is destroyed. This occurs when that side has lost its last city. The peaceful resolution of a war involves diplomatic negotiations. You or your opponent may initiate a Peace Deal. See the section on Diplomacy for further details.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_4_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 可以用暴力或和平形式结束战争。当其中一方被击败时，战争以暴力形式结束。这样的情况发生在这一方失去它的最后一个城市时。战争的和平解决需要外交谈判。对战双方可以提出一个和平协议。查看外交章节获得更多信息。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_4_CHAPTER.en_US: Barbarians will never negotiate. War with Barbarians will continue until the Barbarians are destroyed.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_4_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 与蛮族是无法沟通的。和蛮族之间的战争将会持续到蛮族被击败为止。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: In Civilization VI, military units have five combat oriented stats: Hit Points, [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength, [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength, [ICON_Bombard] Bombard Strength, and [ICON_Range] Range.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 在《文明VI》中，军事单位有5种战斗数据：生命值、 [ICON_Strength] 战斗攻击力、 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力、 [ICON_Bombard] 轰炸攻击力和 [ICON_Range] 射程。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: All units have 100 Hit Points. As a unit takes damage, it loses Hit Points. A unit is destroyed once it loses all of its Hit Points.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 所有单位的生命值都为100。当单位受到伤害时，生命值减少。一旦失去所有生命值，单位即被消灭。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: All military units have [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. Melee units use their [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when attacking or defending. Ranged units use their [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 所有军事单位都有 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。近战单位在攻击和防御时使用它们的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。远程单位在防御时使用它们的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: Any unit that can engage in ranged combat has a [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength statistic. This number is compared with the target's [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength to determine the results of the attack. Land units with a [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength can also attack district defenses but at a reduced effectiveness.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 所有能够参与远程战斗的单位都拥有 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力数值。该数值同目标 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力的比值将决定攻击结果。拥有 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力的陆地单位也可以攻击区域，但形成的效果不佳。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: [ICON_Bombard] Bombard Strength is the anti-district strength of a unit. Units with [ICON_Bombard] Bombard Strength can also attack units, but at a reduced effectiveness. Land units cannot have both a [ICON_Bombard] Bombard and [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength, but naval units essentially function as both [ICON_Bombard] Bombard and [ICON_Ranged] Ranged units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Bombard] 炮击攻击力是单位的反区域战斗力。拥有 [ICON_Bombard] 炮击攻击力的单位也可以攻击其他单位，但效果不佳。陆地单位无法同时拥有 [ICON_Bombard] 炮击和 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力，但海军单位却能同时进行 [ICON_Bombard] 炮击和 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: The unit's [ICON_Range] Range stat determines the distance at which a unit can launch a ranged attack. A [ICON_Range] Range of "2" means that the target can be in an adjacent tile or one tile distant. A [ICON_Range] Range of "1" would mean that the target had to be adjacent to the attacker.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 单位的 [ICON_Range] 射程数据决定了单位能够发动一个远程攻击的距离。2 [ICON_Range] 射程意味着目标能位于一个相邻单元格或一个单元格那么远。1 [ICON_Range] 射程意味着目标肯定与攻击者相邻。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.en_US: Some units have an [ICON_AntiAir_Large] anti-air combat value. These units automatically defend against air attacks within their anti-aircraft range. The [ICON_AntiAir_Large] anti-air strength is used to evaluate combat with the attacking aircraft.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_5_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 部分单位拥有 [ICON_AntiAir_Large] 防空战斗力。这些单位可在自身的防空范围内防御空袭。[ICON_AntiAir_Large] 防空战斗力将判定和来袭飞机进行战斗的结果。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_6_CHAPTER.en_US: Generally, there must be no obstructions, such as a Mountain, between a ranged unit and its target. Units on Hills or flying can often see over obstructing terrain.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_6_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 一般而言，在远程单位和目标之间是一定不能出现如山脉这样的障碍物的。丘陵上的单位或者飞行单位通常视线不受地形阻碍。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.en_US: Warfare is not practiced by just the experienced and well equipped. Military history has shown time and time again that the combatant, using superior tactics, leadership, and the terrain to their advantage can defeat a numerically superior and better equipped force. In Civilization VI, it is no different.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 战争不仅依靠丰富的经验和齐全的设备。军事历史已多次证明利用高级战术、优秀领导力和有利地形可以打败数量上占优势且装备更先进的部队。在《文明VI》中，也不例外。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.en_US: In combining your military might with the right force organization of combined arms, leadership, and intuitive use of terrain you can have the power to destroy your enemies armies, no matter how big or small, advanced or not. Using terrain to your advantage, you can position your forces on Hills, in Rainforests or Woods, and across Rivers from your enemy to ensure a distinct defensive advantage. Looking at the enemies movements across terrain as they approach you can also help you better understand what their battle plan is or where they look to strike.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 将联合部队的适当军事组织、领导力、地形的灵活运用与您的军事力量结合起来，不论敌方军队规模大小、力量强弱，您都将战无不胜。利用地形优势，您可以在丘陵、雨林或树林上放置兵力，并且在敌人面前翻山越岭，以确保独特防御优势。观察敌人在前进途中的移动状况，借此，您能帮助自己更清楚地明白他们的战斗计划或攻击目标。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.en_US: Terrain can also be detrimental to your fight; be sure to avoid fighting on Flood Plains and Marshes as these have a negative effect on your defensibility. If you find yourself on indefensible terrain, and do not feel you can defeat your enemy on the attack, perhaps building a few Forts will help you push back the enemy. Remember to attack the enemy's flanks, it is their weakest point and will also grant you advantage! Using a well-rounded military force with the proper terrain dispositions while having the use of a Great General will ensure victory!
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 地形也会对您的战斗不利；务必避免在泛滥平原和沼泽上战斗，因为它们对您的防御性有负面影响。如果您发现自己位于不可防御的地形，并觉得攻击开始后，无法击败敌人，也许建立几个堡垒将帮您击退敌人。记得攻击敌人侧翼，这是他们最薄弱的地方，此举会让您获得优势！使用带有适当地形配置的全面军事力量，同时使用一个大将军，您必胜无疑！

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.en_US: Flanking and Support bonuses: Outmaneuvering the enemy as well as making sure units in the field are supported by their counterparts is important in order to insure victory in the field. In Civilization VI we simulate this with the Flanking and Support bonuses. Once a player has completed the Military Tradition civic, their military is considered advanced enough in order to benefit from these bonuses.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Flanking: If an enemy melee unit is surrounded by 2 or more adjacent friendly melee units during an attack, it is considered flanked, granting a +2 combat bonus to the melee attacker for each additional flanking melee unit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Support: When defending against an enemy melee attack, a defending unit can gain a +2 combat bonus for every adjacent friendly unit.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_7_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 夹击和支援加成：要成为战场中的常胜将军，重要的是以计谋制敌、让作战单位获得队友的支援。在《文明VI》中，模拟此战术的则是夹击和支援加成。完成“军事传统”市政后，军队便可获得此类加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]夹击：如在战斗中2个或以上的相邻友方近战单位包围敌方近战单位，则视为对敌方形成夹击；每个额外夹击的近战单位可使发起进攻的近战单位战斗力+2。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]支援：防御敌方近战攻击时，每个相邻的友方单位可使防御单位战斗力+2。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_8_CHAPTER.en_US: A unit that survives combat or discovers a Tribal Village will gain "Experience Points" (XP). Once a unit reaches a certain amount of XP it will 'level up', at which point it can receive a promotion. Promotions enhance the unit in some way. When selecting a promotion, the unit is healed an amount of Hit Points. The unit will not continue to gain any further XP until the promotion is selected.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_8_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 战斗中幸存的单位会获得“经验值（XP）”。某单位一旦达到一定数量的经验值，便可以“升级”，升级后，数值会获得一个强化。在某些方面，强化能使单位得到提升。当选择一个强化时，单位会恢复大量生命值。在选择强化之前，单位无法继续获得更多经验值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Cities may be attacked and captured by military units. Each city has a "City Combat Strength" stat that determines its strength when attacked by other units. The higher the city's City Combat Strength, the more difficult it is to capture the city. Unless the city is extremely weak or the attacking unit is extremely strong, it will take multiple turns to capture a city.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城市会被军事单位攻击或占领。每座城市都有“城市战斗力”数据，该数据决定了受其他单位攻击时的战斗力大小。城市战斗力越高，越难被占领。占领一座城市需要多个回合，除非这座城市极度脆弱，或攻击单位极度强大。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Walls add extra protection to a city or Encampment, making it even more difficult to conquer. This protection is like armor, shielding the city from attacks. Melee units deal only 15% of their normal damage to walls, and ranged units deal only 50% of their normal damage. Only Bombard units deal 100% of their normal damage to walls, making them necessary to capture a fortified city. If the walls are damaged, they stop being as effective and the district's health will start taking a little bit of damage with every attack. Walls can only recover health with a Project found in the city's Production Queue, like repairing district buildings, that becomes available if the district has not taken any damage for 3 consecutive turns. Once a city has walls, it can make ranged attacks against enemy units using a "City Ranged Strength" stat.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The City Combat Strength is based on the [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength of the strongest melee unit built by your civilization, minus 10, or by the [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength of a garrisoned military unit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The City Ranged Strength is based on the [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength of the strongest ranged unit built by your civilization.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The city gets additional bonuses to its City Combat Strength for each non-pillaged district it has, making big cities harder to capture, and from terrain and a few other modifiers sources.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城墙为城市或军营增加额外保护，让其更难被占领。这种保护如同护甲一般，使城市免受攻击。近战单位仅对城墙造成它通常伤害的15%，远程单位仅对城墙造成它通常伤害的50%。只有轰炸单位才能对城墙造成它100%的伤害，因此，轰炸单位是占领坚固城市的必需之物。如果城墙遭受损害，其会不再有效，同时，每一次攻击都会让区域生命值受到少量伤害。只有使用在城市生产队列中找到的项目才能回复城墙生命值，比如修理区域建筑，如果区域连续3回合没有遭受任何伤害，则可以进行修复。城市一旦拥有城墙，便可使用“城市远程攻击”对敌方单位发动远程攻击。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]城市战斗力取决于您文明里最强近战单位的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力大小，最小为10，或取决于驻军军事单位的战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]城市远程攻击力取决于您文明里最强 [ICON_Ranged] 远程单位的远程攻击力大小。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]城市所拥有的每个没被掠夺的区域会为其城市战斗力提供额外加成，使大城市更难被占领，城市也能从地形和一些其他改造者来源中获得额外加成。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_9_CHAPTER.en_US: Cities can also be under siege from attacking units. The City Center and other defensible districts like the Encampment are considered under siege if all 6 tiles around them are occupied by enemy units, under enemy Zone of Control, or are impassable due to mountains or Natural Wonders. In these circumstances, the district will not recover lost health, instead of healing automatically every turn as normal.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_COMBAT_9_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 城市也可以被攻击单位包围。如果，城市中心和像军营这样的防御区四周的所有6个单元格都被敌方单位占领，那么，市中心和防御区由此被包围，由于山脉或自然奇观的存在，这些被包围地区会处于敌人的控制之下，或无法通行。在此情况下，该地区不会回复失去的生命值，也无法像往常一样，每回合自动治愈。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CONSUMEABLE_RESO.en_US: Strategic Resources are now extracted from the world and will accumulate in a civilization's stockpile. These resources are divided into two categories: Fuel and Material. Fuel resources are burned automatically to meet the Power needs of your cities. Buildings in your cities that require [ICON_Power] Power will provide bonuses if powered.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CONSUMEABLE_RESO.zh_Hans_CN: 从世界中获取的战略资源现在将累计在文明的储备中。此类资源被分为“燃料”与“物资”两类。燃烧燃料资源可自动满足城市对 [ICON_Power] 电力的需求。城中需要 [ICON_Power] 电力的建筑在获得电力供给时可提供加成。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CONSUMEABLE_RESO.en_US: Material and Fuel resources are also required for production and maintenance of many military units. If Fuel or Material needs are deficient, those units will be less effective in combat.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CONSUMEABLE_RESO.zh_Hans_CN: 许多军事单位同样需要物资与燃料资源的供给。供给不足时，这些单位的战斗能力将大打折扣。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CONSUMEABLE_RESO.en_US: Consumable resources are denoted on the map by nodes icons that indicate which resource is on that tile.  Not all resources will be visible to you at the start of the game - as eras go by, you advance technologically and reveal later resources. Consumable Resources can be bartered with as a lump sum.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CONSUMEABLE_RESO.zh_Hans_CN: 消耗性资源将会以图标的形式显示在地图中，表明单元格中的资源类型。游戏初始时并非所有资源均为可见状态，随着时代发展与科技进步，文明将在后期发现各类资源。消耗性资源可进行一次性的对应交换。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_1_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Culture] Culture is the way that you advance through the Civics Tree, unlocking new policies and Governments. It’s also how you increase the size of your cities’ territories. Most importantly, [ICON_Culture] Culture can be another path to victory. Each civic you acquire gives your civilization access to policies or governments, as well as some buildings, districts, and diplomatic advancements. You acquire civics by accumulating [ICON_Culture] Culture. Every turn your civilization gets some amount of [ICON_Culture] Culture added to its pool. Each civic costs a certain amount of [ICON_Culture] Culture to learn; when you've accumulated enough [ICON_Culture] Culture, you acquire the civic. When you get the new civic, your pool is depleted and you start accumulating all over again, saving up for the next civic.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_1_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 通过市政树、解锁新的政策和政体，您可以增加 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。您也可通过此方法来增加您城市领土面积。更重要的是，可通过 [ICON_Culture] 文化值获得成功。您在文明里获得的每个市政都会帮助您解锁政策或政体，以及一些建筑、区域和外交进步。您可通过积累 [ICON_Culture] 文化值获得市政。每回合，您的文明都将获得一定数量的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。获取每种市政都会消耗一定数量的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值；累积足够的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值，您才能获得市政。获得新市政时，文化值清零，您必须为获得下一个市政而重新累积文化值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_2_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Culture] Culture can be earned from wonders, policies, leader abilities, natural wonders, city-states, Beliefs, [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, and of course the Theater Square district. Look through the Civilopedia to find sources of [ICON_Culture] Culture.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_2_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 可从奇观、政策、领袖能力、自然奇观、城邦、信仰、 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，以及剧院广场区获得 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。仔细查看文明百科来寻找 [ICON_Culture] 文化值的来源。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Inspiration moments, also known as "civic boosts", provide an immediate and significant boost towards your study of a civic. These boosts will be earned as you play the game naturally, and your actions will determine what sort of Inspiration moments you encounter. For example, building a wonder boosts your progress towards Drama and Poetry, and building any district will boost your progress towards State Workforce. The Civics Tree lists boosts associated with each civic, but you may gain them from other sources (such as Great People or team shared research).
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 鼓舞时刻也被称为“市政提升”，可立即为您的市政研究提供显著提升。正常进行游戏即可获得提升，同时您的操作会决定遇见的鼓舞时刻类型。比如，建造一个奇观会提升您戏剧和诗歌的进度，建造任意区域都会提升您国家劳动力的进展。市政树中列出了每个市政相关的提升，但您也可从其他来源处获得提升（如伟人或团队共享研究）。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_4_CHAPTE.en_US: To see how all of this works in the game, check out the amazing Civics Tree. It displays all of the civics and shows how they are intertwined. You can click on a civic to order your civilization to study it – if your civilization doesn't know the prerequisite civic it will research them as well. The Civics Tree will plot the quickest route to the requested civic, and you will study the necessary precursors in the order it displays.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 打开并查看市政树，以了解其在游戏中的作用。它显示了各项市政以及它们之间的复杂联系。点击其中的市政，便可对其进行研究——如果您的文明不了解必要的市政，它也会对它们进行研究。您将按照市政树中所显示的最快研究路线，按照顺序进行研究。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_5_CHAPTE.en_US: A Culture Bomb is an action that allows you to wrest control of adjacent tiles and add them to your own empire, even if owned by another player. Tiles gained in this way must be within 3 spaces of your city that is expanding. Tiles that already contain a completed district or wonder do not switch ownership from Culture Bombs. Incomplete district or wonder tiles will switch ownership, but the partially-built contents of those tiles will be destroyed.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_5_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 通过文化炸弹能获得相邻单元格的控制权并将其纳入本国领土（即使这些单元格为其他玩家所有）。此方法只能获得城市3个单元格内的单元格。文化炸弹无法使包含已完成区域或奇迹的单元格易主。如区域或奇迹未完成，则文化炸弹将使单元格易主，单元格中未建造完成的内容将被摧毁。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_5_CHAPTE.en_US: Culture Bombs are often restricted to unique abilities for civilizations, such as Australia or Poland. Refer to those entries for more details on how to trigger Culture Bombs.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_CULTURE_5_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 通常只有拥有特色能力的文明才能使用文化炸弹，如澳大利亚或波兰。查看其条目，了解触发文化炸弹的详情。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Dedications are a way to focus the growth of your civilization at the start of each Era, beginning in the Classical Era. The list of Dedications available at the start of an Era changes over the course of the game, and some Dedications are available through multiple Eras. During a Dark Age, Dedications are a reliable way to increase your Era Score as you work towards a Heroic Age. As you enter a Golden Age, these Dedications become more powerful, no longer granting Era Score, but now providing substantial bonuses to your civilization.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 从古典时代开始，玩家可以在每个时代的开端选择着力点，专注于文明某一方面的成长。随游戏进程的变化，在时代伊始时出现的着力点列表也会有所变化；某些着力点可在多个时代中选择。处于黑暗时代中时，着力点能有效提升时代得分，帮助玩家迈入英雄时代。而进入黄金时代后这些着力点则更为强大，虽不再提供时代得分，但却能为文明带来大量加成。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Bodyguard of Lies: Gain +1 Era Score for each successful offensive Spy operation. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, Spies take no time to establish presence in an enemy city. Time to complete all offensive missions reduced by 25%. Atomic and later eras.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “兵不厌诈”：每次进攻性间谍行动成功+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，间谍部署到敌方城市时不消耗时间，且完成攻击性任务的时间缩短25%。可在原子能及之后的时代中选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Wish You Were Here:  Gain +1 Era Score for each Artifact extracted. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, Cities with [ICON_Governor] Governors receive +50%  [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from World Wonders. +100%  [ICON_Tourism] Tourism to all National Parks. Atomic and later eras.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “愿你在此”：每发掘1件文物+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，拥有 [ICON_Governor] 总督的城市中的世界奇观所产出的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩+50%。国家公园产出的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩+100%。可在原子能及之后的时代中选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Sky and Stars: Gain +1 Era Score for each Aerodrome building constructed. Gain +1 Era Score each time a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person is earned or purchased. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, unlocks the [ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas for Satellites, Nuclear Fusion, and Nanotechnology if in the Information Era. When chosen in the Future Era the [ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas for Smart Materials, Predictive Systems, and Offworld Mission are unlocked. +100% XP earned for all Air Units. Aluminum mines accumulate +2 more resources per turn. Information and Future Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “漫天繁星”：每建造1座航空港建筑+1时代得分。每获得或购买1名 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人+1时代得分。[NEWLINE]如处于信息时代，在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点将解锁卫星、核聚变和纳米技术的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。如在未来时代中选择，则解锁智能材料、预报系统和宇宙探索任务的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。所有空中单位获得的经验值+100%。每回合收集的铝矿资源+2。可在信息时代和未来时代中选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Automaton Warfare: Gain +1 Era Score each time you kill a non-Barbarian unit with a Giant Death Robot. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, gain a Giant Death Robot in your capital. Receive 3 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium per turn. [ICON_Resource_Uranium] Uranium mines accumulate +1 more resource per turn. Information and Future Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: 机器人大战：每用末日机甲击杀1个非蛮族单位，便+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择后，首都中将出现1个末日机甲。每回合获得3点 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀。每回合收集的 [ICON_Resource_Uranium] 铀资源+1。可在信息时代和未来时代中选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Free Inquiry: Gain +1 Era Score each time you trigger a [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka. +1 Era Score for constructing a building that provides Science as a base yield. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, [ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas provide an additional 10% of technology costs. Commercial Hub and Harbor district's [ICON_GOLD] Gold adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Science] Science as well. Classical and Medieval Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “自由探索”：每次触发 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡+1时代得分。建造以科技值为基础产出的建筑+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，[ICON_TechBoosted]尤里卡额外提供10%科技开销。商业中心和港口区域的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币相邻加成也提供 [ICON_Science] 科技值。可在古典和中世纪时代中选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Pen, Brush, and Voice: Gain +1 Era Score each time you trigger an [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration. +1 Era Score for constructing a building with a Great Work Slot. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspirations provide an additional 10% of civic costs. Each city receives +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture for each specialty district. Classical and Medieval Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “百花齐放”：每次触发 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞+1时代得分。建成拥有巨作槽位的建筑+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，[ICON_CivicBoosted]鼓舞提供额外10%的市政开销。城市每拥有1处特色区域，则+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。可在古典和中世纪时代中选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Exodus of the Evangelists: Gain +2 Era Score each time you convert a city to your founded Religion for the first time. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement for all Missionaries, Apostles, and Inquisitors. Additionally, newly trained ones get +2 Charges. +4 [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet points per turn. Classical through Renaissance Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “布道者的远行”：首次使一座城市信奉您创立的宗教+2时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，所有传教士、使徒和审判官+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。此外，这些新生产单位的使用次数将+2。每回合产生的 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数+4。可在古典时代到文艺复兴时代之间选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Monumentality: Gain +1 Era Score each time you construct a new specialty District. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement for all Builders. May purchase civilian units with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Builders and Settlers are 30% cheaper to purchase with [ICON_FAITH] Faith and [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Classical through Renaissance Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “雄伟壮丽”：每修建1座新特色区域则+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，所有建造者+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。可用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买平民单位。用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值和 [ICON_GOLD] 黄金购买建造者和开拓者的费用降低30%。可在古典时代到文艺复兴时代之间选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Hic Sunt Dracones: Gain +3 Era Score each time you discover a new Continent or natural wonder. Gain +1 Era Score each time you kill a non-Barbarian naval unit in combat. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, +3 starting [ICON_Citizen] Population for cities settled on a different continent than your first city. +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement for naval and embarked units. +2 Loyalty per turn for cities not on your original [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent. Renaissance through Modern Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “此处有龙”：每发现1个新大陆或自然奇观+3时代得分。在战斗中每击杀1个非蛮族海军单位+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，和首座城市不在同一个大陆的城市+3初始 [ICON_Citizen] 人口。海军和水运单位+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。和原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都不在同一个大陆的城市每回合+2忠诚度。可在文艺复兴时代到现代之间选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Reform the Coinage: Gain +1 Era Score each time you successfully complete a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route.  If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, your Traders cannot be plundered. International [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes provide +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold per specialty district in the foreign city. Renaissance through Modern Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “货币改革”：每成功建立1条 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+1时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，商人无法被掠夺。外国城市中每拥有1个特色区域，国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供的 [ICON_Gold] 金币+3。可在文艺复兴时代到现代之间选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: Heartbeat of Steam: Gain +2 Era Score  for each Industrial or later building constructed. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, +10% [ICON_Production] Production toward Industrial era and later wonders. Campus district's [ICON_SCIENCE] Science adjacency bonus provides [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production as well. Industrial through Atomic Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “滚滚蒸汽”：每建造1座后工业时代的建筑+2时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后，建造后工业时代奇观时+10% [ICON_Production] 生产力。学院区域的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值相邻加成也可提供 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。可在工业时代到原子能时代之间选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.en_US: To Arms!: Gain +1 Era Score each time you kill a non-Barbarian Corps in combat and +2 Era Score each time you kill a non-Barbarian Army in combat. If chosen at the start of a Golden Age, unlocks a special Casus Belli which gives 75% less warmonger penalties than formal war and can be used immediately after Denouncing the target. +15% [ICON_Production] Production towards military units. Industrial through Atomic Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DEDICATIONS_CHAP.zh_Hans_CN: “全民皆兵”：在战斗中每击杀1个非蛮族军团+1时代得分、每击杀1个非蛮族军队+2时代得分。在黄金时代开始时选择此着力点后将解锁特殊战争借口，谴责目标后可立即宣战，且好战程度-75%。生产军事单位时+15% [ICON_Production] 生产力。可在工业时代到原子能时代之间选择。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.en_US: The Diplomatic Victory is awarded to the Civilization that masters the World Congress, gaining reputation as a reliable friend, a defender of the greater good, and an outstanding negotiator.  Wield the [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor you have earned through your mutually-beneficial playstyle to accumulate Diplomatic Victory Points until you have reached the threshold to be named victor.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.zh_Hans_CN: 文明获得外交胜利的途径如下：掌控世界议会、被誉为可靠的友人、成为真善美的守护者，或成为出色的谈判方。用双赢的游戏方式获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持，然后用其累积外交胜利点数。累积的点数达到阈值后即可获得外交胜利。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.en_US: When World Congress meets, players who manage to pass their agendas will gain Diplomatic Victory Points.  Team up with other players to vote for a winning target/option combo, or spend your [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to strong-arm Congress into seeing things your way, and you'll receive a Diplomatic Victory Point each time your selected option and target is the one to pass.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.zh_Hans_CN: 世界议会召开后，通过议程的玩家将获得外交胜利点数。与其他文明组队，针对目标/选择进行投票；也可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持来掌控世界议会。选择的项目和目标通过决议后便能获得外交胜利点数。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.en_US: As the World Congress progresses, eventually a Diplomatic Victory Resolution will appear in the mix of resolutions for voting. The resolution will propose awarding Diplomatic Victory Points to or removing Diplomatic Victory Points from a specific civilization. Use your [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to vote yourself or an ally closer to victory, or use the other effect to slow down your enemies.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.zh_Hans_CN: 随着世界议会的发展，最后将出现外交胜利决议，文明可对此进行投票。决议将提出将外交胜利点数奖励给某个文明，或提出扣除某个文明的外交胜利点数。可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持来为自己投票，或阻挠接近胜利的对手；也可通过其他手段来延缓对手的前进脚步。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.en_US: Players can also earn Diplomatic Victory Points through participation in Scored Competitions.  Generate the highest score in Scored Competitions to receive Diplomatic Victory Points as part of your reward.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Additionally, players can earn Diplomatic Victory points by completing the Seasteads Tech, the Global Warming Mitigation Civic, or the Statue of Liberty, Mahabodhi Temple, and Potala Palace Wonders.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.zh_Hans_CN: 玩家参与积分竞赛便能获得外交胜利点数。在积分竞赛中得到最高分后所获奖励的一部分中也包含有外交胜利点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]除此之外，玩家研究“海洋家园”科技、解锁“全球变暖减缓学”市政、建成“自由女神像”、“摩诃菩提寺”或“布达拉宫”奇观后也能获得外交胜利点数。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.en_US: Once a single civilization receives enough Diplomatic Victory points, they immediately win a Diplomatic Victory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.zh_Hans_CN: 一个文明获得足够外交胜利点数后便会立即获得外交胜利。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.en_US: A team wins a Diplomatic Victory when one of the players has enough Diplomatic Victory Points to win the game. A team does not combine their Diplomatic Victory points. When playing as a team, it may benefit you to choose one team member to pursue the victory, and for the remaining members of the team to vote for that player in all Diplomatic Victory Resolutions.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLOMATIC_VICTO.zh_Hans_CN: 团队中的一个玩家获得足够的外交胜利点数后，团队便能集体赢得外交胜利。团队成员的外交胜利点数不会组合计算。进行团队游戏时较为可取的方案是让一个队友全力争取胜利，而其他队友则在所有外交胜利决议中投票对其进行支持。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_11_CHAPTER.en_US: A Defensive Pact is an agreement between two leaders to come to each other's aid when targeted by a Declaration of War. It is unlocked by the Mobilization Civic, and both partners must possess this Civic in order to create a Defensive Pact. If either member of the Defensive Pact is targeted, the other member will also declare war against the aggressor. Defensive Pacts are available through the Make Deal negotiation table. The two leaders must be in an Alliance to make the deal.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_11_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 防御协定是两位领袖之间的协议，旨在其中一方成为战争目标时进行互相帮助。获得“动员”市政即可将其解锁，双方必须皆拥有此市政才能达成防御协定。如果防御协定中的一方成为战争目标，另一方也会对侵略者宣战。防御协议在“交易”谈判桌上达成。签订此协议前，双方领袖先结为同盟。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_11_CHAPTER.en_US: There are some cases where a Defensive Pact will not automatically lead to a leader being drawn into a war as the result of being in a Defensive Pact. For example, Gilgamesh and Cleopatra have a Defensive Pact, and Pedro and Peter have a Defensive Pact. Gilgamesh declares war on Pedro, and due to the Defensive Pact, Peter declares war on Gilgamesh. However, Cleopatra does not automatically declare war on either Pedro or Peter. Emergencies do not trigger Defensive Pacts, either. Using our example from before, if there were an Emergency against Pedro, and Gilgamesh goes to war against Pedro, then Peter does not automatically declare war on Gilgamesh.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_11_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 在一些情况下，防御协定不会自动导致文明卷入战争。举例而言，吉尔伽美什和克利欧佩特拉之间拥有防御协定，而佩德罗和彼得之间也拥有防御协定。吉尔伽美什对佩德罗宣战后，防御协定将会导致彼得对吉尔伽美什宣战。然而克利欧佩特拉却不会自动对佩德罗或彼得宣战。紧急状况同样不会触发防御协定效果。再次用以上为例，如出现针对佩德罗的紧急状况，吉尔伽美什对佩德罗宣战，则彼得不会自动对吉尔伽美什宣战。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_12_CHAPTER.en_US: Every other leader in the game has an opinion of you. Their opinion might be positive or it might be negative; it is in constant flux from events in the game. You can tell what your relationship with another leader is by the icon on their leader portrait, or by selecting Our Relationship with that leader on the Diplomacy Panel. The following relationship states exist in the game:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_12_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 游戏中的其他领袖都会对您有一个意见。他们的意见可能是积极的，也可能是消极的；并随着游戏进展不断变化。您可通过他们的领袖肖像图标，或在外交面板里选择我们的关系，来了解你们之间的关系如何。下列关系状态已出现在游戏中。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_12_CHAPTER.en_US: Allies. When in an Alliance with a leader, you may not declare a formal war on each other, you automatically share Open Borders, you may make Research Agreements and Defensive Pacts, and deals you make with each other are likely to be very favorable. Territory owned by the other civilization in the Alliance is considered 'Friendly', allowing the same privileges as your own territory.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Declared Friend. When you choose to declare your friendship with a leader, you may not declare a formal war on each other, you may make Research Agreements, and deals you make with each other will be more favorable. This relationship state is required to make an Alliance.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Friendly. This means the leader thinks positively of you and you have a better chance of getting favorable deals with them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Neutral. You have done nothing to upset or impress the leader, and your interactions with them will be standard.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unfriendly. For some reason, you have done something to upset this leader, and deals with them will likely be unfavorable for you, or you can choose to make demands of them. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Denounced. This leader has let the other leaders in the world know that you have done something to offend them. Your deals with them will be unfavorable if they will make them at all, but you can declare a Formal War against them and make demands.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]At War. Open hostilities have broken out between you, and you can attack or invade this leader but you will accrue warmongering and war weariness penalties.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_12_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 盟友。与其他一位领袖结盟后，你们无法对彼此宣布正式战争，并且自动互相开放边界。你们可以达成研究协议和防御条约，双方达成的交易会更有利。联盟中其他文明拥有的领土将被视为“友好领土”，拥有和自身领土相同的特权。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宣布友好。当您选择同一位领袖宣布友好时，你们无法对彼此宣布正式战争，可以达成研究协议，双方达成的交易会更有利。需要结成同盟才能拥有这种关系。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]友好。这意味着领袖对您有积极正面的看法，更有可能达成对您有利的交易。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]中立。您未做任何让领袖厌烦或印象深刻的事，您同他们之间的相互交流都是标准化的。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不友好。因为某些原因，您做了让该领袖不愉快的事，同他们的交易将很可能对您非常不利。或者，您可以选择向他们索取。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]谴责。该领袖已让世界上的其他领袖知道您做了冒犯他们的事。同他们之间的交易将对您非常不利，但您可以向其宣布正式战争和进行索取。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]交战。你们之间已爆发战争，您可进攻或侵犯该领袖，但您会获得好战性和厌战情绪减益。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_13_CHAPTER.en_US: Diplomatic Agendas are a major driving force in your relationship with other leaders. They drive the desires and behavior of those leaders. You can use Agendas to know how to get on a leader's good side, or what to do to avoid making them angry.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_13_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 外交议程是您与其他领袖关系的主要推动力。它们能推动领袖的欲望和行为。通过议程，您可了解如何发展领袖积极的一面，或如何避免使其生气。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_13_CHAPTER.en_US: Leaders have a Historic Agenda and a Hidden Agenda. The Historic Agenda is based on that leader's real-world historical personality and achievements. The Hidden Agenda is assigned at beginning of every game, and could be a wide variety of things—maybe they like other civilizations with lots of culture or gold, or maybe they dislike warmongers. Revealing the Hidden Agenda is important to knowing what pleases and displeases a leader. Increase your Diplomatic Visibility with each civilization to find out what their leaders' Hidden Agendas are.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_13_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 领袖有一个历史议程和一个隐藏议程。历史议程取决于该领袖真实的历史性格和成就。隐藏议程在每场游戏的初始阶段由系统分配而成，可以包含多种内容——他们可能喜欢拥有大量文化值和金币的其他文明，或者可能讨厌好战者。显示出隐藏议程对了解领袖的喜怒非常重要。增加您对每种文明的外交能见度来找出这些领袖的隐藏议程。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_14_CHAPTER.en_US: After researching the civic Foreign Trade, a Joint War may be proposed between players who have researched Foreign Trade. If you accept or propose a Joint War, you and another player will immediately be at war with the target player as set in the deal parameters.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_14_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 研究完“对外贸易”市政后，玩家之间可以提出联合作战计划。如果您接受或提出此计划，协议细则敲定后您和另一位玩家便会立即与目标文明开始战争。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.en_US: Diplomatic Territory is divided into 3 types:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 外交领土分为三种类型：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.en_US: Friendly: Territory owned by your civilization. Friendly territory can also be established by becoming allies with a major civilization, or by becoming the Suzerain of a city-state. Units will heal faster in territory that is friendly to them, as well as take advantage of special abilities and policies associated with friendly territory. Units must be in friendly territory in order to be upgraded.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 友好：您自己的文明所拥有的领土。与主流文明结盟或成为城邦的宗主国同样可以获得友好领土。单位在友好领土中的治愈速度将加快，还可利用友好领土相关的特殊能力和政策。单位升级只能在友好领土中进行。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.en_US: Neutral: Territory that is not currently owned by a civilization or city state. This territory may be claimed by a civilization or a city state, through expansion of city borders or by founding a new city there. With the exception of the Fort and Airstrip improvements, players are not allowed to construct items in neutral territory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 中立：当前不被文明或城邦所拥有的领土。文明或城邦可能通过城市边界扩张或创建新城市获得中立领土。除堡垒和飞机跑道这两种改良设施外，玩家无法在中立领土中修建任何项目。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.en_US: Rival: Territory that is owned by another civilization or city-state. Players cannot move into a rival’s territory without first establishing Open Borders with that civilization. Unit healing is lowest in rival territory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_15_CHAPTER.zh_Hans_CN: 敌对：其他文明或城邦所拥有的领土。和该文明开放边界前玩家无法进入敌对领土。单位治愈效果在敌对领土中最差。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: You can accomplish a lot through diplomacy. You can gain allies and isolate your enemies. You can create defensive and offensive pacts. You can increase your technology through cooperative research ventures. You can end wars that are going badly for you. You can bluff the credulous and bully the timid.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 外交至关重要。您可通过外交建立盟友并孤立敌人。签订防御及进攻条约。通过有风险的合作研究来增强科技。结束对您不利的战争。向他国吹嘘及欺凌弱小。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: To initiate diplomacy, click on the leader you wish to contact in the upper right portion of the screen. The Diplomacy Panel will appear, displaying all known civilizations. Click on any leader to speak with them. Alternatively, you can click on a civilization's city banner to open communications with them.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 点击屏幕右上方您期望与之联系的领袖来展开外交。会出现外交面板，上面显示了所有已知文明。点击领袖与之交谈。或者，您可点击一个文明城市面板来与他们进行交流。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: When you engage in diplomacy with civilizations, you will have a number of options available, depending on your current relationship. This screen will also provide important information about your relationship, as well as the latest gossip about what that leader has been doing.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 当您与一个文明展开外交活动时，你有很多选择，一切都取决于目前你们之间的关系。屏幕上也会显示出关于你们关系的重要信息，以及关于领袖行为的最近一次闲聊内容。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: You may choose to declare war, or denounce the leader. You may also negotiate a trade deal, or demand stuff from another civilization. You can also propose friendship, defensive pacts, and send delegations.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 您可以选择宣战或谴责领袖。您也可以进行贸易谈判，或要求从另一文明获得某些物品。此外，您还可以提出友谊请求、防御条约、派遣代表团。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Casus Belli represent reasons to go to war where the normal Warmonger penalty for a declaration of war or capturing cities are reduced or eliminated.  Once you reach the Renaissance-era civic Diplomatic Service, you may accumulate Casus Belli against other powers. You must Denounce the other power in order to use a Casus Belli against them. See the table below for the conditions for each Casus Belli, the civic that unlocks them, and the percentage of the usual warmonger penalty that is applied.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Holy War: If one of your cities is converted to the enemy's religion[NEWLINE](Diplomatic Service, 50% warmongering)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]War of Liberation: If a friend or ally had cities conquered[NEWLINE](Diplomatic Service, no warmongering penalty when liberating cities that have been conquered)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]War of Reconquest: If you had cities conquered in a previous war[NEWLINE](Defensive Tactics, no warmongering penalty when retaking your previous cities)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Protectorate War: if a city-state you are Suzerain of is attacked[NEWLINE](Defensive Tactics, no warmongering penalty when liberating a city-state target)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Colonial War: if target civilization is two eras behind you in technology[NEWLINE](Nationalism, 50% warmongering)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]War of Territorial Expansion: if target civilization borders your nation[NEWLINE](Mobilization, 75% warmongering)
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 战争借口即为发动战争的原因。利用战争借口宣战或占领城市获得的好战程度将减少，甚至完全消除。获得文艺复兴时代的市政“外交部门”后，便可以积累战争借口对其他文明宣战。对其他文明使用战争借口之前必须先进行谴责。下表详述了每种战争借口的使用条件、将其解锁的市政，以及使用时获得的好战程度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]圣战：如玩家的一座城市皈依敌方宗教[NEWLINE]（外交部门；50%好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解放战争：如友方或盟友有城市被占领[NEWLINE]（外交部门；解放被占领的城市无好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]收复战争：如玩家有城市在之前的战争中被占领[NEWLINE]（防御战术；重新夺回之前拥有的城市无好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]卫国战争：城邦遭到袭击，而玩家是该城邦的宗主国[NEWLINE]（防御战术；解放城邦目标时无好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]殖民战争：如果目标文明在科技上落后玩家两个时代[NEWLINE]（民族主义；50%好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]领土扩张战争：如果目标文明与玩家的国土接壤[NEWLINE]（动员；75%好战程度）

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Colonial War: You may declare a Colonial War against a civilization which is lagging behind you by 2 technologies, and you have researched the Nationalism Civic. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. This Casus Belli has a reduced Grievance penalty for the era, both for declaring war and capturing cities. If you raze an enemy city, you will receive the full Grievance penalty for a Formal War of the era, as the world no longer buys your excuses about "bringing enlightenment" to your target.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 殖民战争：研究完“民族主义”市政后，即可对落后2个科技的文明发动殖民战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。使用此战争借口宣战和占领城市在本时代导致的不满将降低。但如若将敌方城市夷为平地，世界将不再相信“启蒙开化”这个所谓的理由，文明会获得本时代正式战争的全额不满。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Territorial War: You may declare Territorial War against a civilization if you have researched the Mobilization Civic. The target must have 2 cities within 10 tiles of 2 of your cities. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns. This Casus Belli reduces the era's Formal War Grievance penalty by a bit, both for the actions of declaring war and capturing cities. Razing cities carries a reduced penalty under this Casus Belli, making it useful if you wish to eliminate enemy cities in regions where you wish to expand.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 领土扩张战争：研究“动员”市政后，即可对文明宣布领土扩张战争。前提是目标文明在您2座城市的10个单元格范围内拥有2座城市。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。用该战争借口宣战并占领城市所导致的正式战争不满将稍微降低。在此战争借口中将敌方城市夷为平地所导致的不满将降低。如果希望摧毁阻碍扩张路线的敌方城市，此战争借口将十分实用。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Golden Age War: You may declare a Golden Age War if you have chosen the To Arms! Dedication, and denounced your target. You do not need to wait after denouncing your target to have access to this Casus Belli. During this time your Grievance penalties for the war declaration and city penalties are greatly reduced, making this one of the least diplomatically costly ways to grab territory from your rivals. However, razing an enemy city will have the same Grievance cost as in a Formal War. Having a Golden Age entitles you to the respect of other nations, but not license to act with impunity.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 黄金时代战争：选择“全民皆兵”着力点并谴责目标后即可宣布黄金时代战争。谴责目标后无需等待即可直接使用此战争借口。在此期间，宣战与占领城市所导致的不满将大幅降低，这是从对手处大肆夺取土地的最佳方式，同时无需担心出现严重的外交后果。但若将敌方城市夷为平地，此举导致的不满与正式战争中导致的不满相同。虽然进入黄金时代能得到其他国家的尊重，但这并不意味着可以肆意妄为。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: War of Retribution: You may declare a War of Retribution if you have researched the Early Empire Civic, and another civilization has broken a promise they made to you within the last 30 turns. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. During a War of Retribution only 50% of the current era's Grievance penalty applies. Although an enemy may have broken his promise to you, this does not entitle you to burn his cities to the ground in revenge.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 报复战争：研究“帝国初期”市政后，如另一文明在过去30回合内曾背弃对您的承诺，则可宣布报复战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。报复战争期间仅会导致当前时代50%的不满。因为即使敌人曾违背对您的承诺，也不能焚毁城市来泄愤。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Ideological War: You may declare an Ideological War if you research the Ideology Civic, and have a different Tier 3 government from your target. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns. During an Ideological War only 50% of the current era's Grievance penalty applies.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 意识形态战争：研究“意识形态”市政后，如目标拥有不同的第3级政体，则可宣布意识形态战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。意识形态战争期间仅会导致当前时代50%的不满。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Casus Belli represent reasons to go to war where the Grievance penalties for actions are reduced or eliminated. The first Casus Belli becomes available after you research Early Empire, and others become available as you research other civics. They are laid out below.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 战争借口即为发动战争的原因。战争所导致的不满将减少，甚至不会导致不满。研究“帝国初期”市政后便会获得首个战争借口。随着市政研究的深入，其他战争借口也会一一解锁。请查阅下方相关信息。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Formal War: You may declare a Formal War after Denouncing an enemy and waiting for 5 turns, after which the Formal War option will be available to you in the diplomacy screen with your target. Formal War carries the current era's standard Grievance penalties.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 正式战争：谴责敌方并等待5回合后即可宣布正式战争，之后您与目标的外交画面中则会出现“正式战争”选项。发动正式战争将导致本时代标准的不满。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Surprise War: You can declare a Surprise War at almost any time, but doing so carries severe Grievance penalties, typically an additional 50% of the Grievance generated by actions during a Formal War. Razing cities during a Surprise War carries an especially grievous Grievance penalty.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 突袭战争：文明几乎可以随时发动突袭战争，但此举将导致大量不满。通常情况下会额外导致本时代正式战争50%的不满。在突袭战争中将敌方城市夷为平地将导致极高的不满。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Holy War: You may declare a Holy War if your religion differs from that of your target, you've researched the Diplomatic Service Civic, and you've denounced your target and waited 5 turns. During a Holy War, only 50% of the current era's Grievance penalty applies. If you wish to raze enemy cities, Holy War is one of the least diplomatically costly ways to do so.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 圣战：研究“外交部门”市政后，如您的宗教与目标不同，则可宣布圣战。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。圣战期间导致的不满为本时代标准的50%。如果希望将敌方城市夷为平地，圣战是一种外交代价较低的方式。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Joint War: You may declare a Joint War with another civilization against a target. Both partners in the Joint War need to have researched the Foreign Trade Civic. The Joint War agreement lasts for 30 turns, and carries the same Grievance penalties as a Formal War in that era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 联合作战：文明可以和另一文明对目标发起联合作战。联合作战的合作两方都需要研究“对外贸易”市政。联合作战协议将持续30回合，期间导致的不满与本时代正式战争的标准相同。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Reconquest War: You may declare a Reconquest War if another civilization has captured a city that you founded, and have researched the Defensive Tactics Civic. You must Denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. This Casus Belli is unique in that it generates no additional Grievances against you. You may also choose to raze your reconquest city without penalty if you successfully capture it. Perhaps you cannot bear the sight of your retaken city? You're the implacable tyrant; do what you want.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 收复战争：研究“防御战术”市政后，如某文明占领了您建立的城市，则可宣布收复战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。该战争借口较为特殊，以此宣战不会导致不满。成功收复城市后，即使选择将城市夷为平地也不会导致不满。也许你不忍目睹这座满目疮痍的城市，那就做个无情的暴君，一把火烧掉它吧。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Protectorate War: You may declare a Protectorate War if one of your allied city-states is targeted for war by a major civilization, and if you have researched the Defensive Tactics Civic. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. There is no Grievance penalty for declaring war on your target, but you will suffer the era's Grievance penalty equal to a Formal War if you capture an enemy city. Razing an enemy city during a Protectorate War carries an additional Grievance penalty, as the world does not recognize your Protectorate War as legitimating your land grab.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 保卫城邦战争：研究“防御战术”市政后，如果结盟城邦成为主要文明的战争目标，则可宣布保卫城邦战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。以此对目标宣战不会导致不满。但如果占领敌方城市，则会导致本时代正式战争的不满。如在保卫城邦战争期间将敌方城市夷为平地，国际社会则不再承认保卫城邦战争的合法性，从而招致额外的不满。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Liberation War: You may declare a Liberation War if a friend or ally had cities conquered, and if you have researched the Diplomatic Service Civic. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. There is no Grievance penalty for declaring war on your target. You will suffer the era's Grievance penalty equal to a Formal War if you capture another, different enemy city. If you raze an enemy city, you will suffer a very severe Grievance penalty! This is the most Grievance-costly action in the game, as burning cities in the name of freedom is particularly awful to the other civilizations in the world.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 解放战争：研究“外交部门”市政后，如果友邦或同盟的城市被占领，则可宣布解放战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。以此对目标宣战不会导致不满。但如果占领其他的敌方城市，则会导致等于本时代正式战争的不满；而如果将敌方城市夷为平地，则会导致即为严重的不满！以自由的名义焚毁城市会在世界其他文明中产生极其恶劣的外交影响，所以导致的不满也会极其高昂。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_DIPLO_4_CHAPTER_.en_US: Diplomatic Visibility allows you to receive Gossip, information about another player's actions. You gain more detailed Gossip based on your level of visibility, of which there are 5 levels: None, Limited, Open, Secret, and Top Secret. For example, when you have just met a civilization, you will receive information about their declarations of war, denouncements, friendships, alliances, and when they do something like found a Pantheon or complete a wonder. If you gain Limited Diplomatic Visibility, you will find out some information about their opinion of you and what government they have. At the Open level, you will have access to that civilization's diplomatic agendas, their relationships with other civilizations, and know when they have launched an inquisition.
