LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_2_CHAPT.en_US: Roads are placed by Traders, but may also be placed manually by Military Engineers.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_2_CHAPT.zh_Hans_CN: 道路由商人进行放置，但军事工程师也能手动放置道路。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_3_CHAPT.en_US: Many combat units exert a "Zone of Control" (ZOC) influence over the tiles around them. Combat units that enter an enemy's ZOC must stop, regardless of any remaining [ICON_Movement] Movement. Units that have been stopped by an enemy's ZOC have the option to attack if they have the required [ICON_Movement] Movement to do so.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ranged and Bombard class units do not exert ZOC. Cavalry units, as well as Naval Raider class units have the ability to ignore an enemy's ZOC.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Religious units exert ZOC against other religious units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_3_CHAPT.zh_Hans_CN: 一些战斗单位能将周围单元格变为自己的“控制区”。进入敌方控制区后，无论剩余多少 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，战斗单位均会强制停下。如拥有足够 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，被敌方控制区强制逼停的单位仍可选择发动进攻。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]远程和炮击单位无法形成控制区。骑兵单位和海军袭击者单位则拥有无视敌方控制区的技能。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宗教单位可对其他宗教单位形成控制区。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_3_CHAPT.en_US: Rivers block Zone of Control from all units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_3_CHAPT.zh_Hans_CN: 河流将阻隔所有单位的控制区。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_4_CHAPT.en_US: Generally, naval units follow the same rules as land units, except that they move in the water rather than on land. Early naval units are often limited to coastal waters (those adjacent to land tiles) and coastal cities. Eventually, you'll produce naval units that can enter deep ocean tiles, and thus explore the world.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_4_CHAPT.zh_Hans_CN: 通常而言，海军单位与陆地单位移动规则相同，只是移动区域从陆地换到了海上。初期的海上单位一般只可在近海（与陆地单元格相邻的区域）及沿海城市移动。在游戏进程中后期，您可以建造能够进入海洋单元格的海军单位来探索世界。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_5_CHAPT.en_US: At the start of the game, your land units cannot enter any water tiles. However, once you've learned the Sailing technology, Builders will be able to move into coastal water tiles. After Celestial Navigation, Traders will be able to embark. And after Shipbuilding, all units will be able to embark. To embark a unit, move the unit to a coastal tile and then click on the "Move To" Action. Once embarked, the unit must move into water.[NEWLINE]Land units that embark are considered to be in a transport ship, and do not have the same combat abilities as they do on land. Embarked land units also suffer a reduced combat strength, and can only heal in friendly waters, making them much more vulnerable to attack from enemy naval units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_MOVEMENT_5_CHAPT.zh_Hans_CN: 游戏伊始，陆地单位无法进入水域单元格。研究航海术科技后建造者便可进入沿海水域单元格、研究天文导航后商人即可上船、研究造船术后所有单位均可上船。将单位移动到沿海单元格并点击“上船”行动选项即可使其上船。完成此操作后，单位必须进入水域。[NEWLINE]上船后的陆地单位被视为处于运输船中，陆地上的战斗技能此时无法使用。陆地单位上船后战斗力同样会被削弱，只能在友好水域中治愈。遭敌方海军单位攻击时较为脆弱。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: There are 2 categories of atomic weapons: the Nuclear Device and the Thermonuclear Device.  They can be built as a city Project in any city and both require the Uranium resource to produce. There is no limit on the number that a player can build. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Once a Nuclear or Thermonuclear Device is created, it is added to the player's inventory and can then be used by any unit or improvement capable of deploying it on the map. This includes bomber aircraft, Nuclear Submarines, and the Missile Silo.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 原子武器有两种类型：核装置和热核装置。任何城市只要研究出了必要技术、有可用的铀资源，并且已完成了曼哈顿计划或常春藤行动，便能创造核装置。玩家创建的数量没有限制，但核装置建造成本巨大，并且还有很高的维护费用。核装置创建后会被添加进玩家的清单，随后，任何能将其部署在地图上的单位或改良设施都能使用它。包括轰炸机、核潜艇和导弹发射井。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: Nuclear Devices have a blast radius of 1. When deployed from a Missile Silo, they have a [ICON_Range] Range of 12. They cost 14 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn to maintain.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 核装置的爆炸半径为1。当通过导弹发射井进行部署时，它们的射程为 [ICON_Range] 12。每回合的维护费为14个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: Thermonuclear Devices have a blast radius of 2. When deployed from a Missile Silo, they have a [ICON_Range] Range of 15. They cost 16 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn to maintain.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 热核装置的爆炸半径为2。当通过导弹发射井进行部署时，它们的 [ICON_Range] 射程为15。每回合的维护费为16个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: When an atomic weapon is detonated, several things happen to all the hexes within the blast radius. [ICON_Citizen] Citizens "working" the affected tiles are eliminated, units occupying the affected tiles are destroyed, and all tile improvements are pillaged. Any districts and buildings in the affected tiles are also pillaged and must be repaired to be used again. All tiles affected are contaminated with radioactive fallout.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 引爆一个原子武器时，爆炸半径的所有格位都会发生变化。 在受影响单元格上“工作”的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民会被消灭，占领受影响单元格的单位会被摧毁，所有单元格改良设施会被掠夺。位于受影响单元格上的区域和建筑也会被掠夺，且必须在修复后才能再次使用。所有受影响的单元格都遭到了放射性尘降物的污染。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: After a nuclear attack, fallout will contaminate every tile affected by the blast. Any units that end their turn in a contaminated tile take 50 damage each turn. [ICON_Production] Production cannot be applied to anything in tiles containing contamination, such as repairing buildings and districts. Tiles that are contaminated cannot be worked by the city until the contamination timer expires or until the tile is "cleaned."
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 核攻击后，放射性尘埃会污染每个受爆炸影响的单元格。在受污染单元格上结束回合的任何单位每回合将受到50点伤害。被污染单元格中的所有内容都无法使用 [ICON_Production] 生产力，如修复建筑或区域。城市无法改良受污染的单元格，只有等待污染倒计时结束或单元格被“清理”干净。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Nuclear contamination can be "cleaned" from affected tiles by Builder and Military Engineer units. Cleaning a contaminated tile takes 1 build charge. Builder, Military Engineer, and Roman Legion units that are able to clean contaminated hexes will take less damage if they end their turn in such a hex. Any city tiles not directly affected by the nuclear blast will still function normally and contribute to the city’s yield.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_NUKES_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 建造者和军事工程师单位可“清除”受影响单元格上的核污染。清理被污染的单元格需要花费1个建造次数。能清理受污染格位的建造者和军事工程师单位在这样的格位上结束回合时，会受到较少伤害。没有直接受到核爆炸影响的城市单元格继续正常运转，并带来城市收益。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.en_US: [ICON_Power] Power is needed by buildings in a city in order to function at their best performance. It is especially important in the Industrial Era and later. Cities without sufficient Power cannot produce yields as well. A well-functioning city will have enough Power to supply its needs.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.zh_Hans_CN: 城市中的一些建筑需要 [ICON_Power] 电力方能维持最佳工作状态。在工业时代及之后的时代中，[ICON_Power] 电力极其重要。[ICON_Power] 供电不足的城市将无法提供产出。城市在 [ICON_Power] 供电充足时方能发挥正常功能。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.en_US: If a city has enough Power to meet all its needs, then it is considered [ICON_Power] Powered. A city that does not have enough Power is [ICON_PowerInsufficient] Unpowered. A city is either one or the other, it cannot provide Power to some buildings and not to others. Buildings which require Power provide less than half of their normal yield when the city is Unpowered.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.zh_Hans_CN: 若城市的 [ICON_Power] 电力供给可以自足，则将被视为 [ICON_Power] 供电充足；无足够电力的城市将被视为 [ICON_PowerInsufficient] 供电不足。城市只会处于以上两种状态之一，无法对特定建筑单独供电。城市供电不足时，建筑产出将降低到正常值的一半以下。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.en_US: One source of Power is resources such as [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal, [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil, and [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium. Once a player has an improvement that provides this resource, and they build the appropriate kind of Power Plant in the Industrial Zone, the city automatically converts the resource from the stockpile into Power. The Power Plant can provide Power to any city that needs it, within a 6 tile range. However, using Coal, Oil, or Uranium to produce Power can also lead to Global Warming, so there will be long-term costs to the environment for doing so.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Power] 电力的来源之一是 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] 煤、[ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油和 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] 铀之类的资源。如文明拥有可提供此类资源的改良设施，在工业区中修建对应种类的发电厂后，城市会自动将资源储备转换为 [ICON_Power] 电力。发电厂可向6个单元格范围内有需要的城市提供 [ICON_Power] 电力。但使用煤、石油和铀会导致全球变暖，进行这类发电将付出长期的环境代价。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.en_US: A Power Plant generates Power for each unit of resource that it consumes. Coal and Oil Power Plants provide 4 Power per resource, while Nuclear provides 16 Power per resource. For example, a Coal Power Plant will convert Coal from the player’s stockpile into Power each turn. Power Plants automatically try to provide enough Power to meet the demands of the cities in range and will draw from the most power-efficient resource first, before moving onto other resources. If there is a tie, a player’s largest resource stockpile is used first. If there is still a tie, they start with the resource that the player is earning more of each turn. If there is still a tie, they start with the more technologically advanced resource. For example, if a player has both a Coal Power Plant and an Oil Power Plant in their Civilization, but a larger supply of Coal than Oil, the Power Plants will draw from the Coal stockpile before making up the difference with Oil. If that player also had a Nuclear Power Plant, they would draw from the Uranium stockpile before anything else, since 1 Uranium provides 16 Power.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.zh_Hans_CN: 发电厂可消耗资源来产生电力。燃煤发电厂和燃油发电厂每消耗1点资源将提供4点电力；而核电站每消耗1点资源将提供16点电力。举例而言，燃煤发电厂每回合可将文明储备的煤转换为电力。发电厂将自行尝试满足范围内城市的电力需求，其将优先消耗转换效率最高的资源，然后再使用其他资源。如果转换效率相等，则优先消耗储量最高的资源。如果储量仍然相同，则优先消耗每回合获得量最大的资源。如获得量依然相同，则优先消耗科技含量最高的资源。举例而言，如文明同时拥有燃煤发电厂与燃油发电厂，而煤储备量大于石油，则石油和煤储备相等之前发电厂将优先消耗煤储备。如该玩家还拥有核电站，则将优先消耗铀储备来发电，因为1点铀可以产生16点电力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.en_US: Alternatively, a player may attempt to build green sources of Energy, such as hydroelectric dams and wind farms. These are unlocked with later technologies and can provide power without adding to global warming.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_POWER_CHAPTER_CO.zh_Hans_CN: 文明也可以选择打造水电站坝和风力发电厂等绿色能源。游戏后期科技能够解锁此类设施，在不加剧全球变暖的前提下为城市提供 [ICON_Power] 电力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_PRIDE_MOMENTS_1_.en_US: Historic Moments are significant events that happen throughout the history of the game, ranging from being the first to choose a new form of government, to building a Unique Unit, to discovering Natural Wonders. There are dozens of these Historic Moments through the course of the game, representing world-first and player first achievements. These moments differ through the eras. For example, clearing a Barbarian Camp in the Ancient Era is an important milestone, but clearing one in the Modern Era won't even merit acknowledgement. You can view your Historic Moments at any time in your game by clicking on the History Timeline in the upper left toolbar. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each Historic Moment adds towards your Era Score for the era, which is the measure of whether you will rise into a Golden Age or sink into a Dark Age in the next era. If you are gaining lots of Historic Moments in an era, it means you are likely to go into a Golden Age in the next era. If you are the first player in the world to get a Historic Moment, you will earn more Era Score points.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_PRIDE_MOMENTS_1_.zh_Hans_CN: 历史时刻是游戏历史进程中的重大事件，例如成为首个选择新政体的文明、生产特色单位、发现自然奇观等。游戏进程中有数十个这样的历史时刻，记载世界首个成就和玩家达成的首个成就。历史时刻在不同时代中有所不同。举例而言，在远古时代清除蛮族营地是重要的里程碑时刻，但在现代却不值一提。点击工具栏左上角的“历史年表”即可在游戏中查看历史时刻。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每个历史时刻将添加时代得分，而这将成为进入黄金时代或沦入黑暗时代的衡量标准。如果您在一个时代中获得了大量历史时刻，则意味着下个时代很可能进入黄金时代。如您成为世界上首个获得一种历史时刻的玩家，则能获得更多时代得分。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_1_CHAPTE.en_US: Each technology you acquire gives your civilization access to some advanced unit, building, resource, or wonder, or gives you some other tangible benefit such as the ability to chop Woods and harvest Cattle. Each new technology makes your civilization that much more powerful. Every turn, your civilization receives [ICON_Science] Science added to its pool, and when you have accumulated enough [ICON_Science] Science, you acquire a new technology.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_1_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 您获得的每种科技都会让您的文明获得某些高级单位、建筑、资源、奇观，或给您一些其他实际好处，比如锯木能力和获得牛这样的牲畜。每种新科技都会让您的文明更加强大。您的文明会在每回合获得 [ICON_Science] 科技值，您累积了足够的 [ICON_Science] 科技值后，会获得新科技。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_2_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Science] Science comes from a variety of sources, including your [ICON_Citizen] Citizens (0.7 per [ICON_Citizen]), your Palace, some Policies, some Religious Beliefs, some resources, wonders, trading, and of course the Campus district and its buildings. Look through the Civilopedia to find sources of [ICON_Science] Science.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_2_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Science] 科技值有多种来源，包括您的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民（每位 [ICON_Citizen] 提供0.7）、宫殿、政策、宗教信仰、资源、奇观、贸易，以及学院区和其中的建筑。查看文明百科，了解 [ICON_Science] 科技值的来源。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Eureka moments, also known as "technology boosts", provide an immediate and significant boost towards your research of a technology. These boosts will be earned as you play the game naturally, and your actions will determine what sort of Eureka moments you encounter. For example, settling a city on the coast will boost your progress towards Sailing and creating a Pasture will boost your progress towards Horseback Riding. The Technology Tree lists boosts associated with each technology, but you may gain them from other sources (such as Great People, Research Agreements, or team shared research).
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 尤里卡时刻也被称为“科技提升”，它能为您的某项科技研究立即提供显著提升。正常玩游戏的同时便可获得提升，同时您的操作会决定遇见的尤里卡时刻类型。例如，在海岸上建造城市会提升您的航海术研究进度，创建一座牧场能提升您的骑马学习进度。科技树列出了与每种科技相关的提升，但玩家也能从其他来源处获得提升（如伟人、研究协议，或团队共享研究）。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_4_CHAPTE.en_US: To see how all of this works in the game, check out the amazing Technology Tree. It displays all of the technologies and shows how they are intertwined. You can click on a technology to order your civilization to research it – if your civilization doesn't know the prerequisite technologies it will research them as well. The technology tree will plot the quickest route to the requested tech, and you will research the necessary precursors in the order it displays.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_SCIENCE_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 查看奇妙的科技树，以了解其在游戏中的作用。它显示了各项科技以及它们之间的复杂联系。点击其中的科技，便可对其进行研究——如果您的文明不了解必要的科技，它也会对它们进行研究。您将按照科技树中所显示的最快研究路线，对必要科技按照顺序进行研究。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: Prior to starting a game, individual civilizations can be placed on teams for a more cooperative experience.  When playing as a team, team members share a variety of gameplay benefits and can win the game collectively.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 开始游戏之前，个体文明可组队合作进行游戏。在团队游戏中，团队成员可共享诸多游戏加成，携手赢得胜利。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: Team play is currently available in standard multiplayer games and most multiplayer scenarios.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 当前可在标准多人游戏和多数的多人情景中进行团队游戏。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: Team members share a permanent diplomatic alliance.  All the standard alliance rules and benefits apply.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 团队成员为永久性的外交同盟，享受所有标准同盟规则和增益。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Team members share war status.  If a team member declares war, the declared Casus Belli conditions apply to all team members.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 团队成员将共享战争状态。如一个团队成员宣战，宣布的战争借口条件将应用到所有团队成员。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_4_CHAPTER_.en_US: Team members partially share research progress. Team members receive a technology boost for every technology possessed by a team member.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TEAMS_4_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 团队成员可共享部分研究进程。团队成员所拥有的每种科技均会为其他团队成员带来科技提升。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_1_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Tourism] Tourism is needed in order to win a Culture Victory. You can generate [ICON_Tourism] Tourism through Great Works, wonders, Holy Cities, [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts, Seaside Resorts and National Parks. You can boost your [ICON_Tourism] Tourism through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, Open Borders, Great People, policies, and shared (or conflicting) late game governments.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Building a wonder will probably be one of the first ways you start earning [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. Each Wonder provides 2 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn, plus 1 for each era you have advanced past the era in which that wonder was first available. So an ancient wonder like Stonehenge can earn you 9 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn by the end of the game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tourism is divided into Religious Tourism (from creating a Holy City and from Relics) and Non-Religious Tourism. Some Civics (Enlightenment) and Wonders (Cristo Redentor) specifically affect the impact of your Religious Tourism.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_1_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 要取得文化胜利，[ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩是关键所在。您能通过巨作、奇观、圣城、[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物、[ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物、海滨度假区和国家公园产生 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。您能通过 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、开放边界、伟人、政策和具有相似特质的（或相矛盾的）游戏后期政体来提升您的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]初期获得 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩的方法之一是修建奇观。每个奇观每回合提供2点 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。奇观修建起后每经历一个时代，旅游业绩+1。以此计算，远古时代奇观巨石阵在游戏后期时每回合可提供9点 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]旅游业绩分为宗教旅游业绩（通过创建圣城和遗物所得）和非宗教旅游业绩。部分市政（启蒙运动）和奇观（救世基督像）对宗教旅游业绩的产生影响较大。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_2_CHAPTE.en_US: Great Works come in five different types. [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] Writing, [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Art, and [ICON_GreatWork_Music] Music which can be generated through [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts, which are retrieved from Antiquity Sites by Archaeologists, and [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, which are created by Apostles with the Martyr ability when they die in Theological Combat. (Relics can be obtained from other sources such as Tribal Villages, the city-state Kandy, or Jeanne D'Arc when she retires.) Once earned, a Great Work can be housed in a Great Work slot in the appropriate building or Wonder.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_2_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 巨作有五种不同的类型。[ICON_GreatWork_Writing] 著作、[ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 艺术和 [ICON_GreatWork_Music] 音乐可通过 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人生成。[ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物由考古学家从历史古迹挖掘。拥有殉教能力的使徒在神学战斗中死去后将生成 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物（也可以通过其他来源获得，如部落村庄、城邦康提，或圣女贞德的隐退）。获得巨作后，可将其放置在适当建筑或奇观的巨作槽位中。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Seaside Resorts are a special improvement that can be built after researching the Radio technology. These generate [ICON_Tourism] Tourism based on the tile's Appeal.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 研究完无线电科技后，可创建海滨度假区这种特殊改良设施。它们能产生以单元格魅力为基础的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.en_US: Designating National Parks can greatly enhance [ICON_Tourism] Tourism and [ICON_Amenities] Amenities. National Parks are designated by Naturalist units, which may be purchased in your city with [ICON_Faith] Faith after researching the Conservation civic.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 建立国家公园可极大增加 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩和 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。国家公园由单位“自然学家”建立。研究完“保护地球”市政后，可在城市中使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买此单位。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.en_US: National Parks can be built on a cluster of any four tiles that meet the following requirements:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 国家公园可建在满足以下条件的一组四个格位上：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.en_US: 1. The tiles must be natural wonders, mountains, or a tile with an Appeal of Charming or better.[NEWLINE]2. All four of the tiles must be owned by the same city.[NEWLINE]3. The tiles must be contiguous and form a vertical diamond shape.[NEWLINE]4. No tile can have an improvement or district.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 1. 单元格必须是自然奇观、山脉，或者，该单元格带有迷人魅力或更高级别魅力。[NEWLINE]2. 这四个单元格必须为同一座城市所有。[NEWLINE]3. 单元格必须相连并形成垂直菱形。[NEWLINE]4. 单元格上不能有改良设施或区域。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.en_US: You can select a Naturalist to reveal any valid locations on the map. Sending the Naturalist to any highlighted tile will reveal the Designate National Park action button. Clicking on this button designates the National Park and consumes the Naturalist.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 选中自然学家即可显示地图上的有效位置。将自然学家移动至高亮单元格将显示“建立国家公园”按钮。点击此按钮即可消耗自然学家建立国家公园。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.en_US: A National Park's [ICON_Tourism] Tourism output is equal to the total Appeal of all the tiles included in the park. Additionally, the city that owns the park receives 2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities, and the four closest cities in your civilization receive 1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 国家公园的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩输出等于公园所含全部单元格的总魅力。此外，拥有公园的城市获得2点 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，且与此城市最近的4座城市获得1点 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_5_CHAPTE.en_US: Some buildings (such as the Art Museum or Archeological Museum) allow you to theme Great Works for a significant boost to [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. To receive a theming bonus, display [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Art of the same type by different artists or [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts of the same era from different civilizations.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_5_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 部分建筑（如艺术博物馆或考古博物馆）可对巨作进行主题分类，以获得 [ICON_Culture] 文化值和 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩的大量提升。展示来自不同艺术家的同类 [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 艺术品或来自不同文明的同时代 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物可获得主题加成。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_6_CHAPTE.en_US: If your civilization attracts more visiting tourists from another civilization than they have domestic tourists, you are culturally dominant over that civilization. A Culture Victory is awarded to the first player to become culturally dominant over all other civilizations.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_6_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 您的文明从另一个文明吸引到的国际游客数量多于此文明的国内游客数量时，即意味着您实现了对此文明的文化征服。对所有其他文明完成文化征服的首位玩家将赢得文化胜利。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_6_CHAPTE.en_US: In addition to progress towards a Culture Victory, however, cultural dominance also provides various benefits to the dominant civilization:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TOURISM_6_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 除了迈向文化胜利之外，文化征服还将为实现征服的文明带来以下益处：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: The Trader unit is unlocked by researching Foreign Trade, and built in cities. Trader units are on a separate map layer, and do not interact with most normal things on a map. They can freely stack with any other units, and they ignore cultural borders.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 通过研究对外贸易可解锁商人单位，并在城市中创建商人单位。商人单位位于单独的地图层，与地图上多数事物不产生任何联系。它们可随意与其他单位重叠，并忽视文化边界。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: When a Trader is in a city the player owns, it can begin a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route between that city and another city that is in range, as long as none of your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes are already going there (for example, if I already have a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route to the city of Athens, I cannot send a second one there), and the player has not reached their maximum number of [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 商人位于玩家拥有的城市中时，可开启一条此城和范围内另一座城市之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。前提是没有通向此处的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线（例如已有一条到雅典的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，便无法建立第二条通往此处的路线），且玩家的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线数量未达上限。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: Once made, the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route will last for at least 20 turns on Standard game speed. The Trader unit will move automatically along its path for the duration of the route, but will not finish the route until it has returned to the origin city's tile. When on an active route, the Trader unit will disregard terrain restrictions and move 1 tile every turn, placing a Road as it moves. Don't forget to protect your Trader from Barbarians or hostile civilizations, as it is vulnerable to pillaging.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 一旦建成， [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线在标准速度下至少持续20回合。在路线持续时间内，商人单位会沿着道路自行移动，但直到返回起源城市单元格后，该路线才算完成。位于有效路线时，商人单位会忽视地形限制，并在每回合移动1个单元格的距离，当其移动时，会放置一条道路。请一定记得保护您的商人免于受到来自蛮族或敌对文明的伤害，因为其很容易受到掠夺。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: At the end of the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route's duration, you will have the option of renewing the previous [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route, assigning a new [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route from the current city, or reassigning the Trader to a new city.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线失效后，玩家可选择续新之前的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、从当前城市指定一条新 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，或将商人重新派遣到一座新城市。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: A player can only maintain a limited number of active [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes. This capacity is determined primarily by the number of Commercial Hub and Harbor districts they have, but can be increased by other means as well. Note that [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes from Commercial Hub and Harbor districts do not stack in the same city—the benefit only applies with the first one you build.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 一个玩家只能拥有数量有限的有效 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。路线容量主要取决于玩家拥有的商业中心和港口的数量，但也可通过其他方式增加。需要注意的是来自商业中心和港口区域的贸易路线不会在相同城市中叠加，只会在建成第一个区域时应用此规则。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: On land, a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route can reach destinations within a range of 15 tiles. Once the player researches the technology that allows embarkation, Traders can also move over water. On water, the range is 30 tiles. If you have a [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post in the city, the Trader "refuels" its allowance for the new travel domain, and can move further. Otherwise, it must stop at that city.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 陆地上的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可到达15个单元格范围内的目的地。玩家研究完成上船科技后，商人便能在水域上移动。贸易路线在水域上的范围为30个单元格。如城中有 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站，商人将“补充”可移动到新地点的限额，可以继续移动。否则它将停留在该城市中。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Changing between land and water can only be done at a City Center or Harbor district, and the allowance does not carry over.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 陆地和水域之间的切换只能在市中心或港口区域中进行，切换后无法继承限额。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_4_CHAPTER_.en_US: Extend your trade network and make it more lucrative with [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Posts. A [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post is placed at a city once a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route to or from that city successfully completes. It belongs to the player that owned the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_4_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站能扩大贸易网络，获得更多利润。到达城市（或从城市出发）的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线成功完成后，[ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站将出现在城市中。它属于拥有 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的玩家。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_4_CHAPTER_.en_US: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes can “refuel” their [ICON_Movement] Movement range in any city that has one of your [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Posts, allowing them to reach further destinations. If the city belongs to another player, the [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post also makes the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route more valuable, providing +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold for its income.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_4_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可在拥有 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站的任意城市中“补充”其 [ICON_Movement] 移动力范围，以便到达更远的目的地。如城市属于另一个玩家，[ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站也可为 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的收入+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币，使其更具价值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_5_CHAPTER_.en_US: A [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route provides yields each turn to its origin city, primarily based on which districts are at its destination city. For example, trading with a city with a Holy Site will provide [ICON_Faith] Faith, and trading with a city with a Theater Square district will provide [ICON_Culture] Culture. Additionally, Religion and [Icon_Tourism] Tourism can spread along [Icon_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_5_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线每回合为其发源城市提供产出，主要取决于其目的地城市所拥有的区域。例如，与拥有圣地的城市进行贸易可产出 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、与拥有剧院广场区域的城市进行贸易可产出 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。此外，宗教与 [Icon_Tourism] 旅游业绩将沿 [Icon_TradeRoute] 贸易路线进行传播。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_5_CHAPTER_.en_US: It also gets yields based on the path it takes. If it passes through a [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post you own in a foreign city, it is worth an additional 1 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Long paths which pass through several [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Posts are very valuable.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_TRADE_5_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 贸易路线还将基于其行进路径进行产出。如通过外国城市中的己方 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站，将额外提供1个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。通过多个 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站的长路线收益颇高。
贸易路线拥有者的收益

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_1_CHAPTE.en_US: There are multiple ways to win and lose a game in Civilization VI. It's important to keep an eye on your opponents' progress toward victory as you advance your own civilization. There's nothing quite as annoying as to be on the verge of capturing your last surviving enemy's final city, only to watch helplessly as he or she completes her Mars colony and wins an upset Science Victory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_1_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 有《文明VI》里获得成功和失败的方法有很多种。在您发展自己文明时，密切关注对手的胜利进度至关重要。当您将要占领最后一位敌人的唯一幸存城市的千钧一发之际，却无能为力地眼睁睁看着他/她建成火星殖民地并赢得科技胜利，这十分的令人不爽。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_2_CHAPTE.en_US: To win a Domination victory, you must capture all original civilization [ICON_Capital] Capitals.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_2_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 达成统治胜利的方法是占领所有文明的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_2_CHAPTE.en_US: If you've lost your original [ICON_Capital] Capital, but still possess other cities, you can still win another type of victory: Culture, Science, Score, or Religious. However, you cannot win a Domination Victory until and unless you recapture your own original [ICON_Capital] Capital.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_2_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 如您已失去原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都，但仍保有其他城市，您仍旧可以通过文化、科技、分数，或宗教方式获得其他胜利。但只有当您夺回自己的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都后，才有机会赢得统治胜利。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_2_CHAPTE.en_US: To win a team domination victory, all team members must control their own original [ICON_Capital] capitals while all other players do not.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_2_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 要达成团队统治胜利，所有团队成员必须守住自身的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都，并占领其他所有玩家的原始首都。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.en_US: The Science Victory is achieved by the first player to establish a colony on the planet Mars. Once the Space Race is underway, and someone has launched their first satellite, all players will know who is attempting this victory. Players receive bonuses for reaching each milestone along the way to victory. The following steps must be completed in order:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 第一个在火星上创建殖民地的玩家将获得科技胜利。一旦开展太空竞赛，以及有人发射第一颗卫星后，所有玩家都会知道谁在试图获得该胜利。在通往成功的路上，玩家会因为达到里程碑而获得加成。以下步骤必须按顺序完成：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.en_US: To win a Team Science Victory, an individual team member needs to complete the standard Science Victory requirements.  Requirement completion is not shared.  Teammates are encouraged to cooperate towards a Team Science Victory using Team Shared Research.  See the Teams page.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 要达成团队科技胜利，其中一名团队成员必须达到标准科技胜利的要求。胜利条件的达成进度无法共享。团队成员可多加利用团队共享研究，合作达成团队科技胜利。详情请查阅“团队”页面。
发射一颗卫星进入太空：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Reminiscent of Sputnik in 1957, you may build a satellite to launch into space after researching Rocketry and building a Spaceport. After completing the Earth Satellite project, your satellite will be launched and you will be awarded visibility of the entire map.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 让人回忆起1957年的人造卫星，在研究完火箭技术和建成一个宇航中心后，您可以建造一颗卫星发射进太空。地球卫星项目完成后，您将能发射卫星并看清整张地图。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Land a Human on the Moon:

Just like the Apollo 11 mission in 1969, you will send a human to the moon. This is unlocked after researching the technology Satellites, and can be built in any city with a Spaceport. Choose to produce the Moon Landing project to begin this mission. After the rocket has been launched, you will immediately be rewarded a lump sum of [ICON_Culture] Culture.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 与1969年阿波罗11号的任务一样，您将把人类送往月球。研究完科技卫星后解锁，可在任何有宇航中心的城市中建造。选择进行登月项目来开始这一任务。发射火箭后，您会立即获得一批量 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Science fiction for now, perhaps – but now you can be the first to send your people to Mars. After researching Robotics, Nuclear Fission, and Nanotechnology, you may build the Reactor, Habitation, and Hydroponics module projects in any city with a Spaceport. Note that more than one Spaceport means parallel production!
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 或许只是暂时的科幻小说——但现在您能成为首位将您的国民送上火星的人。研究机器人学、核裂变、纳米科技后，您可以在任何有宇航中心的城市建造反应堆、住所，以及进行溶液栽培模块项目。注意，一个以上的宇航中心意味着平行生产。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.en_US: Once every piece is launched, you have won the game.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_3_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 发射所有物体后，您便赢得了比赛。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_4_CHAPTE.en_US: If you aim to be the cultural epicenter of the world, this is the victory for you. The first civilization to possess a total number of [ICON_Tourism] Visiting Tourists that exceeds the [ICON_Tourism] Domestic Tourists of each other civilization in the game wins the Culture Victory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 如果您的目标是世界文化中心，那这就是为您设定的胜利方式。第一个 [ICON_Tourism] 国际游客总数超过游戏里其他任一文明 [ICON_Tourism] 国内游客数量的文明获得文化胜利。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_4_CHAPTE.en_US: [ICON_Tourism] Tourism is generated by [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, shared (or conflicting) late game Governments, open borders, Great Works housed in your civilization, [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics housed in your civilization, Holy Sites, National Parks, [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts, and wonders.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、具有相似特质的（或相矛盾的）游戏后期政体、开放边界、放置在您文明里的巨作、 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物、圣地、国家公园、 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物和奇观能产生 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_4_CHAPTE.en_US: To win a Team Culture Victory, an individual team member's [ICON_Tourism] Visiting Tourists must exceed the [ICON_Tourism] Domestic Tourists of all non-team member civilizations.  [ICON_Tourism] Visiting Tourists are not shared between team members.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_4_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 要达成团队文化胜利，其中一名团队成员的 [ICON_Tourism] 国际游客数必须超过所有非团队成员文明的 [ICON_Tourism] 国内游客数。[ICON_Tourism] 国际游客数无法在团队成员之间共享。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_5_CHAPTE.en_US: In order to obtain a Religious Victory, you must make your Religion the predominant Religion for every other major civilization in the game. This means not every one of a civilization's cities must follow your Religion, just the majority.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_5_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 为了取得宗教胜利，您必须让您的宗教成为游戏中所有其他文明的主流宗教。这意味着并不需要文明城市里的所有人都信奉您的宗教，仅需多数人即可。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_5_CHAPTE.en_US: While your Religion will spread passively simply by settling near other players, it is your Missionaries and Apostles who offer the best chance at victory.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_5_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 虽然通过定居在其他玩家附近可以被动地传播您的宗教，但是要取得胜利还是传教士和使徒更有效果。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_5_CHAPTE.en_US: To win a Team Religious Victory, Religions founded by the team must be the predominant Religion in every other civilization.  The dominate Religions can be of any combination as long as the Religions were all founded by team members.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_5_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 达成团队宗教胜利的方法是使团队创建的宗教成为其他每个文明的主流宗教。主流宗教可以是任意多个宗教的组合，只要它们均为团队成员建立即可。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_6_CHAPTE.en_US: In many games, one of the players will win the game by achieving one of the possible victories. However, if no one achieves one of these victories by the year 2050 (or a player-set turn), the winner is determined by the surviving civilization's "score." Points for your score are earned from number of civics, number of population, number of cities, number of technologies, number of "future technologies", number of wonders, military accomplishments, number of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, and number of Beliefs.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_6_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 一般在游戏中，会有一名玩家通过达到某种胜利条件取得胜利。但是，如果到了2050年（或达到玩家设置的回合数）无人取得胜利，胜利者将由幸存文明的“分数”决定。分数取决于市政、人口、城市、科技、“未来科技”、奇观、军事成就、 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人和信仰。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_6_CHAPTE.en_US: When playing as a team, score is calculated as a summation of the team members' individual civilization scores.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_VICTORY_6_CHAPTE.zh_Hans_CN: 进行团队游戏时，团队成员的分数之和即为总分。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: In Civilization VI, the world is made up of hexagonally-shaped "tiles" (also occasionally known as hexes and spaces). These tiles come in a variety of "terrain-types" -  Desert, Plains, Grassland, Hills, and so forth  - and many also include "features" like Woods and Rainforest. These elements help to determine the tile's usefulness to a nearby city as well as how easy or difficult it is to move through the tile. A tile's terrain and features may have important effects upon any combat occurring there.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 在《文明VI》中，世界是由六角形的“单元格”所组成（偶尔被称为格位和空格）。这些单元格有许多不同的“地形”——沙漠、平原、草原、丘陵等等——其中有许多也含有例如树林和雨林等“地貌”。此类元素决定了城市周围单元格的有用性及移动通过其的难易度。此外，单元格的地形及地貌还会对在其上发生的战斗产生重大影响。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_1_CHAPTER_.en_US: Every tile in the game belongs to a continent. Continents are geographical boundaries, and are not necessarily tied to a landmass—the Pangaea map, for example, is made up of several continents. You can determine a tile's continent by that tile's tooltip or by viewing the continent lens.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_1_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 游戏中的每个单元格都属于一个大陆。大陆是地理边界，不一定与地块紧密相连——比如，盘古大陆的地图由几个大陆组成。通过单元格提示框或查看大陆滤镜，你可以确定单元格大陆。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: Resources are sources of a variety of different yields ([ICON_Food] Food, [ICON_Production] Production, etc.), and some provide other special bonuses to a civilization. They appear in certain hexes. Some are visible at the start of the game, while others require the acquisition of specific technologies before you can see them. To utilize a resource, it must be within your civilization's borders and you must construct the appropriate "improvement" in that hex. There are three types of resources: Bonus, Luxury, and Strategic.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 资源是（ [ICON_Food] 食物、 [ICON_Production] 生产力等）不同收益的源泉，其中一些能为文明提供特殊加成。它们出现在特定格位上。有些在游戏伊始可见，有些则是在您获得特定科技后可见。在位于境内的资源格位之上修建改良设施，方可对其加以利用。资源分为三种：加成、奢侈品和战略。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: Bonus resources can increase the [ICON_Food] Food, [ICON_Gold] Gold, or [ICON_Production] Production output of a hex. Bonus resources cannot be traded to other civilizations. These resources can be "harvested" by Builders to remove the resource and provide an immediate, one-time sum of [ICON_Food] Food or [ICON_Production] Production to the city that owns the hex.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 加成资源可提高格位的 [ICON_Food] 食物、 [ICON_Gold] 金币，或 [ICON_Production] 生产力产出。加成资源无法与其他文明进行交易。建造者可通过“收获”而移除资源，并为该格位所属的城市提供即时的、一次性的总 [ICON_Food] 食物和 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: Luxury resources increase your civilization's happiness by providing [ICON_Amenities] Amenities and provide a small bonus to the hex's yield output. Only one source of a specific Luxury resource provides [ICON_Amenities] Amenities.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 奢侈品资源通过提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，以及为格位收益产出提供少量加成来提高您文明的幸福度。只有一种特殊奢侈品资源的来源能提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.en_US: Strategic resources are not always visible at the start of the game—they may require knowledge of a particular technology before they appear on a map. Strategic resources allow you to build certain units. When you construct an improvement on a Strategic resource hex, it allows you to build units that require that resource (i.e. Musketmen require Niter) in any of your cities that has an appropriate district—Encampment for land units, Harbor for naval units, or Aerodrome for air units. If you build an improvement on 2 copies of that resource, you can build or purchase those units in any city, whether it has the appropriate district or not.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_2_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 战略资源并不是说从游戏一开始你就可以看到它的——它们需要解锁某些特定科技才能显示在地图上。您可通过战略资源建造特定单位。在战略资源格位建造一项改良设施后，您便可创建特殊单位，这些单位创建需要您某些城市中的资源（比如火枪手需要硝石），城市中还需要有合适的区域——适用于陆地单位的军营、适用于海军单位的港口，或适用于空中单位的航空港。如果您在两个相同资源上建造一个改良设施，您便能在任何城市创建或购买这些单位，而不管城市中是否有合适区域。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_3_CHAPTER_.en_US: Natural wonders are the great and glorious creations of nature that awe and inspire us all. These include Crater Lake and the Great Barrier Reef – all places that truly display the grand beauty of the natural world. All natural wonders provide unique benefits to your civilization, and some even have additional special effects (for instance, healing adjacent to the Dead Sea will make a unit’s health refill completely.)
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_3_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 自然奇观是大自然伟大而辉煌的创造，让我们感到无比敬畏和鼓舞。自然奇观是包括火山口湖和大堡礁在内的所有真正显示大自然宏伟美景的地方。它能为您的文明带来独特好处，有的甚至还有额外特殊影响（比如，在死海附近治愈效果能让单位生命值完全恢复）。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_4_CHAPTER_.en_US: Traditionally, cities have been built along Rivers, and for good reason. Rivers provide fresh water for people to drink and irrigation, improving the farmland around the city. They also protect a city, as it is quite difficult to mount an assault against a city across a River.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_4_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 一般来说城市是沿着河流建造的，这么做也有着其合理的理由。河流为人类提供饮用淡水，且可以帮助灌溉，改善城市周围的农田。同时，它也具有保护城市的功能，毕竟要越过一条河流突击城市是相当困难的。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_4_CHAPTER_.en_US: Rivers block Zone of Control from all units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_4_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 河流将阻隔所有单位的控制区。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_5_CHAPTER_.en_US: Tribal Villages are less civilized than other civilizations, but are friendly nonetheless. Visiting tribal villages provide a random benefit to the civilization of the unit that first enters their tile. The village disappears after its gifts have been claimed. Gifts include survivors, such as Builders or Traders, technology or technology boosts, military units, [ICON_Faith] Faith, [ICON_Gold] Gold, [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, or civic boosts.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_5_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 部落村庄没有其他文明开化，但却非常友好。拜访部落村庄能为首个进入单元格的单位文明提供随机好处。村庄礼品被领取后，该村庄会消失。礼品包括幸存者，比如建造者或商人，科技或科技提升、军事单位、 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、 [ICON_Gold] 金币、 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物或市政提升。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.en_US: Barbarians come from "outposts", which may appear randomly in any tile that cannot be seen by a unit. Each Barbarian unit belongs to its own home outpost. There are three types of Barbarian outposts: Naval, Cavalry, and Melee. A civilization will earn a [ICON_Gold] Gold reward for dispersing a Barbarian outpost − in addition to the benefit of stopping it from spawning more Barbarian units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 蛮族来自“哨站所”，哨站所会随机出现在任意一个不能被单位看见的单元格上。蛮族单位归它自己的起源哨站所所有。有3种蛮族哨站所：海军、骑兵和近战。驱散一个蛮族哨站，除了能阻止更多蛮族单位的产生，还能让文明获得一个 [ICON_Gold] 金币奖励。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.en_US: Naval Barbarian outposts on the coastline can create naval units (equal to those that can be created by the civilization with the most advanced tech). These units will menace your coastline, destroy naval improvements and attack hapless land units which stray too near the coastline. It's important to maintain a navy to keep them off your back, but the best way to stop these attacks is to destroy the coastal outposts nearby.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 海岸线上的海军蛮族哨站所可创建海军单位（与科技最发达的文明一致）。这些单位会威胁您的海岸线、毁坏海军改良设施、袭击在海岸线附近迷路的倒霉陆地单位。维持一支海军以避免自己背部受敌至关重要，但阻止攻击的最好方式是摧毁附近的沿海哨站所。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.en_US: Cavalry outposts, appearing inland and near a Horse resource, will spawn mounted units.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 出现在内陆和马匹资源附近的骑兵哨站所会产生骑乘单位。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.en_US: Melee outposts include every other instance of Barbarians spawned.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 近战哨站所则生成其他类型的蛮族。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.en_US: Every outpost will first generate a Scout, searching for targets. If you’re spotted by a Barbarian Scout, it will return to its outpost and begin building units for an invasion or raid. Watch out, because you’re going to be the next target. If you don’t move fast, you’ll soon see a party of Barbarians at your borders, ready to destroy your improvements or conquer your city. This is why it's important to periodically sweep the countryside around your civilization, destroying outposts before they become a threat.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_6_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 每个哨站所最先会产生侦察兵来寻找目标。如果您被一位蛮族侦察兵发现，它会返回哨站所并开始建造单位进行入侵或袭击。小心，因为您将成为下一个目标。如果不迅速应对，您的国土边境很快便会出现一群正准备摧毁您的改良设施或攻占您城市的蛮族。因此，定期清理文明周边的村落非常重要，在哨站所形成威胁之前将其摧毁。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_7_CHAPTER_.en_US: Lenses are a tool you can use to change your view of the world. Each lens will overlay important information that will help you make strategic decisions in the game. Some lenses are activated automatically, like when you choose to place a district from a city's Production Menu. Others can be activated manually from the Lenses button on the mini-map. These are the lenses you can use in game and what they do:
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_7_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 您可以使用滤镜来改变您的世界观。每个滤镜都会覆盖重要信息，这些信息将帮助您在游戏中做出战略决策。一些滤镜会自动激活，比如，当您决定从城市生产项目界面放置一个区域时。其他滤镜则需要手动点击迷你地图上的滤镜按钮进行激活。这些是您能在游戏中使用的滤镜以及它们的作用：

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_7_CHAPTER_.en_US: Appeal. Shows the appeal level of each tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Continent. Shows the geographic extent of each continent.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]District Placement. Shows valid placement locations for wonders and districts, as well as any adjacency bonuses available for districts. This will only appear when attempting to build a district or wonder.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Government. Shows the distribution of governments across the map.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Political. Shows the owner of each tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Religion. Shows the majority religion and religious follower distribution across the map. This appears whenever a Religious unit is selected.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settler. Shows recommended city sites and water availability at each tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tourism. Shows the number of [ICON_Tourism] Tourists a tile is attracting.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Empire. Shows your city borders and district locations with adjacency bonuses.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_7_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 魅力：显示每个单元格的魅力级别。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]大陆：显示每个大陆的地理范围。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]区域放置：显示奇观和区域的有效放置位置，以及可用于区域的相邻加成。试图建立区域或奇观时，它才会出现。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]政体：显示地图上所有政体的分布。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]政治：显示每个单元格的所有者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宗教：显示地图上的主流宗教和宗教信徒分布。选择一个宗教单位时，它会显现出来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]开拓者：显示每个单元格上的推荐城址和可用水。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]旅游业绩：显示单元格吸引的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游者数量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]帝国：显示城市边境与提供相邻加成的区域位置。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_7_CHAPTER_.en_US: Loyalty. Shows the Loyalty of cities, and the sources of Loyalty that are influencing it.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_7_CHAPTER_.zh_Hans_CN: 忠诚度：显示城市的忠诚度，以及影响忠诚度的来源。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: The World Congress is a new system representing high-level diplomacy between civilizations, and begins meeting once the game has entered the Medieval Era.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 世界议会是一类新机制，代表各文明之间的高级外事交流。游戏进入中世纪后便可召开世界议会。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: The World Congress operates in two modes. In a regular World Congress session, which happens automatically every 30 turns (on Standard Speed), all the Civilizations of the world gather to vote on Resolutions and Scored Competitions. In a Special Session, which must be requested by a player that has been affected by a trigger for an Emergency, the players who are invited to join that Emergency will vote on whether or not they wish to do so. You will use [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to interact with the World Congress.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 世界议会分为两类模式。常规世界议会议程每30回合（标准速度下）自动召开一次，所有文明需在此阶段对决议与积分竞赛进行投票。特殊议程必须由触发紧急状况的文明请求后方能召开，其他受邀文明需投票决定是否愿意参与行动。文明可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持与世界议会进行互动。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: Scored Competitions are chances for civilizations to win esteem through events and projects that benefit the world. These can be events like the World's Fair, or Climate Accords. If enacted, players who vote in favor of the Scored Competition will compete to contribute to the cause. The players that contribute the most will receive lucrative rewards.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 对于文明而言，积分竞赛是赢得尊重的大好机会，同时还能造福世界。此类事件包括世界博览会或气候协议等。积分竞赛颁布以后，投票支持竞赛的所有文明需要通过做出贡献来互相竞争。而做出最多贡献的文明将获得丰厚奖励。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor is a currency used in the World Congress and is key to winning the Diplomatic Victory and ensuring that Resolutions go your way. It represents the political clout or debt: players can use their past diplomatic deeds to influence World Congress, extract promises from other players, request Emergencies, or even receive financial benefit by trading their [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to willing players.  Players gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor through positive interactions with other powers and actions that benefit the whole world.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: [ICON_Favor] 外交支持是在世界议会中使用的货币，也是确保所选决议胜出和赢得外交胜利的关键。其代表着政治影响力和债务：文明可通过过往的外交行为影响世界议会、收获其他文明的承诺、请求紧急状况，甚至利用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持与其他国家进行交易，从而获得经济收益。文明能从与其他国家的正面互动与造福全世界的行动中获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: Some actions provide a steady trickle of [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on the tier of your government[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You can gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn for each City-State of which you are Suzerain [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Active Alliances with other civilizations generate [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn, increasing as your Alliance Level increases
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 某些行动可向文明提供少量而稳定的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]可基于文明政体的等级每回合获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]成为城邦的宗主国每回合同样能获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]与其他文明建立有效的同盟关系每回合也可获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持，其额度会随着同盟等级的提升而增加

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: But some actions will reduce your incoming [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You lose [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on your CO2 production relative to other nations[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You lose [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on the amount of [ICON_Grievance] Grievances the world as a whole has against you[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You lose [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on the number of original capitals that you occupy
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 但一些行为会减少您获得的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]基于相对于其他国家的二氧化碳排放量损失 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]基于世界整体对您产生的 [ICON_Grievance] 不满损失 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]基于您占领的原始首都数量损失 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: Other actions generate large one-time windfalls of [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Liberating a City-State from another civilization [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Liberating a city from one civilization and returning it to the original civilization[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Returning a player to the game by Liberating their city after they have been completely conquered[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Reaching appropriate score tiers in Emergencies and Scored Competitions
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 而另一些行为则会一次性提供大量 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]从其他文明手中解放城邦[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]从一个文明手中解放城市并将其归还原主[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]解放一座已灭亡文明的城市，使该文明重返游戏[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]在紧急状况和积分竞赛中达到一定的分数等级

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: If a player spends [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor on a measure which did not pass the World Congress, or on a Promise Request that is rejected by the target, then the player gets their full amount refunded for the next session. If they spent it on a measure which ulitmately passes, but on a different target then half the amount of [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor spent is refunded.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 如果文明花费了 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持但议题最终未通过世界议会，或承诺请求被对方所拒绝，则下次议程将全额退还外交支持。如果该议题最终通过世界议会，但目标文明不同，则退还一半数额的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: Two new Emergencies, the Aid Request and the Military Aid Request, are available.  Aid Requests may be called when a player receives significant damage from a natural disaster.  Military Aid Requests may be called when a player receives a declaration of war from another player against whom they already have many Grievances.  In both cases, members who join the Emergencies will be requested to send [ICON_Gold] Gold to the target player in exchange for Score that gets them closer to winning [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor and Diplomatic Victory Point rewards.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 游戏现加入两种全新紧急状况：请求援助和请求军事援助。玩家遭到自然灾害严重破坏时可请求援助。如玩家已积累对某文明的大量不满，那么此文明对玩家宣战时，玩家便可请求军事援助。在这两种情况下，加入紧急状况的成员国需要将 [ICON_Gold] 金币送给目标文明，以换取积分来获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持和外交胜利点数奖励。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: All Emergencies now fall under the purview of the World Congress and must be requested and passed through a Special Session before they will begin. The players who are affected by the trigger for the Emergency may request it: for an Aid Request, the player who is damaged by the natural disaster may request a Special Session.  For a Religious Emergency, the player who lost the city and those players who can join the Emergency may request a Special Session.  Once a Special Session is initiated, all relevant players will vote for or against each request.  When a request passes, a Competition between players to combat the Emergency begins.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 所有紧急状况现在均归世界议会管理，必须发出请求并通过特殊议程才能宣布进入紧急状况。受到紧急状况影响的玩家可以发出请求：在请求援助紧急状况中，受到自然灾害破坏的玩家可以请求召开特殊议程。而在宗教紧急状况中，失去城市的玩家和能够加入紧急状况的玩家均可以请求召开特殊议程。特殊议程发起后，所有相关玩家将对每个请求投票支持或反对。请求通过后，玩家之间便会就此紧急状况展开积分竞赛。

LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.en_US: Resolutions are joint agreements made in the World Congress which change the rules of the game. You will be able to vote on an automatically-generated selection of Resolutions relevant to the current Era using [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor. When voting for a Resolution, you will choose a potential target, and choose between 2 options for how the target is affected. The option that receives the most votes is binding for all players until the next session of the World Congress.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In the event of a tie, the Civilization that spent the greatest percentage of their [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor when voting on the Resolution will be the winner.
LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PAGE_WORLD_CONGRESS_C.zh_Hans_CN: 决议是在世界议会中达成的联合协议，可改变游戏的规则。议程中将自动生成数个决议，文明可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持来投票选择与当前时代有关的决议。对决议投票时，文明首先需要选择一个潜在的目标国，然后再在影响目标国的两个不同选项中做出选择。得票数最高的选项将会对所有文明产生约束，直至下次世界议会召开。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如得票数相同，则花费 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持最多的文明选择的选项将生效。

LOC_POLICY_AFTER_ACTION_REPORTS_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 所有单位的战斗经验值+25%。

LOC_POLICY_AGOGE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +50% [ICON_Production] Production toward Ancient and Classical era melee, anti-cavalry, and ranged units.
LOC_POLICY_AGOGE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 生产远古和古典时代的近战、抗骑兵和远程单位时+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_POLICY_AUTOMATED_WORKFORCE_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Your cities get +20% [ICON_Production] Production towards city projects.[NEWLINE]BUT: -1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity and -5 Loyalty per turn in your cities.
LOC_POLICY_AUTOMATED_WORKFORCE_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 进行城市项目时，您城市的 [ICON_Production] 生产力+20%。[NEWLINE]减益：城市每回合-1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度、-5忠诚度。

LOC_POLICY_BASTIONS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +6 City [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength. +5 City [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength.
LOC_POLICY_BASTIONS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 城市 [ICON_Strength] 防御力+6。城市 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力+5。

LOC_POLICY_CARAVANSARIES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 所有 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_POLICY_CHARISMATIC_LEADER_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: +2 Influence points per turn toward earning city-state [ICON_Envoy] Envoys.
LOC_POLICY_CHARISMATIC_LEADER_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 影响力点数每回合+2，以获得城邦 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。

LOC_POLICY_CHIVALRY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +50% [ICON_Production] Production toward Industrial era and earlier heavy and light cavalry units.
LOC_POLICY_CHIVALRY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 生产工业及更早时代的重型和轻型骑兵单位时+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_POLICY_CIVIL_PRESTIGE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Established [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governors with at least 2 Promotions provide +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity and +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing.
LOC_POLICY_CIVIL_PRESTIGE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 拥有至少2项升级的 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督就职后将提供+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度、+2 [ICON_Housing] 住房。

LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVE_ACTIVISM_DESCRIPTI.en_US: +5% [ICON_Culture] Culture per city-state you are the Suzerain of.
LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVE_ACTIVISM_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 作为宗主国时，每个下辖城邦将使您的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值+5%。

LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVISM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Farms +1 [ICON_Food] Food. All cities +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing. +100% Industrial Zone adjacency bonuses.[NEWLINE]BUT: [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People Points earned 50% slower.
LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVISM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 农场+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。所有城市+2 [ICON_Housing] 住房。工业区相邻加成+100%。[NEWLINE]但 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数的获取速度减缓50%。

LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVIZATION_DESCRIPTION_.en_US: +2 [ICON_Production] Production and +4 [ICON_Food] Food from domestic [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVIZATION_DESCRIPTION_.zh_Hans_CN: 国内贸易路线提供的 [ICON_Production] 生产力+2、[ICON_Food] 食物+4。

LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_OFFICES_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +15% faster growth for cities not on your original [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent.
LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_OFFICES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与您最初的 [ICON_Capital] 首都不在同一大陆的城市发展加速15%。

LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_TAXES_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +25% [ICON_Gold] Gold in cities not on your original [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent.
LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_TAXES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与您最初的 [ICON_Capital] 首都不在同一大陆的城市+25% [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_GUERILLA_LEADER_DESCRI.en_US: Recruit Partisans as if 2 levels more experienced.

LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_ROCKET_SCIENTIST_DESCR.en_US: Disrupt Rocketry as if 2 levels more experienced.

LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SEDUCTION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Counterspy as if 2 levels more experienced.
LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SEDUCTION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 2级反间谍能力，有更高机率成功反间谍。

LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SMEAR_CAMPAIGN_DESCRIP.en_US: Fabricate Scandal as if 2 levels more experienced.
LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SMEAR_CAMPAIGN_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 2级捏造丑闻能力，有更高机率成功捏造丑闻。

LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SURVEILLANCE_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 进行反间谍时效果将覆盖所有城市区域（1格位内的区域将+1等级）。

LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_TECHNOLOGIST_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Steal Technology as if 2 levels more experienced.
LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_TECHNOLOGIST_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 2级窃取科技能力，有更高机率成功窃取科技。

LOC_PROMOTION_STRAFE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与非骑兵单位战斗时+17 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PROMOTION_SUPERFORTRESS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: No minimum health requirement to air pillage.
LOC_PROMOTION_SUPERFORTRESS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 空中掠夺没有最低生命值要求。

LOC_PROMOTION_SURF_ROCK_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在海滨度假区和港口中的表演效果提升1个等级，+500 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩（如港口拥有造船厂，则+1000 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩）。

LOC_PROMOTION_TANK_BUSTER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与骑兵单位战斗时+17 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PROMOTION_THRUST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与近战单位战斗时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PROMOTION_TORPEDO_BOMBER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与海军单位战斗时+17 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PROMOTION_TORTOISE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending against ranged attacks.
LOC_PROMOTION_TORTOISE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 防御远程攻击时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PROMOTION_TRANSLATOR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Religious spread is triple strength in cities of other civilizations.
LOC_PROMOTION_TRANSLATOR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在其他文明的城市，宗教传播增强三倍。

LOC_PROMOTION_URBAN_WARFARE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting in a district.
LOC_PROMOTION_URBAN_WARFARE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 当在区域内攻击时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_PROMOTION_VOLLEY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与陆地单位战斗时+5 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力。

LOC_PROMOTION_ZWEIHANDER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与抗骑兵单位战斗时+7 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_BLIZZARD_CRIPPLING_DESC.en_US: The howling wind and lashing snow turn sky and land white. Familiar forms disappear beneath frozen mounds.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_BLIZZARD_CRIPPLING_DESC.zh_Hans_CN: 呼啸的大风与鹅毛大雪使天空大地一片雪白。人们熟悉的一切都被厚厚的冰雪所覆盖。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_BLIZZARD_SIGNIFICANT_DE.en_US: An icy wind sweeps blanketing snow across the landscape, as living creatures huddle in their dens.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_BLIZZARD_SIGNIFICANT_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 刺骨寒风带来的雪花铺满了整个大地。人和动物都在自己的小窝中瑟瑟发抖。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_DAMAGE.en_US: - Will drop [ICON_Food] Food by 1 per tile if the city has no Aqueduct, Dam, or Stepwell.[NEWLINE]- May destroy or pillage Farms, Camps, Pastures, and Plantations.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_DAMAGE.zh_Hans_CN: - 若城市无水渠、堤坝或梯井，每个单元格递减1点 [ICON_Food] 食物。[NEWLINE]- 有几率摧毁或掠夺农场、营地、牧场和种植园。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_EXTREME_DESCRIP.en_US: A merciless sun beats down on the drought-stricken and withered earth. No rain has fallen, and the skies promise no relief.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_EXTREME_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 无情的阳光直射干旱龟裂的大地。上天毫不留情，一滴雨水也不愿降下。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_MAJOR_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Locusts whirr and dust stirs in the hot wind. The land is parched by drought.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_MAJOR_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 蝗虫呼呼作响，尘土在热风中翻腾。大地因干旱不断开裂。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DUST_STORM_GRADIENT_DES.en_US: The sun is an angry orange disc in a hazy sky as people scurry about their business, cloth wrapped around noses and mouths.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DUST_STORM_GRADIENT_DES.zh_Hans_CN: 灰蒙蒙的天空中，太阳不过就是个橘色的愤怒圆盘，人们捂住口鼻在路上继续为生活奔波。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DUST_STORM_HABOOB_DESCR.en_US: From far off people see the approaching wall of driven sand, and scatter to seek safety before the scouring wind!
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DUST_STORM_HABOOB_DESCR.zh_Hans_CN: 看着远处不断接近的巨大沙墙，人们四处奔逃，希望在狂风到来前找到避难之处。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_1000_YEAR_DESCRIP.en_US: The river bursts its banks, and rising water covers the land for miles around. Not for a thousand years has the river flooded to such an extent!
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_1000_YEAR_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 江河决堤而出，汹涌的洪水淹没了数十公里的大地。简直是千年难遇的洪灾！

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_MAJOR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Surging, murky water rushes over the land around the river during an intense flood.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_MAJOR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 浑浊不堪的河水凶猛地冲刷着河岸，奔涌的洪水在河道中激烈地翻滚着。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_MODERATE_DESCRIPT.en_US: Rising waters overflow the banks of the river and spill into the land beyond.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_MODERATE_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 翻滚的江河拍打着河岸，不断有河水洒出河堤。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_HURRICANE_CAT_4_DESCRIP.en_US: Pelting rain and a howling gale mark the arrival of a mighty hurricane.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_HURRICANE_CAT_4_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 倾盆的大雨与呼啸的大风都预示着一场大型飓风即将到来。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_HURRICANE_CAT_5_DESCRIP.en_US: The wind screams, the torrents of rain fall, and the waves drive inexorably ashore. Little can stand where this hurricane passes!
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_HURRICANE_CAT_5_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 狂风啸叫，暴雨如瀑布般落下，波涛无情地拍打着堤岸。飓风所到之处，一切皆尽数被毁。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_KILIMANJARO_CATASTROPHI.en_US: Kilimanjaro roars, and a plume of smoke and ash jets into the sky, as people and animals flee in terror!
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_KILIMANJARO_CATASTROPHI.zh_Hans_CN: 乞力马扎罗山爆发出怒吼，蘑菇云般的烟雾与灰烬直冲云霄，惊恐的人们与动物四散奔走！

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_CATAST.en_US: An ominous explosion thunders, and a dark plume rises above the Nuclear Power Plant. One by one, the wailing of sirens becomes a shrieking chorus, as hellish lumps of burning fuel begin to rain down.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_CATAST.zh_Hans_CN: 一声巨响，滚滚黑烟在核电站上方升起。悲戚的警报声接连响起，如同一首哀伤的怨曲。与此同时，无数燃烧的残骸如暴雨般从天而降。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_MAJOR_.en_US: Alarms sound at the Nuclear Power Plant! Jets of steam rise from cracks in the reactor and dosimeters click and whir as radiation blankets the area.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_MAJOR_.zh_Hans_CN: 核电站中响起警报！反应堆的裂缝中冒出丝丝蒸汽；辐射开始蔓延，放射测量器指针飙升。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_MINOR_.en_US: Engineers in the Nuclear Power Plant control room work feverishly to contain a spreading leak. They have already prevented a worse outcome, but the situation is still serious.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_MINOR_.zh_Hans_CN: 核电站控制室中的工程师们正奋力修复核泄漏。他们防止了更严重的后果，但情况仍十分危急。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_DAMAGE_FERTILITY.en_US: + May add fertility to tiles it passes over[NEWLINE]- May damage improvements or districts
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_DAMAGE_FERTILITY.zh_Hans_CN: + 灾后有几率提高单元格产出[NEWLINE]- 有几率损坏改良设施或区域

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_DAMAGE_NO_FERTILIT.zh_Hans_CN: - 有几率损坏改良设施或区域

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_NAVAL_DAMAGE_FERTI.en_US: + May add fertility to tiles it passes over[NEWLINE]- May damage improvements or districts[NEWLINE]- May damage naval units
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_NAVAL_DAMAGE_FERTI.zh_Hans_CN: + 灾后有几率提高单元格产出[NEWLINE]- 有几率损坏改良设施或区域[NEWLINE]- 有几率伤害海军单位

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE4_LONG_DE.en_US: Storms and Floods no longer improve fertility.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE4_LONG_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 风暴和洪水不再提升土地肥沃度。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE5_LONG_DE.en_US: Storms and Droughts passing over a tile begin to remove bonus fertility added earlier in the game.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE5_LONG_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 风暴和干旱途经时有较低几率移除单元格之前获得的肥沃度。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE6_LONG_DE.en_US: Storms and Droughts passing over a tile regularly remove bonus fertility added earlier in the game.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE6_LONG_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 风暴和干旱途经时有中等几率移除单元格之前获得的肥沃度。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE7_LONG_DE.en_US: Storms and Droughts passing over a tile quite often remove bonus fertility added earlier in the game.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE7_LONG_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 风暴和干旱途经时有较高几率移除单元格之前获得的肥沃度。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_TORNADO_FAMILY_DESCRIPT.en_US: A tornado slowly descends from a summer storm, and people seek refuge.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_TORNADO_FAMILY_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 龙卷风渐渐从夏日风暴中露出了尾巴，人们开始寻找避难之处。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_TORNADO_OUTBREAK_DESCRI.en_US: A fast-moving line of storms gallop across the darkening summer sky, with tornadoes ominously forming beneath.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_TORNADO_OUTBREAK_DESCRI.zh_Hans_CN: 迅捷的风暴在灰暗的夏日空中划出一道长线，在其之下，龙卷风群正在露出狰狞的面容，想要将一切吞进自己的血盆大口之中。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VESUVIUS_MEGACOLOSSAL_D.en_US: Citizens scream in terror and flee towards safety as the pyroclastic wave crashes down the flanks of Vesuvius!
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VESUVIUS_MEGACOLOSSAL_D.zh_Hans_CN: 浓烟裹挟着滚烫的火山灰，从维苏威火山的山壁上奔涌而下，市民们惊恐地尖叫着四处逃散，想要寻找安全的避难所。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_CATASTROPHIC_DE.en_US: People living near the volcano flee as lava and ash blankets the surrounding land.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_CATASTROPHIC_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 生活在火山周围的人们开始逃离，熔岩与灰烬铺满了整个大地。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_GENTLE_DESCRIPT.en_US: People gaze skyward in concern, watching smoke rise from a once-quiet volcano.
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_GENTLE_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 人们担忧地望向天空，乌黑的烟雾从曾经安详的火山当中喷发而出。

LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_MEGACOLOSSAL_DE.en_US: People flee in terror as pyroclastic flows lash the slopes of the volcano and jets of smoke pour into the sky!
LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_MEGACOLOSSAL_DE.zh_Hans_CN: 火山喷出的滚烫碎屑从山壁上滚滚落下，炙热的浓烟直冲天际，人们开始恐惧地逃散。

LOC_ROUTE_ANCIENT_ROAD_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Can be constructed through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes or by Military Engineers. Improves [ICON_Movement] Movement speed of any unit moving from one road tile to another.
LOC_ROUTE_ANCIENT_ROAD_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可通过 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线或由军事工程师创建，以降低任意单位从一个道路单元格到另一个道路单元格的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力消耗。
