You can accomplish a lot through diplomacy. You can gain allies and isolate your enemies. You can create defensive and offensive pacts. You can increase your technology through cooperative research ventures. You can end wars that are going badly for you. You can bluff the credulous and bully the timid.
外交至关重要。您可通过外交建立盟友并孤立敌人。签订防御及进攻条约。通过有风险的合作研究来增强科技。结束对您不利的战争。向他国吹嘘及欺凌弱小。
Introduction
介绍

To initiate diplomacy, click on the leader you wish to contact in the upper right portion of the screen. The Diplomacy Panel will appear, displaying all known civilizations. Click on any leader to speak with them. Alternatively, you can click on a civilization's city banner to open communications with them.
点击屏幕右上方您期望与之联系的领袖来展开外交。会出现外交面板，上面显示了所有已知文明。点击领袖与之交谈。或者，您可点击一个文明城市面板来与他们进行交流。

When you engage in diplomacy with civilizations, you will have a number of options available, depending on your current relationship. This screen will also provide important information about your relationship, as well as the latest gossip about what that leader has been doing.
当您与一个文明展开外交活动时，你有很多选择，一切都取决于目前你们之间的关系。屏幕上也会显示出关于你们关系的重要信息，以及关于领袖行为的最近一次闲聊内容。

You may choose to declare war, or denounce the leader. You may also negotiate a trade deal, or demand stuff from another civilization. You can also propose friendship, defensive pacts, and send delegations.
您可以选择宣战或谴责领袖。您也可以进行贸易谈判，或要求从另一文明获得某些物品。此外，您还可以提出友谊请求、防御条约、派遣代表团。
Diplomacy with Civilizations
与文明外交

Casus Belli represent reasons to go to war where the normal Warmonger penalty for a declaration of war or capturing cities are reduced or eliminated.  Once you reach the Renaissance-era civic Diplomatic Service, you may accumulate Casus Belli against other powers. You must Denounce the other power in order to use a Casus Belli against them. See the table below for the conditions for each Casus Belli, the civic that unlocks them, and the percentage of the usual warmonger penalty that is applied.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Holy War: If one of your cities is converted to the enemy's religion[NEWLINE](Diplomatic Service, 50% warmongering)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]War of Liberation: If a friend or ally had cities conquered[NEWLINE](Diplomatic Service, no warmongering penalty when liberating cities that have been conquered)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]War of Reconquest: If you had cities conquered in a previous war[NEWLINE](Defensive Tactics, no warmongering penalty when retaking your previous cities)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Protectorate War: if a city-state you are Suzerain of is attacked[NEWLINE](Defensive Tactics, no warmongering penalty when liberating a city-state target)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Colonial War: if target civilization is two eras behind you in technology[NEWLINE](Nationalism, 50% warmongering)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]War of Territorial Expansion: if target civilization borders your nation[NEWLINE](Mobilization, 75% warmongering)

战争借口即为发动战争的原因。利用战争借口宣战或占领城市获得的好战程度将减少，甚至完全消除。获得文艺复兴时代的市政“外交部门”后，便可以积累战争借口对其他文明宣战。对其他文明使用战争借口之前必须先进行谴责。下表详述了每种战争借口的使用条件、将其解锁的市政，以及使用时获得的好战程度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]圣战：如玩家的一座城市皈依敌方宗教[NEWLINE]（外交部门；50%好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解放战争：如友方或盟友有城市被占领[NEWLINE]（外交部门；解放被占领的城市无好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]收复战争：如玩家有城市在之前的战争中被占领[NEWLINE]（防御战术；重新夺回之前拥有的城市无好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]卫国战争：城邦遭到袭击，而玩家是该城邦的宗主国[NEWLINE]（防御战术；解放城邦目标时无好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]殖民战争：如果目标文明在科技上落后玩家两个时代[NEWLINE]（民族主义；50%好战程度）[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]领土扩张战争：如果目标文明与玩家的国土接壤[NEWLINE]（动员；75%好战程度）

Colonial War: You may declare a Colonial War against a civilization which is lagging behind you by 2 technologies, and you have researched the Nationalism Civic. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. This Casus Belli has a reduced Grievance penalty for the era, both for declaring war and capturing cities. If you raze an enemy city, you will receive the full Grievance penalty for a Formal War of the era, as the world no longer buys your excuses about "bringing enlightenment" to your target.
殖民战争：研究完“民族主义”市政后，即可对落后2个科技的文明发动殖民战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。使用此战争借口宣战和占领城市在本时代导致的不满将降低。但如若将敌方城市夷为平地，世界将不再相信“启蒙开化”这个所谓的理由，文明会获得本时代正式战争的全额不满。

Territorial War: You may declare Territorial War against a civilization if you have researched the Mobilization Civic. The target must have 2 cities within 10 tiles of 2 of your cities. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns. This Casus Belli reduces the era's Formal War Grievance penalty by a bit, both for the actions of declaring war and capturing cities. Razing cities carries a reduced penalty under this Casus Belli, making it useful if you wish to eliminate enemy cities in regions where you wish to expand.
领土扩张战争：研究“动员”市政后，即可对文明宣布领土扩张战争。前提是目标文明在您2座城市的10个单元格范围内拥有2座城市。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。用该战争借口宣战并占领城市所导致的正式战争不满将稍微降低。在此战争借口中将敌方城市夷为平地所导致的不满将降低。如果希望摧毁阻碍扩张路线的敌方城市，此战争借口将十分实用。

Golden Age War: You may declare a Golden Age War if you have chosen the To Arms! Dedication, and denounced your target. You do not need to wait after denouncing your target to have access to this Casus Belli. During this time your Grievance penalties for the war declaration and city penalties are greatly reduced, making this one of the least diplomatically costly ways to grab territory from your rivals. However, razing an enemy city will have the same Grievance cost as in a Formal War. Having a Golden Age entitles you to the respect of other nations, but not license to act with impunity.
黄金时代战争：选择“全民皆兵”着力点并谴责目标后即可宣布黄金时代战争。谴责目标后无需等待即可直接使用此战争借口。在此期间，宣战与占领城市所导致的不满将大幅降低，这是从对手处大肆夺取土地的最佳方式，同时无需担心出现严重的外交后果。但若将敌方城市夷为平地，此举导致的不满与正式战争中导致的不满相同。虽然进入黄金时代能得到其他国家的尊重，但这并不意味着可以肆意妄为。

War of Retribution: You may declare a War of Retribution if you have researched the Early Empire Civic, and another civilization has broken a promise they made to you within the last 30 turns. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. During a War of Retribution only 50% of the current era's Grievance penalty applies. Although an enemy may have broken his promise to you, this does not entitle you to burn his cities to the ground in revenge.
报复战争：研究“帝国初期”市政后，如另一文明在过去30回合内曾背弃对您的承诺，则可宣布报复战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。报复战争期间仅会导致当前时代50%的不满。因为即使敌人曾违背对您的承诺，也不能焚毁城市来泄愤。

Ideological War: You may declare an Ideological War if you research the Ideology Civic, and have a different Tier 3 government from your target. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns. During an Ideological War only 50% of the current era's Grievance penalty applies.
意识形态战争：研究“意识形态”市政后，如目标拥有不同的第3级政体，则可宣布意识形态战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。意识形态战争期间仅会导致当前时代50%的不满。

Casus Belli represent reasons to go to war where the Grievance penalties for actions are reduced or eliminated. The first Casus Belli becomes available after you research Early Empire, and others become available as you research other civics. They are laid out below.
战争借口即为发动战争的原因。战争所导致的不满将减少，甚至不会导致不满。研究“帝国初期”市政后便会获得首个战争借口。随着市政研究的深入，其他战争借口也会一一解锁。请查阅下方相关信息。

Formal War: You may declare a Formal War after Denouncing an enemy and waiting for 5 turns, after which the Formal War option will be available to you in the diplomacy screen with your target. Formal War carries the current era's standard Grievance penalties.
正式战争：谴责敌方并等待5回合后即可宣布正式战争，之后您与目标的外交画面中则会出现“正式战争”选项。发动正式战争将导致本时代标准的不满。

Surprise War: You can declare a Surprise War at almost any time, but doing so carries severe Grievance penalties, typically an additional 50% of the Grievance generated by actions during a Formal War. Razing cities during a Surprise War carries an especially grievous Grievance penalty.
突袭战争：文明几乎可以随时发动突袭战争，但此举将导致大量不满。通常情况下会额外导致本时代正式战争50%的不满。在突袭战争中将敌方城市夷为平地将导致极高的不满。

Holy War: You may declare a Holy War if your religion differs from that of your target, you've researched the Diplomatic Service Civic, and you've denounced your target and waited 5 turns. During a Holy War, only 50% of the current era's Grievance penalty applies. If you wish to raze enemy cities, Holy War is one of the least diplomatically costly ways to do so.
圣战：研究“外交部门”市政后，如您的宗教与目标不同，则可宣布圣战。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。圣战期间导致的不满为本时代标准的50%。如果希望将敌方城市夷为平地，圣战是一种外交代价较低的方式。

Joint War: You may declare a Joint War with another civilization against a target. Both partners in the Joint War need to have researched the Foreign Trade Civic. The Joint War agreement lasts for 30 turns, and carries the same Grievance penalties as a Formal War in that era.
联合作战：文明可以和另一文明对目标发起联合作战。联合作战的合作两方都需要研究“对外贸易”市政。联合作战协议将持续30回合，期间导致的不满与本时代正式战争的标准相同。

Reconquest War: You may declare a Reconquest War if another civilization has captured a city that you founded, and have researched the Defensive Tactics Civic. You must Denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. This Casus Belli is unique in that it generates no additional Grievances against you. You may also choose to raze your reconquest city without penalty if you successfully capture it. Perhaps you cannot bear the sight of your retaken city? You're the implacable tyrant; do what you want.
收复战争：研究“防御战术”市政后，如某文明占领了您建立的城市，则可宣布收复战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。该战争借口较为特殊，以此宣战不会导致不满。成功收复城市后，即使选择将城市夷为平地也不会导致不满。也许你不忍目睹这座满目疮痍的城市，那就做个无情的暴君，一把火烧掉它吧。

Protectorate War: You may declare a Protectorate War if one of your allied city-states is targeted for war by a major civilization, and if you have researched the Defensive Tactics Civic. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. There is no Grievance penalty for declaring war on your target, but you will suffer the era's Grievance penalty equal to a Formal War if you capture an enemy city. Razing an enemy city during a Protectorate War carries an additional Grievance penalty, as the world does not recognize your Protectorate War as legitimating your land grab.
保卫城邦战争：研究“防御战术”市政后，如果结盟城邦成为主要文明的战争目标，则可宣布保卫城邦战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。以此对目标宣战不会导致不满。但如果占领敌方城市，则会导致本时代正式战争的不满。如在保卫城邦战争期间将敌方城市夷为平地，国际社会则不再承认保卫城邦战争的合法性，从而招致额外的不满。

Liberation War: You may declare a Liberation War if a friend or ally had cities conquered, and if you have researched the Diplomatic Service Civic. You must denounce your target and wait 5 turns before declaring war. There is no Grievance penalty for declaring war on your target. You will suffer the era's Grievance penalty equal to a Formal War if you capture another, different enemy city. If you raze an enemy city, you will suffer a very severe Grievance penalty! This is the most Grievance-costly action in the game, as burning cities in the name of freedom is particularly awful to the other civilizations in the world.
解放战争：研究“外交部门”市政后，如果友邦或同盟的城市被占领，则可宣布解放战争。宣战之前必须先对目标进行谴责，然后等待5回合。以此对目标宣战不会导致不满。但如果占领其他的敌方城市，则会导致等于本时代正式战争的不满；而如果将敌方城市夷为平地，则会导致即为严重的不满！以自由的名义焚毁城市会在世界其他文明中产生极其恶劣的外交影响，所以导致的不满也会极其高昂。
Casus Belli
战争借口

Diplomatic Visibility allows you to receive Gossip, information about another player's actions. You gain more detailed Gossip based on your level of visibility, of which there are 5 levels: None, Limited, Open, Secret, and Top Secret. For example, when you have just met a civilization, you will receive information about their declarations of war, denouncements, friendships, alliances, and when they do something like found a Pantheon or complete a wonder. If you gain Limited Diplomatic Visibility, you will find out some information about their opinion of you and what government they have. At the Open level, you will have access to that civilization's diplomatic agendas, their relationships with other civilizations, and know when they have launched an inquisition.

外交能见度让您获得小道消息，以及关于另一玩家行动的信息。能见度等级决定您所获得的小道消息详细程度，有五个级别：无、有限、公开、秘密、最高机密。比如，您刚遇见了一个文明，您便会获得关于其宣战、谴责、友谊、联盟，以及它们何时创建一座万神殿或建成一个奇观的信息。如果您获得有限外交能见度，您会弄清它们对您的看法和它们所拥有的政体。达到公开级别时，您能获得的信息包括该文明外交议程、同其他文明的关系，以及他们何时发起审讯。
You must accumulate Diplomatic Visibility levels individually for each civilization. Levels may be gained by accumulating various sources of Gossip, including:
对每个文明的外交能见度等级均单独结算。积累各种来源的小道消息即可提升此等级，其中包括：

Traders. Establish a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route to a civilization to increase visibility by one level.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Send a Delegation. Send a Delegation to a civilization to increase visibility by one level. Once Embassies are available, establishing an Embassy will replace this.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Send a spy on a Listening Post Mission. Performing the Listening Post mission in another civilization's city increases visibility by one level.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Forming an Alliance. Alternatively to spying, you can form an alliance with a friendly civilization. These two actions do not add separate Diplomatic Visibility levels - it does no good to spy on your allies![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Research the Printing Press technology. This will increase your visibility with ALL civilizations by one level.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Play as Catherine de Medici. She gives France one level of access above normal at all times with civilizations she has met.

商人。与该文明建立一条 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，将能见度提升一个级别。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]派遣代表团。向某文明派遣代表团，将能见度提升一个级别。大使馆可用后，便会建立一个大使馆来代替代表团。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]派遣间谍执行情报站任务。对另一文明执行情报站任务会将能见度提升一个级别。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]结盟。与派遣间谍相反的是和友好文明结盟。这两个行动不会叠加提高外交能见度级别——监视盟友没有任何好处！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]研究印刷术。将您对所有文明的能见度提升一个级别。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]使用凯瑟琳·德·美第奇。不论什么时候，她都让法国获得对所遇文明更高一级的访问级别。
When you have Secret or Top Secret level visibility on a foreign civilization you can click on one of that civilization's city banners and view the City Details screen for that foreign city.
对外国文明的外交能见度达到“机密”或“最高机密”级别时，只需点击该文明城市的城市面板即可查看该外国城市的“城市详情”界面。
Diplomatic Visibility and Gossip
外交能见度和小道消息

Starting in the Renaissance era, Spies will become available. You may earn Spies from certain technologies and civics. They can be built in any city, but they cannot be purchased with [ICON_Gold] Gold or [ICON_Faith] Faith. Spies begin at the Recruit level, and may gain levels from successful offensive operations, or capturing an enemy Spy. Upon reaching level 2, Spies may also earn promotions.
进入文艺复兴时代后便可开始使用间谍。可从特定的科技或市政中获得间谍，也可以在任何城市招募间谍，但无法使用 [ICON_Gold] 金币或 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。间谍最初为“新人”等级，成功完成进攻性行动或俘获敌方间谍后即可升级。达到第2级时间谍便能获得强化。

Spies are not moved like other units. They jump from city to city using air, sea, road, or foot travel, each with their own travel time, but they may not move to an ally's city. Once established in a city, a Spy can be sent to a specific district and begin their mission. Missions include stealing technology boosts, creating rebel units, or simply increasing diplomatic visibility. Each mission takes a certain amount of time, and will have a different outcome. Your Spy may be killed or captured, or maybe he failed his mission but was not detected, or perhaps it was not detected and the mission was a success.
间谍的移动方式与其他单位不同。他们使用各种方式在城市之间移动，每位间谍都有自己的移动时间，但其无法移动至盟友的城市。驻扎在城市中后，间谍便可前往特定区域，开始执行任务。任务包括盗取科技提升、创建叛徒单位，或单纯提升外交能见度。每种任务都需要花费一定时间，产生的结果也不尽相同。您的间谍可能会被杀死或俘虏；也可能任务失败但却并未暴露；最好的结果便是成功完成任务且未暴露。
Every civilization can produce 5 Spies. Play as Catherine to earn the ability to produce 6.
每个文明可拥有5名间谍。使用凯瑟琳进行游戏可拥有6名间谍。
The Intelligence Agency building, constructed in the Government Plaza, will also add an additional Spy and Spy capacity.
建筑“情报局”建造在市政广场中，可额外增加1名间谍和1个间谍容量。
Spies and Espionage
间谍和间谍活动

You can make trade deals with other players by selecting Make Deal from the Diplomacy Panel with a leader selected. You will enter a negotiation table with that leader.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]On the left of the table are items you are able to trade, and on the right of the table are items the other player has available to trade. You can trade anything from [ICON_Gold] Gold to resources to cities! Select items from the other leader's side of the table to request they trade them to you, and select items from your side of the table to offer in exchange.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When the other leader finds the deal acceptable, an "Accept Deal" button will appear, which will confirm the trade that is on the table. You will lose any items you proposed and gain any items from the other leader.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If the leader does not like the deal, you can select the "Make this deal more equitable" button to cause the leader to propose a deal they believe is fair. You may then adjust their offer to suit your needs, and see if they accept. You can also ask the leader for something and select "What would it take?" to see what they want from you in trade.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If you propose an item but do not ask anything in return, you can select "Give Gift" to give the item to the leader for free. Who doesn't like gifts? Or you can select "What would you give me?" to ask the leader what they would be willing to pay.

通过在外交面板选择与所选领袖进行交易，您能同其他玩家达成贸易协议。您将与该领袖进入谈判桌。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]桌子左边是您可用来进行贸易的商品，右边是其他玩家可用来进行贸易的商品。您可使用 [ICON_Gold] 金币来交易从资源到城市的任何物品！从桌子上的另一领袖处挑选物品，请求他们同您进行交易，并从您自己这边选择用于交换的物品。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果其他领袖接受该交易，会出现“成交”按钮，这会对公开交易进行确认。您会失去您用于交易的任何物品，并获得来自其他领袖的任何物品。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果领袖不喜欢此次交易，您可选择“让这一交易更公平”按钮，来让该领袖提出一个他们认为合理的交易。随后，您可以调整他们的提议来使其符合您的需求，并看看对方是否接受。您也可以向领袖要求得到某事物，并选择“需要花费什么？”来查看他们希望通过贸易从您这里得到什么。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果您拿出一项物品，并且不要求获得任何回报，您可以选择“赠送礼品”来将该物品免费送给一位领袖。没人会不喜欢礼物。或者，您可以选择“您会给我什么？”来询问领袖愿意拿什么来报答。

If you are Unfriendly with a leader or either of you has Denounced each other, you will see the Make Demand option on the Diplomacy Panel with that leader selected. This option will take you to a negotiation table, but your side of the table will be blank. Instead, you select items from their side of the table to demand as tribute! Select "Demand Deal" to see if they will pay you what you ask. The leader may not take kindly to your demands.
如果您与一位领袖的关系不友好，或者你们曾谴责彼此，您将会在外交面板看到所选领袖的索取选项。该选项会把您带往谈判桌，但您在桌上的这边将会是空白。相反，您从他们那边选择物品，并要求将其作为贡品！选择“要求交易”来查看他们是否给您所需之物。领袖可能不会乐意接受您的要求。

Whether making a Deal or a Demand, some items are given permanently and some are only loaned to the leader. Sums of [ICON_Gold] Gold, Great Works, [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts, and captured Spies are all permanent trades—once you give those items away, you have to trade again to get them back. Resources and gold per turn, however, are temporary, and once the deal has run its course you will get them back.
不论是进行交易还是索取，领袖能永久获得某些物品，同时，另一些物品只能租借给领袖。所有 [ICON_Gold] 金币、巨作、 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物、 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物和被捕获的间谍都属于永久交易——一旦您放弃这些物品，便需要进行再次交易才能将其拿回。但每回合的资源和金币不固定，交易一旦进行下去，您便能将其取回。

Depending on your interactions with a leader, you might also have the Discuss option on the Diplomacy Panel. Selecting it will show you a list of actions you can ask the leader to promise to stop doing towards you, but only if the leader has already done that action at least once. You can ask them to stop settling new cities near you, to stop spreading their religion to you, to stop spying on you, or to stop attacking a City State you are Suzerain of.
根据您与领袖的交流情况，您有可能在外交面板上看到讨论选项。选择它，您将看到行动清单，您可要求领袖承诺停止对您采取清单上的行动，但前提是该领袖已经实施过该行动至少一次。您可要求他们停止在您附近开拓新城市、停止向您传播他们的宗教、停止监视您，或停止攻击您是其领主的城邦。
All Deals, Demands, and Promises last for 30 turns, at which point they need to be renewed.
所有交易、索取和承诺都会持续30回合，届时，它们需要更新。
Trade, Demand, and Discuss
交易、索取和讨论
Delegations and Resident Embassies can be established between players to improve relations and gain Diplomatic Visibility.
在玩家间建立代表团和常驻使馆能改善关系，并获得外交能见度。

A Delegation, or Embassy, needs to be sent to every leader individually. Delegations cost 10 [ICON_Gold] Gold and Embassies cost 25 [ICON_Gold] Gold, which is paid to the other leader. This will give you a small positive bonus in your relationship with that leader. It also gives you 1 level of Diplomatic Visibility.  See the Diplomatic Visibility and Gossip section of the Civilopedia for more information on Diplomatic Visibility.
需要向每个领袖单独派遣代表团或大使馆。代表团消耗10个 [ICON_Gold] 金币，大使馆消耗25个 [ICON_Gold] 金币，这些金币会付给另一位领袖。这会为您和该领袖的关系提供少量积极加成。同时，还会给您1个级别的外交能见度。查看文明百科的外交能见度和小道消息章节内容以获取更多关于外交能见度的信息。
Resident Embassies are unlocked with the Diplomatic Service Civic, at which point they replace Delegations. The effects of Resident Embassies and Delegations do not stack.
常驻使馆会随着外交部门市政一起解锁，届时，它们将取代代表团。常驻使馆和代表团的影响力不会产生重叠。
Delegations and Embassies
代表团和大使馆

Open Borders is an agreement with another leader to allow them to move their units, military or civilian, through your territory. Without this agreement, entering another leader's territory is an act of war, except with Religious Units, who can ignore borders entirely. If you have Open Borders with a leader, their border will appear as a dotted line instead of a solid one. Open Borders is unlocked with the Early Empire Civic. Prior to that, your borders are open to everyone.
开放边界是与另一位领袖达成协议，以便让其单位、军队，或平民穿过您的领土。如果没有这份协议，进入另一领袖的领土会是一种战争行为，不过宗教单位除外，它们能完全忽略边界。如果您与另一位领袖有开发边界，他们的边界会是虚线，而不是实线。开放边界会随着帝国初期市政一起解锁。在此之前，您的边界对所有人开放。

Open Borders can be offered as part of a Deal trade agreement if both parties have researched the Early Empire Civic, but it is offered individually by each leader—you can be granted Open Borders with a leader without granting them Open Borders in return. The deal lasts for 30 turns, and then it needs to be renewed.
如双方均已研究“帝国初期”市政，开放边界可被纳入贸易协定当中，但它是由每个领袖分别提供——玩家可以被同盟领袖授予边界通行权，同时也不需要向对方授予通行权作为回报。协定有效期为30回合，失效后需要续签。
If you are in an Alliance with another leader, you both grant each other Open Borders automatically.
如果您与另一位领袖是盟友，你们会向对方自动授予开放边界。
Open Borders
开放边界

Emergencies are triggered in response to a serious action by a civilization, such as conquering a city-state, converting a Holy City, or launching a nuclear attack. The other civilizations in the game will have an opportunity to join in against the player that triggered the Emergency. Civilizations that are Declared Friends or Allies with the target civilization are only invited to join against Betrayal Emergencies.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The joined civs will work towards a specific goal that must be accomplished within a time limit. There may also be bonuses for members of the group to assist them towards the goal. If the goal is accomplished, all members who participated in the Emergency will receive a special reward, but if time runs out first, there will be a penalty assigned and the target will receive rewards, instead.

如果文明造成严重事态（如占领城邦、改变圣城信仰、或发动核攻击），则能够触发紧急状况。游戏中的其他文明将团结起来共同对付触发紧急状况的玩家。只有出现背叛紧急状况后，才能邀请目标文明的好友或盟友加入联合反抗行动。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]联合起来的文明将获得特定目标，必须在时限内达成。成员国能够获得部分加成，以便达成目标。如果目标达成，所有成员国将获得特殊奖励；而如果超过时限，成员国将遭受惩罚，对手将得到奖励。

These are the Emergencies in the game:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Military Emergency: A civilization that is leading in some victory type has just captured another civilization's city.  The Members must capture cities from the Target. The Members receive a bonus to [ICON_Movement] Movement in the Target's territory, and have Peace, Open Borders, and Shared Visibility with each other.  All Members will go to War with the Target and the Target's [ICON_Strength] Strength is reduced when fighting them. If successful, they receive bonus healing in the Target's territory in the future. If the Members cannot capture enough cities by the end of the Emergency, then the Target wins and receives a permanent bonus to the [ICON_Strength] Strength of their city ranged attack. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]City-State Emergency: A civilization has captured and is occupying a city-state. The Members must liberate the city-state. All Members will go to War with the Target and have Peace, Open Borders, and Shared Visibility with each other. If the Members liberate the city-state, then they receive [ICON_GOLD] Gold per turn for each of their [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys there. If the Target retains control of the city-state, then he wins, and receives bonus [ICON_GOLD] Gold per turn for each of his [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes there. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Religious Emergency: A civilization has converted the Holy City of another Religion through a Religious Spread action. The Members must convert the Holy City away from its new Religion, for a number of turns, before the Emergency expires. If successful, each member receives a Relic. The Target wins if the Members were unable to keep it converted away from the new Religion for the appropriate number of turns before the end of Emergency. There will then be a surge of pressure of the new Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Nuclear Emergency: A civilization has used a nuclear weapon on a city. The Members must capture cities from the Target. The Members receive a bonus to [ICON_Movement] Movement in the Target's territory, and have Peace, Open Borders, and Shared Visibility with each other.  All Members will go to War with the Target and the Target's [ICON_Strength] Strength is reduced when fighting them. If the Members succeed, then the Target's military units suffer an even greater and permanent penalty in [ICON_Strength] Strength when fighting the Members. If they fail, then all the Member cities suffer reduced Loyalty. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Betrayal Emergency: A civilization has declared war on another civilization, with whom they had a high-level Alliance. The Members must capture cities from the Target. The Members receive a bonus to [ICON_Movement] Movement in the Target's territory, and have Peace, Open Borders, and Shared Visibility with each other.  All Members will go to War with the Target and the Target's [ICON_Strength] Strength is reduced when fighting them. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes between the Members and the Targets are cancelled, and [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes between members provide [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production as well. If the Members win, then the Target's military units suffer a permanent penalty in [ICON_Strength] Strength versus the Members. If the Members cannot capture enough cities by the end of the Emergency, then the Target wins and gains a permanent reduction in War Weariness when fighting the Members.

游戏中会出现以下紧急状况：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]军事紧急状况：游戏中某种胜利方式上处于领先地位的文明占领了另一个文明的城市。成员国必须占领目标国的城市。成员国在目标国的领土中将获得 [ICON_Movement] 移动力加成，且成员国之间将和平共处、开放边界并共享能见度。所有成员国均会对目标国宣战，而目标国与成员国作战时 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力将被削弱。如成员国顺利完成目标，之后的游戏中在目标国领土内将获得治疗加成。如紧急状况结束时成员国未能占领足够多的城市，则目标国获胜，其城市远程 [ICON_Strength] 攻击力将获得永久加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]城邦紧急状况：一个文明征服了一个城邦。成员国必须解放城邦。所有成员国均会对目标国宣战，且成员国之间将和平共处、开放边界并共享能见度。如成员国顺利解放城邦，则其将根据派驻此城邦处的 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者数量每回合获得 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。如紧急状况结束时目标国仍然控制城邦，则目标国获胜，将视其通往此城邦的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线数量每回合获得金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]宗教紧急状况：一个文明通过传播宗教使其他宗教的圣城转变信仰。成员国必须使此圣城放弃其采纳的新宗教，并持续此结果数个回合，直至紧急状况结束。如成功，每个成员国都将获得1件遗物。如在紧急状况结束前成员国无法使此圣城放弃采纳的新宗教并持续数回合之久，则目标国获胜。此新宗教将释放大量压力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]核武紧急状况：一个文明对一座城市使用了核武器。成员国必须占领目标国的城市。成员国在目标国的领土中将获得 [ICON_Movement] 移动力加成，且成员国之间将和平共处、开放边界并共享能见度。所有成员国均会对目标国宣战，而目标国与成员国作战时 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力将被削弱。如成员国成功，目标国的军事单位与成员国作战时将蒙受更大、且永久性的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力减益。反之，如失败，成员国所有城市的忠诚度都将降低。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]背叛紧急状况：一个文明对自己的高等级盟友宣战。成员国必须占领目标国的城市。成员国在目标国的领土中将获得 [ICON_Movement] 移动力加成，且成员国之间将和平共处、开放边界并共享能见度。所有成员国均会对目标国宣战，而目标国与成员国作战时 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力将被削弱。成员国与目标国之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线将被废弃，而成员国彼此间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线将提供 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。如成员国获胜，目标国的军事单位在对阵成员国时将蒙受永久性的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力减益。如紧急状况结束时成员国未能占领足够多的城市，则目标国获胜，在与成员国作战时厌战情绪将永久性降低。
A civilization's ability to participate in an Emergency is determined by their diplomatic relationship to other civilizations and city-states in the game.
一个文明能否加入紧急状况由其和其他文明与城邦的外交关系所决定。
Emergencies
紧急状况

As the game progresses through the eras, Civilizations will discover Power and Consumable Resources.  Using Consumable Resources to provide Power will produce CO2.  As more CO2 is produced, polar ice will begin to melt causing the sea levels to rise.
随着游戏时代的发展，文明将会发现电力与消耗性资源。使用消耗性资源进行发电会产生二氧化碳。随着二氧化碳浓度的提升，极地冰盖将会逐渐融化，造成海平面的升高。
Coastal terrain is displayed as one of four levels:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]1 meter[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]2 meters[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]3 meters[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Not affected by coastal flooding.
在游戏中，海岸地貌将会显示为以下4种等级：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]1米[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]2米[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]3米[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]无海岸洪水影响。

Each level of global CO2 that is reached raises the sea level by .5 meters.  This means at Level 2 the 1 meter coastal terrain will be flooded. If a high enough level is reached 1 meter and 2 meter tiles will become submerged and become coastal water tiles. This may result in the destruction of improvements and districts on flooded tiles, and the loss of population in City Centers.
每达到一个全球性二氧化碳浓度标准，海平面将提升0.5米。这意味着，1米到2米的海岸地貌将会被洪水淹没。若达到一定高度，1米和2米的单元格将会沉入海中，成为海岸水域单元格。受灾单元格中的改良设施与区域将被摧毁，同时市中心的人口也将随之下降。

As the global CO2 increases, the chance of Storms, River Flooding, and Drought occurring increases. Also, these events are likely to be more severe than at lower CO2 levels. At the highest levels of Climate Change desertification begins to occur: Storms and Floods no longer leave behind yields and earlier fertility gains (from Volcanoes, Floods or Storms) can be lost to Storms and Droughts.
随着全球二氧化碳升高，风暴、江河泛滥和干旱的出现几率也会升高。此外，这些灾害将比二氧化碳排放量低时更为严重。气候变化最高峰时将出现荒漠化：风暴和洪水将不再提供产出，之前曾有的肥沃度收获（来自火山喷发、洪水或风暴）可能被风暴和干旱所摧毁。
Climate Change
气候变化

Environmental Effects are dangerous events that can happen at random around the world.  There are many types of Environmental Effects that are dependent on the type of terrain.  Explorers in the Tundra may be struck by a sudden Blizzard, farms near a large volcano may suddenly discover it has become active and could erupt anytime! There are dangers for setting near disaster zones, but there is also rewards for those who brave the risk.  You can adjust the frequency of these events when creating a new game.
环境效应是一种危险的事件，可能会随机发生在世界的任何地方。根据地貌类型的不同，产生的环境效应也有所不同。在冻土地区前行的探险者可能会突然遭遇暴风雪的袭击；而巨型火山附近农场的人们可能会发现火山已经开始活跃起来，随时有喷发的可能！在灾害地区建设城市十分危险，但是对于敢于冒险的人来说也暗藏着机遇。新建游戏时可以调整此类事件发生的频率。
Environmental Effects
环境效应
Droughts are prolonged period of reduced precipitation, where agriculture becomes more difficult or impossible, resulting in a loss of [ICON_Food] Food.
降水量长期减少会引发干旱，使农作物生长困难甚至颗粒无收，从而引发 [ICON_Food] 食物短缺。

Droughts can occur in Grassland or Plains areas without features like trees, hills, or nearby rivers or coasts. The Drought will be centered on a Grassland or Plains tile, with at least four Grassland or Plains tiles adjacent that do not have any other feature. A Drought may extend to additional tiles as well, potentially affecting huge regions. Droughts become more common as global temperature increases.
在缺少树木丘陵、或远离河流海岸等地貌的草原或平原地区有可能发生干旱。干旱将以草原或平原单元格为中心，周围则有至少4个与之相邻且无其他地貌的草原或平原单元格。干旱可能蔓延至其他单元格，有可能影响大片地区。随着全球变暖加剧，干旱将愈发常见。

A Drought will reduce the [ICON_Food] Food yield of a tile by 1. In addition, any Farms, Camps, Plantations, Pastures, and the Mekewap, Outback Station, and Cahokia Mound improvements built in the affected areas will be pillaged. There is a chance that the most severe Droughts will entirely remove these improvements!
干旱会使单元格减少1点 [ICON_Food] 食物产出。此外，修建在受影响区域中的所有农场、营地、种植园、牧场、棚屋、内陆牧场和卡霍基亚土墩改良设施将被掠夺。发生最严重的干旱时，这些改良设施有可能被完全移除！
A city with an Aqueduct, Dam, Bath District, or Stepwell improvement will not suffer the -1 [ICON_Food] Food yield during a Drought, but will still have Improvements pillaged by the Drought.
拥有水渠、堤坝、浴场区域或梯井改良设施的城市在干旱中不会蒙受 [ICON_Food] 食物产出-1的减益，但其改良设施仍会遭到掠夺。
A Major Drought lasts for 5 turns, and an Extreme Drought for 10. Improvements cannot be rebuilt or replaced while the Drought is active. Droughts do not offer any benefits after they have ended.
大型干旱可持续5回合，而极端干旱将持续10回合。干旱发生期间无法重建或替换改良设施。干旱结束后不会带来任何加成。
Droughts
干旱

Flooding may occur along any tile adjacent to a river. Floods have the chance to pillage or remove tile improvements, pillage buildings in districts, reduce city center population, and damage units or fortifications. Wonders are not affected by Floods. Floods may vary in severity, with more severe floods (like the 1000-year-Flood) affecting greater areas. You can prevent flooding by building a Dam along the river. Only one Dam may be constructed along a river. The Great Bath wonder prevents damage caused by Floods. After a Flood passes, there is a chance that affected tiles will have an improved [ICON_Food] Food or [ICON_Production] Production yield.

洪水可能会在相邻江河的任何单元格中泛滥。其有几率掠夺或移除改良设施、掠夺区域中的建筑、减少市中心人口，并造成单位或防御工事的损伤。奇观不受洪水的影响。洪水的等级各不相同，等级越高（例如千年难遇洪水）影响的范围便越大。沿河岸建造堤坝可防止江河泛滥；每条河流旁仅能建造1座堤坝。“大浴场”奇观可防止洪水造成伤害。洪水过后受影响单元格有几率提升 [ICON_Food] 食物或 [ICON_Production]生产力的产出。
Floods
洪水

Geothermal Fissures are a non-removable terrain feature which add +1 [ICON_Science] Science to the tile.  The standard Aqueduct and Roman Bath grant +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity when placed adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure. The Hungarian Thermal Bath grant +2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities and +3 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. The Geothermal Power Plant improvement must be constructed over a Geothermal Fissure.
地热裂缝是一种无法清除的地貌特征，其为单元格+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值。建造在地热裂缝旁的标准水渠和罗马浴场+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。若为匈牙利温泉浴场，则+2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度、+3 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。地热发电厂改良设施必须建造在地热裂缝上。
Geothermal Fissures
地热裂缝
Although Nuclear Power Plants can provide your cities with [Icon_Power] Power without causing significant global warming, there is a chance that a Nuclear Accident may occur as the Power Plant ages.
虽然核电站可以在不造成明显全球变暖的前提下为城市提供 [Icon_Power] 电力，但随着核电设施的老化，便存在发生核事故的可能性。

Once a Nuclear Power Plant is built, it will provide [Icon_Power] Power without problems for a number of turns. As it ages, the chances that a Nuclear Accident will occur increase. You can protect yourself from this by performing maintenance on the Nuclear Power Plant as a project in the home city.
核电站建成后，其可安全地提供一定回合数的 [Icon_Power] 电力。而随着设施的老化，核事故发生的几率将会增加。在核电站所在城市中开展维护核电站的项目可以降低此类事故发生的风险。

There are three levels of severity for Nuclear Accidents in increasing order of severity: Radioactive Steam Venting, Radiation Leak, and Nuclear Meltdown. When these occur, radiation leaks and tiles are subject to fallout, just as if a nuclear weapon had detonated. There is also a chance that improvements, buildings, units, and population may be damaged.
核事故按照严重性分为以下三个等级：放射性蒸汽溢出、辐射泄漏与核芯融毁。发生以上情况时，辐射泄露会使单元格布满放射性尘埃，效果如同核武器爆炸。受影响的改良设施、建筑、单位与人口有几率遭受伤害。
Nuclear Accidents
核事故

Storms have the potential to appear anywhere on the map and will persist for 3 turns.  The stages of storms are Entry, Movement, and Dissipation. The type of storms that occur are dependent on the surrounding terrain.  All storms have the chance to pillage or remove tile improvements, pillage buildings in districts, reduce city center population and damage units.  Storm effects vary on their type:
风暴可能出现在地图中的任何地方，持续3回合。风暴分为形成、移动、消散3个阶段。而风暴类型则视周围地貌而定。所有类型的风暴都有一定几率掠夺或移除单元格中的改良设施、掠夺区域中的建筑、减少市中心人口，同时对单位造成伤害。不同类型的风暴带来的影响也有所不同：

Blizzards can occur only in Snow or Tundra tiles.  They range from significant (7 tiles) to crippling (19 tiles). After a Blizzard passes, there is a chance that affected tiles will have an improved [ICON_Food] Food yield.
暴风雪仅会发生在雪地或冻土单元格中。其强度由“严重性”（7个单元格）到“灾难性”（19个单元格）。暴风雪经过后，受影响的单元格有一定几率提高 [ICON_Food] 食物产出。

Dust Storms can only occur in Desert tiles.  They range from gradient (3 tiles) to haboob (7 tiles).  After a Dust Storm passes, there is a chance that affected tiles will have an improved [ICON_Food] Food or [ICON_Production] Production yield.
沙尘暴仅会发生在沙漠单元格中。其强度由“梯度”级（3个单元格）到“哈布”级（7个单元格）。沙尘暴经过后，受影响的单元格有一定几率提高 [ICON_Food] 食物或 [ICON_Production] 生产力收益。
Tornados only occur in Plains and Grassland tiles.  They range from family (1 tile) to outbreak (3 tiles).
龙卷风仅会发生在平原和草原单元格中。其强度由“多漩涡”级（1个单元格）到“爆发”级（3个单元格）。

Hurricanes only occur in Ocean tiles.  They range from Category 4 (7 tiles) to Category 5 (19 tiles).  After a Hurricane passes, there is a chance that affected tiles will have an improved [ICON_Food] Food or [ICON_Production] Production yield.
飓风仅会发生在海洋单元格中。其强度“4级”（7个单元格）及“5级”（19个单元格）。飓风经过后，受影响的单元格有一定几率提高 [ICON_Food] 食物或 [ICON_Production] 生产力的产出。
Storms
风暴

Volcanoes are commonly found near continent borders.  Volcanoes have three states: dormant, active and erupting.  Dormant Volcanoes are identical to mountain tiles.  A dormant Volcano may become active.  Once active, they begin to glow from within, and billowing smoke from the top hints at what's to come.  Active Volcanoes will eventually erupt and damage the surrounding tiles and any features or improvements on those tiles.
火山通常位于大陆边缘。火山分为三类状态：休眠、活跃与喷发。休眠火山与山脉单元格相同。但休眠火山可能会转为活跃。一旦进入活跃状态后，其内部将开始闪烁火光，山顶冒出的滚滚浓烟则暗示着即将发生的事情。活跃火山最终会开始喷发，对周围的单元格及其中的地貌和改良设施造成损害。

Improvements affected by a Volcano erupting can be pillaged or removed. Garrisons and fortifications may take damage. City Centers near an erupting Volcano may suffer population loss in that city. All is not lost, however. Each tile effected by volcanic eruptions has a chance to have an increased [ICON_Food] Food and [ICON_Production] Production yield after the eruption. Wonders are not affected by eruptions.
火山喷发将掠夺或移除受影响的改良设施。其还会对驻军和防御工事造成伤害。喷发火山旁的市中心人口可能会有所下降。塞翁失马焉知非福，喷发结束后，受影响的所有单元格有一定几率提高 [ICON_Food] 食物和 [ICON_Production] 生产力的产出。奇观不受喷发影响。
Volcanoes
火山

Your Religion choices are incredibly important and can be game-changing. With the Religious Victory and Theological Combat, you have new and exciting tools at your disposal to spread your beliefs to other cities and civilizations.
您的宗教选择非常重要，它能改变游戏规则。取得宗教胜利和进行神学战斗时，您能任意使用一些新的奇妙工具，以此向其他城市和文明传播您的信仰。
Introduction
简介

[ICON_Faith] Faith is the currency of Religion and can be earned from wonders, policies, leader abilities, natural wonders, city-states, Beliefs, [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, and of course the Holy Site district and its buildings. Look through the Civilopedia to find sources of [ICON_Faith] Faith.
[ICON_Faith] 信仰值是一种宗教货币，能通过奇观、政策、领袖能力、自然奇观、城邦、信仰、 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、圣地和其建筑获得。查看文明百科，寻找 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值的来源。
Earning Faith
获得信仰值

Once you accumulate enough [ICON_Faith] Faith, you’ll be prompted to found a Pantheon, a precursor to the full-blown Religions to be founded later. Choosing which Pantheon to found depends on your short- and long-term goals for your civilization. After earning a Pantheon, you are well on your way to establishing your Religion. Unlike a full Religion, a Pantheon you choose will be unique to your civilization, and cannot spread outside your borders, or be displaced.
一旦您累积了足够的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，您会收到创建万神殿的提示，万神殿是您接下来会创建的某种成熟宗教的前身。万神殿类型取决于您为文明设定的长期和短期目标。获得一个万神殿后，您将很快创建自己的宗教。与完整的宗教不同，您所选择的万神殿是您的文明独有的，并且无法向国境之外传播，也无法被替换。
Pantheons
万神殿

You may found your Religion once you have earned (or purchased) a [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet. Religious buildings will accumulate the [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet points necessary to bring this special unit to your civilization. After the [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet has been earned, send the unit to your Holy Site, and then found your Religion. [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophets may also be earned from Stonehenge.
一旦获得（或购买）一位 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家，您便能创建自己的宗教。宗教建筑会积累 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数，这种点数对将这种特殊单位带回您的文明必不可少。获得 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家后，把该单位派遣至您的圣地，随后创建您的宗教。也可从巨石阵中获得 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家。
Great Prophets
大预言家

After founding your Religion, you will be prompted to choose a name and icon to represent your beliefs. You may choose a historical Religion, or create one of your own! A newly established Religion will consist of two beliefs: a Follower belief, and one of three additional types of beliefs that can be tailored to your play style. Once your Religion is founded, all of your cities with Holy Sites will automatically convert to the Religion.
您创建宗教后，会收到提示，让您选择能代表您信仰的名字和图标。您可以选择一个历史宗教，或创建自己的宗教！一种新创建的宗教会包含两个信仰：一个是信徒信仰，另一个是信仰的三种额外类型之一，能根据您的游戏风格定制。创建宗教后，您所有带有圣地的城市会自动信奉该宗教。
You can then use the Evangelize Belief action on Apostles to add additional beliefs to your Religion. You can have a total of 4 beliefs in a Religion.
您随后可使用使徒的“传道信仰”来为您的宗教添加额外的信仰。您可在一种宗教里拥有4种信仰。

Follower beliefs provide some kind of yield or other inherent bonus. This applies to all cities and civilizations that follow that Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Founder beliefs provide a bonus that relies on the number of followers it has. Followers are citizens that follow that religion in all cities, regardless of whether or not that Religion is predominant in a city. This bonus is applied only to the civilization that founded that Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Worship beliefs grant a unique type of building that can be built in Holy Sites, or purchased there with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Every Worship building has different benefits.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Enhancer beliefs help spread the religion by making its natural religious pressure stronger or by making Missionaries and Apostles cheaper.

信徒信仰提供多种收益或其他内在加成。它适用于所有信奉该宗教的城市和文明。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]创始人信仰提供的加成由信徒数量决定。信徒是所有城市中信奉该宗教的公民，而不论该宗教是否是城市中的主流宗教。此加成仅适用于创建了该宗教的文明。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]祭祀信仰能授予一种特色建筑，该建筑可被建在圣地，或使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。每种祭祀建筑都有不同好处。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]强化信仰通过使其自然宗教压力更强大，或让传教士和使徒的价格更便宜，来帮助传播宗教信仰。
Founding Your Religion
创建您的宗教

There are four types of Religious units: Missionaries, Apostles, Gurus, and Inquisitors. Religious units may be purchased through your city with [ICON_Faith] Faith and will adopt the majority Religion of the city in which they are built. Religious units' primary purpose is to spread their Religion to other cities. To do so, move the unit adjacent to a City Center—or inside it, if the city is yours—and use the Spread Religion action. This will convert some of the citizens of that city to Followers of your Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If more than half the citizens in the city are Followers of a particular Religion and that Religion has the majority of Followers in that city, that Religion will become predominant in that city. Cities with a dominant Religion will apply religious pressure on other cities within 10 tiles, slowly converting the citizens of those cities to that Religion.

宗教单位有四种：传教士、使徒、上师和审判官。可在城市中使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买宗教单位，其将采纳生产城市的主流宗教。宗教单位的主要作用是将其宗教传播到其他城市。为了达到这一目标，需要移动单位至市中心附近（如为本方城市，则移动到城市中），然后使用“传播宗教”行动。这样一来此城的部分公民便会皈依玩家的宗教。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果一座城市中有超过半数的公民成为某宗教的信徒，且此宗教在此城中拥有信徒数量最多，则此教将成为该城的主流宗教。拥有主流宗教的城市会对10个单元格以内的其他城市释放宗教压力，缓慢地转变这些城市公民的信仰。
Missionaries may be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith in any city with a Shrine and a dominant Religion, and have the ability to spread your Religion to any City Center in an adjacent hex.
在任何带有一个神社和一个主流宗教的城市里，都可以使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买传教士，并拥有能力将您的宗教传播至相邻格位上的任何市中心。

Apostles may be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith in any city with a Temple and a dominant Religion, and are stronger than Missionaries. Apostles get to select a unique promotion when they are created which makes them more unique, such as having more charges or removing other religions from a city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Apostles have several unique actions available in addition to spreading their Religion. They can Evangelize Belief, adding additional beliefs to your Religion, or Launch Inquisition, granting the ability to purchase Inquisitors. Furthermore, Apostles may initiate theological combat against other Religious units.

在任何带有一个寺庙和一个主流宗教的城市里，都可以使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买使徒，使徒比传教士强大。创建使徒时，可以选择能使其更加特别的特色强化，比如拥有更多次数，或将其他宗教从城市里移除。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]除了传播宗教，使徒还有其他可用的特色行动。他们可以传道信仰、为您的宗教增加额外信仰，或发起审讯、授予购买审判官的能力。此外，使徒还可以发动神学战斗来对抗其他宗教单位。

Inquisitors are special units that must be unlocked with the Launch Inquisition action on an Apostle. You only need to use this action once; once you have started an Inquisition, it never ends! You can then purchase Inquisitors with [ICON_Faith] Faith in cities that follow the religion of the Apostle that launched the Inquisition. Inquisitors are not good at spreading a Religion, but instead remove all other Religions from a user owned city. They may also engage in theological combat against other Religious units.
审判官是特殊单位，必须用使徒发起审讯行动才能被解锁。您只需使用一次该行动；一旦发起审讯，便永远不会结束！随后您可以在信奉使徒宗教的城市里购买审判官，这些使徒可使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值发起审讯。审判官不擅长传播宗教，但他们反而擅长将所有其他宗教从玩家拥有的城市中移除。他们也会参与神学战斗来对抗其他宗教单位。
Gurus serve as Religious support units, providing healing to the Religious units nearby. When it expends a healing charge, the Guru heals itself and all adjacent units of the same religion.
上师是宗教支援单位，能治疗附近的宗教单位。使用治疗次数后，上师能治疗自身和相邻的所有同宗教单位。

Religion can also spread through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes. Whenever a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route is created between two cities, there is an exchange of Religion between those two cities. The origin city has greater outgoing religious pressure, but there is still pressure that comes back from the endpoint city. This information will appear in the menu with the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route yield when choosing where to send a Trader.
也可通过 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线传播宗教。两座城市之间建立 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线后便会产生宗教交流。起源城市向外的宗教压力更大，但目的地城市也会反馈宗教压力。此信息将显示在商人派遣选择菜单的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线产量中。
Religious Units and Pressure
宗教单位和压力

Theological combat is the best way to defend against other Religions trying to spread across the map. Only Apostles and Inquisitors may initiate theological combat, and then only against other Religious units. You do not need to be at war with another civilization to engage in theological combat. Doing so will not by itself provoke a war, though it could result in negative diplomatic consequences from a Religious pressure drop. Religious units exert a Zone of Control against other religious units, restricting their movement when close.
神学战争是抵御其他宗教在地图上传播的最佳方式。只有使徒和审判官能够发动神学战斗并对抗其他宗教单位。无需发动战争即可和其他文明展开神学战争。发动神学战争不会引发战争，但却可能因宗教压力下降而出现负面外交后果。宗教单位能对其他宗教单位形成控制区，在接近时限制其移动力。

Theological combat works just like combat with military units, just attack one Religious unit with another. They will deal damage to each other based on their strength. Religious units can get bonuses to their theological combat strength from promotions, policies, flanking and support bonuses from other units, the Theocracy government, if they are in or adjacent to a Holy Site following their Religion, if they are in the territory of a city following their Religion, or a huge bonus if they are in the territory of their Religion's Holy City.
神学战争和军事单位的战斗并无二致，用一个宗教单位攻击另一宗教单位即可。造成的伤害将以其各自的战斗力进行判定。宗教单位能从升级、政策、其他单位的夹击和支援、以及“神权政体”政体中获得神学战斗力加成；处于或相邻于信仰其宗教的圣地中时也可获得加成；处于其宗教圣城的领土中时则可获得极大加成。

A damaged Religious unit suffers a penalty to the strength of its Spread Religion action, meaning it will convert fewer Followers. If a Religious unit is reduced to 0 Hit Points from theological combat, it will die. When a Religious unit is defeated this way, all cities within 10 tiles have a religious pressure drop of the defeated unit's Religion equal to the strength of an Apostle at full health and then a boost in the victorious unit's Religion of the same amount. If a Religious unit is killed by a hostile military unit, then the Religious pressure will drop in cities within 6 tiles, and the Religious pressure drop is halved.
受伤宗教单位的传播宗教行动将受到减益，这意味着它所转换的追随者数量将变少。如果宗教单位的生命值在神学战斗中减少为0点，它会死去。用这种方式击败一个宗教单位后，在10个单元格内所有城市中被击败单位的宗教压力下降，下降量与一个生命值全满的使徒的攻击力相同，随后，获胜单位的宗教会获得同等量的提升。若宗教单位被敌方军事单位消灭后，6个单元格内城市中的宗教压力会下降，下降量减半。

Religious units can heal any damage they have by staying adjacent to or in a Holy Site in the player's territory, regardless of the Religion of that Holy Site. Religious units heal damage equivalent to 3 times the Faith output of that Holy Site. Some improvements may also act as an alternative source of healing to religious units.
停留在玩家领土中的圣地或与其相邻的单元格中时，宗教单位将治疗受到的伤害，而无视此圣地的宗教。宗教单位的生命值回复量等于此圣地信仰值产量的3倍。部分改良设施也可能用作宗教单位的回复来源。

Religious units are also vulnerable to attack from combat units. Condemn Heretic is an action that combat units may take against them when on the same tile, and works similarly to plundering a Trade Route.
宗教单位遭战斗单位攻击时防御力极弱。处于同一单元格时，战斗单位能够通过“审判异教徒”来与宗教单位对抗，方式与掠夺贸易路线类似。
Theological Combat
神学战斗

A Free City is a city which has left its original civilization due to a loss of Loyalty. These are not City-States, as they are likely to look towards rejoining one of the major civilizations of the game. A Free City has Loyalty to maintain just like a normal city, and accepts Loyalty pressure from other Civilizations. If its Loyalty reaches 0, it will join the Civilization that has exerted the most Loyalty pressure on it since the Free City became independent. This means there is a race against other civilizations when looking to attract a Free City into your civilization. Maximizing your Loyalty pressure will raise the chances that you will accumulate the most Loyalty and gain the city.

自由城市是因为忠诚度归零而离开其原所属文明的城市。自由城市并非城邦，所以它们希望再次加入游戏中的主要文明。玩家需要像对待普通城市一样保持自由城市的忠诚度，此外自由城市还会受到来自其他文明的忠诚度压力。自由城市的忠诚度归零后，它将加入对其施加最大忠诚度压力的文明（从其宣布独立开始）。这也意味着各个文明需要相互竞争，吸引自由城市的加入。将忠诚度压力输出提升至最高可以积累更多忠诚度，也有更大的机会获得自由城市。

A Free City will repair pillaged improvements and spawn units to defend itself, and may build walls to defend itself. If attacked by a civilization, the Free City will try to retaliate against one of the civilization’s cities. Otherwise its citizens pursue their own activities, waiting to see which civilization of the world will be most attractive to them.
自由城市会修复被掠夺的单元格并生产单位进行自卫，也可能修建城墙提升防御力。如果遭到文明的攻击，自由城市会尝试对此文明的城市进行报复回击。如果相安无事，自由城市的居民便会自得其乐，等待加入自己最心仪的文明。
Free Cities
自由城市

Using Fuel Consumable Resources will impact the world climate by increasing CO2 Levels, Global Temperature, and the world age. These, in turn, affect the weather forecast, the rising tide of the sea level, and polar ice caps melting. You can view the World Climate screen by selecting the appropriate icon. There are seven phases of Climate Change that occur as your CO2 levels rise. Each phase has unique effects on the world, including increasing the chance of storms, flooding, droughts, and rising sea level.
使用燃料类消耗性资源将导致二氧化碳浓度和全球性温度的提高，从而对世界气候和世界纪元产生影响。这些变化又会影响天气预测，导致海平面上升和极地冰盖融化。选择相应图标可打开“世界气候”界面。随着二氧化碳浓度提高，气候变化将进入7个不同阶段。每个阶段会对世界产生不同影响，如风暴、洪水、干旱和海平面升高的发生几率上升。
See the Climate Change entry under Environmental Effects for additional information.
浏览“环境效应”下的“气候变化”目录了解更多信息。
Global Temperature
全球气温

As the game progresses from era to era your civilization can enter a Golden Age or a Dark Age. If you're doing better than the other civilizations or completing many Historic Moments, then there is a good chance you will enter a Golden Age in the next era. If you start falling behind, you might fall into a Dark Age. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A Golden Age is a time of great prosperity for your people. Your Loyalty decays at a lower rate than normal. Not only are your cities more likely to stay in your civilization, but you might even convert nearby cities into your civilization as well. In addition, you can choose a Dedication for the next era. Dedications are powerful bonuses that apply to a specific part of your civilization. But be aware that earning a Golden Age makes it harder to earn the next Golden Age, and easier to fall into a Dark Age.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Dark Ages are difficult periods of time for your people. Your Loyalty decays faster than normal, which may lead to the cities at the edge of your civilization leaving and becoming independent cities, or being conquered by other players and integrated into their civilization. You can help prevent this by using your [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governors, or by strategically choosing to lose cities (and maybe hope to reconquer them later.)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Don't worry or be too upset if you fall into a Dark Age because you have the chance to enter a Heroic Age. Your threshold for entering a Golden Age will be lower if you're in a Dark Age, and if you pass that Golden Age threshold, you will enter a Heroic Age. A Heroic Age lets you choose three Dedications in the next era! This may actually set you ahead of a player who goes from Golden Age to Golden Age, if you're able to take advantage of your abilities.

游戏进程中时代更迭，您的文明可能进入黄金时代或黑暗时代。如您在竞争中优于其他文明，或完成了较多历史时刻，下个时代则很可能进入黄金时代。反之，落后则可能坠入黑暗时代。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]黄金时代是文明的一段繁荣时期。您城市忠诚度的降低率将放缓。您的城市将紧密依附在文明旗下，甚至还能将附近的城市纳入文明。此外还可选择对下个时代的着力点。着力点是应用到文明特定部分的强力加成。但需要注意的是，进入黄金时代后再次进入黄金时代的难度将提升，却更容易坠入黑暗时代。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]黑暗时代则是文明的艰难岁月。您城市的忠诚度下滑更快，城市可能走向抛弃文明成为自由城市的边缘，或被其他玩家占领、并入其领土。灵活运用 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督可防止出现此类状况，或战略性地暂时放弃城市，待日后收复。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如不幸坠入黑暗时代，切莫灰心丧气，因为您仍能进入英雄时代。坠入黑暗时代后，进入黄金时代的临界值更低，超过此临界值即可进入英雄时代。进入英雄时代后可以选择3个着力点！善用各种能力，超越连续进入黄金时代的玩家也并非天方夜谭。

If you exceed the Era Score threshold for a Dark Age, but do not have a high enough score to enter a Golden Age, then you enter into a Normal Age. During a Normal Age you may still choose a Dedication for that age, but you do not gain any other bonuses or penalties.
如果玩家的时代得分超过黑暗时代的临界值但却不足以进入黄金时代，则会进入普通时代。在普通时代中您仍然可以选择1个此时代的着力点，但无法获得其他加成或惩罚。

Dark Ages also give you access to special Dark Age Policies. These wildcard policies can provide you with options to emerge from a Dark Age, but carry a cost. For example, the Isolationism Policy gives bonuses to internal [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, but prevents you from building or buying Settlers or settling new cities.
玩家在黑暗时代中可以选择特殊的黑暗时代政策。这些通配符政策能给玩家带来更多选择，以便度过艰难的黑暗时代，但其也存在一定限制。例如“孤立主义”政策会为国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线带来加成，但无法生产或购买开拓者，也无法建立新城市。
You may complete Dedications during a Normal and Dark Age to increase your Era Score, giving you a better chance to gain a Golden Age in the future.
在普通时代和黑暗时代中完成着力点能够增加时代得分。提升未来进入黄金时代的机率。
Golden and Dark Ages
黄金时代和黑暗时代
[ICON_Gold] Gold is the lifeblood of a civilization. It may be true that "money can't buy you love," but it can purchase a submarine armed with nuclear missiles, and that's not bad.
[ICON_Gold] 金币是文明的命脉。“金钱非万能”这句话或许是真的，但它却能买到装备有核导弹的潜艇，这还真是不赖。
Introduction
介绍

[ICON_Gold] Gold comes from a variety of sources. You'll obtain [ICON_Gold] Gold by working the tiles around your cities, but other sources are available as well: terrains and improvements, trading posts, districts and buildings, [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, Barbarian outposts, Tribal Villages, city-states, pillaging enemy improvements, capturing cities, and diplomacy with other civilizations.
有多种方式获得 [ICON_Gold] 金币。您能通过改良城市周边的单元格获得 [ICON_Gold] 金币，但也有其他办法可供选择：地形和改良设施、贸易站、区域和建筑、 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、蛮族哨站、部落村庄、城邦、掠夺敌方改良设施、占领城市、与其他文明进行外交。
Obtaining Gold
获得金币

There are many times that you can and will spend [ICON_Gold] Gold. Units, nukes, districts, and buildings have "maintenance costs" that must be paid every turn. You can also extend your civilization's territory by purchasing individual tiles, or you can use the [ICON_Gold] Gold to purchase units and buildings. Upgrading obsolete units will also cost [ICON_Gold] Gold. [ICON_Gold] Gold may also be exchanged with other civilizations during diplomacy.
[ICON_Gold] 金币是您会经常用到的资源。每回合必须支付单位、核武器、区域和建筑的“维护费”。同时您可以购买单元格来扩张文明的领土，或使用 [ICON_Gold] 金币购买单位和建筑。升级过时的单位也会消耗 [ICON_Gold] 金币。在外交中也可与其他文明交换 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
Spending Gold
花费金币

If your treasury is at zero and you're running a negative budget, you will begin to receive a -1 penalty to your [ICON_Amenities] Amenities per every 10 [ICON_Gold] Gold you drop below 0. Additionally, at -10 [ICON_Gold] Gold you will automatically disband a unit, at -20 [ICON_Gold] Gold, two units will be disbanded, and so forth.
如果国库已空以及预算达到赤字，低于0以下，每减少 [ICON_Gold] 10金币，您的 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度会获得-1减益。此外， [ICON_Gold] 金币数量为-10时，您会自动解散一个单位， [ICON_Gold] 金币数量为-20时，会自动解散两个单位，以此类推。
Bankruptcy
破产

Governors [ICON_GOVERNOR] allow players to manage cities in their civilization in the following ways:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Appointing Governors with unique strengths and abilities to serve in their civilization.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Promoting appointed Governors to unlock new abilities and effects.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Assigning an appointed Governor to a specific city within their civilization.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Using assigned Governors special abilities to gain various unique effects in that city.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Using assigned Governors to increase the process of establishing a stronger Loyalty in the city.

玩家可借助总督 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 用以下方式管理城市：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 任命并指派拥有特殊能力的总督为文明效力。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 对总督进行升级，解锁新能力和效果。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 将总督派遣到文明中的特定城市。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 利用总督的特殊能力为城市带来诸多特殊效果。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 利用总督巩固城市的忠诚度。

There are 8 different Governors that may be recruited and promoted:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_AMBASSADOR_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_AMBASSADOR_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_BUILDER_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_BUILDER_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_EDUCATOR_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_EDUCATOR_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_MERCHANT_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_MERCHANT_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_DEFENDER_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_DEFENDER_TITLE}'[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_IBRAHIM_NAME}  '{LOC_GOVERNOR_IBRAHIM_TITLE}' (Suleiman's unique Governor)

可招募和升级8种不同的总督：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_AMBASSADOR_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_AMBASSADOR_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_BUILDER_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_BUILDER_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_EDUCATOR_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_EDUCATOR_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_MERCHANT_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_MERCHANT_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_DEFENDER_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_DEFENDER_TITLE}”[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] {LOC_GOVERNOR_IBRAHIM_NAME}“{LOC_GOVERNOR_IBRAHIM_TITLE}”（奥斯曼特色总督）

Appointing a Governor:[NEWLINE] Governors and their promotions are obtained by using Governor Titles. Governor Titles are unlocked throughout the game, primarily through the Civics tree, but also through building the Government Plaza district and its buildings, and building the Casa de Contratación Wonder. Once a Governor is appointed, they can be assigned to a city to perform their duties. Players can only have one Governor of each type in their civilization, and only one Governor can be assigned to a city at a time.
任命总督：[NEWLINE]使用总督头衔即可任命并升级总督。总督头衔随游戏进程解锁，主要通过市政树获得，也可通过建造“市政广场”区域和其中的建筑来获得。此外还可通过建造“西印度交易所”奇观来获得。任命总督后即可将其派遣到城市中行使职责。每种总督文明中仅限保留一个；一次只能指派一个总督到一座城市。

Promoting a Governor:[NEWLINE]Players can also use Governor Titles to promote Governors that they have previously appointed. Each Governor type has a unique promotion tree. Choosing a promotion unlocks a new ability that the Governor can implement once they become established in the city they have been assigned.
升级总督：[NEWLINE]玩家可使用总督头衔来升级之前任命的总督。每种总督均有独特的升级树。选择升级即可解锁总督的能力，总督在指派城市中就职后即可运用这些能力。

Governor Effects:[NEWLINE]There are various ways Governors can affect a city in which they are assigned:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Gaining identity in the city toward their civilization, thereby increasing the Loyalty of its [ICON_Citizen] Citizens.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Applying the Governor's special abilities in that city by becoming established there.
总督特效：[NEWLINE]总督能以多种方式对任职的城市产生影响：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 增加城市 [ICON_Citizen] 公民的忠诚度，从而提升城市对文明的认同度。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] 在城市中就职，发挥总督的特殊能力。

Becoming Established:[NEWLINE]When a Governor is first placed in a city, there is an amount of time before they come into power in that city. This time period represents the amount of time a Governor would take in order to create policies and laws, propose changes, and establish their power and influence on that city. The amount of 'transition' time is dependent upon the Governor. Once a particular Governor has established themselves in a city and then leaves, their established time there will start to decay over time. After the requisite amount of time, the Governor's special abilities come into effect. This includes their base ability, as well as any promotions they have been given. These abilities are passive, in that they are not required to be activated by the player, nor are they one-time single use effects.

就职：[NEWLINE]总督被派遣到城市后需要一段时间才能行使职权。总督需要一定时间来建立政策和法规、提议改进，并在城市中建立起威信和影响力。而这个过渡周期的长短则取决于总督本人。总督在城市中就职并离开后，其在此处的就职时间将逐渐减少。一段时间之后，总督的特殊能力将开始发挥作用。其中包括总督的基础能力，以及他们额外获得的升级。这些能力均为被动技能，玩家无需手动发动，同时这些能力也并非单次使用的效果。

Changing Governor Assignments:[NEWLINE]Sometimes during gameplay it is necessary to change the location in which your Governors are assigned. Governors can be reassigned to a different city at any time, but keep in mind that once assigned to a different city it will take time for them to become established there. If a Governor is assigned to a city that already contains a Governor, the existing Governor is taken out of the city and is put back into your Governor pool, ready to be assigned to a new location.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Governors can only be assigned to cities within their civilization with two exceptions. The 'Diplomat' Governor is unique in that she can be assigned to a city-state as well as any of the cities within her civilization. The Ottoman leader Suleiman has The 'Grand Visier' unique Governor which can be assigned to the capital city of another major civilization as well as any domestic city. Both The 'Diplomat' and 'Grand Visier' cannot be assigned to a city the player is currently at war with.

总督调职：[NEWLINE]游戏进程中有时需要调整派遣总督的地点。可以随时将总督调职到其他城市，但需要注意的是调职后总督需要一定时间才能够在新城市中就职。如总督被派遣到一个已拥有总督的城市中，那么现在职的总督将离开城市返回总督人才库，等待被派至其他城市。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]总督只能被派遣到本方文明的城市中，但有2个例外。“外交官”总督不仅能被派遣到本方文明的城市中，还能被派遣到城邦中。奥斯曼领袖苏莱曼一世的“大维齐尔”特色总督可被派遣到其他主要文明的首都城市和任意国内城市中。“外交官”和“大维齐尔”总督皆无法被派遣到当前正与玩家交战的城市中。
Governors
总督
Governments allow you to customize your civilization to match your play style by offering different combinations of slots to elect different types of policies, as well as offering distinct bonuses.
政体允许您提供不同的槽位组合来选择不同的政策类型，或者提供独特加成来定制您的文明，使其与您的游戏风格相匹配。

Unlocked through the Civics Tree, the available governments will change as you progress through time. In the beginning, you will have a simple government with only a handful of slots. But as you reach later eras, more slots in different combinations will be unlocked. On top of this, governments have their own special bonuses; the Theocracy government, for instance, will allow you to purchase land units with [ICON_Faith] Faith and offers a discount on [ICON_Faith] Faith purchases when active.
通过市政树解锁，可用政体随着您的游戏进程会发生变化。最先，您只有一个政体且只有少量槽位。但随着您进入其他时代，会解锁不同组合的更多槽位。除此之外，政体会有自己的特殊加成；比如神权政体会让您使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买陆地单位，并且当激活时，可为 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买提供折扣。

Finally, all governments have Legacy bonuses based on how long that government was active within your empire. For example, though you may have moved past the Theocracy government, you will receive a Legacy bonus of [ICON_Faith] Faith discounts based on how long that government was active in your empire’s history. You may switch your government at any time. If you switch to a previously adopted government, you will enter a state of Anarchy.
最终，您帝国内所有政体都会产生传承加成，加成数量取决于该政体的存在时间长短。比如，您的神权政体时代可能已过去，但您依然会获得 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值被降低后的传承加成，加成数量取决于该政体在您帝国历史上的存在时间。您可以随时转换政体。如切换至之前采用的政体，则会进入无政府状态。
Governments
政体

Policies have concrete effects for gameplay. Some increase your cities’ [ICON_Production] Production, while others generate more wealth, and still others help create a more effective military. There are no right or wrong policy choices in the game, and one policy may be better for a given circumstance than other, or better suit your personal playing style. Try them out and see.
政策对游戏设置有特定影响。有些会增加您城市的 [ICON_Production] 生产力，有些会产生更多财富，还有的会帮助创建一支更高效的军队。游戏中没有正确或错误的政策选项，某项政策在特定情况下可能比别的好，或者更符合您的个人游戏风格。试试看吧。

There are 6 types of policies, each of which may be slotted into a corresponding slot in a given government. Slotting these individual policies will give you the benefits described and enhance your game.
有6种政策类型，每种都会被放入特定政体的相应槽位。放置单个政策会让您获得所描述的好处，并能强化您的游戏。
Policies
政策

You can choose to adopt policies once you have gained [ICON_Culture] Culture to unlock your first government. Policies will be unlocked as you progress through the Civics Tree, and changing your government will allow you to slot different combinations of policies to better suit your play style. Any time a new government or policy is unlocked from the Civics Tree, you will have the opportunity to reselect policies or change your government for free. Otherwise, there will be a cost to make these changes.
一旦获得 [ICON_Culture] 文化值，您可选择采用政策来解锁您第一个政体。通过在市政树中不断进步来解锁政策，变更政体让您能放置不同的政策组合，以便能更加符合您的游戏风格。在市政树解锁新政体或新政策时，您会获得机会免费重新选择政策或变更政体。否则变更将产生消耗。
Gaining Policies
获得政策

There are 4 different policy types to explore, each attributing to a different style of government. All types must be applied to an empty slot of the same type in the government, but a Wildcard slot can house any type of policy.
能探索四种不同的政策类型，政策不同是因为政体类型不同。所有类型都必须放入政体中相同类型的空槽位，但在通配符槽位能放入任何类型的政策。
Military: These policies are best for players who want a strong military on land and sea.
军事：对于想要强大的陆地和海洋军队的玩家来说，这种政策再好不过。
Economic: These policies can be useful in increasing all sorts of yields, whether through increasing district adjacency bonuses or reducing costs.
经济：不管是通过增加区域相邻加成，或减少消耗，这些政策都有助于增加所有类型的产出。
Diplomatic: These policies are best for players with a strong interest in building relationships, and can help strengthen the bonds with city-states or improve espionage operations.
外交：这些政策对有强烈兴趣建立外交关系的玩家来说，真是再好不过了，它们可帮助增加与城邦之间的凝聚力，或改善间谍行动。
Wildcard: These policies accelerate the rate of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person production.
通配符政策：这些政策会加速 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人的产生。

Government: These policies provide powerful legacy bonuses for different Government types. They are unlocked when you build a Government Plaza district and one of the buildings corresponding to the tier of a Government. For example, if you adopt the Classical Republic Government, and then construct a Warlord's Throne, Ancestral Hall, or Audience Chamber, you'll unlock the Republican Legacy Policy.
政体政策：这些政策能为不同政体类型带来强大的遗产加成。玩家建造市政广场区域和政体级别相关的建筑后即可解锁这些政策。举例而言：采用“古典共和”政体，然后建造“军阀宝座”、“祠堂”或“谒见厅”即可解锁“共和传承”政策。

Dark Age: If you enter a Dark Age, you can gain access to special Policies that apply only while you are in a Dark Age. The selection of Dark Age Policies will change as the Eras advance. These policies can provide you with a special advantage that might help you, but have a cost that may restrict you in other ways.
黑暗时代政策：进入黑暗时代后即可采用特殊政策，但仅限在黑暗时代中使用。随着时代发展，黑暗时代政策的选择将发生变化。这些政策能够提供一些有帮助的特殊优势，但在其他方面则会存在限制。
Policy Types

Switching to a previously adopted government briefly places your civilization into a state of Anarchy, which has the following negative effects:
切换至之前采用的政体将把文明置于无政府状态，存在以下负面效果：

Your policies provide no benefit and cannot be slotted.[NEWLINE]4. You won't be able to change governments until the state of Anarchy ends.
1. 无法从资源处获得 [ICON_Gold] 黄金、[ICON_Science] 科技值、[ICON_Culture] 文化值或 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]2. 无政府状态无法获得政体特殊加成或传承。[NEWLINE]3. 政策无法带来增益，无法存入槽位。[NEWLINE]4. 无政府状态结束前无法变更政体。
Anarchy lasts a minimum of three turns. The more you previously adopted this form of government, the longer Anarchy will last.
无政府状态最低持续3回合。之前采用此政体的时间越长，无政府状态的持续时间越长。
Anarchy
