[ICON_GreatPerson] Great People are the artists, merchants, engineers, scientists, generals, and admirals who can, singlehandedly, change the course of a civilization. There are nine types of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People: [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artists, [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writers, [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musicians, [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineers, [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchants, [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientists, [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophets, [ICON_GreatAdmiral] Great Admirals, and [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great Generals.

[ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人包括艺术家、商人、工程师、科学家、将军和海军将领，他们能独自改变文明的进程。有9种 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人类型： [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家、 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家、 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师、 [ICON_GreatMerchant] 大商人、 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家、[ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家、 [ICON_GreatAdmiral] 海军统帅和 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军。
Introduction
介绍

[ICON_GreatPerson] Great People can be earned by generating enough of the right type of points. They are visible to all players, and they are visibly competed for between all players. Only major civilizations can earn [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, not Barbarians or city-states. Each type of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person has its own points which are tracked separately. [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist Points cannot count as [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist Points, and so on. The number of points needed to earn a particular [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person depends on that [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person’s era. A Renaissance-era [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist will cost much less [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist Points than a Modern-era one. The points come from a variety of sources.

通过产生足够的正确类型的点数获得 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人。伟人对所有玩家可见，玩家对其进行的争夺可见。只有主流文明能获得 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人，蛮族和城邦无法获得伟人。每种类型的 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人都有自己的点数，可分别追踪点数大小。不能把 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家点数看作 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家点数，以此类推。用于获取特殊 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人的点数多少取决于 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人所处的时代。文艺复兴时期的 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家花费的点数远远少于现代 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家。点数有多种来源。

Each district, and the buildings within it, provides points towards its associated [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person type. This is the slow but steady source of points. Districts also allow a city to use [ICON_Production] Production towards projects which, when completed, contribute [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person points.
每个区域和其中的建筑都为它的相关 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人类型提供点数。这是点数缓慢但稳定的来源。区域也允许城市使用 [ICON_Production] 生产力来完成项目，这些项目完成时，能贡献 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数。

Players can also spend [ICON_Gold] Gold or [ICON_Faith] Faith to patronize a Great Person, earning that person instantly. The patronage cost is based on how many more [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person points the player would need to recruit that person normally.
玩家可消耗 [ICON_Gold] 金币或 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值资助伟人，从而立即获得该伟人。资助费用取决于正常招募此伟人所需的 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数与当前点数的差额。
If a player cannot earn a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person, such as when there are no [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophets left, those unneeded points are converted into 1 [ICON_Faith] Faith per point.
如玩家无法获得某种 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人，例如游戏中已没有剩余的 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家。无用的伟人点数便会按一比一的比例转换为 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
Earning Great People
获得伟人

Each [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person individual has a different effect, inspired by history. Most effects are strongly linked to a particular era of play, and are not optimal for use outside of that time. The effects fall into two broad categories, Passive Effects and Action Effects.
受历史鼓舞，每个 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人都会产生不同影响。大多影响和游戏的特定年代息息相关，在该时代以外使用效果不佳。影响分为两大类：被动效果和主动效果。
A Passive Effect happens as soon as the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person is spawned on the map. These are mostly found on Great Generals and Great Admirals.
[ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人出现在地图上后会立即触发被动效果。一般来说拥有这种效果的是大将军和海军统帅。

An Action Effect must be activated by the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person by using a “charge” at a certain location. The number of charges, the type of location needed, and the effect activated will vary based on the individual. Most individuals only have 1 charge and can only activate at a district matching its type (ex. most [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientists have 1 charge and must use it at a Campus). Like other charge-based units, the individual will disappear when all charges are depleted.
[ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人在特定地点使用“次数”才能激活效果。所需次数、所需地点类型和被激活的效果完全取决于个体本身。多数个体的次数为1，并且只能在与本身类型相匹配的区域激活（比如，多数 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家的次数为1，且必须在学院激活）。与其他基于次数的单位一样，次数耗尽后，个体也将消失。
Using Great People
使用伟人

[ICON_GreatPerson] Great People can move about the board like any other units. They are non-combat units, which means that they cannot stack in a tile with other non-combat units (Workers, Settlers), but they can stack with one military unit. If an enemy unit enters a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person's tile, that [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person automatically retreats to a nearby city if able (the enemy doesn't capture it.) These units may also be transferred to another city when in a city center.
[ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人像其他单位一样可以任意移动。伟人属于非战斗单位，意味着他们不能和其他非战斗单位（工人、开拓者）处于同一单元格内，但可与军事单位重叠。如敌方单位进入 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人所在格位， [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人会自动撤退到附近城市（前提是敌人未占领该城）。位于市中心时，这些单位也可能转移到另一座城市。
Moving Great People
移动伟人

[ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances are diplomatic penalties that you accumulate through hostile acts or by acting against the wishes of the other civilizations in the game. Each civilization keeps track of its [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances with each other civilization, and takes them into account when deciding how favorably to view other civilizations and their diplomatic options.  When another civilization has high [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against you, cities they founded are less loyal to you, they are less likely to act favorably toward you, and third-party civilizations may consider you a warmonger if you continue to grieve other civilizations.

在游戏中做出敌对或违背其他文明意愿的行为时将累积外交减益，也就是 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。每个文明均会记录与其他文明相互间的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满，并以此作为依据来看待其他文明和进行外交选择。其他文明对您非常 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满时，他们建立的城市对您的忠诚度更低，他们也不会选择对您有利的行为。如果您持续让其他文明产生不满，第三方文明可能会将您视为好战分子。

Most [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances are generated in one large sum as the result of a single action, but possessing enemy cities generates a certain amount every turn.  During times of peace between civilizations, their [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances tend toward zero turn by turn. [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances decay quickly in early Eras, but the rate of decay slows as the Eras advance.
产生大量 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满的多数情况均是单次行为的结果，占据敌人的城市每回合将产生一定量不满。文明之间和平相处时，每回合彼此的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满趋近于零。在早期时代中，[ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满的下降速度较快。随着时代发展，下降速度将放缓。

[ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances are most often generated when declaring war or capturing enemy cities. Using a Casus Belli will mitigate some of the [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances generated by your actions during the war. Denouncing a civilization will generate [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against you. Eliminating a city-state generates [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against you from all other civilizations that have met that city-state. If you ignore or deny a Request from another civilization, the other civilization gets [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against you; however, if you Promise to follow a Request and then break your promise, that will generate even higher levels of [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances.

[ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满产生的主要原因是宣战或占领敌方城市。使用战争借口可以减少战争中的行为所引起的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。谴责文明将导致其对您产生 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。消灭城邦时将导致所有曾与其会面的文明对您产生 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。无视或拒绝另一文明的请求也将导致其对您产生 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。而对请求做出承诺随后却打破诺言时将会产生更高数额的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。

In addition, you will generate [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances with third parties that have a relationship with the civilization that is angry with you. For example, if you do something that gives America [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against you, and America has an Alliance with England, then you will also generate a percentage of those [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances with England.
此外，与关系不睦的文明有亲密关系的第三方国家也会对您产生 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。举例而言，若您的行为导致美国产生 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满，而与此同时英国与美国有同盟关系，那么英国同样会对您产生一定比例的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满。
Grievances
不满

Welcome to the Civilopedia for Sid Meier's Civilization VI! Here you will find detailed descriptions of all aspects of the game. Clicking on the tabs on the top edge of the screen will take you to the various major sections of the Civilopedia. The Navigation Bar on the left side of the screen will display the various entries within a section. Click on an entry to go directly there.
欢迎使用《席德·梅尔的文明VI》里的文明百科！您可以在这里找到关于游戏各方面的详细说明。点击画面顶端的标签可直接进入文明百科的各个主要章节。画面左侧的导航栏里有章节中的各个条目。点击其中条目即可直接查阅其内容。
Introduction
介绍
Basic Concepts
基本概念

Loyalty is a city’s measure of its devotion to your civilization. Every city has a Loyalty value from 0 to 100, which reflects how much the [ICON_Citizen] Citizens of the city want to stay as part of your civilization. When the Loyalty drops below 75, the city’s yields and growth are penalized 25%. When the Loyalty drops below 25, the city’s yields are penalized 50% and growth is penalized 75%. When Loyalty reaches 0, the city revolts against its owner and becomes a Free City. Free Cities belong to no civilization and will seek to defend themselves from military intrusion. If a Free City’s Loyalty drops to 0, its experiment of independence fails, and they seek to join a civilization. Which civilization they request to join depends on who exerted the most pressure on the Free City during their independence. In this way, a Free City may be peacefully brought into your civilization (or brought back into your civilization).

忠诚度是城市对文明的热爱程度。每个城市的忠诚度为0-100点，代表城市 [ICON_Citizen] 公民依附您文明的愿望强度。忠诚度降至低于75点后，城市的产量与成长将降低25%；当降至低于25点后，城市产出将减少50%，而城市成长将减缓50%；忠诚度归零后，城市将反叛并成为自由城市。自由城市不属于任何文明，会用武力来进行自卫。如自由城市的忠诚度归零，则其独立的尝试宣告失败，其将寻求加入一个文明。他们请求加入的目标将会是在争取独立期间对其施加最大忠诚度压力的文明。通过这样的方法可兵不血刃地将自由城市纳入己方文明（亦或是失而复得）。

Loyalty changes each turn based on many factors, but the most important factor is the pressure of [ICON_Citizen] Citizens who live in or near the city. If pressure from your own [ICON_Citizen] Citizens outweighs pressure from other civilizations, the city’s Loyalty will increase (up to +20 per turn). If other civilizations’ pressure is stronger, the city’s Loyalty will decrease (down to -20 per turn). Each [ICON_Citizen] Citizen exerts a base pressure of 1, but it can be modified. For example, [ICON_Citizen] Citizens in a Capital city exert an additional 1 pressure. Golden and Heroic Ages add 0.5 for all [ICON_Citizen] Citizens, while Dark Ages subtract 0.5. This [ICON_Citizen] Citizen pressure affects cities within 9 tiles, but is 10% less effective per tile distant.

忠诚度每回合皆会基于诸多因素发生变化，其中最重要的因素则是此城中、或附近城市中 [ICON_Citizen] 公民所带来的压力。如果本国 [ICON_Citizen] 公民输出的压力大于其他文明输出的压力，城市的忠诚度则会增加（上限为每回合+20）。如若其他文明的压力更强，则城市的忠诚度将减少（下限为每回合-20）。每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民输出的压力基数为1，但此值并非固定。举例而言，首都 [ICON_Citizen] 公民将额外输出1点压力。在黄金时代和英雄时代中，所有 [ICON_Citizen] 公民输出的压力+0.5，在黑暗时代中则-0.5。 [ICON_Citizen] 公民输出的压力将影响9个单元格内的城市，每远离1个单元格，效果则减弱10%。

The city’s [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor and Happiness level are other strong factors that affect a city’s Loyalty per turn. Additionally, cities conquered with military force will receive Loyalty penalties based on the conqueror's Grievances caused against the city's original owner, but these can be mitigated by keeping a garrisoned military unit in the city. Use the Loyalty lens to get a view of Loyalty factors, including the sources of pressure from other nearby cities. A complete breakdown of factors affecting a city’s Loyalty can be viewed in the Loyalty and Governors section of the City Details panel.
城市的 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督和幸福度等级则是影响城市每回合忠诚度的其他重要因素。此外，武力攻占的城市将蒙受忠诚度减益（此减益视城市原拥有者对征服者的不满而定），在城市中驻军可减弱此效果。可使用忠诚度滤镜查看影响忠诚度的因素，以及来自其他城市的压力源。可在“城市详情”面板中的“忠诚度和总督”部分查看影响城市忠诚度的各种因素。
For players who founded a Religion, cities get +3 Loyalty for following that Religion, but -3 Loyalty per turn if following another player's Religion.
文明创立宗教后，信仰此宗教的城市将+3忠诚度，信仰其他文明宗教的城市每回合将-3忠诚度。
Loyalty
忠诚度

All mobile units have a certain number of [ICON_Movement] Movement points that they can expend on [ICON_Movement] Movement every turn. Once they've expended those [ICON_Movement] Movement points, they can't move any more until the next turn. Units expend [ICON_Movement] Movement points to enter tiles, to attack other units, or to pillage improvements or districts. The terrain of the tile a unit is entering determines the [ICON_Movement] Movement point cost of the move.
所有可移动单位都有一定的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，可用于每回合的 [ICON_Movement] 移动。 [ICON_Movement] 移动力耗尽后，单位将无法移动，直到其下个回合才可移动。单位需要消耗 [ICON_Movement] 移动力才能进入单元格。单位进入的单元格地形决定了此次移动的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力消耗数量。
Movement Points
移动力

Roads are an important part of moving around the world. Placed by Trader units beginning in the Ancient Era, roads begin by reducing the [ICON_Movement] Movement cost of a tile to 1 when moving from one road tile to another. As technology progresses, you will unlock the ability to build better and better roads, and even bridges. Modern roads, for example, reduce [ICON_Movement] Movement to a half [ICON_Movement] Movement point per tile, when moving from one road tile to another. All roads allow units to ignore terrain-based movement penalties.
道路是在世界范围内移动的重要部分。由商人单位在远古时代进行修建的。早期，道路能将从一个道路单元格移动到另一个单元格的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力消耗减少为1。随着科技发展，您将解锁能力以修建越来越好的道路，甚至是桥梁。比如，当从一个道路单元格移动到另一个时，现代道路能将每个单元格上的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力消耗降低一半。所有道路都能让单位忽略以地形为基础的移动减益。
Roads are placed by Traders, but may also be placed manually by Military Engineers.
道路由商人进行放置，但军事工程师也能手动放置道路。
Roads
道路

Many combat units exert a "Zone of Control" (ZOC) influence over the tiles around them. Combat units that enter an enemy's ZOC must stop, regardless of any remaining [ICON_Movement] Movement. Units that have been stopped by an enemy's ZOC have the option to attack if they have the required [ICON_Movement] Movement to do so.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ranged and Bombard class units do not exert ZOC. Cavalry units, as well as Naval Raider class units have the ability to ignore an enemy's ZOC.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Religious units exert ZOC against other religious units.

一些战斗单位能将周围单元格变为自己的“控制区”。进入敌方控制区后，无论剩余多少 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，战斗单位均会强制停下。如拥有足够 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，被敌方控制区强制逼停的单位仍可选择发动进攻。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]远程和炮击单位无法形成控制区。骑兵单位和海军袭击者单位则拥有无视敌方控制区的技能。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宗教单位可对其他宗教单位形成控制区。
Rivers block Zone of Control from all units.
河流将阻隔所有单位的控制区。
Zone of Control
控制区

Generally, naval units follow the same rules as land units, except that they move in the water rather than on land. Early naval units are often limited to coastal waters (those adjacent to land tiles) and coastal cities. Eventually, you'll produce naval units that can enter deep ocean tiles, and thus explore the world.
通常而言，海军单位与陆地单位移动规则相同，只是移动区域从陆地换到了海上。初期的海上单位一般只可在近海（与陆地单元格相邻的区域）及沿海城市移动。在游戏进程中后期，您可以建造能够进入海洋单元格的海军单位来探索世界。
Naval Movement
海军移动力

At the start of the game, your land units cannot enter any water tiles. However, once you've learned the Sailing technology, Builders will be able to move into coastal water tiles. After Celestial Navigation, Traders will be able to embark. And after Shipbuilding, all units will be able to embark. To embark a unit, move the unit to a coastal tile and then click on the "Move To" Action. Once embarked, the unit must move into water.[NEWLINE]Land units that embark are considered to be in a transport ship, and do not have the same combat abilities as they do on land. Embarked land units also suffer a reduced combat strength, and can only heal in friendly waters, making them much more vulnerable to attack from enemy naval units.

游戏伊始，陆地单位无法进入水域单元格。研究航海术科技后建造者便可进入沿海水域单元格、研究天文导航后商人即可上船、研究造船术后所有单位均可上船。将单位移动到沿海单元格并点击“上船”行动选项即可使其上船。完成此操作后，单位必须进入水域。[NEWLINE]上船后的陆地单位被视为处于运输船中，陆地上的战斗技能此时无法使用。陆地单位上船后战斗力同样会被削弱，只能在友好水域中治愈。遭敌方海军单位攻击时较为脆弱。
Embarking Units
上船单位

There are 2 categories of atomic weapons: the Nuclear Device and the Thermonuclear Device.  They can be built as a city Project in any city and both require the Uranium resource to produce. There is no limit on the number that a player can build. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Once a Nuclear or Thermonuclear Device is created, it is added to the player's inventory and can then be used by any unit or improvement capable of deploying it on the map. This includes bomber aircraft, Nuclear Submarines, and the Missile Silo.
原子武器有两种类型：核装置和热核装置。任何城市只要研究出了必要技术、有可用的铀资源，并且已完成了曼哈顿计划或常春藤行动，便能创造核装置。玩家创建的数量没有限制，但核装置建造成本巨大，并且还有很高的维护费用。核装置创建后会被添加进玩家的清单，随后，任何能将其部署在地图上的单位或改良设施都能使用它。包括轰炸机、核潜艇和导弹发射井。
Nuclear Devices have a blast radius of 1. When deployed from a Missile Silo, they have a [ICON_Range] Range of 12. They cost 14 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn to maintain.
核装置的爆炸半径为1。当通过导弹发射井进行部署时，它们的射程为 [ICON_Range] 12。每回合的维护费为14个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
Thermonuclear Devices have a blast radius of 2. When deployed from a Missile Silo, they have a [ICON_Range] Range of 15. They cost 16 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn to maintain.
热核装置的爆炸半径为2。当通过导弹发射井进行部署时，它们的 [ICON_Range] 射程为15。每回合的维护费为16个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
Nuclear Device Types
核装置类型

When an atomic weapon is detonated, several things happen to all the hexes within the blast radius. [ICON_Citizen] Citizens "working" the affected tiles are eliminated, units occupying the affected tiles are destroyed, and all tile improvements are pillaged. Any districts and buildings in the affected tiles are also pillaged and must be repaired to be used again. All tiles affected are contaminated with radioactive fallout.
引爆一个原子武器时，爆炸半径的所有格位都会发生变化。 在受影响单元格上“工作”的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民会被消灭，占领受影响单元格的单位会被摧毁，所有单元格改良设施会被掠夺。位于受影响单元格上的区域和建筑也会被掠夺，且必须在修复后才能再次使用。所有受影响的单元格都遭到了放射性尘降物的污染。
Nuclear Destruction
核破坏

After a nuclear attack, fallout will contaminate every tile affected by the blast. Any units that end their turn in a contaminated tile take 50 damage each turn. [ICON_Production] Production cannot be applied to anything in tiles containing contamination, such as repairing buildings and districts. Tiles that are contaminated cannot be worked by the city until the contamination timer expires or until the tile is "cleaned."
核攻击后，放射性尘埃会污染每个受爆炸影响的单元格。在受污染单元格上结束回合的任何单位每回合将受到50点伤害。被污染单元格中的所有内容都无法使用 [ICON_Production] 生产力，如修复建筑或区域。城市无法改良受污染的单元格，只有等待污染倒计时结束或单元格被“清理”干净。

Nuclear contamination can be "cleaned" from affected tiles by Builder and Military Engineer units. Cleaning a contaminated tile takes 1 build charge. Builder, Military Engineer, and Roman Legion units that are able to clean contaminated hexes will take less damage if they end their turn in such a hex. Any city tiles not directly affected by the nuclear blast will still function normally and contribute to the city’s yield.
建造者和军事工程师单位可“清除”受影响单元格上的核污染。清理被污染的单元格需要花费1个建造次数。能清理受污染格位的建造者和军事工程师单位在这样的格位上结束回合时，会受到较少伤害。没有直接受到核爆炸影响的城市单元格继续正常运转，并带来城市收益。
Nuclear Contamination
核污染

[ICON_Power] Power is needed by buildings in a city in order to function at their best performance. It is especially important in the Industrial Era and later. Cities without sufficient Power cannot produce yields as well. A well-functioning city will have enough Power to supply its needs.
城市中的一些建筑需要 [ICON_Power] 电力方能维持最佳工作状态。在工业时代及之后的时代中，[ICON_Power] 电力极其重要。[ICON_Power] 供电不足的城市将无法提供产出。城市在 [ICON_Power] 供电充足时方能发挥正常功能。

If a city has enough Power to meet all its needs, then it is considered [ICON_Power] Powered. A city that does not have enough Power is [ICON_PowerInsufficient] Unpowered. A city is either one or the other, it cannot provide Power to some buildings and not to others. Buildings which require Power provide less than half of their normal yield when the city is Unpowered.
若城市的 [ICON_Power] 电力供给可以自足，则将被视为 [ICON_Power] 供电充足；无足够电力的城市将被视为 [ICON_PowerInsufficient] 供电不足。城市只会处于以上两种状态之一，无法对特定建筑单独供电。城市供电不足时，建筑产出将降低到正常值的一半以下。

One source of Power is resources such as [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal, [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil, and [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium. Once a player has an improvement that provides this resource, and they build the appropriate kind of Power Plant in the Industrial Zone, the city automatically converts the resource from the stockpile into Power. The Power Plant can provide Power to any city that needs it, within a 6 tile range. However, using Coal, Oil, or Uranium to produce Power can also lead to Global Warming, so there will be long-term costs to the environment for doing so.

[ICON_Power] 电力的来源之一是 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] 煤、[ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油和 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] 铀之类的资源。如文明拥有可提供此类资源的改良设施，在工业区中修建对应种类的发电厂后，城市会自动将资源储备转换为 [ICON_Power] 电力。发电厂可向6个单元格范围内有需要的城市提供 [ICON_Power] 电力。但使用煤、石油和铀会导致全球变暖，进行这类发电将付出长期的环境代价。

A Power Plant generates Power for each unit of resource that it consumes. Coal and Oil Power Plants provide 4 Power per resource, while Nuclear provides 16 Power per resource. For example, a Coal Power Plant will convert Coal from the player’s stockpile into Power each turn. Power Plants automatically try to provide enough Power to meet the demands of the cities in range and will draw from the most power-efficient resource first, before moving onto other resources. If there is a tie, a player’s largest resource stockpile is used first. If there is still a tie, they start with the resource that the player is earning more of each turn. If there is still a tie, they start with the more technologically advanced resource. For example, if a player has both a Coal Power Plant and an Oil Power Plant in their Civilization, but a larger supply of Coal than Oil, the Power Plants will draw from the Coal stockpile before making up the difference with Oil. If that player also had a Nuclear Power Plant, they would draw from the Uranium stockpile before anything else, since 1 Uranium provides 16 Power.

发电厂可消耗资源来产生电力。燃煤发电厂和燃油发电厂每消耗1点资源将提供4点电力；而核电站每消耗1点资源将提供16点电力。举例而言，燃煤发电厂每回合可将文明储备的煤转换为电力。发电厂将自行尝试满足范围内城市的电力需求，其将优先消耗转换效率最高的资源，然后再使用其他资源。如果转换效率相等，则优先消耗储量最高的资源。如果储量仍然相同，则优先消耗每回合获得量最大的资源。如获得量依然相同，则优先消耗科技含量最高的资源。举例而言，如文明同时拥有燃煤发电厂与燃油发电厂，而煤储备量大于石油，则石油和煤储备相等之前发电厂将优先消耗煤储备。如该玩家还拥有核电站，则将优先消耗铀储备来发电，因为1点铀可以产生16点电力。

Alternatively, a player may attempt to build green sources of Energy, such as hydroelectric dams and wind farms. These are unlocked with later technologies and can provide power without adding to global warming.
文明也可以选择打造水电站坝和风力发电厂等绿色能源。游戏后期科技能够解锁此类设施，在不加剧全球变暖的前提下为城市提供 [ICON_Power] 电力。
Power
电力

Historic Moments are significant events that happen throughout the history of the game, ranging from being the first to choose a new form of government, to building a Unique Unit, to discovering Natural Wonders. There are dozens of these Historic Moments through the course of the game, representing world-first and player first achievements. These moments differ through the eras. For example, clearing a Barbarian Camp in the Ancient Era is an important milestone, but clearing one in the Modern Era won't even merit acknowledgement. You can view your Historic Moments at any time in your game by clicking on the History Timeline in the upper left toolbar. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each Historic Moment adds towards your Era Score for the era, which is the measure of whether you will rise into a Golden Age or sink into a Dark Age in the next era. If you are gaining lots of Historic Moments in an era, it means you are likely to go into a Golden Age in the next era. If you are the first player in the world to get a Historic Moment, you will earn more Era Score points.

历史时刻是游戏历史进程中的重大事件，例如成为首个选择新政体的文明、生产特色单位、发现自然奇观等。游戏进程中有数十个这样的历史时刻，记载世界首个成就和玩家达成的首个成就。历史时刻在不同时代中有所不同。举例而言，在远古时代清除蛮族营地是重要的里程碑时刻，但在现代却不值一提。点击工具栏左上角的“历史年表”即可在游戏中查看历史时刻。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每个历史时刻将添加时代得分，而这将成为进入黄金时代或沦入黑暗时代的衡量标准。如果您在一个时代中获得了大量历史时刻，则意味着下个时代很可能进入黄金时代。如您成为世界上首个获得一种历史时刻的玩家，则能获得更多时代得分。
Historic Moments
历史时刻

Each technology you acquire gives your civilization access to some advanced unit, building, resource, or wonder, or gives you some other tangible benefit such as the ability to chop Woods and harvest Cattle. Each new technology makes your civilization that much more powerful. Every turn, your civilization receives [ICON_Science] Science added to its pool, and when you have accumulated enough [ICON_Science] Science, you acquire a new technology.
您获得的每种科技都会让您的文明获得某些高级单位、建筑、资源、奇观，或给您一些其他实际好处，比如锯木能力和获得牛这样的牲畜。每种新科技都会让您的文明更加强大。您的文明会在每回合获得 [ICON_Science] 科技值，您累积了足够的 [ICON_Science] 科技值后，会获得新科技。
Introduction
介绍

[ICON_Science] Science comes from a variety of sources, including your [ICON_Citizen] Citizens (0.7 per [ICON_Citizen]), your Palace, some Policies, some Religious Beliefs, some resources, wonders, trading, and of course the Campus district and its buildings. Look through the Civilopedia to find sources of [ICON_Science] Science.
[ICON_Science] 科技值有多种来源，包括您的 [ICON_Citizen] 公民（每位 [ICON_Citizen] 提供0.7）、宫殿、政策、宗教信仰、资源、奇观、贸易，以及学院区和其中的建筑。查看文明百科，了解 [ICON_Science] 科技值的来源。
Earning Science
获得科技值

Eureka moments, also known as "technology boosts", provide an immediate and significant boost towards your research of a technology. These boosts will be earned as you play the game naturally, and your actions will determine what sort of Eureka moments you encounter. For example, settling a city on the coast will boost your progress towards Sailing and creating a Pasture will boost your progress towards Horseback Riding. The Technology Tree lists boosts associated with each technology, but you may gain them from other sources (such as Great People, Research Agreements, or team shared research).
尤里卡时刻也被称为“科技提升”，它能为您的某项科技研究立即提供显著提升。正常玩游戏的同时便可获得提升，同时您的操作会决定遇见的尤里卡时刻类型。例如，在海岸上建造城市会提升您的航海术研究进度，创建一座牧场能提升您的骑马学习进度。科技树列出了与每种科技相关的提升，但玩家也能从其他来源处获得提升（如伟人、研究协议，或团队共享研究）。
Eureka Moments
尤里卡时刻

To see how all of this works in the game, check out the amazing Technology Tree. It displays all of the technologies and shows how they are intertwined. You can click on a technology to order your civilization to research it – if your civilization doesn't know the prerequisite technologies it will research them as well. The technology tree will plot the quickest route to the requested tech, and you will research the necessary precursors in the order it displays.
查看奇妙的科技树，以了解其在游戏中的作用。它显示了各项科技以及它们之间的复杂联系。点击其中的科技，便可对其进行研究——如果您的文明不了解必要的科技，它也会对它们进行研究。您将按照科技树中所显示的最快研究路线，对必要科技按照顺序进行研究。
The Technology Tree
科技树

Prior to starting a game, individual civilizations can be placed on teams for a more cooperative experience.  When playing as a team, team members share a variety of gameplay benefits and can win the game collectively.
开始游戏之前，个体文明可组队合作进行游戏。在团队游戏中，团队成员可共享诸多游戏加成，携手赢得胜利。
Team play is currently available in standard multiplayer games and most multiplayer scenarios.
当前可在标准多人游戏和多数的多人情景中进行团队游戏。
Introduction
介绍
Team members share a permanent diplomatic alliance.  All the standard alliance rules and benefits apply.
团队成员为永久性的外交同盟，享受所有标准同盟规则和增益。
Team Diplomatic Relations
团队外交关系
Team members share war status.  If a team member declares war, the declared Casus Belli conditions apply to all team members.
团队成员将共享战争状态。如一个团队成员宣战，宣布的战争借口条件将应用到所有团队成员。
Team Shared War
团队共享战争
Team members partially share research progress. Team members receive a technology boost for every technology possessed by a team member.
团队成员可共享部分研究进程。团队成员所拥有的每种科技均会为其他团队成员带来科技提升。
Team Shared Research
团队共享研究

[ICON_Tourism] Tourism is needed in order to win a Culture Victory. You can generate [ICON_Tourism] Tourism through Great Works, wonders, Holy Cities, [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts, Seaside Resorts and National Parks. You can boost your [ICON_Tourism] Tourism through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes, Open Borders, Great People, policies, and shared (or conflicting) late game governments.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Building a wonder will probably be one of the first ways you start earning [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. Each Wonder provides 2 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn, plus 1 for each era you have advanced past the era in which that wonder was first available. So an ancient wonder like Stonehenge can earn you 9 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn by the end of the game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tourism is divided into Religious Tourism (from creating a Holy City and from Relics) and Non-Religious Tourism. Some Civics (Enlightenment) and Wonders (Cristo Redentor) specifically affect the impact of your Religious Tourism.

要取得文化胜利，[ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩是关键所在。您能通过巨作、奇观、圣城、[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物、[ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物、海滨度假区和国家公园产生 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。您能通过 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、开放边界、伟人、政策和具有相似特质的（或相矛盾的）游戏后期政体来提升您的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]初期获得 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩的方法之一是修建奇观。每个奇观每回合提供2点 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。奇观修建起后每经历一个时代，旅游业绩+1。以此计算，远古时代奇观巨石阵在游戏后期时每回合可提供9点 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]旅游业绩分为宗教旅游业绩（通过创建圣城和遗物所得）和非宗教旅游业绩。部分市政（启蒙运动）和奇观（救世基督像）对宗教旅游业绩的产生影响较大。
Introduction
介绍

Great Works come in five different types. [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] Writing, [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Art, and [ICON_GreatWork_Music] Music which can be generated through [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts, which are retrieved from Antiquity Sites by Archaeologists, and [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, which are created by Apostles with the Martyr ability when they die in Theological Combat. (Relics can be obtained from other sources such as Tribal Villages, the city-state Kandy, or Jeanne D'Arc when she retires.) Once earned, a Great Work can be housed in a Great Work slot in the appropriate building or Wonder.

选中自然学家即可显示地图上的有效位置。将自然学家移动至高亮单元格将显示“建立国家公园”按钮。点击此按钮即可消耗自然学家建立国家公园。

The Trader unit is unlocked by researching Foreign Trade, and built in cities. Trader units are on a separate map layer, and do not interact with most normal things on a map. They can freely stack with any other units, and they ignore cultural borders.
通过研究对外贸易可解锁商人单位，并在城市中创建商人单位。商人单位位于单独的地图层，与地图上多数事物不产生任何联系。它们可随意与其他单位重叠，并忽视文化边界。

When a Trader is in a city the player owns, it can begin a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route between that city and another city that is in range, as long as none of your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes are already going there (for example, if I already have a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route to the city of Athens, I cannot send a second one there), and the player has not reached their maximum number of [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
商人位于玩家拥有的城市中时，可开启一条此城和范围内另一座城市之间的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。前提是没有通向此处的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线（例如已有一条到雅典的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，便无法建立第二条通往此处的路线），且玩家的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线数量未达上限。

一旦建成， [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线在标准速度下至少持续20回合。在路线持续时间内，商人单位会沿着道路自行移动，但直到返回起源城市单元格后，该路线才算完成。位于有效路线时，商人单位会忽视地形限制，并在每回合移动1个单元格的距离，当其移动时，会放置一条道路。请一定记得保护您的商人免于受到来自蛮族或敌对文明的伤害，因为其很容易受到掠夺。

At the end of the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route's duration, you will have the option of renewing the previous [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route, assigning a new [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route from the current city, or reassigning the Trader to a new city.
[ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线失效后，玩家可选择续新之前的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、从当前城市指定一条新 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，或将商人重新派遣到一座新城市。
Introduction
介绍

A player can only maintain a limited number of active [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes. 一个玩家只能拥有数量有限的有效 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。路线容量主要取决于玩家拥有的商业中心和港口的数量，但也可通过其他方式增加。需要注意的是来自商业中心和港口区域的贸易路线不会在相同城市中叠加，只会在建成第一个区域时应用此规则。

On land, a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route can reach destinations within a range of 15 tiles. Once the player researches the technology that allows embarkation, Traders can also move over water. 贸易范围

Extend your trade network and make it more lucrative with [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Posts. A [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post is placed at a city once a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route to or from that city successfully completes. It belongs to the player that owned the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route.
[ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站能扩大贸易网络，获得更多利润。到达城市（或从城市出发）的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线成功完成后，[ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站将出现在城市中。它属于拥有 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的玩家。

It also gets yields based on the path it takes. If it passes through a [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Post you own in a foreign city, it is worth an additional 1 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Long paths which pass through several [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Posts are very valuable.
贸易路线还将基于其行进路径进行产出。如通过外国城市中的己方 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站，将额外提供1个 [ICON_Gold] 金币。通过多个 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站的长路线收益颇高。

There are multiple ways to win and lose a game in Civilization VI. It's important to keep an eye on your opponents' progress toward victory as you advance your own civilization. 如您已失去原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都，但仍保有其他城市，您仍旧可以通过文化、科技、分数，或宗教方式获得其他胜利。但只有当您夺回自己的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都后，才有机会赢得统治胜利。

第一个在火星上创建殖民地的玩家将获得科技胜利。一旦开展太空竞赛，以及有人发射第一颗卫星后，所有玩家都会知道谁在试图获得该胜利。在通往成功的路上，玩家会因为达到里程碑而获得加成。以下步骤必须按顺序完成：

让人回忆起1957年的人造卫星，在研究完火箭技术和建成一个宇航中心后，您可以建造一颗卫星发射进太空。地球卫星项目完成后，您将能发射卫星并看清整张地图。

让人类登陆月球：

与1969年阿波罗11号的任务一样，您将把人类送往月球。研究完科技卫星后解锁，可在任何有宇航中心的城市中建造。选择进行登月项目来开始这一任务。发射火箭后，您会立即获得一批量 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

在火星上建立殖民地：

或许只是暂时的科幻小说——但现在您能成为首位将您的国民送上火星的人。研究机器人学、核裂变、纳米科技后，您可以在任何有宇航中心的城市建造反应堆、住所，以及进行溶液栽培模块项目。注意，一个以上的宇航中心意味着平行生产。

[ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线、具有相似特质的（或相矛盾的）游戏后期政体、开放边界、放置在您文明里的巨作、 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物、圣地、国家公园、 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物和奇观能产生 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。

要达成团队文化胜利，其中一名团队成员的 [ICON_Tourism] 国际游客数必须超过所有非团队成员文明的 [ICON_Tourism] 国内游客数。[ICON_Tourism] 国际游客数无法在团队成员之间共享。

In order to obtain a Religious Victory, you must make your Religion the predominant Religion for every other major civilization in the game. This means not every one of a civilization's cities must follow your Religion, just the majority.

虽然通过定居在其他玩家附近可以被动地传播您的宗教，但是要取得胜利还是传教士和使徒更有效果。

In Civilization VI, the world is made up of hexagonally-shaped "tiles" (also occasionally known as hexes and spaces). These tiles come in a variety of "terrain-types" -  Desert, Plains, Grassland, Hills, and so forth  - and many also include "features" like Woods and Rainforest. These elements help to determine the tile's usefulness to a nearby city as well as how easy or difficult it is to move through the tile. A tile's terrain and features may have important effects upon any combat occurring there.
在《文明VI》中，世界是由六角形的“单元格”所组成（偶尔被称为格位和空格）。这些单元格有许多不同的“地形”——沙漠、平原、草原、丘陵等等——其中有许多也含有例如树林和雨林等“地貌”。此类元素决定了城市周围单元格的有用性及移动通过其的难易度。此外，单元格的地形及地貌还会对在其上发生的战斗产生重大影响。

Every tile in the game belongs to a continent. Continents are geographical boundaries, and are not necessarily tied to a landmass—the Pangaea map, for example, is made up of several continents. You can determine a tile's continent by that tile's tooltip or by viewing the continent lens.
游戏中的每个单元格都属于一个大陆。大陆是地理边界，不一定与地块紧密相连——比如，盘古大陆的地图由几个大陆组成。通过单元格提示框或查看大陆滤镜，你可以确定单元格大陆。
Terrain and Features
地形和地貌

Resources are sources of a variety of different yields ([ICON_Food] Food, [ICON_Production] Production, etc.), and some provide other special bonuses to a civilization. They appear in certain hexes. Some are visible at the start of the game, while others require the acquisition of specific technologies before you can see them. To utilize a resource, it must be within your civilization's borders and you must construct the appropriate "improvement" in that hex. There are three types of resources: Bonus, Luxury, and Strategic.
资源是（ [ICON_Food] 食物、 [ICON_Production] 生产力等）不同收益的源泉，其中一些能为文明提供特殊加成。它们出现在特定格位上。有些在游戏伊始可见，有些则是在您获得特定科技后可见。在位于境内的资源格位之上修建改良设施，方可对其加以利用。资源分为三种：加成、奢侈品和战略。

Bonus resources can increase the [ICON_Food] Food, [ICON_Gold] Gold, or [ICON_Production] Production output of a hex. Bonus resources cannot be traded to other civilizations. These resources can be "harvested" by Builders to remove the resource and provide an immediate, one-time sum of [ICON_Food] Food or [ICON_Production] Production to the city that owns the hex.
加成资源可提高格位的 [ICON_Food] 食物、 [ICON_Gold] 金币，或 [ICON_Production] 生产力产出。加成资源无法与其他文明进行交易。建造者可通过“收获”而移除资源，并为该格位所属的城市提供即时的、一次性的总 [ICON_Food] 食物和 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

Luxury resources increase your civilization's happiness by providing [ICON_Amenities] Amenities and provide a small bonus to the hex's yield output. Only one source of a specific Luxury resource provides [ICON_Amenities] Amenities.
奢侈品资源通过提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，以及为格位收益产出提供少量加成来提高您文明的幸福度。只有一种特殊奢侈品资源的来源能提供 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

Strategic resources are not always visible at the start of the game—they may require knowledge of a particular technology before they appear on a map. Strategic resources allow you to build certain units. When you construct an improvement on a Strategic resource hex, it allows you to build units that require that resource (i.e. Musketmen require Niter) in any of your cities that has an appropriate district—Encampment for land units, Harbor for naval units, or Aerodrome for air units. If you build an improvement on 2 copies of that resource, you can build or purchase those units in any city, whether it has the appropriate district or not.

战略资源并不是说从游戏一开始你就可以看到它的——它们需要解锁某些特定科技才能显示在地图上。您可通过战略资源建造特定单位。在战略资源格位建造一项改良设施后，您便可创建特殊单位，这些单位创建需要您某些城市中的资源（比如火枪手需要硝石），城市中还需要有合适的区域——适用于陆地单位的军营、适用于海军单位的港口，或适用于空中单位的航空港。如果您在两个相同资源上建造一个改良设施，您便能在任何城市创建或购买这些单位，而不管城市中是否有合适区域。
Resources
资源

Natural wonders are the great and glorious creations of nature that awe and inspire us all. These include Crater Lake and the Great Barrier Reef – all places that truly display the grand beauty of the natural world. All natural wonders provide unique benefits to your civilization, and some even have additional special effects (for instance, healing adjacent to the Dead Sea will make a unit’s health refill completely.)
自然奇观是大自然伟大而辉煌的创造，让我们感到无比敬畏和鼓舞。自然奇观是包括火山口湖和大堡礁在内的所有真正显示大自然宏伟美景的地方。它能为您的文明带来独特好处，有的甚至还有额外特殊影响（比如，在死海附近治愈效果能让单位生命值完全恢复）。
Natural Wonders
自然奇观

Traditionally, cities have been built along Rivers, and for good reason. Rivers provide fresh water for people to drink and irrigation, improving the farmland around the city. They also protect a city, as it is quite difficult to mount an assault against a city across a River.
一般来说城市是沿着河流建造的，这么做也有着其合理的理由。河流为人类提供饮用淡水，且可以帮助灌溉，改善城市周围的农田。同时，它也具有保护城市的功能，毕竟要越过一条河流突击城市是相当困难的。
Rivers block Zone of Control from all units.
河流将阻隔所有单位的控制区。
Rivers
河流

Tribal Villages are less civilized than other civilizations, but are friendly nonetheless. Visiting tribal villages provide a random benefit to the civilization of the unit that first enters their tile. The village disappears after its gifts have been claimed. Gifts include survivors, such as Builders or Traders, technology or technology boosts, military units, [ICON_Faith] Faith, [ICON_Gold] Gold, [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics, or civic boosts.
部落村庄没有其他文明开化，但却非常友好。拜访部落村庄能为首个进入单元格的单位文明提供随机好处。村庄礼品被领取后，该村庄会消失。礼品包括幸存者，比如建造者或商人，科技或科技提升、军事单位、 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、 [ICON_Gold] 金币、 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物或市政提升。
Tribal Villages
部落村庄

Barbarians come from "outposts", which may appear randomly in any tile that cannot be seen by a unit. Each Barbarian unit belongs to its own home outpost. There are three types of Barbarian outposts: Naval, Cavalry, and Melee. A civilization will earn a [ICON_Gold] Gold reward for dispersing a Barbarian outpost − in addition to the benefit of stopping it from spawning more Barbarian units.
蛮族来自“哨站所”，哨站所会随机出现在任意一个不能被单位看见的单元格上。蛮族单位归它自己的起源哨站所所有。有3种蛮族哨站所：海军、骑兵和近战。驱散一个蛮族哨站，除了能阻止更多蛮族单位的产生，还能让文明获得一个 [ICON_Gold] 金币奖励。

Naval Barbarian outposts on the coastline can create naval units (equal to those that can be created by the civilization with the most advanced tech). These units will menace your coastline, destroy naval improvements and attack hapless land units which stray too near the coastline. It's important to maintain a navy to keep them off your back, but the best way to stop these attacks is to destroy the coastal outposts nearby.
海岸线上的海军蛮族哨站所可创建海军单位（与科技最发达的文明一致）。这些单位会威胁您的海岸线、毁坏海军改良设施、袭击在海岸线附近迷路的倒霉陆地单位。维持一支海军以避免自己背部受敌至关重要，但阻止攻击的最好方式是摧毁附近的沿海哨站所。
Cavalry outposts, appearing inland and near a Horse resource, will spawn mounted units.
出现在内陆和马匹资源附近的骑兵哨站所会产生骑乘单位。
Melee outposts include every other instance of Barbarians spawned.
近战哨站所则生成其他类型的蛮族。

Every outpost will first generate a Scout, searching for targets. If you’re spotted by a Barbarian Scout, it will return to its outpost and begin building units for an invasion or raid. Watch out, because you’re going to be the next target. If you don’t move fast, you’ll soon see a party of Barbarians at your borders, ready to destroy your improvements or conquer your city. This is why it's important to periodically sweep the countryside around your civilization, destroying outposts before they become a threat.
每个哨站所最先会产生侦察兵来寻找目标。如果您被一位蛮族侦察兵发现，它会返回哨站所并开始建造单位进行入侵或袭击。小心，因为您将成为下一个目标。如果不迅速应对，您的国土边境很快便会出现一群正准备摧毁您的改良设施或攻占您城市的蛮族。因此，定期清理文明周边的村落非常重要，在哨站所形成威胁之前将其摧毁。
Barbarians
蛮族

Lenses are a tool you can use to change your view of the world. Each lens will overlay important information that will help you make strategic decisions in the game. Some lenses are activated automatically, like when you choose to place a district from a city's Production Menu. Others can be activated manually from the Lenses button on the mini-map. These are the lenses you can use in game and what they do:
您可以使用滤镜来改变您的世界观。每个滤镜都会覆盖重要信息，这些信息将帮助您在游戏中做出战略决策。一些滤镜会自动激活，比如，当您决定从城市生产项目界面放置一个区域时。其他滤镜则需要手动点击迷你地图上的滤镜按钮进行激活。这些是您能在游戏中使用的滤镜以及它们的作用：

Appeal. Shows the appeal level of each tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Continent. Shows the geographic extent of each continent.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]District Placement. Shows valid placement locations for wonders and districts, as well as any adjacency bonuses available for districts. This will only appear when attempting to build a district or wonder.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Government. Shows the distribution of governments across the map.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Political. Shows the owner of each tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Religion. Shows the majority religion and religious follower distribution across the map. This appears whenever a Religious unit is selected.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settler. Shows recommended city sites and water availability at each tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tourism. Shows the number of [ICON_Tourism] Tourists a tile is attracting.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Empire. Shows your city borders and district locations with adjacency bonuses.

魅力：显示每个单元格的魅力级别。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]大陆：显示每个大陆的地理范围。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]区域放置：显示奇观和区域的有效放置位置，以及可用于区域的相邻加成。试图建立区域或奇观时，它才会出现。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]政体：显示地图上所有政体的分布。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]政治：显示每个单元格的所有者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宗教：显示地图上的主流宗教和宗教信徒分布。选择一个宗教单位时，它会显现出来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]开拓者：显示每个单元格上的推荐城址和可用水。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]旅游业绩：显示单元格吸引的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游者数量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]帝国：显示城市边境与提供相邻加成的区域位置。
Loyalty. Shows the Loyalty of cities, and the sources of Loyalty that are influencing it.
忠诚度：显示城市的忠诚度，以及影响忠诚度的来源。
Lenses
滤镜
The World Congress is a new system representing high-level diplomacy between civilizations, and begins meeting once the game has entered the Medieval Era.
世界议会是一类新机制，代表各文明之间的高级外事交流。游戏进入中世纪后便可召开世界议会。

The World Congress operates in two modes. In a regular World Congress session, which happens automatically every 30 turns (on Standard Speed), all the Civilizations of the world gather to vote on Resolutions and Scored Competitions. In a Special Session, which must be requested by a player that has been affected by a trigger for an Emergency, the players who are invited to join that Emergency will vote on whether or not they wish to do so. You will use [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to interact with the World Congress.
世界议会分为两类模式。常规世界议会议程每30回合（标准速度下）自动召开一次，所有文明需在此阶段对决议与积分竞赛进行投票。特殊议程必须由触发紧急状况的文明请求后方能召开，其他受邀文明需投票决定是否愿意参与行动。文明可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持与世界议会进行互动。
World Congress
世界议会

Scored Competitions are chances for civilizations to win esteem through events and projects that benefit the world. These can be events like the World's Fair, or Climate Accords. If enacted, players who vote in favor of the Scored Competition will compete to contribute to the cause. The players that contribute the most will receive lucrative rewards.
对于文明而言，积分竞赛是赢得尊重的大好机会，同时还能造福世界。此类事件包括世界博览会或气候协议等。积分竞赛颁布以后，投票支持竞赛的所有文明需要通过做出贡献来互相竞争。而做出最多贡献的文明将获得丰厚奖励。
Scored Competitions
积分竞赛

[ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor is a currency used in the World Congress and is key to winning the Diplomatic Victory and ensuring that Resolutions go your way. It represents the political clout or debt: players can use their past diplomatic deeds to influence World Congress, extract promises from other players, request Emergencies, or even receive financial benefit by trading their [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to willing players.  Players gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor through positive interactions with other powers and actions that benefit the whole world.
[ICON_Favor] 外交支持是在世界议会中使用的货币，也是确保所选决议胜出和赢得外交胜利的关键。其代表着政治影响力和债务：文明可通过过往的外交行为影响世界议会、收获其他文明的承诺、请求紧急状况，甚至利用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持与其他国家进行交易，从而获得经济收益。文明能从与其他国家的正面互动与造福全世界的行动中获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。

Some actions provide a steady trickle of [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on the tier of your government[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You can gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn for each City-State of which you are Suzerain [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Active Alliances with other civilizations generate [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn, increasing as your Alliance Level increases

某些行动可向文明提供少量而稳定的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]可基于文明政体的等级每回合获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]成为城邦的宗主国每回合同样能获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]与其他文明建立有效的同盟关系每回合也可获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持，其额度会随着同盟等级的提升而增加

But some actions will reduce your incoming [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You lose [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on your CO2 production relative to other nations[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You lose [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on the amount of [ICON_Grievance] Grievances the world as a whole has against you[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You lose [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor each turn based on the number of original capitals that you occupy

但一些行为会减少您获得的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]基于相对于其他国家的二氧化碳排放量损失 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]基于世界整体对您产生的 [ICON_Grievance] 不满损失 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]基于您占领的原始首都数量损失 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持

Other actions generate large one-time windfalls of [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Liberating a City-State from another civilization [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Liberating a city from one civilization and returning it to the original civilization[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Returning a player to the game by Liberating their city after they have been completely conquered[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Reaching appropriate score tiers in Emergencies and Scored Competitions
而另一些行为则会一次性提供大量 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]从其他文明手中解放城邦[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]从一个文明手中解放城市并将其归还原主[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]解放一座已灭亡文明的城市，使该文明重返游戏[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]在紧急状况和积分竞赛中达到一定的分数等级

If a player spends [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor on a measure which did not pass the World Congress, or on a Promise Request that is rejected by the target, then the player gets their full amount refunded for the next session. If they spent it on a measure which ulitmately passes, but on a different target then half the amount of [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor spent is refunded.
如果文明花费了 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持但议题最终未通过世界议会，或承诺请求被对方所拒绝，则下次议程将全额退还外交支持。如果该议题最终通过世界议会，但目标文明不同，则退还一半数额的 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。
Diplomatic Favor
外交支持

Two new Emergencies, the Aid Request and the Military Aid Request, are available.  Aid Requests may be called when a player receives significant damage from a natural disaster.  Military Aid Requests may be called when a player receives a declaration of war from another player against whom they already have many Grievances.  In both cases, members who join the Emergencies will be requested to send [ICON_Gold] Gold to the target player in exchange for Score that gets them closer to winning [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor and Diplomatic Victory Point rewards.
游戏现加入两种全新紧急状况：请求援助和请求军事援助。玩家遭到自然灾害严重破坏时可请求援助。如玩家已积累对某文明的大量不满，那么此文明对玩家宣战时，玩家便可请求军事援助。在这两种情况下，加入紧急状况的成员国需要将 [ICON_Gold] 金币送给目标文明，以换取积分来获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持和外交胜利点数奖励。

All Emergencies now fall under the purview of the World Congress and must be requested and passed through a Special Session before they will begin. The players who are affected by the trigger for the Emergency may request it: for an Aid Request, the player who is damaged by the natural disaster may request a Special Session.  For a Religious Emergency, the player who lost the city and those players who can join the Emergency may request a Special Session.  Once a Special Session is initiated, all relevant players will vote for or against each request.  When a request passes, a Competition between players to combat the Emergency begins.
所有紧急状况现在均归世界议会管理，必须发出请求并通过特殊议程才能宣布进入紧急状况。受到紧急状况影响的玩家可以发出请求：在请求援助紧急状况中，受到自然灾害破坏的玩家可以请求召开特殊议程。而在宗教紧急状况中，失去城市的玩家和能够加入紧急状况的玩家均可以请求召开特殊议程。特殊议程发起后，所有相关玩家将对每个请求投票支持或反对。请求通过后，玩家之间便会就此紧急状况展开积分竞赛。
Emergencies
紧急状况

Resolutions are joint agreements made in the World Congress which change the rules of the game. You will be able to vote on an automatically-generated selection of Resolutions relevant to the current Era using [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor. When voting for a Resolution, you will choose a potential target, and choose between 2 options for how the target is affected. The option that receives the most votes is binding for all players until the next session of the World Congress.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In the event of a tie, the Civilization that spent the greatest percentage of their [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor when voting on the Resolution will be the winner.

决议是在世界议会中达成的联合协议，可改变游戏的规则。议程中将自动生成数个决议，文明可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持来投票选择与当前时代有关的决议。对决议投票时，文明首先需要选择一个潜在的目标国，然后再在影响目标国的两个不同选项中做出选择。得票数最高的选项将会对所有文明产生约束，直至下次世界议会召开。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如得票数相同，则花费 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持最多的文明选择的选项将生效。
Resolutions
决议
